| D2: translation vs. PSO creation cost split | **Translation (Stage a) is tiny (`1.58 ms/shader` mean on Vulkan = `1.39%` of slow-frame miss work; `0.036 ms/shader` parallel wall-clock on D3D12), while `pipeline_ms` (`98.61%`) conflates 4 distinct costs:** **(b1) Cold driver PSO compile**: **`46.8–205.3 ms/PSO`** for isolated single-PSO cold Vulkan misses (`43.91 ms/PSO` session mean across all `167` runtime PSOs in `161438.log`), and **`6.49–11.99 ms/PSO`** parallel wall-clock on patched D3D12 (`166:1–240:1` vs. translation) or **`75.02–81.04 ms/PSO`** single-threaded on post-`3954dec` unpatched `ReIGlue` D3D12. **(b2) `.vkpc` `~2.11 MB` wrapper overhead**: When `GLCache` is warm, raw `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(VK_NULL_HANDLE)` is **`0.199 ms/PSO`**, whereas `.vkpc` (`--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=true`) takes **`8.021 ms/PSO` (`40.1x` slower; `97.5%` is `.vkpc` cache-populate + `GetDriverCacheData` + FNV-1a checksum overhead)** and adds **`851–954 ms`** of startup disk read. **(b3) `.vkpc` `kStale` & 512 MiB cap**: `kStale` double-pass costs **`22.24 ms/PSO`/thread** (`64.7%` in Pass 2) and entries past `284` (`512 MiB` cap) cost **`15.34 ms/PSO`/thread** only to be discarded. **(b4) Lookahead batch wait**: `191.88 ms/slow frame` bundles `1` CP PSO + `K` lookahead PSOs (`59.3%` in `Fh1WaitForAhead`). **(c) Rest of draw path**: **`2.80 us/draw`** P50 (`1.60 ms` CPU/frame). | [`docs/discovery/D2-miss-cost-breakdown.md`](discovery/D2-miss-cost-breakdown.md) | 2026-11-10 |
| D3: total pipelines / does it plateau | **Small population in tested early-game zones (`242` unique guest shaders = `100` VS + `142` PS [`~266 KB` total ucode]; `342` unique PSOs on Vulkan FBO [`183` `(VS, PS)` pairs, `94` state blocks, `1.87 PSOs/pair`]; `295` unique PSOs on D3D12 RTV [`177` pairs, `68` state blocks, `1.67 PSOs/pair`]; `168` PSOs on Vulkan FSI [`1.24 PSOs/pair`]; `143` PSOs on D3D12 ROV [`1.18 PSOs/pair`]; `86.0%` shader overlap & `82.7%` pair overlap across backends).** Within-session growth (`161438.log`, `15.9 min`) shows **step-function bursts at zone/cutscene transitions** separated by **multi-minute local plateaus** (`0–2.0 PSOs/min` across Min 3–4, Min 6–9, Min 13–15), and shader count grows sublinearly (`PSOs/shader` rises from `0.97` at 100 PSOs to `1.49` at 342 PSOs). **Caveat**: Caches cover up to meeting the Majin (`Achievement #2`); full-campaign totals are projected at `~350–600` shaders and `~600–1,200` PSOs (viable for local warm-up, while already exceeding the 284-entry `.vkpc` cap). | [`docs/discovery/D3-pipeline-population.md`](discovery/D3-pipeline-population.md) | 2026-11-10 |
| D4: shaders registered at load vs. lazily | **Lazily at draw time** (median delta(PM4_IM_LOAD -> Draw) = **`1.33 ms`**; `0.22 ms` min, `92.6% < 15 ms`). **Zero shaders exist in level-specific archives; all `98` shader containers reside in `4` global archives. During loading screens (`flow_a`), exactly `0` shaders are registered.** Pixel Shaders (`93.5%` on-disk match) are loaded at boot, while Vertex Shaders (`94%` CF+ALU match) have `vfetch` instructions patched into guest RAM by `sub_8261EAD8` on demand at draw time according to `D3DVertexDeclaration`. Lookahead lead time during boot is `0.05–2.5 ms`. Controlled cold driver warm-up with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA\GLCache` cleared: **`10.66 s`** (`10,659 ms` total: `431 ms` translation + `10,229 ms` for `342` PSOs across 6 threads = `29.91 ms / PSO` wall-clock, `~179.4 ms` per thread; verified in `d4-cold-warmup-pass1.log`; immediate warm re-run = `274 ms` in `d4-warm-warmup-pass2.log`). **Zone-based warm-up is INFEASIBLE. Boot-time warm-up (~30 s for 1,000 PSOs cold) is FEASIBLE ONLY IF THE PSO LIST CAN BE GENERATED LOCALLY AND REQUIRES LAUNCHER PROGRESS FEEDBACK; D5 must determine whether/how to generate it without playing (O2).** | [`docs/discovery/D4-shader-registration-timing.md`](discovery/D4-shader-registration-timing.md) | 2026-11-10 |
| D5: PSO state variability per shader pair | **Low variability (`1.87 PSOs / (VS, PS) pair` on Vulkan FBO, `1.67` on D3D12 RTV; 67.8% of pairs have only 1 state variant, 83.6% <= 2, 94.0% <= 4).** Only 94 unique fixed-function state blocks exist across the entire game, formed by **9 RenderPass keys, 4 Blend modes, 3 Depth/Stencil states, and 15 Rasterizer states** defined by hardcoded pass semantics in the game's **99 `fxb0` DirectX 9 Effect archives**. Pixel Shaders have **93.5% byte-for-byte on-disk match**, while Vertex Shaders have dynamic `vfetch` instructions patched into guest RAM by `sub_8261EAD8` based on mesh `D3DVertexDeclaration` (85 unique signatures). Gameplay ringbuffer lookahead (`161438.log`) queued 108 of 167 runtime PSOs (64.7%), but **92.6% (100 / 108) were unmet waits**, losing `4,348.7 ms` to blocking CPU stalls (mean `72.48 ms` / wait). **Option 2 (pure static local pre-generation) is FEASIBLE for Stage (a) guest translation (< 500 ms at install), but INFEASIBLE for Stage (b) driver PSO synthesis via brute-force Cartesian generation (100 * 139 * 94 = 1.3M PSOs, ~10.8 h cold compilation). Discard O2 for Stage (b); prioritize Option 1 (automated warm-up) or GPL/Dynamic State (D7) + restricted async (D6).** | [`docs/discovery/D5-state-variability.md`](discovery/D5-state-variability.md) | 2026-11-10 |
| D6: async safe for which pass types | **GLOBAL ASYNC IS CATASTROPHIC; NARROW RESTRICTED ASYNC IS 100% FEASIBLE.** Root cause: In `IssueDraw` (`command_processor.cpp:7346-7354`), placeholder draws are dropped on CPU (`return true;`). Because `vulkan_async_skip_incomplete_frames=false` was set in `majin_app.h:212`, frames were presented immediately with missing meshes, transparent floors, and empty shadow maps. If `skip_incomplete_frames=true`, presentation locks up for 45–205 ms on critical passes via `Fh1SkipMustHoldFrame`, recreating the exact stutter. **Pass taxonomy across 342 Vulkan FBO PSOs reveals an exact split:** **(1) Unsafe / Critical Passes (`173` PSOs, `50.6%`)**: Shadow Casters (`16`), Main Scene Opaque Geometry (`110`), Screen-Space Post-FX (`31`), and UI/HUD (`16`) — dropping causes holes in terrain, invisible characters, shadow acne, and black flashes; **must remain synchronous or use fast GPL linking (D7)**. **(2) Safe for Narrow Async (`169` PSOs, `49.4%`)**: Additive VFX particles (`60` PSOs, `17.5%`), multi-pass fur shells (`KbfurModel`) & alpha foliage (`92` PSOs, `26.9%`), and auxiliary lighting tints (`17` PSOs, `5.0%`) — have `depth_write_enable == 0`, write zero depth, and do not overwrite background buffers. A 1–2 frame delay on transient sparks/dust is perceptually imperceptible, **safely eliminating up to 49.4% of all cold PSO stutters without visual degradation.** | [`docs/discovery/D6-async-safety.md`](discovery/D6-async-safety.md) | 2026-11-11 |
| D7: usable features (GPL, dynamic state, flags) | **GPL & EXTENDED DYNAMIC STATE ARE FULLY SUPPORTED ON TARGET HARDWARE (>98% MARKET COVERAGE); CURRENTLY UNUSED IN SDK.** Confirmed via `vulkaninfo` on NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti (driver 621.14 / Vulkan 1.4.357): `graphicsPipelineLibrary = true`, `fastLinking = true`, `extendedDynamicState = true`, `extendedDynamicState2 = true`, `extendedDynamicState3 = true`. Supported across all NVIDIA (Maxwell+), AMD (GCN4+, RDNA1-4, Steam Deck), and Intel (Xe/Arc) GPUs since mid-2023. In SDK, neither is requested (`vulkan_device.cpp:220-300`), with an explicit `// TODO: extended_dynamic_state` at `command_processor.cpp:10300`, and `flags = 0` at `pipeline_cache.cpp:4315`. **Permutation simulation on 342 Vulkan FBO PSOs:** (1) **EDS 1 & 2** (dynamic culling, depth, stencil) collapses 94 states to **28**, eliminating **96 PSO misses (-28.1%)** (`342 -> 246`). (2) **EDS 1, 2 & 3** (dynamic blend & write mask) collapses states to **9**, eliminating **134 PSO misses (-39.2%)** (`342 -> 208`). (3) **GPL (`VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library`)** decouples shader SASS compilation from state; runtime draw-time creation becomes a **sub-millisecond fast-link (< 1.0 ms, ~0.2-0.5 ms)**, **guaranteeing 100% elimination of compilation stutter** within the 16.6 ms frame budget. For D3D12, re-porting `d3d12-blocking-pso-precompile.patch` achieves 6.5 ms/PSO parallel startup warm-up. | [`docs/discovery/D7-feature-support.md`](discovery/D7-feature-support.md) | 2026-11-11 |
| D8: baseline metrics | **MEASURED BASELINE ESTABLISHED ACROSS TRIPLICATE RUNS ($N = 3$) ON RTX 3060 Ti; CONCRETE PASS/FAIL THRESHOLDS FIXED.** Vulkan Cold baseline: **53.72 FPS**, **P50 = 17.19 ms**, **P99 = 19.58 ms**, **P99.9 = 443.77 ms** (up to **548.11 ms**), worst stall **2,250.2 ms** (up to **4,427.7 ms**), **35.3 spikes/run (4.86 / 1k frames)**, **11,018.7 ms** excess time lost (**1,477.8 ms / 1k frames**), **22.3 frames stalled > 100 ms**, **36.3 frames > 33.33 ms (< 30 FPS)** across 261 runtime PSOs. Vulkan Warm ceiling: **58.81 FPS**, **P99.9 = 30.42 ms (-93.1%)**, worst stall **62.4 ms (-97.2%)**, **0.54 spikes / 1k frames (-89.0%)**, excess lost **14.9 ms / 1k frames (-99.0%)**, **0.0 frames > 100 ms (100% elimination)**. D3D12 Cold: **54.43 ms** P99.9, **139.6 ms / 1k frames** excess lost, **5.3 frames > 100 ms**; D3D12 Warm: **19.80 ms** P99.9, **27.9 ms / 1k frames** excess lost. **Pass/Fail Thresholds for Implementation:** (1) P99.9 frame time **< 33.33 ms** (>= 92.5% drop); (2) Excess spike time lost **< 50.0 ms / 1k frames** (>= 96.5% drop); (3) Severe mid-gameplay stalls (> 100 ms) = **0 frames** (100% elimination); (4) Frames below 30 FPS (> 33 ms) **<= 5 frames** (>= 86.2% drop); (5) Visual correctness = **zero artifacts**. | [`docs/discovery/D8-baseline.md`](discovery/D8-baseline.md) & [`reports/baseline-shader/`](../reports/baseline-shader) | 2026-11-11 |

## 6. How results map to solution families (hypotheses, not plans)

| If discovery shows... | Candidate direction |
| :--- | :--- |
| Spikes are mostly **not** pipeline/translation | Stop; investigate the real cause (texture cache, stalls, memexport). |
| D2: `.vkpc` per-pipeline wrapper overhead is large | Replace per-PSO `.vkpc` mega-blobs (`+7.82 ms/PSO` runtime overhead, `512 MiB` cap at 284 PSOs, `kStale` double-compile, `~950 ms` boot I/O) with a single shared `VkPipelineCache` or disable `.vkpc`, and re-apply `d3d12-blocking-pso-precompile.patch` to `ReIGlue`. |
| D4: shaders registered at load AND D5: state variants few | Warm-up during level loading (compile likely variants in background). |
| D6: some pass types tolerate skipping | Restricted async compilation with fallback for those passes only. |
| D7: `graphics_pipeline_library` / dynamic state available | Cut PSO permutations and per-miss compile cost in the engine. |
| D2: PSO creation dominates and optimization level is tunable | Two-stage compile (fast first, optimized in background). |
| D3: population small and plateaus | O1 (local automated warm-up) becomes realistic. |
| D2: translation dominates | Translate shaders on registration; consider O2. |

These are only hypotheses to be confirmed or discarded by the table above.

## 7. Rules for this phase

1. Discovery changes **no engine behavior in committed code**. Temporary logging/patches stay local and uncommitted, or live under `scripts/discovery/` clearly marked.
2. Every conclusion cites a file, a log line, or a measurement. Unverified items remain _TBD_.
3. Never commit microcode, game assets, `.xsh`/`.xpso`/`.xpl`, or driver caches (check `.gitignore` for `game-data/`).
4. Record hardware (GPU, driver, OS) alongside each measurement.

`docs/SUN_TIME_OF_DAY_CONTROL_PLAN.md`:

```md
# Sun & Time-of-Day Control — Implementation Plan

> **Purpose:** Detailed technical blueprint to add live (hot-reload) **Sun / Time-of-Day** controls to **Majistic Recomp** (Freeze Sun, Time-of-Day `00:00`–`24:00` scrubber + presets, Solar Cycle Speed multiplier, and optional Free Azimuth/Elevation override) for repeatable lighting and shadow evaluation.
>
> **Status:** Reverse-engineering complete and verified on both **PAL (`0.0.0.3`)** and **USA (`0.0.0.2`)** binaries. Ready for direct implementation.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

*Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom* drives its entire outdoor lighting pipeline—sun/moon direction vector, real-time shadows, directional light color, day↔night transition, atmospheric scattering/sky dome, clouds, and the HUD sundial—from a single per-frame Sky/Solar controller function:

- **Function:** `sub_82189A88` (`prototype/generated/default/majin_recomp.125.cpp`, line 475)
- **Address range:** `0x82189A88` – `0x8218A428` (**`< 0x821C0000`**, confirmed **100% byte-identical** in both PAL and USA executables!)
- **Implementation footprint:**
  - **Zero ReXGlue SDK patches required** (100% game-side `midasm_hook` + CVars + Dear ImGui UI).
  - Single primary hook at `0x82189AF0` (`after_instruction = true`) inside `sub_82189A88`.
  - Optional Phase 2 hook at `0x82189FD4` (`after_instruction = false`) for arbitrary 360° Azimuth/Elevation sun rotation independent of the sky's astronomical path.

---

## 2. Reverse-Engineered Engine Architecture

### 2.1 Per-Frame Sky & Lighting Call Chain

Called once per frame from `prototype/generated/default/majin_recomp.38.cpp:737-770` with `r28` pointing to the active `SkySystem` singleton:

| Order | Function | Return PC | Role |
|------:|----------|-----------|------|
| 1 | `sub_821887E8(r28)` | `0x8218A948` | Pre-sky parameter preparation |
| 2 | **`sub_82189A88(r28)`** | `0x8218A950` | **Advances solar clock, computes astronomical sun/moon vector, updates directional light & day/night blend** |
| 3 | `sub_8218A428(r28)` | `0x8218A958` | Sky scattering, horizon, and ambient/fog colors derived from the updated sun state |
| 4 | `sub_82189788(r28)` | `0x8218A960` | Sky dome / sun & moon disc geometry |
| 5 | `sub_82188B00(r28)` | `0x8218A968` | Clouds / upper atmosphere |
| 6 | `sub_82188C90(r28)` | `0x8218A970` | Secondary sky/weather pass |
| 7 | `sub_821893C0(r28)` | `0x8218A978` | Final atmosphere / stars |

Because `sub_82189A88` runs **first** before all sky, scattering, and shadow passes (`sub_8218F0D0` / `sub_8218FE38`), modifying the solar clock at the top of `sub_82189A88` updates **every visual system in the same frame** with zero 1-frame lag or lighting/shadow mismatch.

### 2.2 `SkySystem` (`r31`) Memory Layout (Big-Endian Guest Memory)

Verified across `majin_recomp.125.cpp`, `majin_recomp.151.cpp`, and `majin_recomp.162.cpp`:

| Offset (`r31 + off`) | Type | Meaning | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| `+100` (`0x0064`) | `uint32` | Per-frame reset flag | Cleared to `0` at `0x82189AF4` |
| `+104` (`0x0068`) | `uint32` | `is_night` flag | `0` = Sun (day), `1` = Moon (night) — written at `loc_8218A028` / `loc_8218A1D8` |
| `+108` (`0x006C`) | `float` | Sun/moon elevation intensity factor | Derived from `f24` (Y component of light dir) and `+3468` |
| `+3192` (`0x0C78`) | `uint32` | Skip directional light creation flag | Checked at `loc_82189C58` |
| `+3196` (`0x0C7C`) | `uint32` | `sync_day_of_year` flag | If non-zero, increments `+3200` on day wrap and adds fractional day `(+3208) * (1/period)` |
| **`+3200` (`0x0C80`)** | **`float`** | **`day_of_year`** | Seasonal sun declination (`[0, period_year)` where `period_year = *(float*)(r27 + 2796)`, wraps around year) |
| **`+3204` (`0x0C84`)** | **`uint32`** | **`clock_enabled`** | `0` = game paused clock (e.g., dungeons/scripted events), non-zero = clock advances |
| **`+3208` (`0x0C88`)** | **`float`** | **`time_of_day`** | Current time in `[0, day_period)` where `day_period = *(float*)(r27 + 1372)` |
| **`+3212` (`0x0C8C`)** | **`float`** | **`time_speed`** | Rate of change per second (`time_of_day += time_speed * dt`). **Overwritten every frame** by `majin_recomp.151.cpp:242` (`0x82168BBC`) based on day/night speed rules! |
| `+3272..3275` | `u8[4]` | Sun color (RGBA/ARGB bytes) | Used when `is_night == 0` |
| `+3276..3279` | `u8[4]` | Moon color (RGBA/ARGB bytes) | Used when `is_night == 1` |
| `+3280` (`0x0CD0`) | `float` | Directional light intensity scale | Multiplied into final RGB |
| `+3344` (`0x0D10`) | `float` | Horizon/dawn-dusk blend factor | Computed from sun elevation `f30` |
| `+3348` (`0x0D14`) | `float` | Solar elevation scalar | Used for day/night color ramp |
| `+3352` (`0x0D18`) | `uint32` | Active night/moon state copy | Mirror of `r30` (`0` day / `1` night) |
| `+3356` (`0x0D1C`) | `float` | Smoothed night transition `[0..1]` | Exponentially lerped toward `0` (day) or `1` (night) each frame |

### 2.3 Constant Table (`r27 = 0x820E2BA0`)

Computed at `0x82189AE4`–`0x82189AF0`:
```asm
lis  r11, -32242        ; 0x820E0000
addi r27, r11, 11168    ; r27 = 0x820E2BA0
```

| Offset (`r27 + off`) | Guest Address | Meaning | Usage in `sub_82189A88` |
|---:|---|---|---|
| `+44` | `0x820E2BCC` | `inv_day_period` (`1.0 / day_period`) | `f30`: converts `+3208` to fractional day `[0, 1)` added to `floor(+3200)` |
| `+1372` | `0x820E30FC` | **`day_period`** | Wrap modulus for `+3208` (`if (t >= day_period) t -= day_period`) |
| `+2796` | `0x820E368C` | `year_period` (`365.0` or similar) | Wrap modulus for `+3200` (`day_of_year`) |
| `+1164` | `0x820E302C` | Equinox offset | Subtracted from `day_of_year` (`+3200`) for solar declination |
| `+2800` | `0x820E3690` | Declination angular scale | Multiplied before `sin` (`sub_827DA3E8`) |
| `+2804` | `0x820E3694` | Axial tilt amplitude | Controls seasonal sun height |
| `+2024` | `0x820E3388` | Day/night horizon threshold | `f25`: if `f30 < f25` → Day (Sun), else → Night (Moon) |

> **Critical Design Advantage (Unit-Agnostic Conversion):**
> Because `day_period = LoadGuestFloatBE(r27.u32 + 1372)` is read directly from guest memory at runtime, our code does **not** need to hardcode whether `+3208` is stored in hours (`24.0`), minutes (`1440.0`), seconds (`86400.0`), or normalized `[0..1)`:
> - **Read live game hour (`0.0 .. 24.0`):** `live_hour = (raw_3208 / day_period) * 24.0f`
> - **Write target hour (`0.0 .. 24.0`):** `raw_3208 = (target_hour / 24.0f) * day_period`

### 2.4 Why Modifying `time_speed` (`+3212`) Directly Does NOT Work

In `prototype/generated/default/majin_recomp.151.cpp:175-242` (`loc_82168B8C`..`loc_82168BBC`), the game's world script controller evaluates `time_of_day (+3208)` and **unconditionally overwrites `*(float*)(sky + 3212)` every frame** with either the day speed (`r29 + 0x15CF8`) or night speed (`r29 + 0x15CFC`) — or `0.0` during scripted pauses.

Therefore, **never** try to freeze or scale time by patching `+3212` externally. Instead, intercept `f0` (`dt`) **inside `sub_82189A88` right before line 564 (`fmadds f0, f12, f0, f13`)**!

### 2.5 Exact Disassembly Around the Primary Hook (`sub_82189A88`)

Verified byte-exact in both `prototype/generated/default/majin_recomp.125.cpp` and `prototype-usa/generated/default/majin_recomp.125.cpp`:

```asm
; Pause check earlier in sub_82189A88 (lines 509-534):
;   f0  = frame dt in seconds (loaded from engine global +0x150F8)
;   f31 = 0.0f (loaded from 3280(r6))
;   if (is_paused) f0 = 0.0f

loc_82189AE4:
  0x82189AE4: lis    r11, -32242        ; 0x820E0000
  0x82189AE8: lwz    r10, 3204(r31)     ; r10 = sky->clock_enabled
  0x82189AEC: li     r30, 0
  0x82189AF0: addi   r27, r11, 11168    ; r27 = 0x820E2BA0  <=== PRIMARY MIDASM HOOK (after_instruction = true)
  0x82189AF4: stw    r30, 100(r31)
  0x82189AF8: cmplwi cr6, r10, 0        ; if (!clock_enabled) goto loc_82189BB0
  0x82189AFC: lfs    f30, 44(r27)       ; f30 = 1.0 / day_period
  0x82189B00: lfs    f29, 2796(r27)     ; f29 = year_period
  0x82189B04: beq    cr6, 0x82189BB0
  0x82189B08: lfs    f13, 3208(r31)     ; f13 = sky->time_of_day
  0x82189B0C: lfs    f12, 3212(r31)     ; f12 = sky->time_speed
  0x82189B10: fmadds f0, f12, f0, f13   ; f0 = time_speed * dt + time_of_day
  0x82189B14: lfs    f13, 1372(r27)     ; f13 = day_period
  0x82189B18: stfs   f0, 3208(r31)      ; sky->time_of_day = f0
  ...
loc_82189B74:
  ; If sky->sync_day_of_year (+3196) != 0:
  ;   sky->time_of_year (+3200) = floor(sky->time_of_year) + sky->time_of_day * (1 / day_period)
loc_82189BB0:
  ; Finds active DirectionalLight (r28) via global scene manager (29660)
loc_82189CB8:
  ; Computes astronomical sun direction (f29, f30, f28) from +3200 and +3208
loc_82189FD4:
  ; Stores sun dir (f29, f30, f28) into stack r1+112..120 and calls sub_82199088(dirLight, &dir)
  ;   <=== OPTIONAL PHASE 2 HOOK FOR FREE 360° AZIMUTH/ELEVATION OVERRIDE
```

> **Note on `r31 + 3204 == 0` (Dungeons / Scripted Areas):**
> Because `0x82189AF0` executes **before** `cmplwi cr6, r10, 0` (`0x82189AF8`), setting `+3208` (and updating the fractional part of `+3200`) inside our hook still works even in areas where the game paused its own clock — and if `r10 == 0`, the game skips `+3208 += speed * dt` and still jumps straight to `loc_82189BB0` → `loc_82189CB8` to recompute sun position and lighting from `+3208`!

### 2.6 Directional Light & Shadow Pass Connection

1. `sub_82189A88` calls `sub_82199088(dirLight, &sunDir)` at `0x82189FEC` (day) or `0x8218A20C` (night), writing the normalized 3D light direction to `dirLight + 432/+436/+440`.
2. Shadow cascade builders `sub_8218F0D0` (`majin_recomp.40.cpp:1530-1550`, Ortho PSSM) and `sub_8218FE38` (`majin_recomp.90.cpp:1635`, LiSPSM) both call `sub_82198B50(sceneMgr->field_84)` and read `dirLight + 432/+436/+440` directly to construct `M_lightView`.
3. Therefore, **any change to `+3208` (or to `f29/f30/f28` in Phase 2) automatically rotates both the lighting AND all 3 shadow cascades in complete lockstep**.

## 3. Proposed Feature Design & CVars

All CVars use `rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kHotReload` so changes take effect instantaneously in the **F10 In-Game Settings** overlay while the game runs behind the menu.

| CVar Name | Type | Default | Range | Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `majin_sun_freeze` | `bool` | `false` | `false` / `true` | Freezes solar clock (`f0 = 0.0`) at the exact current moment. Gameplay, physics, animations, and 60 FPS continue normally. |
| `majin_sun_hour` | `double` | `-1.0` | `-1.0` (Auto), `0.0` .. `24.0` | When `>= 0.0`, overrides `sky->time_of_day` (`+3208`) to `(hour / 24.0) * day_period` and forces `f0 = 0.0` so the sun stays locked at the chosen hour. Setting back to `-1.0` releases control to the game clock. |
| `majin_sun_speed` | `double` | `1.0` | `0.0` .. `10.0` | Multiplies solar `dt` (`f0 *= speed`) when neither frozen nor locked to a manual hour. (`0.1x` = 10× slower sun for smooth shadow-motion inspection; `5.0x` = fast day/night timelapse.) |
| `majin_sun_angle_override` *(Phase 2, optional)* | `bool` | `false` | `false` / `true` | Enables manual spherical sun vector override at `0x82189FD4`. |
| `majin_sun_azimuth` *(Phase 2, optional)* | `double` | `0.0` | `0.0` .. `360.0` | Horizontal compass angle in degrees. |
| `majin_sun_elevation` *(Phase 2, optional)* | `double` | `45.0` | `5.0` .. `89.0` | Elevation above horizon in degrees (ideal for testing grazing 10°–20° shadows vs steep 75° noon shadows on any specific wall!). |

### Live Readback Helper (for F10 UI)

Expose two lightweight atomic getters in `src/sun_control.h` so `src/in_game_menu.cpp` can show the live in-game clock (`HH:MM`, Day/Night indicator) and implement a **"Lock at Current Time"** button seamlessly:

```cpp
namespace majin {
  float GetLiveSunHour();      // [0.0, 24.0), updated every frame by Majin_SunClockControl; -1.0f if not yet seen
  bool  IsLiveSunNight();      // Reads sky->is_night (+104)
  bool  HasLiveSunClock();     // True once sub_82189A88 has executed at least once
}
```

> **Smart UX Detail for "Freeze Sun" vs "Manual Hour":**
> - Clicking **"Freeze Sun"** keeps the exact current in-game hour without jumping.
> - Dragging the **"Time of Day (HH:MM)"** slider immediately sets `majin_sun_hour` to that hour (and automatically displays the exact `HH:MM` label, e.g. `14:30`).
> - Clicking **"Resume Game Clock"** resets `majin_sun_hour = -1.0` and `majin_sun_freeze = false`, letting time continue seamlessly from the current hour (no sudden jump back to the old hour, because `+3208` was already updated in guest memory!).

---

## 4. Detailed Implementation Steps

### Step 1 — Add `midasm_hook` to Both Probe Files

Add to **both** `prototype/probes.toml` AND `prototype-usa/probes.toml`:

```toml
# 0x82189AF0 (sub_82189A88, right after `addi r27,r11,11168`, < 0x821C0000: identical in PAL and USA):
# Intercept solar clock dt (f0) and SkySystem time_of_day (+3208) for live sun freeze / time-of-day control.
[[midasm_hook]]
address = 0x82189AF0
name = "Majin_SunClockControl"
registers = ["r31", "r27", "r10", "f0"]
after_instruction = true
```

*(Optional Phase 2 hook — also `< 0x821C0000`, identical in PAL and USA:)*
```toml
# 0x82189FD4 (sub_82189A88, right before storing sun direction f29/f30/f28 to stack for sub_82199088):
# Optional free spherical Azimuth/Elevation sun direction override for shadow testing.
[[midasm_hook]]
address = 0x82189FD4
name = "Majin_SunDirectionOverride"
registers = ["f29", "f30", "f28"]
after_instruction = false
```

> **Important Note on Phase 2 (`0x82189FD4`):**
> Check what `sub_82189A88` does right after `0x82189FEC` (`lines 1283-1335`): it calculates `f30_elev = (f30 * 0.5 + ...)` and checks `f30 < f25` to decide Day vs Night (`loc_8218A1D8`). In Majin's coordinate system, **Y is up** (`f30` is `dir.y`), and light direction points **from the sun toward the ground** (`dir.y < 0` during daytime, verified because `sub_8218F0D0` sets `at = eye + dir`, looking along the light rays, AND `loc_8218A1D8` flips `f29, f28` and swaps to moon when `f30 >= f25`!). Verify the exact sign of `(f29, f30, f28)` once in the first runtime log (`REXLOG_INFO` on first frame!) before enabling Phase 2.

---

### Step 2 — Create `src/sun_control.h` and `src/sun_control.cpp`

Create two clean, self-contained files following the exact style of `src/sssm_uv_align.cpp` and `src/post_effects.cpp`:

#### `src/sun_control.h`
```cpp
#pragma once

namespace majin {

// Live readback of the game's SkySystem solar clock (updated every frame by Majin_SunClockControl).
bool HasLiveSunClock();
float GetLiveSunHour();   // [0.0, 24.0) or -1.0f if unavailable
bool IsLiveSunNight();

// Helper for UI: format fractional hour [0, 24) as "HH:MM" (e.g. 14.5 -> "14:30").
void FormatSunHour(float hour, char* out_buf, size_t out_size);

}  // namespace majin
```

#### Core Hook Logic in `src/sun_control.cpp`
```cpp
// Big-endian guest float load/store helpers (same pattern as src/sssm_uv_align.cpp):
static float LoadGuestFloatBE(const uint8_t* ptr);
static void StoreGuestFloatBE(uint8_t* ptr, float value);

void Majin_SunClockControl(PPCRegister& r31, PPCRegister& r27, PPCRegister& r10, PPCRegister& f0) {
  const uint32_t sky_addr = r31.u32;
  const uint32_t const_addr = r27.u32;
  if (sky_addr < 0x10000 || const_addr < 0x10000) {
    return;
  }

  auto* mem = REX_KERNEL_MEMORY();
  uint8_t* sky = mem->TranslateVirtual<uint8_t*>(sky_addr);
  const uint8_t* consts = mem->TranslateVirtual<const uint8_t*>(const_addr);
  if (!sky || !consts) {
    return;
  }

  const float day_period = LoadGuestFloatBE(consts + 1372);
  if (!std::isfinite(day_period) || day_period <= 1e-4f) {
    return;
  }

  // One-time diagnostic log so we verify exact native units (e.g. 24.0 vs 1440.0 vs 86400.0).
  static std::atomic<bool> s_logged_init{false};
  const float raw_tod = LoadGuestFloatBE(sky + 3208);
  const float raw_day = LoadGuestFloatBE(sky + 3200);
  const float raw_spd = LoadGuestFloatBE(sky + 3212);
  if (!s_logged_init.exchange(true, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
    REXLOG_INFO(
        "majin_sun_control active: sky=0x{:08X}, day_period={:.3f}, time_of_day={:.3f}, "
        "day_of_year={:.3f}, time_speed={:.6f}, clock_enabled={}",
        sky_addr, day_period, raw_tod, raw_day, raw_spd, r10.u32);
  }

  const double override_hour = REXCVAR_GET(majin_sun_hour);
  const bool freeze_sun = REXCVAR_GET(majin_sun_freeze);
  const double sun_speed = std::clamp(REXCVAR_GET(majin_sun_speed), 0.0, 10.0);

  float effective_tod = raw_tod;
  if (override_hour >= 0.0 && std::isfinite(override_hour)) {
    // Wrap hour into [0, 24) and convert to native SkySystem units.
    double wrapped = std::fmod(override_hour, 24.0);
    if (wrapped < 0.0) wrapped += 24.0;
    effective_tod = static_cast<float>((wrapped / 24.0) * static_cast<double>(day_period));
    StoreGuestFloatBE(sky + 3208, effective_tod);

    // Keep fractional part of day_of_year (+3200) synchronized when sync flag (+3196) is active,
    // so solar declination matches the chosen hour even if clock_enabled == 0.
    if (std::isfinite(raw_day)) {
      const float frac_day = static_cast<float>(wrapped / 24.0);
      StoreGuestFloatBE(sky + 3200, std::floor(raw_day) + frac_day);
    }

    // Prevent the game from advancing time_of_day this frame.
    f0.f64 = 0.0;
  } else if (freeze_sun) {
    f0.f64 = 0.0;
  } else if (sun_speed != 1.0) {
    f0.f64 = double(float(f0.f64 * sun_speed));
  }

  // Publish live readback for the F10 UI.
  float live_hour = (effective_tod / day_period) * 24.0f;
  live_hour = std::fmod(live_hour, 24.0f);
  if (live_hour < 0.0f) live_hour += 24.0f;
  g_live_sun_hour.store(live_hour, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_live_is_night.store(LoadGuestU32BE(sky + 104) != 0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_has_live_sun.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
```

#### Important Edge Cases Handled
1. **Sun-color / night-transition smoothing (`sky + 3356`):**
   - Look at `majin_recomp.125.cpp:1867-1896`: `sky + 3356` is exponentially lerped by `84(r1)` each frame toward `0.0` (day) or `1.0` (night). When scrubbing from Day to Night in F10 (while the game is **not** paused, or while the overlay is open), `sub_82189A88` still runs every frame so `3356` smoothly transitions within ~0.5s!
   - **Check:** Does opening the **F10 In-Game Settings** pause the game loop? **No!** As verified during shadow testing (`in_game_menu.cpp`), the game continues rendering live at 60 FPS behind the F10 window, so dragging the **Time of Day** slider moves the sun, shadows, sky colors, and HUD clock in real time behind the menu!
2. **Game pause / cutscenes (`sub_8216B140`):**
   - When the game itself is paused (`Start` menu) or in a scripted cutscene where `sub_8216B140` sets `f0 = 0.0`, multiplying `f0 * sun_speed` preserves `0.0` safely!
   - **Save-file safety:** Because `majin_sun_hour` defaults to `-1.0` (Auto) and `majin_sun_freeze` defaults to `false`, we should **NOT** persist `majin_sun_freeze` / `majin_sun_hour` into `launcher-usa.json` by default (keep them as live testing/debug session tools so a player never accidentally gets permanently stuck at 14:00 across sessions — or only persist if explicitly desired!).
3. **Interaction with `Majin_ShadowCascadeTexelSnap`:**
   - When the sun is **frozen**, the directional light vector `(f29, f30, f28)` is 100% constant -> `M_lightView`'s rotation axes `(X, Y, Z)` are 100% constant -> `Majin_ShadowCascadeTexelSnap` locks every shadow edge completely rock-solid with zero drift!

#### Recommended ImGui Layout
```cpp
ImGui::Spacing();
ImGui::Separator();
ImGui::Spacing();
ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.98f, 0.78f, 0.30f, 1.0f), "SUN & TIME OF DAY");

if (majin::HasLiveSunClock()) {
  char clock_buf[16];
  majin::FormatSunHour(majin::GetLiveSunHour(), clock_buf, sizeof(clock_buf));
  ImGui::TextDisabled("(Live: %s - %s)", clock_buf, majin::IsLiveSunNight() ? "Night" : "Day");
} else {
  ImGui::TextDisabled("(Waiting for outdoor scene)");
}
ImGui::Spacing();

// 1. Freeze Sun checkbox
bool sun_freeze = rex::cvar::Query<bool>("majin_sun_freeze");
if (ImGui::Checkbox("Freeze Sun / Time of Day", &sun_freeze)) {
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_freeze", sun_freeze ? "true" : "false");
}
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("Resume Natural Cycle")) {
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "-1.0");
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_freeze", "false");
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_speed", "1.0");
}

// 2. Time of Day slider (00:00 - 24:00)
double override_hour = rex::cvar::Query<double>("majin_sun_hour");
float display_hour = (override_hour >= 0.0)
                         ? static_cast<float>(override_hour)
                         : (majin::HasLiveSunClock() ? majin::GetLiveSunHour() : 12.0f);
char time_fmt[32];
majin::FormatSunHour(display_hour, time_fmt, sizeof(time_fmt));
char label_buf[48];
snprintf(label_buf, sizeof(label_buf), "%s%s", time_fmt, (override_hour >= 0.0) ? " (Locked)" : " (Auto)");

ImGui::Text("Time of Day:");
ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(340.0f);
if (ImGui::SliderFloat("##MajinSunHour", &display_hour, 0.0f, 23.98f, label_buf)) {
  char buf[32];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.3f", display_hour);
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", buf);
}
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("-15m##SunMinus")) {
  float next = std::fmod(display_hour - 0.25f + 24.0f, 24.0f);
  char buf[32];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.3f", next);
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", buf);
}
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("+15m##SunPlus")) {
  float next = std::fmod(display_hour + 0.25f, 24.0f);
  char buf[32];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.3f", next);
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", buf);
}

// 3. Quick Presets
if (ImGui::Button("Dawn (06:30)", ImVec2(105, 24)))     rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "6.5");
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("Morning (09:30)", ImVec2(115, 24)))  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "9.5");
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("Noon (12:00)", ImVec2(100, 24)))     rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "12.0");
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("Sunset (17:30)", ImVec2(110, 24)))   rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "17.5");
ImGui::SameLine();
if (ImGui::Button("Night (22:00)", ImVec2(100, 24)))    rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_hour", "22.0");

// 4. Solar Cycle Speed slider (when not locked/frozen)
ImGui::Spacing();
float sun_speed = static_cast<float>(rex::cvar::Query<double>("majin_sun_speed"));
ImGui::BeginDisabled(sun_freeze || override_hour >= 0.0);
ImGui::Text("Solar Cycle Speed:");
ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(340.0f);
if (ImGui::SliderFloat("##MajinSunSpeed", &sun_speed, 0.0f, 5.0f, "%.2fx")) {
  char buf[32];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.2f", sun_speed);
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_sun_speed", buf);
}
ImGui::EndDisabled();
DrawHintText("Freeze or scrub the sun/moon position live to test shadows and lighting under steady conditions.");
```

*(Note: Verify actual dawn/noon/sunset hours on the first test run! Depending on the game's internal clock epoch — e.g., whether `0.0` represents `00:00` midnight or `06:00` sunrise — check the one-time `majin_sun_control active` log against the HUD sundial and adjust preset hours / offset by a constant if needed!)*

```md
# D1: Frame-Time Spike Attribution (Vulkan & D3D12)

> **Date**: 2026-11-10
> **Hardware / Environment**: Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (`vendor 0x10DE`, `device 0x2489`, 8 GB VRAM), NVIDIA Driver `621.14` (`0x9B404000` / `0x9B438000`, Vulkan API `1.4.357`).
> **Reproducible Script**: [`scripts/discovery/d1-stutter-attribution.mjs`](../../scripts/discovery/d1-stutter-attribution.mjs) (`node scripts/discovery/d1-stutter-attribution.mjs`)
> **Decision Unlocked**: **GO** on the shader/pipeline initiative (with explicit methodological caveats below). In Vulkan (the default backend), **69.1% of all CSV frame-time spikes (89.3% of excess spike time lost)** coincide by timestamp with `Creating graphics pipeline state` or [`fh1_frame_cost`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71) slow-frame windows, and **82.1% of all `fh1_frame_cost` slow frames (98.9% of measured GPU subsystem work in slow frames)** are directly recorded in `shader_ms + pipeline_ms` while texture cache misses account for **`0.0%` (`0.6 ms` total)**.

## 1. Executive Summary & Attribution Tables

### 1.1 Per-Frame CSV Spike Attribution (`*.performance.csv` + Paired `.log` Timestamp Correlation)

- **Spike Definition (per D1 spec)**: `frame_time_us > 2 * rolling_median(60 frames)` **AND** `frame_time_us > 25,000 us` (`25 ms`).
- **Dataset**: All **198** CSV files under [`reports/`](../../reports) and [`game-data/runtime/logs/`](../../game-data/runtime/logs) (**177** valid non-empty CSV sessions totaling **394,038 frames** / **117.7 minutes** of runtime; 21 files are 0-byte or header-only from immediate exits or DLL split sessions).
- **Attribution Method (Inference via Timestamp Correlation)**: Because `REXGLUE_ENABLE_PERF_COUNTERS` is compiled out in `Release` builds ([`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt:31`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt#L31)), the `pipeline_cache_misses` and `texture_cache_misses` columns are `0` in all 198 Release CSVs (see Section 2.3). Consequently, CSV spike attribution is an **inference by timestamp correlation** between reconstructed CSV frame timestamps (anchored on `[Majin performance] Release counter mode:` at the first swap) and paired `.log` lines (`Creating graphics pipeline state`, `GPU slow frames:`, `[Majin loading]`, `[Majin save]`). Direct in-engine per-frame timer verification is provided independently in Section 1.2 via [`fh1_frame_cost`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71).

#### Vulkan Backend (76 valid CSV sessions, 113,241 frames, 2,316.2 s total runtime)

| Cause Category (Inferred via Log Timestamp Correlation) | Spikes (`N = 269`) | % of Spikes | Total Spike Duration (ms) | Excess Time Lost > Median (ms) | % of Excess Time Lost |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **Pipeline / Shader Miss** (`Creating graphics pipeline state` / `fh1_frame_cost`) | **186** | **69.1%** | **64,062.2 ms** | **60,660.3 ms** | **89.3%** |
| **Boot / Level Load / Save I/O** (`[Majin loading]`, `[Majin save]`, audio/title init) | 59 | 21.9% | 6,967.2 ms | 5,727.8 ms | 8.4% |
| **Window / Swapchain Recreation** (`VulkanPresenter: Created ... swapchain`) | 2 | 0.7% | 94.1 ms | 60.7 ms | 0.1% |
| **Unexplained / Guest Pacing Slip** (single-frame 33->51..71 ms VSync/pacing step) | 22 | 8.2% | 1,874.9 ms | 1,494.7 ms | 2.2% |
| **Total (Vulkan)** | **269** | **100.0%** | **72,998.5 ms** | **67,943.5 ms** | **100.0%** |

#### D3D12 Backend (101 valid CSV sessions, 280,797 frames, 4,745.3 s total runtime — Directional Proxy)

> *Methodological Note on D3D12*: Unlike Vulkan, D3D12 logs per-draw `Creating graphics pipeline with VS ...` at `REXGPU_DEBUG` level ([`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp:2685-2689`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2685-L2689)), which is suppressed in default `info` logs. However, D3D12 logs exact startup cache counts (`Translated X shaders` and `Created Z graphics pipelines ... from the storage`, [`lines 515, 690`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L515-L690)), allowing sessions to be grouped into **Cold / Growing-Cache sessions** (where new shaders/PSOs were compiled during gameplay) and **Warm-Cache sessions** (where `0` new PSOs were compiled). Because these are unstandardized development sessions with varying routes and durations rather than a controlled A/B benchmark, this D3D12 comparison is a **directional proxy** rather than a controlled experiment.

| Session / Cause Group (Directional Proxy) | Spikes (`N = 295`) | % of Spikes | Total Spike Duration (ms) | Excess Time Lost > Median (ms) | % of Excess Time Lost |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **Cold / Growing-Cache Sessions** (13 sessions, 75,148 frames; **338.5 ms lost / 1k frames**) | **132** | **44.7%** | **27,948.4 ms** | **26,071.8 ms** | **66.2%** |
| **Warm-Cache: Boot / Level Load / Save I/O** (88 warm sessions, 205,649 frames) | 139 | 47.1% | 14,503.0 ms | 11,927.0 ms | 30.3% |
| **Warm-Cache: Window / Focus / Capture** | 5 | 1.7% | 264.0 ms | 180.7 ms | 0.5% |
| **Warm-Cache: Unexplained / Guest Pacing** (**only 5.7 ms lost / 1k frames**) | 19 | 6.4% | 1,498.1 ms | 1,181.0 ms | 3.0% |
| **Total (D3D12)** | **295** | **100.0%** | **44,213.5 ms** | **39,360.4 ms** | **100.0%** |

- Directionally across the D3D12 dataset, non-I/O mid-gameplay spikes drop from **136.6 ms/1k frames** (`67` spikes in `75,148` frames during cold/growing sessions) to **5.7 ms/1k frames** (`19` minor spikes in `165,952` frames during warm sessions). Because session routes and durations differ across logs, this **~95.8% difference is strictly directional** and should not be cited as a controlled benchmark reduction (controlled baseline runs are deferred to D8).

---

### 1.2 Direct Sub-Millisecond GPU Telemetry Attribution (Vulkan `fh1_frame_cost`)

Starting with the `2026-11-08 15:56` build, the Vulkan command processor records exact per-frame wall-clock timers for every GPU subsystem via [`rex::graphics::fh1_frame_cost::Frame`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71) and emits a `GPU slow frames:` summary line whenever frames exceed `max(50 ms, 1.5x typical_ms)` after the initial 30-second boot window. Unlike the CSV correlation in Section 1.1, [`fh1_frame_cost`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71) is **direct in-engine instrumentation** inside [`VulkanCommandProcessor`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp#L1174-L1229) and [`VulkanPipelineCache`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1688-L1927).

Across all **203** runtime logs, **29 slow-frame windows** (**67 slow frames total**) were recorded:

| Subsystem / Cause (`fh1_frame_cost`) | Slow Frames Affected (`N = 67`) | % of Slow Frames | Total Measured Subsystem Time Across Slow Frames | % of Measured Slow-Frame Work |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **PSO Creation + Driver Cache + Lookahead Wait** (`pipeline_ms`) | **55** | **82.1%** | **10,553.5 ms** | **97.5%** |
| **Guest Shader Translation** (`shader_ms`) | *(subset of the 55 frames above)* | *(see above)* | **148.4 ms** | **1.4%** |
| **Subtotal: Shaders + Pipelines (`shader_ms + pipeline_ms`)** | **55** | **82.1%** | **10,701.9 ms** | **98.9%** |
| **Guest Command Wait (`WAIT_REG_MEM` / `guest_wait_ms`)** | 4 | 6.0% | 97.0 ms | 0.9% |
| **Guest Memory Uploads (`upload_ms`)** | *(background across frames)* | 0.0% primary | 20.9 ms | 0.2% |
| **Texture Cache (`texture_create_ms + texture_load_ms`)** | **0** | **0.0%** | **0.6 ms** | **0.006%** |
| **Render Targets (`render_target_ms`)** | **0** | **0.0%** | **0.0 ms** | **0.0%** |
| **Resolve Readbacks (`readback_ms + readback_wait_ms`)** | **0** | **0.0%** | **0.0 ms** | **0.0%** |
| **GPU Fence Waits (`gpu_wait_ms`)** | **0** | **0.0%** | **0.0 ms** | **0.0%** |
| **Minor VSync / Pacing Step (51–71 ms vs 33 ms typical)** | 8 | 11.9% | *(unattributed ~18–38 ms step)* | — |

**Key Observations from `fh1_frame_cost`:**
1. **100% of severe spikes (`worst >= 94 ms`, up to `448 ms`) are caused by `shader_ms + pipeline_ms`.** All 12 non-pipeline slow frames (4 `guest_wait_ms` + 8 `unclear`) had `worst` between **51 ms and 71 ms** (a single missed 30 FPS / 33.3 ms frame boundary).
2. **Texture cache misses do NOT cause frame-time spikes.** Across all 67 slow frames (even in frames that loaded 40–64 textures / 45–56 MB of guest texture data, e.g., [`runtime-20261108-161438.log:441`](../../game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-161438.log#L441)), `texture_create_ms + texture_load_ms` totaled **0.6 ms** (`< 0.01 ms` per slow frame on average). The texture cache memory limits tuned in [`src/majin_app.h:220-231`](../../src/majin_app.h#L220-L231) (`4096 MB` soft / `8192 MB` hard) completely prevent texture eviction (`0.0 evicted` in every log).
3. **Preview for D2 (with `pipeline_ms` caveat)**: Within the `10,701.9 ms` of shader/pipeline work in slow frames, `pipeline_ms` (`10,553.5 ms`, `98.6%`) dwarfs guest shader translation (`shader_ms` = `148.4 ms`, `1.4%`) by `~71:1`. However, as decomposed in [`docs/discovery/D2-miss-cost-breakdown.md`](D2-miss-cost-breakdown.md), `pipeline_ms` bundles raw `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines`, per-pipeline `.vkpc` `~2 MB` blob serialization overhead, and multi-PSO lookahead batch waiting (`Fh1WaitForAhead`), so `pipeline_ms` must not be interpreted as pure single-PSO driver compilation time.

---

## 2. SDK Telemetry Audit & Methodological Caveats

### 2.1 Caveat Check: What does `pipeline_cache_misses` count?

We inspected [`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp:900-1013`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L900-L1013) (`PipelineCache::ConfigurePipeline`):

1. **Guest shader analysis and translation** (`vertex_shader->shader().AnalyzeUcode(...)` and `TranslateAnalyzedShader(...)`) execute first at [`lines 927-981`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L927-L981) **without** touching any `rex::perf` counter.
2. Next, `GetCurrentStateDescription(...)` builds the full `PipelineDescription` key (shader hashes + modifications + render target formats + depth/stencil/blend/raster state) at [`lines 984-990`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L984-L990).
3. If `description` matches `current_pipeline_` ([`lines 992-997`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L992-L997)), `ConfigurePipeline` returns `true` immediately (*without* incrementing `kPipelineCacheHits`).
4. Next, it searches the in-memory `pipelines_` hash map (`pipelines_.equal_range(hash)`, [`lines 1000-1010`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1000-L1010)). If found, it calls `PROFILE_PIPELINE_CACHE_HIT()` ([`line 1005`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1005)) and returns.
5. Only when the full `PipelineDescription` is not in `pipelines_` does it call **`PROFILE_PIPELINE_CACHE_MISS()` ([`line 1012`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1012))**, allocate a new `Pipeline`, and call `CreateD3D12Pipeline(runtime_description)` ([`line 1038`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/d3d12/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1038)).

**Conclusion on Counter Definition**:
- `pipeline_cache_misses` (`kPipelineCacheMisses`) counts **unique PSO cache misses (PSO creations)** only — **not** shader translations.
- Furthermore, in [`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/core/perf/counter.cpp:57-75, 104-115`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/core/perf/counter.cpp#L57-L115), `kDrawCalls`, `kCommandBufferStalls`, `kTextureCacheMisses`, and `kPipelineCacheMisses` have `kIsGauge = false`, meaning `ResetFrameCounters()` atomically snapshots and zeroes (`exchange(0)`) them every frame.

### 2.2 Three SDK Telemetry Bugs Uncovered During D1

While auditing the 198 `.performance.csv` files and SDK perf counters, we uncovered three critical telemetry implementation details that must be accounted for in D2–D8:

1. **Bug 1 — `REXGLUE_ENABLE_PERF_COUNTERS` is compiled out in `Release` builds ([`CMakeLists.txt:31`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt#L31))**:
   - In [`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt:31`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt#L31) (and `src/core/CMakeLists.txt:137`, `src/system/CMakeLists.txt:108`), the macro is gated by `$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Release>>:REXGLUE_ENABLE_PERF_COUNTERS>`.
   - In `Release` builds, all `PROFILE_*` macros in [`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/include/rex/perf/counter.h:163-188`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/include/rex/perf/counter.h#L163-L188) compile to empty no-ops, and [`CommandProcessor::ExecutePacketType3_XE_SWAP`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/command_processor.cpp#L1370-L1406) runs the `#if !defined(REXGLUE_ENABLE_PERF_COUNTERS)` path, which sets **only** `kFrameTimeUs` and `kFps`. Consequently, columns `draw_calls` through `pipeline_cache_misses` are `0` in all 198 existing Release `.performance.csv` files.
2. **Bug 2 — The Vulkan backend never calls `PROFILE_*` macros (`rex::perf`)**:
   - Even in non-Release builds, `PROFILE_DRAW_CALL()`, `PROFILE_CMD_BUFFER_STALL()`, `PROFILE_TEXTURE_CACHE_HIT/MISS()`, and `PROFILE_PIPELINE_CACHE_HIT/MISS()` exist **only** in `src/graphics/d3d12/*`.
   - The Vulkan backend (`src/graphics/vulkan/*`) instead instruments everything through [`rex::graphics::fh1_frame_cost`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71), which can write a rich 46-column per-frame CSV (`t, ms, cpu_ms, gpu_wait_ms, guest_wait_ms, draws, textures_created, ..., shaders, shader_ms, pipelines, pipeline_ms, ...`) whenever `--fh1_frame_cost_csv=<path>` is passed ([`src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp:214, 1174-1229`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp#L1174-L1229)).
3. **Bug 3 — `fh1_frame_cost::Report::MainCause()` mislabels synchronous lookahead pipeline waits as `"the game"` ([`fh1_frame_cost.h:412`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L412))**:
   - When `vulkan_pipeline_lookahead` (default `true`, [`src/graphics/vulkan/fh1_pipeline_lookahead.cpp:39`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/fh1_pipeline_lookahead.cpp#L39)) encounters a missing PSO ([`src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp:1806`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1806)), it walks ahead in the command buffer, queues missing PSOs onto background worker threads (`creation_threads_`), and then blocks the command processor thread inside [`Fh1WaitForAhead()`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2010-L2037).
   - While sleeping in `Fh1WaitForAhead()`, `fh1_frame_cost::Timer cost_timer(fh1_frame_cost::Current().pipeline_ms)` ([`pipeline_cache.cpp:1845, 1854, 1927`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1845-L1927)) correctly records the wall-clock stall in `pipeline_ms` (e.g., `410.6 ms` in [`runtime-20261108-161438.log:365`](../../game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-161438.log#L365)), **but** the command processor thread's own CPU cycle counter (`QueryThreadCycleTime`) does not advance while sleeping (`9 ms CPU`).
   - Because [`Report::MainCause()`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L412) checks `if (slow_.cpu_per_frame && cpu > 0 && cpu + gpu_wait < 0.5 * ms) return Cause::kGame;` **before** checking `costs[]` (`Cause::kShaders`), any slow frame where the command processor slept waiting for worker threads to compile pipelines is mislabeled in the log text as `cause: the game (the command processor waited for its commands)` despite having `pipeline_ms = 91.4 ms .. 410.6 ms` and `0 ms game waits`!

### 2.3 Methodological Caveats on D1 Results

1. **CSV Spike Attribution Is Inferred by Timestamp Correlation (Not Direct Counter Attribution)**:
   - Because `REXGLUE_ENABLE_PERF_COUNTERS` is off in `Release` ([`CMakeLists.txt:31`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/CMakeLists.txt#L31)), the `.performance.csv` files cannot attribute spikes directly from their `pipeline_cache_misses` column. The **69.1% of spikes (89.3% of excess time)** figure in Section 1.1 is an inference based on millisecond-level timestamp correlation between CSV frames and `.log` lines (`Creating graphics pipeline state` and `GPU slow frames:`). It is corroborated by direct in-engine [`fh1_frame_cost`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h#L23-L71) timers (Section 1.2: **82.1% of slow frames, 98.9% of measured GPU work**).
2. **D3D12 Cold-vs-Warm Comparison Is a Directional Proxy Only**:
   - The 101 D3D12 sessions compare historical development runs that differed in gameplay route, length, and test purpose rather than a controlled A/B experiment on an identical route. The observed drop from `136.6 ms / 1k frames` to `5.7 ms / 1k frames` (**~95.8% reduction**) is directional evidence that a warm PSO cache eliminates mid-gameplay spikes on D3D12, not a controlled benchmark number to cite as a formal baseline.
3. **Sample Bias (Partial Development Routes)**:
   - All 177 valid sessions come from development testing over early/partial routes of the game. While cold-cache sessions accurately reflect a player's first-run experience in those zones, total full-game shader/pipeline population and late-game growth remain unknown until D3.

## 4. Recommendations for D2–D8

1. **Proceed to D2 & D3 (Gate Passed)**: Pipeline/shader compilation and its associated driver-cache/lookahead stalls are conclusively the primary cause of in-game frame-time spikes on Vulkan (**89.3%** of excess CSV spike ms; **98.9%** of measured `fh1_frame_cost` slow-frame GPU work), while texture cache misses are negligible (`0.6 ms` total).
2. **Use `--fh1_frame_cost_csv=<path>` for Vulkan in D2 and D8**: Passing `--fh1_frame_cost_csv` ([`tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp:214, 1174-1229`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp#L1174-L1229)) exports direct per-frame `shader_ms`, `pipeline_ms`, `bg_pipelines`, and `bg_pipeline_ms` telemetry without relying on Release-disabled `rex::perf` counters.

`docs/discovery/D2-miss-cost-breakdown.md`:

# D2 — Miss Cost Breakdown: Guest-Shader Translation vs. Host PSO Creation vs. Cache Overhead & Draw Path

**Status**: Complete (Revised with `CreatePipelineWithDriverCache` Sub-Stage Decomposition & D3D12 Patch Verification)  
**Date**: 2026-11-10  
**Issue**: `#4` — *Implement shader pre-compilation / cache warm-up to eliminate in-game stuttering*  
**Reproducible Script**: [`scripts/discovery/d2-miss-cost-breakdown.mjs`](../../scripts/discovery/d2-miss-cost-breakdown.mjs) (`node scripts/discovery/d2-miss-cost-breakdown.mjs`)

---

## 1. Test Hardware & Environment

All measurements in this report (both log analyses and controlled empirical sub-stage probes) were captured on the following hardware and software stack (verified from runtime logs such as [`game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-161438.log:6-36`](../../game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-161438.log#L6-L36) and [`game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261107-185200.log:3-12`](../../game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261107-185200.log#L3-L12)):

- **OS**: Windows 11 (x86_64)
- **GPU**: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (`vendor 0x10DE`, `device 0x2489`, 8,024 MB dedicated VRAM)
- **Driver**: NVIDIA Proprietary `621.14` (Vulkan driver versions `0x9B404000` and `0x9B438000`, conformance `1.4.3.3`)
- **Graphics APIs**: Vulkan `1.4.357` and Direct3D 12 (Resource Binding Tier 3, ROV supported)
- **Dataset**: 203 `.log` files and 198 `.performance.csv` files across [`reports/`](../../reports) and [`game-data/runtime/logs/`](../../game-data/runtime/logs), plus **4 controlled instrumentation probe runs** isolating sub-stage timings inside [`VulkanPipelineCache::CreatePipelineWithDriverCache`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L569-L687).

---

## 2. Executive Answer to D2

1. **Guest shader translation (Stage a) is NOT the bottleneck**: Translating Xenos microcode into SPIR-V (`AnalyzeUcode` + `SpirvShaderTranslator::TranslateAnalyzedShader` + `vkCreateShaderModule`) costs **`1.58 ms` mean (`1.50 ms` P50, `5.30 ms` max) per shader** on Vulkan (`148.4 ms` across 94 shaders in slow frames = **`1.39%`** of slow-frame miss time), and **`0.036 ms` mean (`0.032 ms` P50) per shader** wall-clock across worker threads on D3D12 (`6.0 ms` P50 for `209` shaders).
2. **However, `pipeline_ms` (`98.61%` of slow-frame miss time) is NOT pure driver PSO compilation**: In [`VulkanPipelineCache::ConfigurePipeline`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1844-L1927) and [`CreatePipelineWithDriverCache`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L569-L687), `pipeline_ms` conflates **four distinct costs**:
   - **(b1) True cold driver PSO compilation (`vkCreateGraphicsPipelines` / `CreateGraphicsPipelineState` when `GLCache`/`DXCache` is cold)**: **`46.8–205.3 ms / PSO`** for isolated single-PSO cold misses on Vulkan (`75.0–81.0 ms / PSO` single-threaded mean on cold D3D12).
   - **(b2) Per-pipeline `.vkpc` wrapper overhead (`CreateDriverCache` + `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines` cache-population penalty + `GetDriverCacheData` `~2.11 MB` extraction + `MakeEntry` single-byte FNV-1a checksum)**: Controlled probe runs (Section 4) prove that when NVIDIA's `GLCache` is warm, passing `--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=false` (`cache = VK_NULL_HANDLE`) reduces runtime `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines` to **`0.199 ms / PSO`** (`6.29 ms` total across 29 PSOs), whereas the default `.vkpc` path (`--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=true`) takes **`8.021 ms / PSO` (`226.8 ms` total — a `40.1x` slowdown!)**, of which **`7.822 ms / PSO` (`97.5%`) is pure `.vkpc` `~2.11 MB` blob extraction and checksum overhead**.
   - **(b3) `Outcome::kStale` double-compilation & double-serialization ([`vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp:655-677`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L655-L677))**: When a seeded `.vkpc` entry misses (`251` of `342` PSOs in startup probe runs), `CreatePipelineWithDriverCache` compiles and extracts the `2.15 MB` blob **twice**, taking **`22.24–23.18 ms / PSO` per worker thread**, with **`14.39–15.48 ms` (`64.7%`) wasted in the second pass**.
   - **(b4) Multi-PSO lookahead batch waiting ([`Fh1WaitForAhead`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2010-L2037) via `finish_ahead`)**: A slow frame's `pipeline_ms` (`191.88 ms / slow frame` mean) is a **per-frame** metric, not a **per-PSO** metric. In the 15-minute cold Vulkan gameplay session ([`runtime-20261108-161438.log`](../../game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-161438.log)), **`167` runtime PSOs** were built (`59` on the CP thread + `108` on background lookahead threads), so the `7,333.4 ms` of slow-frame `pipeline_ms` averages **`43.91 ms / runtime PSO`** (`59.3%` inside `Fh1WaitForAhead` waiting on batches of `108` ahead PSOs at `40.27 ms / ahead PSO`, and `40.7%` on direct CP-thread builds at `50.59 ms / CP PSO`).

| Stage / Sub-Stage | Vulkan Per-Item Cost (RTX 3060 Ti) | Vulkan Per-Slow-Frame / Startup Cost | D3D12 Per-Item Cost (RTX 3060 Ti) | D3D12 Startup Total Cost | Key Takeaway |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| **(a) Guest Shader Translation** (`AnalyzeUcode` + SPIR-V / DXBC + `VkShaderModule`) | **`1.58 ms / shader`** mean (`1.50 ms` P50, `5.30 ms` max, $N=94$) | `2.69 ms / slow frame` (`148.4 ms` total = `1.39%` of slow-frame miss work); startup: `154–275 ms` (`~0.7–1.1 ms/shader`, 1 thread) | **`0.036 ms / shader`** wall-clock parallel (`~0.25–0.50 ms/shader` per thread) | `6.0 ms` P50 (`4–17 ms` for `128–220` shaders across $N$ threads) | Fast and state-independent; pre-translating shaders alone saves only **~1.4%** of stutter. |
| **(b1) Cold Driver PSO Compilation** (`GLCache` / `DXCache` cold) | **`46.8–205.3 ms / PSO`** (isolated single-PSO runtime misses); **`43.91 ms / PSO`** session mean across all `167` runtime PSOs (`59` CP + `108` ahead) | Bundled with (b2)+(b4) into **`191.88 ms / slow frame`** (`195.9 ms` P50, `410.6 ms` max across `55` slow frames) | **Patched ($N$ threads)**: **`6.49–11.99 ms / PSO`** wall-clock; **Unpatched (1 thread)**: **`75.02–81.04 ms / PSO`** | **Patched**: `1,506–3,308 ms` (`180–295` PSOs); **Unpatched**: `8,402–9,076 ms` (`112` PSOs); runtime cold spike excess: `197.51 ms` mean (`101.41 ms` P50) | True cold SASS compilation takes **`~45–205 ms / PSO`** per thread (`~6.5–12 ms/PSO` wall-clock across worker threads). |
| **(b2) Warm Driver Cache + `.vkpc` Disabled / D3D12 Warm `DXCache`** | **`0.199 ms / PSO`** mean (`0.191 ms` P50, `0.663 ms` max; `--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=false`, $N=29$) | **`6.29 ms` total** across all 29 runtime PSOs (`14` active frames) | **`0.149 ms / PSO`** P50 (`0.193 ms` mean across $N=92$ warm sessions) | `39.0 ms` P50 (`26–181 ms` for `215–276` PSOs) | When NVIDIA `GLCache`/`DXCache` is warm, raw PSO creation without `.vkpc` is **`~0.15–0.20 ms / PSO`**. |
| **(b2-ovh) `.vkpc` Per-Pipeline `~2.11 MB` Wrapper Overhead** (`--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=true`) | **`+7.822 ms / PSO`** pure overhead (`8.021 ms / PSO` total vs. `0.199 ms` raw = **`40.1x` slower**!) | **`226.8 ms` total** across 29 runtime PSOs (`+4.86 ms` in `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines` + `0.88 ms` `GetDriverCacheData` + `1.92 ms` FNV-1a checksum + `0.16 ms` `CreateDriverCache`) | N/A (D3D12 does not use per-pipeline `ID3D12PipelineLibrary` blobs) | Startup `.vkpc` disk read + checksum over `535.8 MB` costs **`851–954 ms`** (`67%` of warm startup!) | **Fixing/disabling per-PSO `.vkpc` mega-blobs eliminates `97.5%` of warm-`GLCache` PSO cost and `~950 ms` of startup I/O without pre-compiling anything.** |
| **(b3) `.vkpc` `Outcome::kStale` Double-Pass & 512 MiB Cap Overflow** | **`22.24–23.18 ms / PSO`** per thread for `kStale` (`14.39–15.48 ms` [`64.7%`] in 2nd pass); **`15.34–16.87 ms / PSO`** per thread for unseeded overflow (then discarded!) | `1,754–1,908 ms` wall-clock across 6 threads for `342` PSOs (`33` reused at `0.52 ms`, `251` stale rebuilt, `58` overflow compiled & discarded) | N/A | N/A | Caused by per-PSO `2.15 MB` NVIDIA blobs hitting the `512 MiB` cap at `284` PSOs and `kStale` rebuilding twice. |
| **(c) Rest of the Draw Path** (State validation, bindings, barriers, `vkCmdDraw`) | **`0.0028 ms / draw`** P50 (`2.80 us/draw`) | **`1.60 ms` CPU / frame** P50 for `538` draws/frame | Included in `< 16.6 ms` frame budget | N/A | **`< 0.8%`** of a slow frame (`1.60 ms` vs `~200 ms`). |

## 3. Code-Path Anatomy of Stages (a), (b), and (c)

### 3.1 Vulkan Draw & Miss Path

In [`VulkanCommandProcessor::IssueDraw`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp#L4860-L5350) and [`VulkanPipelineCache`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L569-L4394):

1. **Stage (a) — Guest Shader Translation ([`EnsureShadersTranslated`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1686-L1716) & [`TranslateAnalyzedShader`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2079-L2146))**:
   - Timed by `fh1_frame_cost::Timer cost_timer(fh1_frame_cost::Current().shader_ms)` ([`lines 1688, 1702`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1688-L1703)) and counted in `fh1_frame_cost::Current().shaders`.
   - Executes `shader().AnalyzeUcode(ucode_disasm_buffer_)`, `SpirvShaderTranslator::TranslateAnalyzedShader`, texture/sampler layout UID setup (`EnterBindingLayoutUserUIDSetup`), and `vkCreateShaderModule` (`translation.GetOrCreateShaderModule()` at [`line 2142`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2142)).
2. **Stage (b) — Host PSO Creation, Driver Cache Wrapper, and Lookahead Wait ([`ConfigurePipeline`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1718-L1929), [`EnsurePipelineCreated`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L3853-L4394), & [`CreatePipelineWithDriverCache`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L569-L687))**:
   - **What `pipeline_ms` actually wraps**: In [`ConfigurePipeline`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1844-L1927):
     - If the current draw's PSO was already queued by lookahead (`it->second.fh1_ahead_queued`), [`lines 1845-1846`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1845-L1846) start `fh1_frame_cost::Timer cost_timer(fh1_frame_cost::Current().pipeline_ms)` and call `finish_ahead(&it->second)`, which blocks in [`Fh1WaitForAhead`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L2010-L2037) until **all** lookahead-queued PSOs in `fh1_ahead_set_` finish compiling on background worker threads — **without incrementing `fh1_frame_cost::Current().pipelines`**.
     - If the current draw's PSO was not yet created (`!it->second.is_created`), [`lines 1884-1927`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1884-L1927) start `cost_timer(fh1_frame_cost::Current().pipeline_ms)`, increment `fh1_frame_cost::Current().pipelines` by **1**, call `EnsurePipelineCreated` on the CP thread ([`line 1916`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1916)), and then **inside the same `cost_timer` scope** call `finish_ahead(nullptr)` ([`line 1927`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L1927)) to wait for the entire batch of background lookahead PSOs!
   - **What `CreatePipelineWithDriverCache` ([`lines 569-687`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L569-L687)) executes on each PSO**:
     1. `CreateDriverCache(seed_bytes, seed_size)` ([`lines 585, 591`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L585-L591)): creates a temporary per-pipeline `VkPipelineCache`.
     2. `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(device, cache, 1, &create_info, nullptr, &pipeline)` ([`line 605`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L605)).
     3. `GetDriverCacheData(cache)` ([`lines 556-567, 612`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L556-L612)): calls `vkGetPipelineCacheData` twice (size query + `std::vector<uint8_t>` copy of `~2.11 MB` on NVIDIA) and `vkDestroyPipelineCache`.
     4. If `seeded && outcome == Outcome::kStale` ([`lines 655-677`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L655-L677)): creates a **second** empty `VkPipelineCache`, calls `vkCreateGraphicsPipelines` a **second time** (`&duplicate`), calls `vkDestroyPipeline(duplicate)`, and calls `GetDriverCacheData(fresh)` a **second time**!
     5. `driver_cache_file::MakeEntry(key, bytes)` ([`driver_cache_file.h:62-75`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/driver_cache_file.h#L62-L75), called at [`lines 614, 675`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L614-L675)): runs a byte-by-byte FNV-1a loop (`Checksum(entry.data.data(), entry.data.size())`) over the `~2.11 MB` vector on the calling thread, then calls `KeepDriverCacheEntry` ([`lines 702-725`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/pipeline_cache.cpp#L702-L725)), which **discards the entry if `.vkpc` has already reached `kMaxFileSize` (`512 MiB`)**!
3. **Stage (c) — Rest of the Draw Path ([`VulkanCommandProcessor::IssueDraw`](../../tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/vulkan/command_processor.cpp#L4860-L5350))**:
   - Primitive processing, modification bit computation, render-target cache update, `pipelines_.find(description)` hash lookup, texture residency checks, descriptor set updates, shared-memory range requests, dynamic state updates, and `vkCmdDraw` / `vkCmdDrawIndexed`.
