```rs
                        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) == Some("vkpc")
                            || path.to_string_lossy().ends_with(".monolithic.vkpc")
                        {
                            if fs::remove_file(&path).is_ok() {
                                deleted_count += 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(deleted_count > 0)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn launch_game(settings: Settings) -> Result<(), String> {
    save_settings(settings.clone())?;

    let root = get_project_root();
    let script = root.join("scripts/run-usa.ps1");
    if !script.exists() {
        return Err(format!("Runner script not found at: {}", script.display()));
    }

    let game_data_rel = if Path::new(&settings.game_data_root).is_absolute() {
        if let Ok(rel) = PathBuf::from(&settings.game_data_root).strip_prefix(&root) {
            rel.to_string_lossy().to_string()
        } else {
            settings.game_data_root.clone()
        }
    } else if settings.game_data_root.trim().is_empty() {
        "game-data".to_string()
    } else {
        settings.game_data_root.trim().to_string()
    };

    let is_dev = settings.dev_mode || is_dev_or_debug();
    let log_file_path = if is_dev {
        let p = root.join("private/launcher-launch.log");
        if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
            let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent);
        }
        Some(p)
    } else {
        None
    };

    let mut args = vec![
        "-NoLogo".to_string(),
        "-NoProfile".to_string(),
        "-ExecutionPolicy".to_string(),
        "Bypass".to_string(),
        "-File".to_string(),
        script.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
        "-WindowSize".to_string(),
        settings.window_size,
        format!("-Fullscreen:${}", settings.fullscreen),
        format!("-VSync:${}", settings.vsync),
        "-RenderScale".to_string(),
        settings.render_scale.to_string(),
        "-ShadowScale".to_string(),
        settings.shadow_scale.to_string(),
        "-ShadowPcfMode".to_string(),
        match settings.shadow_pcf_mode.as_str() {
            "soft" | "bilinear" | "ultra" | "original" => settings.shadow_pcf_mode.clone(),
            _ => "soft".to_string(),
        },
        format!("-ShadowReceiverBias:${}", settings.shadow_receiver_bias),
        format!("-ShadowTwoSided:${}", settings.shadow_two_sided),
        format!("-ShadowTexelSnap:${}", settings.shadow_texel_snap),
        "-ShadowSssmMode".to_string(),
        match settings.shadow_sssm_mode.as_str() {
            "auto" | "original" | "subtle" | "off" => settings.shadow_sssm_mode.clone(),
            _ => "auto".to_string(),
        },
        "-ShadowSlopeBias".to_string(),
        format!("{:.2}", settings.shadow_slope_bias),
        "-ShadowConstantBias".to_string(),
        format!("{:.3}", settings.shadow_constant_bias),
        "-ShadowBiasClamp".to_string(),
        format!("{:.3}", settings.shadow_bias_clamp),
        "-PostEffect".to_string(),
        settings.post_effect,
        "-DeDitherStrength".to_string(),
        settings.dedither_strength.to_string(),
        "-FoliageAlphaMode".to_string(),
        match settings.foliage_alpha_mode.as_str() {
            "smooth" | "lush" | "original" | "solid" => settings.foliage_alpha_mode.clone(),
            _ => "solid".to_string(),
        },
        "-Upscaler".to_string(),
        settings.upscaler,
        "-RenderingPath".to_string(),
        settings.rendering_path,
        "-FrameRateMode".to_string(),
        settings.frame_rate_mode,
        "-InputMode".to_string(),
        settings.input_mode,
        "-MouseSensitivity".to_string(),
        settings.mouse_sensitivity.to_string(),
        format!("-SkipIntroLogos:${}", settings.skip_intro_logos),
        format!("-SkipCutscenes:${}", settings.skip_cutscenes),
        "-CutsceneSpeed".to_string(),
        settings.cutscene_speed.to_string(),
        "-GameDataRoot".to_string(),
        game_data_rel,
        "-Language".to_string(),
        settings.language,
        "-AudioLanguage".to_string(),
        if settings.audio_language.trim().is_empty() {
            "Auto".to_string()
        } else {
            settings.audio_language
        },
        format!("-StepFix:${}", settings.step_fix),
        format!("-AnimSpeedFix:${}", settings.anim_speed_fix),
        format!("-DtSmoothing:${}", settings.dt_smoothing),
        "-FovScale".to_string(),
        settings.fov_scale.to_string(),
        "-DrawDistanceScale".to_string(),
        settings.draw_distance_scale.to_string(),
        format!("-PauseDistortion:${}", settings.pause_distortion),
        format!("-DepthOfField:${}", settings.depth_of_field),
        "-DepthOfFieldIntensity".to_string(),
        settings.depth_of_field_intensity.to_string(),
        "-DepthOfFieldMode".to_string(),
        if settings.depth_of_field_mode == "native" {
            "native".to_string()
        } else {
            "bokeh".to_string()
        },
        format!("-Bloom:${}", settings.bloom_intensity),
        "-BloomIntensity".to_string(),
        settings.bloom_intensity.to_string(),
        "-FogIntensity".to_string(),
        settings.fog_intensity.to_string(),
        "-CasSharpness".to_string(),
        settings.cas_sharpness.to_string(),
        "-FsrReduction".to_string(),
        settings.fsr_reduction.to_string(),
        format!("-WindowFps:${}", settings.window_fps),
        format!("-PresentDither:${}", settings.present_dither),
        format!("-DevMode:${}", is_dev),
        "-Configuration".to_string(),
        settings.configuration,
        "-ActiveSaveProfile".to_string(),
        if settings.active_save_profile.trim().is_empty() {
            saves::DEFAULT_PROFILE_ID.to_string()
        } else {
            settings.active_save_profile
        },
    ];

    if !is_dev {
        args.push("-DisableLogging".to_string());
    }

    let mut cmd = Command::new("powershell.exe");
    cmd.args(&args).current_dir(&root);

    if let Some(ref p) = log_file_path {
        let out_file = fs::File::create(p)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to create launch log: {}", e))?;
        let err_file = out_file
            .try_clone()
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to clone file handle: {}", e))?;
        cmd.stdout(out_file).stderr(err_file);
    } else {
        cmd.stdout(Stdio::null()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
    }

    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        const CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP: u32 = 0x00000200;
        const CREATE_NO_WINDOW: u32 = 0x08000000;
        cmd.creation_flags(CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
    }

    let mut child = cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| format!("Failed to spawn runner process: {}", e))?;

    // Allow PowerShell 1.5s to validate parameters and launch majin.exe
    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1500));

    match child.try_wait() {
        Ok(Some(status)) => {
            let detail = if let Some(ref p) = log_file_path {
                fs::read_to_string(p).unwrap_or_default()
            } else if let Some(mut stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
                use std::io::Read;
                let mut buf = String::new();
                let _ = stderr.read_to_string(&mut buf);
                buf
            } else {
                String::new()
            };
            let trimmed = detail.trim();
            let msg = if !trimmed.is_empty() {
                trimmed
            } else {
                "PowerShell process terminated unexpectedly."
            };
            Err(format!("Game failed to start (exit status {}):\n\n{}", status, msg))
        }
        Ok(None) => {
            std::thread::spawn(|| {
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300));
                std::process::exit(0);
            });
            Ok(())
        }
        Err(e) => {
            Err(format!("Failed to monitor game process: {}", e))
        }
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn minimize_window(window: tauri::Window) {
    let _ = window.minimize();
}

#[tauri::command]
fn toggle_maximize_window(window: tauri::Window) {
    if let Ok(is_max) = window.is_maximized() {
        if is_max {
            let _ = window.unmaximize();
        } else {
            let _ = window.maximize();
        }
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn close_window(window: tauri::Window) {
    let _ = window.close();
    std::process::exit(0);
}

#[tauri::command]
fn is_window_maximized(window: tauri::Window) -> bool {
    window.is_maximized().unwrap_or(false)
}

/// Moves the window while the left mouse button is held. Tauri's native start_dragging()
/// returns Ok but does not move the window here (WebView2 keeps the mouse capture), so the
/// drag is driven manually: poll the cursor and move the window until the button is released.
#[tauri::command]
fn start_drag_window(window: tauri::Window) {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        #[repr(C)]
        struct Pt { x: i32, y: i32 }
        #[repr(C)]
        struct Rc { l: i32, t: i32, r: i32, b: i32 }
        #[link(name = "user32")]
        extern "system" {
            fn GetCursorPos(p: *mut Pt) -> i32;
            fn GetAsyncKeyState(vk: i32) -> i16;
            fn GetWindowRect(h: isize, r: *mut Rc) -> i32;
            fn SetWindowPos(h: isize, after: isize, x: i32, y: i32, cx: i32, cy: i32, flags: u32) -> i32;
        }
        // Maximized windows are not dragged.
        if window.is_maximized().unwrap_or(false) {
            return;
        }
        let hwnd = match window.hwnd() {
            Ok(h) => h.0 as isize,
            Err(_) => return,
        };
        std::thread::spawn(move || unsafe {
            const VK_LBUTTON: i32 = 0x01;
            const SWP_NOSIZE_NOZORDER_NOACTIVATE: u32 = 0x0001 | 0x0004 | 0x0010;
            let mut start = Pt { x: 0, y: 0 };
            let mut rect = Rc { l: 0, t: 0, r: 0, b: 0 };
            if GetCursorPos(&mut start) == 0 || GetWindowRect(hwnd, &mut rect) == 0 {
                return;
            }
            let (off_x, off_y) = (rect.l - start.x, rect.t - start.y);
            // Only drag while the left button is actually down.
            while (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0 {
                let mut cur = Pt { x: 0, y: 0 };
                if GetCursorPos(&mut cur) != 0 {
                    SetWindowPos(hwnd, 0, cur.x + off_x, cur.y + off_y, 0, 0, SWP_NOSIZE_NOZORDER_NOACTIVATE);
                }
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(8));
            }
        });
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    {
        let _ = window.start_dragging();
    }
}

fn process_failed_kind_to_str(kind: i32) -> &'static str {
    match kind {
        0 => "BROWSER_PROCESS_EXITED",
        1 => "RENDER_PROCESS_EXITED",
        2 => "RENDER_PROCESS_UNRESPONSIVE",
        3 => "FRAME_RENDER_PROCESS_EXITED",
        4 => "UTILITY_PROCESS_EXITED",
        5 => "SANDBOX_HELPER_PROCESS_EXITED",
        6 => "GPU_PROCESS_EXITED",
        7 => "PPAPI_PLUGIN_PROCESS_EXITED",
        8 => "PPAPI_BROKER_PROCESS_EXITED",
        9 => "UNKNOWN_PROCESS_EXITED",
        _ => "OTHER",
    }
}

pub fn is_dev_or_debug() -> bool {
    DEV_MODE_RUNTIME.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
        || cfg!(debug_assertions)
        || cfg!(feature = "dev-mode")
        || std::env::args().any(|a| {
            a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("--debug")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("--dev")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("-debug")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("-dev")
        })
}

#[tauri::command]
fn is_dev_mode() -> bool {
    is_dev_or_debug()
}

#[tauri::command]
fn set_dev_mode(enabled: bool) {
    DEV_MODE_RUNTIME.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub fn write_debug_log(msg: &str) {
    if !is_dev_or_debug() {
        return;
    }
    let path = std::env::current_exe()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("launcher-debug.log")))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("launcher-debug.log"));
    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(&path) {
        use std::io::Write;
        let ts = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.3f");
        let _ = writeln!(f, "[{}] [RUST] {}", ts, msg);
        let _ = f.flush();
    }
}

/// Queries recent Application Error / WER events (last 2 minutes) and writes the
/// faulting module info into launcher-debug.log. Also records where WebView2 logs live.
fn collect_crash_events() {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        let query = "*[System[(Level=2) and TimeCreated[timediff(@SystemTime) <= 120000]]]";
        match Command::new("wevtutil")
            .args(["qe", "Application", &format!("/q:{}", query), "/c:6", "/rd:true", "/f:text"])
            .creation_flags(0x08000000)
            .output()
        {
            Ok(out) => {
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
                let mut kept = 0;
                for line in text.lines() {
                    let l = line.trim();
                    if l.is_empty() { continue; }
                    write_debug_log(&format!("[CRASH_EVENT] {}", l));
                    kept += 1;
                    if kept > 120 { break; }
                }
                if kept == 0 {
                    write_debug_log("[CRASH_EVENT] No Application error events found in last 2 minutes");
                }
            }
            Err(e) => write_debug_log(&format!("[CRASH_EVENT] wevtutil failed: {}", e)),
        }
        if let Ok(local) = std::env::var("LOCALAPPDATA") {
            write_debug_log(&format!("[CRASH_EVENT] LOCALAPPDATA={} (check <identifier>\\EBWebView for logs/Crashpad dumps)", local));
        }
    }
}

/// Issue #6: overlay hooks (MSI Afterburner / RTSS) crash the WebView2 browser process
/// right after startup. The WebView cannot be recovered in-process, so either tell the
/// user how to fix it (overlay detected) or relaunch the launcher a limited number of times.
fn handle_browser_process_exit() {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));

        let overlay = ["RTSS.exe", "MSIAfterburner.exe", "RTSSHooksLoader64.exe"].iter().find(|name| {
            Command::new("tasklist")
                .args(["/FI", &format!("IMAGENAME eq {}", name), "/NH"])
                .creation_flags(0x08000000)
                .output()
                .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).to_lowercase().contains(&name.to_lowercase()))
                .unwrap_or(false)
        });

        if let Some(name) = overlay {
            write_debug_log(&format!("[RECOVERY] Overlay process detected: {}. Showing guidance.", name));
            let text = r#"Majistic Launcher was closed because MSI Afterburner / RTSS (RivaTuner Statistics Server) is running and conflicts with the launcher's web UI.

To fix this (one time only):
1. Open RTSS (tray icon) and click 'Add' to add these two programs:
   - Majistic Launcher.exe (in the launcher folder)
   - msedgewebview2.exe (usually at: C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\Application\<version>\msedgewebview2.exe)
2. For each one, set 'Application detection level' to 'None'.
3. Open the launcher again.

RTSS will still work normally in the game itself; these two exclusions only affect the launcher window.

Alternatively, close MSI Afterburner / RTSS before opening the launcher."#;
            message_box("Majistic Launcher - RTSS / MSI Afterburner", text);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }

        let attempt: u32 = std::env::var("MAJISTIC_RELAUNCH").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        if attempt >= 2 {
            write_debug_log("[RECOVERY] Browser process exited again; giving up after 2 relaunches.");
            message_box(
                "Majistic Launcher",
                "The launcher UI failed repeatedly (WebView2 process exited). Close overlay / monitoring software (MSI Afterburner, RTSS, etc.) and try again. See launcher-debug.log for details.",
            );
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        write_debug_log(&format!("[RECOVERY] Relaunching launcher (attempt {}/2)...", attempt + 1));
        if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
            let _ = Command::new(exe).env("MAJISTIC_RELAUNCH", (attempt + 1).to_string()).spawn();
        }
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn message_box(title: &str, text: &str) {
    use windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{MessageBoxW, MB_ICONWARNING, MB_OK, MB_TOPMOST};
    let t: Vec<u16> = title.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
    let m: Vec<u16> = text.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
    unsafe {
        MessageBoxW(std::ptr::null_mut(), m.as_ptr(), t.as_ptr(), MB_ICONWARNING | MB_OK | MB_TOPMOST);
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn log_message(msg: String) {
    if !is_dev_or_debug() {
        return;
    }
    let path = std::env::current_exe()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("launcher-debug.log")))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("launcher-debug.log"));
    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path) {
        use std::io::Write;
        let ts = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.3f");
        let _ = writeln!(f, "[{}] [JS] {}", ts, msg);
        let _ = f.flush();
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn exit_app() {
    std::process::exit(0);
}

#[tauri::command]
fn open_external_url(url: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    if !url.starts_with("https://") && !url.starts_with("http://") {
        return Err("Invalid URL protocol".to_string());
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        const CREATE_NO_WINDOW: u32 = 0x08000000;
        std::process::Command::new("cmd")
            .args(["/C", "start", "", &url])
            .creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to open URL: {}", e))?;
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    {
        std::process::Command::new("xdg-open")
            .arg(&url)
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to open URL: {}", e))?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn get_connected_gamepads() -> Vec<String> {
    let mut gamepads: Vec<String> = Vec::new();

    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::ffi::c_void;

        #[repr(C)]
        struct RAWINPUTDEVICELIST {
            h_device: *mut c_void,
            dw_type: u32,
            _pad: u32,
        }

        #[repr(C)]
        struct RID_DEVICE_INFO_HID {
            dw_vendor_id: u32,
            dw_product_id: u32,
            dw_version_number: u32,
            us_usage_page: u16,
            us_usage: u16,
        }

        #[repr(C)]
        struct RID_DEVICE_INFO {
            cb_size: u32,
            dw_type: u32,
            hid: RID_DEVICE_INFO_HID,
            _pad: [u8; 8],
        }

        extern "system" {
            fn GetRawInputDeviceList(
                p_raw_input_device_list: *mut RAWINPUTDEVICELIST,
                pui_num_devices: *mut u32,
                cb_size: u32,
            ) -> u32;

            fn GetRawInputDeviceInfoW(
                h_device: *mut c_void,
                ui_command: u32,
                p_data: *mut c_void,
                pcb_size: *mut u32,
            ) -> u32;
        }

        let mut num_devices: u32 = 0;
        let list_item_size = std::mem::size_of::<RAWINPUTDEVICELIST>() as u32;
        let mut xinput_raw_count: usize = 0;

        unsafe {
            if GetRawInputDeviceList(std::ptr::null_mut(), &mut num_devices, list_item_size) != u32::MAX
                && num_devices > 0
            {
                let mut list: Vec<RAWINPUTDEVICELIST> = Vec::with_capacity(num_devices as usize);
                list.set_len(num_devices as usize);
                let count = GetRawInputDeviceList(list.as_mut_ptr(), &mut num_devices, list_item_size);
                if count != u32::MAX {
                    for dev in list.iter().take(count as usize) {
                        if dev.dw_type == 2 {
                            // RIM_TYPEHID
                            let mut info: RID_DEVICE_INFO = std::mem::zeroed();
                            info.cb_size = std::mem::size_of::<RID_DEVICE_INFO>() as u32;
                            let mut info_size = info.cb_size;

                            let res = GetRawInputDeviceInfoW(
                                dev.h_device,
                                0x2000000b, // RIDI_DEVICEINFO
                                &mut info as *mut _ as *mut c_void,
                                &mut info_size,
                            );

                            if res != u32::MAX {
                                let page = info.hid.us_usage_page;
                                let usage = info.hid.us_usage;
                                if page == 1 && (usage == 4 || usage == 5 || usage == 8) {
                                    let mut name_size: u32 = 0;
                                    let mut is_xinput = false;
                                    GetRawInputDeviceInfoW(
                                        dev.h_device,
                                        0x20000007, // RIDI_DEVICENAME
                                        std::ptr::null_mut(),
                                        &mut name_size,
                                    );
                                    if name_size > 0 {
                                        let mut name_buf: Vec<u16> = Vec::with_capacity(name_size as usize);
                                        name_buf.set_len(name_size as usize);
                                        if GetRawInputDeviceInfoW(
                                            dev.h_device,
                                            0x20000007,
                                            name_buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void,
                                            &mut name_size,
                                        ) != u32::MAX
                                        {
                                            let path_str = String::from_utf16_lossy(&name_buf);
                                            let upper = path_str.to_uppercase();
                                            if upper.contains("&IG_") || info.hid.dw_vendor_id == 0x045E {
                                                is_xinput = true;
                                                xinput_raw_count += 1;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    let vid = info.hid.dw_vendor_id;
                                    let pid = info.hid.dw_product_id;
                                    let name = match vid {
                                        0x3537 => match pid {
                                            0x1040 => "GameSir T4 Nova Lite".to_string(),
                                            0x1005 => "GameSir G7".to_string(),
                                            0x1008 => "GameSir G7 SE".to_string(),
                                            0x1010..=0x1012 => "GameSir T4 Pro".to_string(),
                                            0x1025 => "GameSir Cyclone".to_string(),
                                            _ => "GameSir Controller".to_string(),
                                        },
                                        0x054C => match pid {
                                            0x09CC | 0x05C4 | 0x0BA0 => {
                                                "Sony DualShock 4 Wireless Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                            0x0CE6 | 0x0DF2 => {
                                                "Sony DualSense Wireless Controller (PS5)".to_string()
                                            }
                                            0x0268 => "Sony DualShock 3 Controller".to_string(),
                                            _ => "PlayStation Controller".to_string(),
                                        },
                                        0x045E => match pid {
                                            0x028E | 0x028F | 0x0288 => "Xbox 360 Controller".to_string(),
                                            0x02A1 | 0x0719 | 0x0291 | 0x02A9 | 0x0219 => {
                                                "Xbox 360 Wireless Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                            0x02D1 | 0x02DD | 0x02EA | 0x02FD | 0x0B12 | 0x0B13
                                            | 0x0B20 | 0x0B22 => {
                                                "Xbox Wireless Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                            0x02E3 | 0x0B00 | 0x0B05 => {
                                                "Xbox Elite Wireless Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                            0x0B0A | 0x0B21 => {
                                                "Xbox Adaptive Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                            _ => "Xbox Controller".to_string(),
                                        },
                                        0x057E => match pid {
                                            0x2009 => "Nintendo Switch Pro Controller".to_string(),
                                            0x2006 | 0x2007 => {
                                                "Nintendo Switch Joy-Con".to_string()
                                            }
                                            _ => "Nintendo Controller".to_string(),
                                        },
                                        0x2DC8 | 0x05A0 => "8BitDo Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x0F0D => "Hori Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x1532 => "Razer Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x1038 => "SteelSeries Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x24C6 | 0x0E6F => "PowerA / PDP Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x2563 | 0x11C0 => "Flydigi Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x20BC => "EasySMX Controller".to_string(),
                                        0x28DE => "Steam Controller".to_string(),
                                        _ => {
                                            if is_xinput {
                                                "Xbox Controller".to_string()
                                            } else if usage == 5 {
                                                "Wireless / USB Controller".to_string()
                                            } else {
                                                "Joystick Controller".to_string()
                                            }
                                        }
                                    };
                                    if !gamepads.contains(&name) {
                                        gamepads.push(name);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Also check XInput controllers (ports 0..3)
            // Only add an Xbox Controller entry if there are active XInput ports that
            // were not already mapped/accounted for by the RawInput &IG_ enumeration.
            type PfnXInputGetState = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut u8) -> u32;

            for dll_name in [
                b"xinput1_4.dll\0".as_ptr(),
                b"xinput1_3.dll\0".as_ptr(),
                b"xinput9_1_0.dll\0".as_ptr(),
            ] {
                let h_mod = windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::LoadLibraryA(dll_name);
                if !h_mod.is_null() {
                    let proc = windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::GetProcAddress(
                        h_mod,
                        b"XInputGetState\0".as_ptr(),
                    );
                    if let Some(pfn) = proc {
                        let get_state: PfnXInputGetState = std::mem::transmute(pfn);
                        let mut state = [0u8; 16];
                        let mut xinput_active_ports: usize = 0;
                        for port in 0..4 {
                            if get_state(port, state.as_mut_ptr()) == 0 {
                                xinput_active_ports += 1;
                            }
                        }

                        if xinput_active_ports > xinput_raw_count {
                            let unmapped = xinput_active_ports - xinput_raw_count;
                            for _ in 0..unmapped {
                                let name = "Xbox Controller".to_string();
                                if !gamepads.contains(&name) {
                                    gamepads.push(name);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::FreeLibrary(h_mod);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // Post-processing deduplication:
        // 1. If specific Xbox models are present, remove generic "Xbox Controller"
        if gamepads.iter().any(|g| g.starts_with("Xbox ") && g != "Xbox Controller") {
            gamepads.retain(|g| g != "Xbox Controller");
        }
        // 2. If specific Sony models are present, remove generic "PlayStation Controller"
        if gamepads.iter().any(|g| g.starts_with("Sony ") && g != "PlayStation Controller") {
            gamepads.retain(|g| g != "PlayStation Controller");
        }
        // 3. If specific GameSir models are present, remove generic "GameSir Controller"
        if gamepads.iter().any(|g| g.starts_with("GameSir ") && g != "GameSir Controller") {
            gamepads.retain(|g| g != "GameSir Controller");
        }
        // 4. If any named controller is present, remove generic fallbacks
        if gamepads.iter().any(|g| g != "Wireless / USB Controller" && g != "Joystick Controller") {
            gamepads.retain(|g| g != "Wireless / USB Controller" && g != "Joystick Controller");
        }
    }

    gamepads
}

#[cfg_attr(mobile, tauri::mobile_entry_point)]
pub fn run() {
    tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
        .on_window_event(|window, event| {
            if let tauri::WindowEvent::CloseRequested { .. } | tauri::WindowEvent::Destroyed = event {
                if window.label() == "main" {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
            }
        })
        .setup(|app| {
            if let Ok(loaded) = load_settings() {
                if loaded.dev_mode {
                    DEV_MODE_RUNTIME.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                }
            }
            write_debug_log("=== Setup Hook Entered ===");
            write_debug_log(&format!("OS Architecture: {}", std::env::consts::ARCH));

            #[cfg(windows)]
            {
                use tauri::Manager;
                if let Some(main_window) = app.get_webview_window("main") {
                    write_debug_log("Main WebviewWindow found. Initializing telemetry and listeners...");

                    if let Ok(hwnd) = main_window.hwnd() {
                        unsafe {
                            use windows_sys::Win32::Graphics::Dwm::{
                                DwmSetWindowAttribute,
                                DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE, DWMWCP_DONOTROUND,
                                DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR, DWMWA_COLOR_NONE,
                                DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE,
                            };

                            // 1. Tell DWM not to draw any native rounded system corners
                            let do_not_round = DWMWCP_DONOTROUND;
                            let _ = DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                                hwnd.0 as _,
                                DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE as u32,
                                &do_not_round as *const _ as *const _,
                                std::mem::size_of_val(&do_not_round) as u32,
                            );

                            // 2. Remove the Windows 11 1px native outer system border entirely
                            let border_none = DWMWA_COLOR_NONE;
                            let res_border = DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                                hwnd.0 as _,
                                DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR as u32,
                                &border_none as *const _ as *const _,
                                std::mem::size_of_val(&border_none) as u32,
                            );
                            write_debug_log(&format!("DwmSetWindowAttribute BORDER_COLOR (NONE) result: 0x{:X}", res_border));

                            // 3. Enable immersive dark mode
                            let dark_mode: i32 = 1;
                            let _ = DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                                hwnd.0 as _,
                                DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE as u32,
                                &dark_mode as *const _ as *const _,
                                std::mem::size_of_val(&dark_mode) as u32,
                            );
                        }
                    }

                    // Watchdog thread: checks window state periodically (dev-mode only)
                    if is_dev_or_debug() {
                        let window_for_watchdog = main_window.clone();
                        std::thread::spawn(move || {
                            let mut tick: u64 = 0;
                            loop {
                                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
                                tick += 1;
                                let is_visible = window_for_watchdog.is_visible().unwrap_or(false);
                                let is_minimized = window_for_watchdog.is_minimized().unwrap_or(false);
                                let is_focused = window_for_watchdog.is_focused().unwrap_or(false);
                                if tick % 4 == 0 || !is_visible || is_minimized {
                                    write_debug_log(&format!(
                                        "[Watchdog Heartbeat #{} ({}s)] window: visible={} minimized={} focused={}",
                                        tick, tick * 3, is_visible, is_minimized, is_focused
                                    ));
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    let _ = main_window.with_webview(move |webview| {
                        unsafe {
                            use webview2_com::Microsoft::Web::WebView2::Win32::*;
                            use webview2_com::{ProcessFailedEventHandler, AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler, NavigationCompletedEventHandler};
                            use windows_core::Interface;

                            let controller = webview.controller();
                            let environment = webview.environment();

                            if let Ok(c2) = controller.cast::<ICoreWebView2Controller2>() {
                                let _ = c2.SetDefaultBackgroundColor(COREWEBVIEW2_COLOR { A: 0, R: 0, G: 0, B: 0 });
                            }

                            let mut ver = windows_core::PWSTR::null();
                            if environment.BrowserVersionString(&mut ver).is_ok() && !ver.is_null() {
                                write_debug_log(&format!("CoreWebView2 Runtime Version: {}", ver.to_string().unwrap_or_default()));
                            }

                            if let Ok(core) = controller.CoreWebView2() {
                                let core_for_reload = core.clone();
                                let core_for_f5 = core.clone();

                                // 1. ProcessFailed Listener (covers all processes: GPU, Renderer, Utility, etc.)
                                let handler = ProcessFailedEventHandler::create(Box::new(move |_sender, args| {
                                    if let Some(args) = args {
                                        let mut kind = COREWEBVIEW2_PROCESS_FAILED_KIND(0);
                                        let _ = args.ProcessFailedKind(&mut kind);
                                        let kind_str = process_failed_kind_to_str(kind.0);
                                        let mut exit_code = 0i32;
                                        let mut desc_str = String::new();
                                        if let Ok(args2) = args.cast::<ICoreWebView2ProcessFailedEventArgs2>() {
                                            let mut code = 0i32;
                                            let _ = args2.ExitCode(&mut code);
                                            exit_code = code;
                                            let mut desc = windows_core::PWSTR::null();
                                            if args2.ProcessDescription(&mut desc).is_ok() && !desc.is_null() {
                                                desc_str = desc.to_string().unwrap_or_default();
                                            }
                                        }
                                        write_debug_log(&format!(
                                            "[PROCESS_FAILED] kind={} ({}) exit_code={} desc='{}'",
                                            kind.0, kind_str, exit_code, desc_str
                                        ));
                                        // Issue #6: capture the Windows Application event log
                                        // (faulting module / WER data) for this crash in dev mode.
                                        if is_dev_or_debug() {
                                            std::thread::spawn(|| {
                                                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
                                                collect_crash_events();
                                            });
                                        }
                                        // Browser process died (kind 0): the WebView is unrecoverable.
                                        if kind.0 == 0 {
                                            std::thread::spawn(handle_browser_process_exit);
                                        }
                                        // Auto-recovery: If renderer (1/2/3) or GPU (6) exited, trigger reload
                                        if kind.0 == 1 || kind.0 == 2 || kind.0 == 3 || kind.0 == 6 {
                                            write_debug_log("[PROCESS_FAILED] Triggering CoreWebView2.Reload() auto-recovery...");
                                            let res = core_for_reload.Reload();
                                            write_debug_log(&format!("[PROCESS_FAILED] Reload() returned: {:?}", res));
                                        } else {
                                            write_debug_log(&format!("[PROCESS_FAILED] Informational notification for kind={} (no action taken)", kind.0));
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(())
                                }));
                                let mut token = 0i64;
                                let _ = core.add_ProcessFailed(&handler, &mut token);

                                // 2. AcceleratorKeyPressed (Native Win32 key interception inside webview)
                                let acc_handler = AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler::create(Box::new(move |_ctrl, args| {
                                    if let Some(args) = args {
                                        let mut vk = 0u32;
                                        let _ = args.VirtualKey(&mut vk);
                                        let mut key_event = COREWEBVIEW2_KEY_EVENT_KIND(0);
                                        let _ = args.KeyEventKind(&mut key_event);
                                        // KeyDown is 0, SysKeyDown is 2
                                        if key_event.0 == 0 || key_event.0 == 2 {
                                            write_debug_log(&format!("[NATIVE_KEY] KeyDown vk=0x{:X} ({})", vk, vk));
                                            if vk == 0x74 { // VK_F5
                                                write_debug_log("[NATIVE_KEY] F5 key detected! Forcing native CoreWebView2.Reload()...");
                                                let res = core_for_f5.Reload();
                                                write_debug_log(&format!("[NATIVE_KEY] Reload() returned: {:?}", res));
                                                let _ = args.SetHandled(true);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(())
                                }));
                                let mut acc_token = 0i64;
                                let _ = controller.add_AcceleratorKeyPressed(&acc_handler, &mut acc_token);

                                // 3. NavigationCompleted Listener
                                let controller_for_nav = controller.clone();
                                let nav_handler = NavigationCompletedEventHandler::create(Box::new(move |_sender, args| {
                                    if let Some(args) = args {
                                        let mut is_success = windows_core::BOOL(0);
                                        let _ = args.IsSuccess(&mut is_success);
                                        let mut status = COREWEBVIEW2_WEB_ERROR_STATUS(0);
                                        let _ = args.WebErrorStatus(&mut status);
                                        write_debug_log(&format!(
                                            "[NAVIGATION_COMPLETED] is_success={} status={}",
                                            is_success.as_bool(), status.0
                                        ));
                                        // Synchronize controller bounds and visibility with DWM swapchain
                                        let _ = controller_for_nav.NotifyParentWindowPositionChanged();
                                        let _ = controller_for_nav.SetIsVisible(true);
                                    }
                                    Ok(())
                                }));
                                let mut nav_token = 0i64;
                                let _ = core.add_NavigationCompleted(&nav_handler, &mut nav_token);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            Ok(())
        })
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            load_settings,
            save_settings,
            check_game_status,
            get_available_languages,
            select_iso_file,
            select_game_data_folder,
            start_game_build,
            precompile_shaders,
            get_shader_cache_info,
            clean_shader_cache,
            launch_game,
            minimize_window,
            toggle_maximize_window,
            close_window,
            is_window_maximized,
            start_drag_window,
            log_message,
            is_dev_mode,
            set_dev_mode,
            exit_app,
            open_external_url,
            get_connected_gamepads,
            saves::list_save_profiles,
            saves::create_save_profile,
            saves::duplicate_save_profile,
            saves::rename_save_profile,
            saves::set_active_save_profile,
            saves::delete_save_profile,
            saves::export_save_profile,
            saves::pick_and_inspect_savistic,
            saves::import_save_profile,
            saves::open_saves_folder,
            updater::consume_clean_update_notice
        ])
        .run(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while running tauri application");
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_get_connected_gamepads() {
        let pads = get_connected_gamepads();
        println!("Connected gamepads: {:?}", pads);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_deserialize_settings_with_null_fov_scale() {
        let json = r#"{
            "WindowSize": "1920x1080",
            "Fullscreen": false,
            "RenderScale": 2,
            "RenderingPath": "Default",
            "FrameRateMode": "60",
            "VSync": true,
            "PostEffect": "fxaa",
            "Upscaler": "fsr",
            "SkipIntroLogos": true,
            "SkipCutscenes": true,
            "CutsceneSpeed": 4,
            "InputMode": "Controller",
            "MouseSensitivity": null,
            "RecordPerformance": true,
            "GameDataRoot": "game-data",
            "Configuration": "Release",
            "Language": "English",
            "StepFix": false,
            "AnimSpeedFix": true,
            "DtSmoothing": false,
            "FovScale": null,
            "DrawDistanceScale": null,
            "PauseBlur": null,
            "DepthOfField": true,
            "Bloom": true
        }"#;

        let parsed: Result<Settings, _> = serde_json::from_str(json);
        assert!(parsed.is_ok(), "Failed to deserialize settings with null fields: {:?}", parsed.err());
        let settings = parsed.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(settings.fov_scale, 1.0);
        assert_eq!(settings.draw_distance_scale, 1.0);
        assert_eq!(settings.mouse_sensitivity, 1.0);
        assert!(!settings.pause_blur);
        assert!(settings.pause_distortion);
        assert_eq!(settings.depth_of_field_intensity, 0.40);
        assert_eq!(settings.depth_of_field_mode, "bokeh");
        assert_eq!(settings.bloom_intensity, 0.80);
        assert_eq!(settings.fog_intensity, 0.80);
        assert_eq!(settings.cas_sharpness, 0.0);
        assert_eq!(settings.fsr_reduction, 0.0);
        assert!(!settings.window_fps);
        assert_eq!(settings.shadow_slope_bias, 0.30);
        assert_eq!(settings.shadow_constant_bias, 0.0);
        assert_eq!(settings.shadow_bias_clamp, 0.002);

    #[test]
    fn test_zip_deflate_support() {
        use std::io::Write;
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        {
            let mut writer = zip::ZipWriter::new(std::io::Cursor::new(&mut buf));
            let options = zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default()
                .compression_method(zip::CompressionMethod::Deflated);
            writer.start_file("test.txt", options).unwrap();
            writer.write_all(b"deflate test data").unwrap();
            writer.finish().unwrap();
        }

        let cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(buf);
        let mut archive = zip::ZipArchive::new(cursor).unwrap();
        let mut file = archive.by_name("test.txt").unwrap();
        let mut content = String::new();
        std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut file, &mut content).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(content, "deflate test data");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_detect_available_languages_pal_and_usa() {
        let base = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("majin_lang_test_{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&base);

        // Mock PAL edition: has kr.pak leftover on disc, plus us/po/du/ru, no jp
        let pal_dir = base.join("pal");
        let pal_pkg = pal_dir.join("finalizedXBox360/KB/package");
        let pal_snd = pal_dir.join("finalizedXBox360/KB/sound/xbox360");
        fs::create_dir_all(&pal_pkg).unwrap();
        fs::write(pal_dir.join("default.xex"), [0u8, 0, 0x67, 0xBD, 0x87, 0xEF, 0, 0]).unwrap();
        for p in ["us", "po", "sp", "fr", "ge", "it", "du", "ru", "kr"] {
            fs::write(pal_pkg.join(format!("{}.pak", p)), b"pak").unwrap();
        }
        for s in ["en", "po", "sp", "fr", "ge", "it", "du", "ru"] {
            let d = pal_snd.join(format!("rtd_{}", s));
            fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
            fs::write(d.join("000.gtd"), b"gtd").unwrap();
        }

        let pal_info = detect_available_languages_in_dir(&pal_dir);
        assert_eq!(pal_info.edition_code, "PAL");
        assert!(pal_info.detected_from_assets);
        let pal_texts: Vec<&str> = pal_info.text_languages.iter().map(|l| l.value.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(pal_texts, vec!["English", "Portuguese", "Spanish", "French", "German", "Italian", "Dutch", "Russian"]);
        assert!(!pal_texts.contains(&"Korean"));
        assert!(!pal_texts.contains(&"Japanese"));
        let pal_audios: Vec<&str> = pal_info.audio_languages.iter().map(|l| l.value.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(pal_audios, vec!["English", "Portuguese", "Spanish", "French", "German", "Italian", "Dutch", "Russian"]);

        // Mock USA edition: only EN/FR/SP/KR text and EN/FR/SP audio
        let usa_dir = base.join("usa");
        let usa_pkg = usa_dir.join("finalizedXBox360/KB/package");
        let usa_snd = usa_dir.join("finalizedXBox360/KB/sound/xbox360");
        fs::create_dir_all(&usa_pkg).unwrap();
        fs::write(usa_dir.join("default.xex"), [0u8, 0, 0x76, 0xFD, 0xB6, 0x42, 0, 0]).unwrap();
        for p in ["us", "fr", "sp", "kr", "po"] {
            fs::write(usa_pkg.join(format!("{}.pak", p)), b"pak").unwrap();
        }
        for s in ["en", "fr", "sp"] {
            let d = usa_snd.join(format!("rtd_{}", s));
            fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
            fs::write(d.join("000.gtd"), b"gtd").unwrap();
        }

        let usa_info = detect_available_languages_in_dir(&usa_dir);
        assert_eq!(usa_info.edition_code, "USA");
        let usa_texts: Vec<&str> = usa_info.text_languages.iter().map(|l| l.value.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(usa_texts, vec!["English", "Spanish", "French", "Korean"]);
        let usa_audios: Vec<&str> = usa_info.audio_languages.iter().map(|l| l.value.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(usa_audios, vec!["English", "Spanish", "French"]);

        // Uninstalled fallback
        let empty_info = detect_available_languages_in_dir(&base.join("missing"));
        assert_eq!(empty_info.edition_code, "NotInstalled");
        assert!(!empty_info.detected_from_assets);
        assert_eq!(empty_info.text_languages.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(empty_info.text_languages[0].value, "English");

        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&base);
    }
}
```

`launcher/src-tauri/src/main.rs`:

```rs
#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]

use std::fs::OpenOptions;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub fn is_dev_or_debug() -> bool {
    cfg!(feature = "dev-mode")
        || std::env::args().any(|a| {
            a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("--debug")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("--dev")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("-debug")
                || a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("-dev")
        })
}

pub fn write_log(msg: &str) {
    if !is_dev_or_debug() {
        return;
    }
    let path = std::env::current_exe()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("launcher-debug.log")))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("launcher-debug.log"));
    if let Ok(mut f) = OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open(&path)
    {
        let ts = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.3f");
        let _ = writeln!(f, "[{}] [MAIN] {}", ts, msg);
        let _ = f.flush();
    }
}

fn handle_update_mode() -> bool {
    majistic_launcher_lib::updater::handle_update_mode(&write_log)
}

fn main() {
    let is_dev = is_dev_or_debug();
    let exe_path = std::env::current_exe().unwrap_or_default();
    let exe_dir = exe_path.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    let chromium_log = exe_dir.join("launcher-chromium.log");

    if is_dev {
        write_log("==================================================");
        write_log("=== Majistic Launcher Diagnostic Session Start ===");
        write_log(&format!("Exe Path: {}", exe_path.display()));
        write_log(&format!("Working Dir: {}", std::env::current_dir().map(|d| d.display().to_string()).unwrap_or_default()));
        write_log(&format!("Chromium Log Destination: {}", chromium_log.display()));
    }

    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        // Use Microsoft WARP (Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform) for the ANGLE backend.
        // This ensures DirectComposition remains fully functional with DWM, while bypassing physical GPU
        // driver crashes, MPO plane drops, and idle renderer freezes on AMD Radeon GPUs.
        let existing = std::env::var("WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS").unwrap_or_default();

        let full = "--use-angle=warp --disable-direct-composition-video-overlays --disable-gpu-watchdog --disable-renderer-code-integrity --disable-webgpu --disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion,OptimizationGuideModelDownloading,OptimizationHints,Dawn,Graphite --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-renderer-backgrounding";

        // Chromium engine logging is only enabled if explicitly requested via
        // MAJISTIC_CHROMIUM_LOG=1 or --chromium-log CLI arg. Passing --enable-logging
        // causes Edge/Chromium to call AllocConsole(), which spawns an annoying popup
        // console window titled 'msedgewebview2.exe'.
        let enable_chromium_log = std::env::var("MAJISTIC_CHROMIUM_LOG").map(|v| v == "1").unwrap_or(false)
            || std::env::args().any(|a| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case("--chromium-log"));

        let logging = if enable_chromium_log {
            let log_path_normalized = chromium_log.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
            format!(" --enable-logging --log-file={}", log_path_normalized)
        } else {
            String::new()
        };

        // Diagnostic mode (issue #6): env MAJISTIC_WEBVIEW_MODE or first line of
        // "webview-mode.txt" next to the exe. Modes:
        //   full    (default) all custom flags
        //   minimal only CalculateNativeWinOcclusion + logging
        //   none    no custom flags except logging
        //   noa11y  full + accessibility/UIA disabled
        //   nogpu   full + --disable-gpu
        let mode_file = std::fs::read_to_string(exe_dir.join("webview-mode.txt")).unwrap_or_default();
        let mode = std::env::var("MAJISTIC_WEBVIEW_MODE")
            .ok()
            .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| mode_file.lines().next().unwrap_or("").to_string())
            .trim()
            .to_lowercase();
        let mode = if mode.is_empty() { "full".to_string() } else { mode };
        if is_dev {
            write_log(&format!("WebView mode: {}", mode));
        }

        let flags = match mode.as_str() {
            "none" => logging.trim().to_string(),
            "minimal" => format!("--disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion{}", logging),
            "noa11y" => format!("{} --disable-renderer-accessibility --disable-features=UiaProvider{}", full, logging),
            "nogpu" => format!("{} --disable-gpu{}", full, logging),
            _ => format!("{}{}", full, logging),
        };
        let combined = if existing.is_empty() {
            flags
        } else {
            format!("{} {}", flags, existing)
        };
        std::env::set_var("WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS", &combined);
        if is_dev {
            write_log(&format!("Set WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS: {}", combined));
        }
    }

    if handle_update_mode() {
        return;
    }

    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|info| {
        let msg = format!("PANIC: {}", info);
        write_log(&msg);

        #[cfg(windows)]
        unsafe {
            use std::ffi::CString;
            let title = CString::new("Majistic Launcher Error").unwrap_or_default();
            let body = CString::new(msg.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
            windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::MessageBoxA(
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                body.as_ptr() as *const u8,
                title.as_ptr() as *const u8,
                windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::MB_ICONERROR | windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::MB_OK,
            );
        }
    }));

    if is_dev {
        write_log("Calling majistic_launcher_lib::run()...");
    }
    majistic_launcher_lib::run();
    if is_dev {
        write_log("majistic_launcher_lib::run() finished.");
    }
}
```

```rs
use flate2::read::ZlibDecoder;
use serde::Deserialize;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

// =============================================================================
// Pure-Rust XXH3_64bits (seed = 0, default secret)
// =============================================================================

const PRIME32_1: u64 = 0x9E3779B1;
const PRIME32_2: u64 = 0x85EBCA77;
const PRIME32_3: u64 = 0xC2B2AE3D;

const PRIME64_1: u64 = 0x9E3779B185EBCA87;
const PRIME64_2: u64 = 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4F;
const PRIME64_3: u64 = 0x165667B19E3779F9;
const PRIME64_4: u64 = 0x85EBCA77C2B2AE63;
const PRIME64_5: u64 = 0x27D4EB2F165667C5;

const PRIME_MX1: u64 = 0x165667919E3779F9;
const PRIME_MX2: u64 = 0x9FB21C651E98DF25;

const DEFAULT_SECRET: [u8; 192] = [
    0xb8, 0xfe, 0x6c, 0x39, 0x23, 0xa4, 0x4b, 0xbe, 0x7c, 0x01, 0x81, 0x2c, 0xf7, 0x21, 0xad, 0x1c,
    0xde, 0xd4, 0x6d, 0xe9, 0x83, 0x90, 0x97, 0xdb, 0x72, 0x40, 0xa4, 0xa4, 0xb7, 0xb3, 0x67, 0x1f,
    0xcb, 0x79, 0xe6, 0x4e, 0xcc, 0xc0, 0xe5, 0x78, 0x82, 0x5a, 0xd0, 0x7d, 0xcc, 0xff, 0x72, 0x21,
    0xb8, 0x08, 0x46, 0x74, 0xf7, 0x43, 0x24, 0x8e, 0xe0, 0x35, 0x90, 0xe6, 0x81, 0x3a, 0x26, 0x4c,
    0x3c, 0x28, 0x52, 0xbb, 0x91, 0xc3, 0x00, 0xcb, 0x88, 0xd0, 0x65, 0x8b, 0x1b, 0x53, 0x2e, 0xa3,
    0x71, 0x64, 0x48, 0x97, 0xa2, 0x0d, 0xf9, 0x4e, 0x38, 0x19, 0xef, 0x46, 0xa9, 0xde, 0xac, 0xd8,
    0xa8, 0xfa, 0x76, 0x3f, 0xe3, 0x9c, 0x34, 0x3f, 0xf9, 0xdc, 0xbb, 0xc7, 0xc7, 0x0b, 0x4f, 0x1d,
    0x8a, 0x51, 0xe0, 0x4b, 0xcd, 0xb4, 0x59, 0x31, 0xc8, 0x9f, 0x7e, 0xc9, 0xd9, 0x78, 0x73, 0x64,
    0xea, 0xc5, 0xac, 0x83, 0x34, 0xd3, 0xeb, 0xc3, 0xc5, 0x81, 0xa0, 0xff, 0xfa, 0x13, 0x63, 0xeb,
    0x17, 0x0d, 0xdd, 0x51, 0xb7, 0xf0, 0xda, 0x49, 0xd3, 0x16, 0x55, 0x26, 0x29, 0xd4, 0x68, 0x9e,
    0x2b, 0x16, 0xbe, 0x58, 0x7d, 0x47, 0xa1, 0xfc, 0x8f, 0xf8, 0xb8, 0xd1, 0x7a, 0xd0, 0x31, 0xce,
    0x45, 0xcb, 0x3a, 0x8f, 0x95, 0x16, 0x04, 0x28, 0xaf, 0xd7, 0xfb, 0xca, 0xbb, 0x4b, 0x40, 0x7e,
];

#[inline]
fn read_u32_le(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u32 {
    u32::from_le_bytes([
        bytes[offset],
        bytes[offset + 1],
        bytes[offset + 2],
        bytes[offset + 3],
    ])
}

#[inline]
fn read_u64_le(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u64 {
    u64::from_le_bytes([
        bytes[offset],
        bytes[offset + 1],
        bytes[offset + 2],
        bytes[offset + 3],
        bytes[offset + 4],
        bytes[offset + 5],
        bytes[offset + 6],
        bytes[offset + 7],
    ])
}

#[inline]
fn read_secret_u32(offset: usize) -> u32 {
    read_u32_le(&DEFAULT_SECRET, offset)
}

#[inline]
fn read_secret_u64(offset: usize) -> u64 {
    read_u64_le(&DEFAULT_SECRET, offset)
}

#[inline]
fn mul128_fold64(lhs: u64, rhs: u64) -> u64 {
    let prod = (lhs as u128).wrapping_mul(rhs as u128);
    (prod as u64) ^ ((prod >> 64) as u64)
}

#[inline]
fn xxh64_avalanche(mut h: u64) -> u64 {
    h ^= h >> 33;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(PRIME64_2);
    h ^= h >> 29;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(PRIME64_3);
    h ^= h >> 32;
    h
}

#[inline]
fn xxh3_avalanche(mut h: u64) -> u64 {
    h ^= h >> 37;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(PRIME_MX1);
    h ^= h >> 32;
    h
}

#[inline]
fn rrmxmx(mut h: u64, len: u64) -> u64 {
    h ^= h.rotate_left(49) ^ h.rotate_left(24);
    h = h.wrapping_mul(PRIME_MX2);
    h ^= (h >> 35).wrapping_add(len);
    h = h.wrapping_mul(PRIME_MX2);
    h ^ (h >> 28)
}

#[inline]
fn mix16b(bytes: &[u8], input_offset: usize, secret_offset: usize) -> u64 {
    let input_lo = read_u64_le(bytes, input_offset);
    let input_hi = read_u64_le(bytes, input_offset + 8);
    let key_lo = read_secret_u64(secret_offset);
    let key_hi = read_secret_u64(secret_offset + 8);
    mul128_fold64(input_lo ^ key_lo, input_hi ^ key_hi)
}

fn accumulate_512(acc: &mut [u64; 8], bytes: &[u8], input_offset: usize, secret_offset: usize) {
    for i in 0..8 {
        let data_val = read_u64_le(bytes, input_offset + i * 8);
        let data_key = data_val ^ read_secret_u64(secret_offset + i * 8);
        acc[i ^ 1] = acc[i ^ 1].wrapping_add(data_val);
        let prod = (data_key & 0xFFFF_FFFF).wrapping_mul(data_key >> 32);
        acc[i] = acc[i].wrapping_add(prod);
    }
}

fn scramble_acc(acc: &mut [u64; 8], secret_offset: usize) {
    for i in 0..8 {
        let mut v = acc[i];
        v ^= v >> 47;
        v ^= read_secret_u64(secret_offset + i * 8);
        v = v.wrapping_mul(PRIME32_1);
        acc[i] = v;
    }
}

fn merge_accs(acc: &[u64; 8], secret_offset: usize, start: u64) -> u64 {
    let mut result = start;
    for i in 0..4 {
        let a0 = acc[2 * i] ^ read_secret_u64(secret_offset + 16 * i);
        let a1 = acc[2 * i + 1] ^ read_secret_u64(secret_offset + 16 * i + 8);
        result = result.wrapping_add(mul128_fold64(a0, a1));
    }
    xxh3_avalanche(result)
}

pub fn xxh3_64bits(bytes: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    let len = bytes.len();
    if len == 0 {
        return xxh64_avalanche(read_secret_u64(56) ^ read_secret_u64(64));
    }
    if len <= 3 {
        let c1 = bytes[0] as u64;
        let c2 = bytes[len >> 1] as u64;
        let c3 = bytes[len - 1] as u64;
        let combined = (c1 << 16) | (c2 << 24) | c3 | ((len as u64) << 8);
        let bitflip = (read_secret_u32(0) ^ read_secret_u32(4)) as u64;
        return xxh64_avalanche(combined ^ bitflip);
    }
    if len <= 8 {
        let input1 = read_u32_le(bytes, 0) as u64;
        let input2 = read_u32_le(bytes, len - 4) as u64;
        let bitflip = read_secret_u64(8) ^ read_secret_u64(16);
        let input64 = input2.wrapping_add(input1 << 32);
        return rrmxmx(input64 ^ bitflip, len as u64);
    }
    if len <= 16 {
        let bitflip1 = read_secret_u64(24) ^ read_secret_u64(32);
        let bitflip2 = read_secret_u64(40) ^ read_secret_u64(48);
        let input_lo = read_u64_le(bytes, 0) ^ bitflip1;
        let input_hi = read_u64_le(bytes, len - 8) ^ bitflip2;
        let acc = (len as u64)
            .wrapping_add(input_lo.swap_bytes())
            .wrapping_add(input_hi)
            .wrapping_add(mul128_fold64(input_lo, input_hi));
        return xxh3_avalanche(acc);
    }
    if len <= 128 {
        let mut acc = (len as u64).wrapping_mul(PRIME64_1);
        if len > 32 {
            if len > 64 {
                if len > 96 {
                    acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 48, 96));
                    acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, len - 64, 112));
                }
                acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 32, 64));
                acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, len - 48, 80));
            }
            acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 16, 32));
            acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, len - 32, 48));
        }
        acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 0, 0));
        acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, len - 16, 16));
        return xxh3_avalanche(acc);
    }
    if len <= 240 {
        let mut acc = (len as u64).wrapping_mul(PRIME64_1);
        let nb_rounds = len / 16;
        for i in 0..8 {
            acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 16 * i, 16 * i));
        }
        acc = xxh3_avalanche(acc);
        for i in 8..nb_rounds {
            acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, 16 * i, 16 * (i - 8) + 3));
        }
        acc = acc.wrapping_add(mix16b(bytes, len - 16, 136 - 17));
        return xxh3_avalanche(acc);
    }

    let mut acc: [u64; 8] = [
        PRIME32_3, PRIME64_1, PRIME64_2, PRIME64_3, PRIME64_4, PRIME32_2, PRIME64_5, PRIME32_1,
    ];
    let secret_len = 192;
    let stripe_len = 64;
    let nb_stripes_per_block = (secret_len - stripe_len) / 8; // 16
    let block_len = stripe_len * nb_stripes_per_block; // 1024
    let nb_blocks = (len - 1) / block_len;

    for n in 0..nb_blocks {
        for s in 0..nb_stripes_per_block {
            accumulate_512(&mut acc, bytes, n * block_len + s * stripe_len, s * 8);
        }
        scramble_acc(&mut acc, secret_len - stripe_len);
    }

    let nb_stripes = (len - 1 - block_len * nb_blocks) / stripe_len;
    for s in 0..nb_stripes {
        accumulate_512(&mut acc, bytes, nb_blocks * block_len + s * stripe_len, s * 8);
    }
    accumulate_512(&mut acc, bytes, len - stripe_len, secret_len - stripe_len - 7);

    merge_accs(&acc, 11, (len as u64).wrapping_mul(PRIME64_1))
}

#[allow(dead_code)]

fn decode_hex(hex_str: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    if hex_str.len() % 2 != 0 {
        return Err(format!("Odd hex string length: {}", hex_str.len()));
    }
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(hex_str.len() / 2);
    for i in (0..hex_str.len()).step_by(2) {
        let byte = u8::from_str_radix(&hex_str[i..i + 2], 16)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid hex at {}: {}", i, e))?;
        out.push(byte);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn find_prebuild_resources_dir(root: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let candidates = [
        root.join("launcher/resources/prebuild"),
        root.join("resources/prebuild"),
    ];
    for dir in &candidates {
        if dir.join("shader_recipes.json").exists() && dir.join("4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl").exists() {
            return Ok(dir.clone());
        }
    }
    Err(format!(
        "Clean-room prebuild resources (shader_recipes.json / 4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl) not found under {}",
        root.display()
    ))
}

fn resolve_iso_source_file(game_data_dir: &Path, rel_source: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let candidates = [
        game_data_dir.join("finalizedXBox360").join(rel_source),
        game_data_dir.join(rel_source),
    ];
    for p in &candidates {
        if p.exists() {
            return Ok(p.clone());
        }
    }
    Err(format!(
        "Required ISO asset '{}' not found in '{}' (or finalizedXBox360/). Please extract your game ISO first.",
        rel_source,
        game_data_dir.display()
    ))
}

fn resolve_decrypted_loaded_image(root: &Path, game_data_dir: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let candidates = [
        game_data_dir.join("unpacked/loaded-image.bin"),
        root.join("prototype/private/loaded-image.bin"),
        root.join("prototype-usa/private/loaded-image.bin"),
    ];
    for p in &candidates {
        if let Ok(mut f) = fs::File::open(p) {
            let mut magic = [0u8; 2];
            if f.read_exact(&mut magic).is_ok() && &magic == b"MZ" {
                return Some(p.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn rebuild_prebuild_shader_cache(
    root: &Path,
    game_data_dir: &Path,
    configuration: &str,
    emit_log: &dyn Fn(&str),
) -> Result<RebuildSummary, String> {
    let res_dir = find_prebuild_resources_dir(root)?;
    let recipes_path = res_dir.join("shader_recipes.json");
    let xpl_src_path = res_dir.join("4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl");

    let json_text = fs::read_to_string(&recipes_path)
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read {}: {}", recipes_path.display(), e))?;
    let manifest: ShaderRecipesManifest = serde_json::from_str(&json_text)
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to parse shader_recipes.json: {}", e))?;

    let decrypted_loaded_image = resolve_decrypted_loaded_image(root, game_data_dir);
    if let Some(ref img_path) = decrypted_loaded_image {
        emit_log(&format!(
            "[Clean-Room] Found decrypted PE executable image: {}",
            img_path.display()
        ));
    } else {
        emit_log(
            "[Clean-Room] Decrypted PE loaded-image.bin (MZ) not present; skipping 5 raw_* D3D9 clear/blit recipes.",
        );
    }

    let mut file_cache: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut zlib_cache: HashMap<(String, usize, usize), Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();

    // Build XSH binary payload:
    // Header: magic = 0x48534558 ('XESH') LE, version_swapped = 0x20201219 BE
    let mut xsh_out: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(340 * 1024);
    xsh_out.extend_from_slice(&0x48534558u32.to_le_bytes());
    xsh_out.extend_from_slice(&0x20201219u32.to_be_bytes());

    let mut reconstructed_count = 0usize;
    let mut skipped_raw_count = 0usize;

    for recipe in &manifest.recipes {
        if recipe.source_file == "loaded-image.bin" && decrypted_loaded_image.is_none() {
            skipped_raw_count += 1;
            continue;
        }

        if (recipe.dword_count as usize) * 4 != recipe.byte_length {
            return Err(format!(
                "Recipe {} has inconsistent dword_count ({}) vs byte_length ({})",
                recipe.hash, recipe.dword_count, recipe.byte_length
            ));
        }

        let mut ucode: Vec<u8> = match recipe.mode.as_str() {
            "zlib_exact" | "zlib_vfetch_patch" | "zlib_vfetch_reg_patches" => {
                let z_off = recipe
                    .zlib_offset
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing zlib_offset", recipe.hash))?;
                let z_size = recipe.zlib_compressed_size.ok_or_else(|| {
                    format!("Recipe {} missing zlib_compressed_size", recipe.hash)
                })?;
                let u_off = recipe
                    .uncompressed_offset
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing uncompressed_offset", recipe.hash))?;

                let cache_key = (recipe.source_file.clone(), z_off, z_size);
                if !zlib_cache.contains_key(&cache_key) {
                    if !file_cache.contains_key(&recipe.source_file) {
                        let full_path = resolve_iso_source_file(game_data_dir, &recipe.source_file)?;
                        let bytes = fs::read(&full_path).map_err(|e| {
                            format!("Failed to read ISO file {}: {}", full_path.display(), e)
                        })?;
                        file_cache.insert(recipe.source_file.clone(), bytes);
                    }
                    let src_bytes = file_cache.get(&recipe.source_file).unwrap();
                    if z_off + z_size > src_bytes.len() {
                        return Err(format!(
                            "Recipe {} zlib slice out of bounds in {}",
                            recipe.hash, recipe.source_file
                        ));
                    }
                    let mut decoder = ZlibDecoder::new(&src_bytes[z_off..z_off + z_size]);
                    let mut inflated = Vec::new();
                    decoder.read_to_end(&mut inflated).map_err(|e| {
                        format!(
                            "Failed to inflate zlib block at {}+{} in {}: {}",
                            z_off, z_size, recipe.source_file, e
                        )
                    })?;
                    zlib_cache.insert(cache_key.clone(), inflated);
                }

                let inflated = zlib_cache.get(&cache_key).unwrap();
                if u_off + recipe.byte_length > inflated.len() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "Recipe {} uncompressed slice out of bounds ({}+{} > {})",
                        recipe.hash,
                        u_off,
                        recipe.byte_length,
                        inflated.len()
                    ));
                }
                inflated[u_off..u_off + recipe.byte_length].to_vec()
            }
            "raw_exact" | "raw_descriptor_patches" => {
                let raw_off = recipe
                    .raw_offset
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing raw_offset", recipe.hash))?;
                if !file_cache.contains_key("loaded-image.bin") {
                    let img_path = decrypted_loaded_image.as_ref().unwrap();
                    let bytes = fs::read(img_path).map_err(|e| {
                        format!("Failed to read {}: {}", img_path.display(), e)
                    })?;
                    file_cache.insert("loaded-image.bin".to_string(), bytes);
                }
                let raw_bytes = file_cache.get("loaded-image.bin").unwrap();
                if raw_off + recipe.byte_length > raw_bytes.len() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "Recipe {} raw slice out of bounds in loaded-image.bin",
                        recipe.hash
                    ));
                }
                raw_bytes[raw_off..raw_off + recipe.byte_length].to_vec()
            }
            other => {
                return Err(format!("Unsupported recipe mode '{}' for {}", other, recipe.hash));
            }
        };

        // Apply patches if present
        if recipe.mode == "zlib_vfetch_patch" {
            let p_off = recipe
                .patch_offset
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing patch_offset", recipe.hash))?;
            let patch_hex = recipe
                .vfetch_patch_hex
                .as_ref()
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing vfetch_patch_hex", recipe.hash))?;
            let patch_bytes = decode_hex(patch_hex)?;
            if p_off + patch_bytes.len() > ucode.len() {
                return Err(format!("Recipe {} vfetch patch out of bounds", recipe.hash));
            }
            ucode[p_off..p_off + patch_bytes.len()].copy_from_slice(&patch_bytes);
        } else if recipe.mode == "zlib_vfetch_reg_patches"
            || recipe.mode == "raw_descriptor_patches"
        {
            let patches = recipe
                .patches
                .as_ref()
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("Recipe {} missing patches array", recipe.hash))?;
            for p in patches {
                let patch_bytes = decode_hex(&p.hex)?;
                if p.offset + patch_bytes.len() > ucode.len() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "Recipe {} patch at offset {} out of bounds",
                        recipe.hash, p.offset
                    ));
                }
                ucode[p.offset..p.offset + patch_bytes.len()].copy_from_slice(&patch_bytes);
            }
        }

        // Verify XXH3_64bits hash
        let expected_hash = u64::from_str_radix(&recipe.hash, 16)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid recipe hash '{}': {}", recipe.hash, e))?;
        let computed_hash = xxh3_64bits(&ucode);
        if computed_hash != expected_hash {
            return Err(format!(
                "Clean-Room XXH3_64bits verification failed for shader {}: expected {:016X}, got {:016X}",
                recipe.hash, expected_hash, computed_hash
            ));
        }

        let type_bit: u32 = if recipe.shader_type == "ps" { 1 } else { 0 };
        let count_type: u32 = (recipe.dword_count & 0x7FFF_FFFF) | (type_bit << 31);

        xsh_out.extend_from_slice(&expected_hash.to_le_bytes());
        xsh_out.extend_from_slice(&count_type.to_le_bytes());
        xsh_out.extend_from_slice(&ucode);
        reconstructed_count += 1;
    }

    // Write to <cache_root>/shaders/prebuild/ for both 'release' and active configuration
    let cfg_lower = {
        let c = configuration.trim().to_lowercase();
        if c.is_empty() {
            "release".to_string()
        } else {
            c
        }
    };
    let mut target_configs = vec!["release".to_string()];
    if cfg_lower != "release" {
        target_configs.push(cfg_lower.clone());
    }

    let mut primary_xsh_path = PathBuf::new();
    let mut primary_xpl_path = PathBuf::new();

    for cfg in &target_configs {
        let prebuild_dir = game_data_dir
            .join("runtime/cache/vulkan-vulkan")
            .join(cfg)
            .join("shaders/prebuild");
        fs::create_dir_all(&prebuild_dir).map_err(|e| {
            format!(
                "Failed to create prebuild directory {}: {}",
                prebuild_dir.display(),
                e
            )
        })?;

        let dst_xsh = prebuild_dir.join(format!("{}.xsh", manifest.title_id));
        let dst_xpl = prebuild_dir.join(&manifest.pipeline_list_file);

        fs::write(&dst_xsh, &xsh_out)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to write {}: {}", dst_xsh.display(), e))?;
        fs::copy(&xpl_src_path, &dst_xpl)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to copy {}: {}", dst_xpl.display(), e))?;

        if cfg == &cfg_lower || primary_xsh_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            primary_xsh_path = dst_xsh;
            primary_xpl_path = dst_xpl;
        }
    }

    emit_log(&format!(
        "[Clean-Room] Reconstructed {}/{} Xenos shaders ({} skipped raw_*) — 100% XXH3_64bits verified ({} bytes)",
        reconstructed_count,
        manifest.recipes.len(),
        skipped_raw_count,
        xsh_out.len()
    ));
    emit_log(&format!(
        "[Clean-Room] Deployed prebuild cache to: {}",
        primary_xsh_path
            .parent()
            .unwrap_or(&primary_xsh_path)
            .display()
    ));

    Ok(RebuildSummary {
        reconstructed_count,
        skipped_raw_count,
        total_recipes: manifest.recipes.len(),
        xsh_path: primary_xsh_path,
        xpl_path: primary_xpl_path,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_clean_room_rebuild_and_xxh3() {
        let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
        let root = manifest_dir
            .parent()
            .and_then(|p| p.parent())
            .expect("repo root");
        let game_data_dir = root.join("game-data");
        let summary = rebuild_prebuild_shader_cache(root, &game_data_dir, "Release", &|msg| {
            println!("{}", msg);
        })
        .expect("rebuild_prebuild_shader_cache failed");

        assert_eq!(summary.total_recipes, 257);
        assert_eq!(summary.reconstructed_count, 257);
        assert_eq!(summary.skipped_raw_count, 0);
        assert!(summary.xsh_path.exists());
        assert!(summary.xpl_path.exists());
    }
}
```

```rs
fn format_bytes(bytes: u64) -> String {
    if bytes < 1024 {
        format!("{} B", bytes)
    } else if bytes < 1024 * 1024 {
        format!("{:.1} KB", bytes as f64 / 1024.0)
    } else {
        format!("{:.2} MB", bytes as f64 / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
    }
}
```
