```js
// ==========================================
// Developer Mode Toggle
// ==========================================
function applyDevModeUI(enabled) {
  isDevModeCached = !!enabled;

  // Toggle header DEV badge
  if (elements.devModeBadge) {
    elements.devModeBadge.classList.toggle("hidden", !isDevModeCached);
  }

  // Sync Developer Mode toggle switch in Setup Game tab
  if (elements.toggleDevMode) {
    elements.toggleDevMode.checked = isDevModeCached;
  }

  // Show/hide all [data-dev-only] elements without removing them from DOM
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-dev-only]").forEach((el) => {
    if (el.tagName === "OPTION") {
      el.hidden = !isDevModeCached;
      el.disabled = !isDevModeCached;
    } else {
      el.classList.toggle("hidden", !isDevModeCached);
    }
  });

  // If Dev Mode was turned off while a dev-only option was selected, fall back cleanly
  if (!isDevModeCached) {
    const fallbacks = [
      { el: elements.frameRateMode, fallback: "60" },
      { el: elements.renderingPath, fallback: "Vulkan" },
      { el: elements.postEffect, fallback: "dedither_fxaa" },
    ];
    for (const { el, fallback } of fallbacks) {
      if (!el) continue;
      const selectedOpt = el.options[el.selectedIndex];
      if (selectedOpt && (selectedOpt.hidden || selectedOpt.disabled)) {
        el.value = fallback;
      }
    }
    if (elements.chkCompileBinary) {
      elements.chkCompileBinary.checked = false;
    }
    updatePostProcessingVisibility();
    updateShadowBiasVisibility();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(refreshCustomSelect);

  if (isDevModeCached) {
    updateShaderCacheInfo();
  }
}

if (elements.toggleDevMode) {
  elements.toggleDevMode.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const nextState = Boolean(elements.toggleDevMode.checked);
    applyDevModeUI(nextState);
    try {
      await invoke("set_dev_mode", { enabled: nextState });
      const settings = readForm();
      await invoke("save_settings", { settings });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to toggle dev mode:", err);
    }
  });
}

// ==========================================
// Save Profiles & .savistic Management
// ==========================================
let saveProfilesState = null;
let saveNameModalContext = null; // { mode: 'new' | 'duplicate' | 'rename', profileId?: string }
let pendingImportPreview = null;
let pendingDeleteProfileId = null;
let savesFeedbackTimer = null;

function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function showSavesFeedback(message, isError = false) {
  if (!elements.savesFeedbackBanner || !elements.savesFeedbackText) return;
  if (savesFeedbackTimer) {
    clearTimeout(savesFeedbackTimer);
    savesFeedbackTimer = null;
  }
  elements.savesFeedbackText.textContent = message;
  elements.savesFeedbackBanner.className = isError
    ? "flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs border bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-700/60 text-rose-200"
    : "flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs border bg-[#6da712]/15 border-[#6da712]/50 text-[#c9eb86]";
  savesFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    elements.savesFeedbackBanner?.classList.add("hidden");
  }, isError ? 8000 : 5000);
}

function hideSavesFeedback() {
  if (savesFeedbackTimer) {
    clearTimeout(savesFeedbackTimer);
    savesFeedbackTimer = null;
  }
  elements.savesFeedbackBanner?.classList.add("hidden");
}

if (elements.btnDismissSavesFeedback) {
  elements.btnDismissSavesFeedback.addEventListener("click", hideSavesFeedback);
}

function applySaveProfilesState(state) {
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object") return;
  saveProfilesState = state;
  currentSettings.ActiveSaveProfile = state.activeProfileId || "default";

  const profiles = Array.isArray(state.profiles) ? state.profiles : [];
  if (elements.tabSavesCountBadge) {
    elements.tabSavesCountBadge.textContent = String(profiles.length);
  }

  const activeProfile = profiles.find((p) => p.isActive) || profiles[0];
  if (elements.footerActiveSaveName && activeProfile) {
    elements.footerActiveSaveName.textContent = activeProfile.name;
  }
  if (elements.footerActiveSaveBtn && activeProfile) {
    elements.footerActiveSaveBtn.title = `Active Save: ${activeProfile.name} (click to manage)`;
  }

  if (elements.savesGameRunningBanner) {
    elements.savesGameRunningBanner.classList.toggle("hidden", !state.gameRunning);
  }

  renderSaveProfiles(state);
}

function renderSaveProfiles(state) {
  if (!elements.savesProfilesList) return;
  const profiles = Array.isArray(state.profiles) ? state.profiles : [];
  const gameRunning = Boolean(state.gameRunning);
  const canDelete = profiles.length > 1 && !gameRunning;

  if (profiles.length === 0) {
    elements.savesProfilesList.innerHTML = `
      <div class="bg-darkCard rounded-xl p-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 border border-darkBorder/40">
        No save profiles found. Click <strong class="text-white">New Save</strong> to create one.
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  // Sort active profile first, then preserve order
  const ordered = [...profiles].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.isActive && !b.isActive) return -1;
    if (!a.isActive && b.isActive) return 1;
    if (a.isDefault && !b.isDefault) return -1;
    if (!a.isDefault && b.isDefault) return 1;
    return 0;
  });

  elements.savesProfilesList.innerHTML = ordered
    .map((p) => {
      const cardClasses = p.isActive
        ? "bg-[#6da712]/10 border border-[#6da712]/50 shadow-sm"
        : "bg-darkCard border border-darkBorder/50 hover:border-slate-600/80";

      const slotText = p.hasSaveData
        ? `${p.saveSlotCount} save ${p.saveSlotCount === 1 ? "file" : "files"} · ${escapeHtml(p.sizeFormatted)}`
        : "Empty (New Game)";

      const achText = p.achievementCount > 0
        ? `${p.achievementCount} ${p.achievementCount === 1 ? "achievement" : "achievements"}`
        : "No achievements";

      const timeText = p.lastModified
        ? `Updated ${escapeHtml(p.lastModified)}`
        : `Created ${escapeHtml(p.createdAt)}`;

      const activeBadge = p.isActive
        ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#6da712]/25 text-[#b5de63] border border-[#6da712]/50">Active</span>`
        : "";

      const defaultBadge = p.isDefault
        ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700/60">Default</span>`
        : "";

      const activateBtn = p.isActive
        ? ""
        : `<button
            type="button"
            data-save-action="activate"
            data-profile-id="${escapeHtml(p.id)}"
            ${gameRunning ? "disabled" : ""}
            class="h-8 px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#6da712]/20 hover:bg-[#6da712] text-[#b5de63] hover:text-white border border-[#6da712]/40 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none"
          >
            Set Active
          </button>`;

      return `
        <div class="rounded-xl p-3.5 transition-all ${cardClasses}">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span class="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate max-w-[320px]" title="${escapeHtml(p.name)}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</span>
                ${activeBadge}
                ${defaultBadge}
              </div>
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <span class="${p.hasSaveData ? "text-slate-300" : "text-slate-500"}">${slotText}</span>
                <span class="text-slate-600">&bull;</span>
                <span class="${p.achievementCount > 0 ? "text-amber-300/90" : "text-slate-500"}">${achText}</span>
                <span class="text-slate-600">&bull;</span>
                <span class="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">${timeText}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
              ${activateBtn}
              <button
                type="button"
                data-save-action="duplicate"
                data-profile-id="${escapeHtml(p.id)}"
                title="Create a snapshot copy of this save"
                ${gameRunning ? "disabled" : ""}
                class="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-darkControl hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 hover:text-white border border-darkBorder/60 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none"
              >
                Duplicate
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-save-action="rename"
                data-profile-id="${escapeHtml(p.id)}"
                title="Rename this save profile"
                class="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-darkControl hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-darkBorder/60 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Rename
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-save-action="export"
                data-profile-id="${escapeHtml(p.id)}"
                title="Export save, achievements &amp; launcher config as .savistic"
                ${gameRunning ? "disabled" : ""}
                class="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-darkControl hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 hover:text-white border border-darkBorder/60 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none"
              >
                Export
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-save-action="delete"
                data-profile-id="${escapeHtml(p.id)}"
                title="${canDelete ? "Delete save profile" : "Cannot delete the only remaining save"}"
                ${canDelete ? "" : "disabled"}
                class="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-darkControl hover:bg-rose-900/70 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-200 border border-darkBorder/60 hover:border-rose-700/60 flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none"
              >
                <svg class="w-4 h-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                  <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M9.5 2.75C8.5335 2.75 7.75 3.5335 7.75 4.5V5.25H4.5C4.08579 5.25 3.75 5.58579 3.75 6C3.75 6.41421 4.08579 6.75 4.5 6.75H5.29168L6.1052 18.9529C6.21242 20.5612 7.54779 21.8125 9.1597 21.8125H14.8403C16.4522 21.8125 17.7876 20.5612 17.8948 18.9529L18.7083 6.75H19.5C19.9142 6.75 20.25 6.41421 20.25 6C20.25 5.58579 19.9142 5.25 19.5 5.25H16.25V4.5C16.25 3.5335 15.4665 2.75 14.5 2.75H9.5ZM9.25 4.5C9.25 4.36193 9.36193 4.25 9.5 4.25H14.5C14.6381 4.25 14.75 4.36193 14.75 4.5V5.25H9.25V4.5ZM10.25 10C10.25 9.58579 9.91421 9.25 9.5 9.25C9.08579 9.25 8.75 9.58579 8.75 10V17C8.75 17.4142 9.08579 17.75 9.5 17.75C9.91421 17.75 10.25 17.4142 10.25 17V10ZM15.25 10C15.25 9.58579 14.9142 9.25 14.5 9.25C14.0858 9.25 13.75 9.58579 13.75 10V17C13.75 17.4142 14.0858 17.75 14.5 17.75C14.9142 17.75 15.25 17.4142 15.25 17V10Z" clip-rule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    })
    .join("");
}

async function loadSaveProfiles() {
  try {
    const state = await invoke("list_save_profiles");
    applySaveProfilesState(state);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Failed to load save profiles:", err);
    showSavesFeedback(`Failed to load save profiles: ${err}`, true);
  }
}

// --- Save Name Modal (New / Duplicate / Rename) ---
function openSaveNameModal(mode, profile = null) {
  saveNameModalContext = { mode, profileId: profile?.id || null };
  if (!elements.saveNameModal) return;

  if (mode === "new") {
    elements.saveNameModalTitle.textContent = "New Save Profile";
    elements.saveNameModalDesc.textContent =
      "Create a clean save profile with separate game progress and achievements (great for another player or a fresh playthrough).";
    elements.saveNameInput.value = "";
    elements.saveNameInput.placeholder = "e.g. Player 2, Hard Run, Speedrun...";
    elements.saveNameDefaultHint.textContent =
      "Leave blank to let the launcher assign a default name automatically.";
    elements.saveNameSetActiveWrap.classList.remove("hidden");
    elements.saveNameSetActiveCheck.checked = true;
    elements.btnConfirmSaveName.textContent = "Create Save";
  } else if (mode === "duplicate") {
    elements.saveNameModalTitle.textContent = "Duplicate Save (Checkpoint)";
    elements.saveNameModalDesc.textContent = `Create an independent copy of "${profile?.name || "Save"}" including its current save slots and achievements.`;
    elements.saveNameInput.value = "";
    elements.saveNameInput.placeholder = `e.g. ${profile?.name || "Save"} - Before Boss`;
    elements.saveNameDefaultHint.textContent =
      "Leave blank to use an automatic copy name.";
    elements.saveNameSetActiveWrap.classList.remove("hidden");
    elements.saveNameSetActiveCheck.checked = false;
    elements.btnConfirmSaveName.textContent = "Create Copy";
  } else if (mode === "rename") {
    elements.saveNameModalTitle.textContent = "Rename Save Profile";
    elements.saveNameModalDesc.textContent =
      "Enter a new display name for this save profile.";
    elements.saveNameInput.value = profile?.name || "";
    elements.saveNameInput.placeholder = "Enter save name...";
    elements.saveNameDefaultHint.textContent =
      "Clearing the name will revert it to a default name.";
    elements.saveNameSetActiveWrap.classList.add("hidden");
    elements.btnConfirmSaveName.textContent = "Save Name";
  }

  elements.saveNameModal.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => {
    elements.saveNameInput?.focus();
    elements.saveNameInput?.select();
  }, 30);
}

function closeSaveNameModal() {
  saveNameModalContext = null;
  elements.saveNameModal?.classList.add("hidden");
}

async function confirmSaveNameModal() {
  if (!saveNameModalContext) return;
  const { mode, profileId } = saveNameModalContext;
  const rawName = elements.saveNameInput?.value ?? "";
  const setActive = Boolean(elements.saveNameSetActiveCheck?.checked);

  if (elements.btnConfirmSaveName) elements.btnConfirmSaveName.disabled = true;
  try {
    let state;
    if (mode === "new") {
      state = await invoke("create_save_profile", {
        name: rawName.trim() ? rawName.trim() : null,
        setActive,
      });
      applySaveProfilesState(state);
      showSavesFeedback("New save profile created.");
    } else if (mode === "duplicate" && profileId) {
      state = await invoke("duplicate_save_profile", {
        sourceId: profileId,
        name: rawName.trim() ? rawName.trim() : null,
        setActive,
      });
      applySaveProfilesState(state);
      showSavesFeedback("Save checkpoint duplicated successfully.");
    } else if (mode === "rename" && profileId) {
      state = await invoke("rename_save_profile", {
        profileId,
        newName: rawName,
      });
      applySaveProfilesState(state);
      showSavesFeedback("Save profile renamed.");
    }
    closeSaveNameModal();
  } catch (err) {
    showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
  } finally {
    if (elements.btnConfirmSaveName) elements.btnConfirmSaveName.disabled = false;
  }
}

if (elements.btnNewSave) {
  elements.btnNewSave.addEventListener("click", () => openSaveNameModal("new"));
}
if (elements.btnCloseSaveNameModal) {
  elements.btnCloseSaveNameModal.addEventListener("click", closeSaveNameModal);
}
if (elements.btnCancelSaveName) {
  elements.btnCancelSaveName.addEventListener("click", closeSaveNameModal);
}
if (elements.btnConfirmSaveName) {
  elements.btnConfirmSaveName.addEventListener("click", confirmSaveNameModal);
}
if (elements.saveNameInput) {
  elements.saveNameInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      confirmSaveNameModal();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      closeSaveNameModal();
    }
  });
}

// --- Import .savistic Modal ---
function openImportSaveModal(preview) {
  pendingImportPreview = preview;
  if (!elements.importSaveModal) return;

  if (elements.importFileName) {
    elements.importFileName.textContent = preview.fileName || "save.savistic";
  }
  if (elements.importExportedAt) {
    elements.importExportedAt.textContent = preview.exportedAt
      ? `Exported ${preview.exportedAt}`
      : "";
  }
  if (elements.importMetaBadges) {
    const badges = [];
    badges.push(
      preview.saveSlotCount > 0
        ? `<span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700/70">${preview.saveSlotCount} save ${preview.saveSlotCount === 1 ? "file" : "files"}</span>`
        : `<span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700/70">Empty save</span>`
    );
    if (preview.hasAchievements) {
      badges.push(
        `<span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-300 border border-amber-700/50">${preview.achievementCount} ${preview.achievementCount === 1 ? "achievement" : "achievements"}</span>`
      );
    }
    if (preview.hasLauncherConfig) {
      badges.push(
        `<span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#6da712]/20 text-[#b5de63] border border-[#6da712]/40">Launcher Config Included</span>`
      );
    }
    elements.importMetaBadges.innerHTML = badges.join("");
  }

  if (elements.importSaveNameInput) {
    elements.importSaveNameInput.value = preview.saveName || "";
  }
  if (elements.importSetActiveCheck) {
    elements.importSetActiveCheck.checked = true;
  }

  // Reset radio selection to "keep" by default so user opts in cleanly
  const keepRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="importLauncherConfigMode"][value="keep"]');
  if (keepRadio) keepRadio.checked = true;

  if (preview.hasLauncherConfig) {
    elements.importLauncherConfigSection?.classList.remove("hidden");
    elements.importNoLauncherConfigNote?.classList.add("hidden");
    if (elements.importConfigSummaryBadges && preview.launcherConfigSummary) {
      const c = preview.launcherConfigSummary;
      const pills = [
        c.windowSize,
        c.fullscreen ? "Fullscreen" : "Windowed",
        `${c.renderScale}x Scale`,
        c.frameRateMode === "Uncapped" ? "Uncapped FPS" : `${c.frameRateMode} FPS`,
        c.renderingPath,
        c.inputMode === "KeyboardMouse" ? "Keyboard & Mouse" : "Controller",
        c.audioLanguage && c.audioLanguage !== "Auto"
          ? `${c.language} / Audio: ${c.audioLanguage}`
          : c.language,
      ];
      elements.importConfigSummaryBadges.innerHTML = pills
        .map(
          (label) =>
            `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-darkControl text-slate-300 border border-darkBorder/50">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`
        )
        .join("");
    }
  } else {
    elements.importLauncherConfigSection?.classList.add("hidden");
    elements.importNoLauncherConfigNote?.classList.remove("hidden");
  }

  elements.importSaveModal.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => {
    elements.importSaveNameInput?.focus();
    elements.importSaveNameInput?.select();
  }, 30);
}

function closeImportSaveModal() {
  pendingImportPreview = null;
  elements.importSaveModal?.classList.add("hidden");
}

async function handlePickImportSave() {
  if (elements.btnImportSave) elements.btnImportSave.disabled = true;
  try {
    const preview = await invoke("pick_and_inspect_savistic");
    if (preview) {
      openImportSaveModal(preview);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
  } finally {
    if (elements.btnImportSave) elements.btnImportSave.disabled = false;
  }
}

async function confirmImportSave() {
  if (!pendingImportPreview) return;
  const filePath = pendingImportPreview.filePath;
  const customName = elements.importSaveNameInput?.value ?? "";
  const setActive = Boolean(elements.importSetActiveCheck?.checked);
  const selectedMode =
    document.querySelector('input[name="importLauncherConfigMode"]:checked')?.value || "keep";
  const applyLauncherConfig =
    Boolean(pendingImportPreview.hasLauncherConfig) && selectedMode === "apply";

  if (elements.btnConfirmImportSave) elements.btnConfirmImportSave.disabled = true;
  try {
    const res = await invoke("import_save_profile", {
      filePath,
      customName,
      applyLauncherConfig,
      setActive,
    });
    applySaveProfilesState(res.state);

    if (res.settingsUpdated && res.settings) {
      currentSettings = { ...defaultSettings, ...res.settings };
      populateForm(currentSettings);
      await loadAvailableLanguages(currentSettings.Language, currentSettings.AudioLanguage);
      document.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(refreshCustomSelect);
      showSavesFeedback(
        `Imported "${res.importedProfileName}" and applied its bundled launcher settings.`
      );
    } else {
      showSavesFeedback(`Imported "${res.importedProfileName}" successfully.`);
    }
    closeImportSaveModal();
  } catch (err) {
    showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
  } finally {
    if (elements.btnConfirmImportSave) elements.btnConfirmImportSave.disabled = false;
  }
}

if (elements.btnImportSave) {
  elements.btnImportSave.addEventListener("click", handlePickImportSave);
}
if (elements.btnCloseImportSaveModal) {
  elements.btnCloseImportSaveModal.addEventListener("click", closeImportSaveModal);
}
if (elements.btnCancelImportSave) {
  elements.btnCancelImportSave.addEventListener("click", closeImportSaveModal);
}
if (elements.btnConfirmImportSave) {
  elements.btnConfirmImportSave.addEventListener("click", confirmImportSave);
}

// --- Delete Save Modal ---
function openDeleteSaveModal(profile) {
  pendingDeleteProfileId = profile.id;
  if (elements.deleteSaveTargetName) {
    elements.deleteSaveTargetName.textContent = profile.name;
  }
  elements.deleteSaveModal?.classList.remove("hidden");
}

function closeDeleteSaveModal() {
  pendingDeleteProfileId = null;
  elements.deleteSaveModal?.classList.add("hidden");
}

async function confirmDeleteSave() {
  if (!pendingDeleteProfileId) return;
  if (elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave) elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave.disabled = true;
  try {
    const state = await invoke("delete_save_profile", {
      profileId: pendingDeleteProfileId,
    });
    applySaveProfilesState(state);
    showSavesFeedback("Save profile deleted.");
    closeDeleteSaveModal();
  } catch (err) {
    showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
  } finally {
    if (elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave) elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave.disabled = false;
  }
}

if (elements.btnCloseDeleteSaveModal) {
  elements.btnCloseDeleteSaveModal.addEventListener("click", closeDeleteSaveModal);
}
if (elements.btnCancelDeleteSave) {
  elements.btnCancelDeleteSave.addEventListener("click", closeDeleteSaveModal);
}
if (elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave) {
  elements.btnConfirmDeleteSave.addEventListener("click", confirmDeleteSave);
}

// --- Open Folder ---
if (elements.btnOpenSavesFolder) {
  elements.btnOpenSavesFolder.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await invoke("open_saves_folder", { profileId: null });
    } catch (err) {
      showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
    }
  });
}

// --- Event Delegation for Save Card Action Buttons ---
if (elements.savesProfilesList) {
  elements.savesProfilesList.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-save-action]");
    if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
    const action = btn.dataset.saveAction;
    const profileId = btn.dataset.profileId;
    const profile = saveProfilesState?.profiles?.find((p) => p.id === profileId);
    if (!profile) return;

    if (action === "activate") {
      btn.disabled = true;
      try {
        const state = await invoke("set_active_save_profile", { profileId });
        applySaveProfilesState(state);
        showSavesFeedback(`"${profile.name}" is now your active save.`);
      } catch (err) {
        showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    } else if (action === "duplicate") {
      openSaveNameModal("duplicate", profile);
    } else if (action === "rename") {
      openSaveNameModal("rename", profile);
    } else if (action === "export") {
      btn.disabled = true;
      try {
        const savedPath = await invoke("export_save_profile", { profileId });
        if (savedPath) {
          showSavesFeedback(`Exported "${profile.name}" to ${savedPath}`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showSavesFeedback(String(err), true);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    } else if (action === "delete") {
      openDeleteSaveModal(profile);
    }
  });
}

// ==========================================
// Initialization
// ==========================================
async function init() {
  logToBackend("init() started");

  try {
    const loaded = await invoke("load_settings");
    if (loaded && typeof loaded === "object") {
      currentSettings = { ...defaultSettings, ...loaded };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Could not load settings:", err);
    logToBackend("Could not load settings: " + err);
  }

  let backendDev = false;
  try {
    backendDev = await invoke("is_dev_mode");
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Could not determine dev mode:", err);
  }

  const initialDev = Boolean(currentSettings.DevMode || backendDev);

  initCustomSelects();
  populateForm(currentSettings);
  await loadAvailableLanguages(currentSettings.Language, currentSettings.AudioLanguage);
  applyDevModeUI(initialDev);
  await updateGameStatus();
  await loadSaveProfiles();
  await updateShaderCacheInfo();
  await updateMaximizeIcon();

  try {
    const cleanNotice = await invoke("consume_clean_update_notice");
    if (cleanNotice) {
      showCleanUpdateDoneModal(cleanNotice);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Could not check clean update notice:", err);
  }

  logToBackend("init() completed successfully");

  // Note: Automatic silent check for updates on startup was disabled to prevent
  // idle compositor freezes on AMD GPUs. Updates can be checked manually via "Check for Updates".
}

init();
```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/empty_packet_recovery.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <algorithm>

namespace rex::audio::majin {
// Recover only an entirely zero padding packet followed immediately by an
// independently decodable XMA2 packet. Never cross input buffers or loop points.
inline std::optional<uint32_t> EmptyPacketSuccessor(
    std::span<const uint8_t> buffer, uint32_t packet_index, uint32_t loop_count) {
  constexpr uint32_t bytes = 2048, bits = bytes * 8;
  if (loop_count != 0 || buffer.size() % bytes != 0 ||
      buffer.size() / bytes < 2 || packet_index >= buffer.size() / bytes - 1) return {};
  auto current = buffer.subspan(size_t(packet_index) * bytes, bytes);
  if (!std::all_of(current.begin(), current.end(), [](uint8_t b) { return b == 0; })) return {};
  auto next = buffer.subspan(size_t(packet_index + 1) * bytes, bytes);
  if ((next[2] & 7) != 1 || (next[0] >> 2) == 0 || next[3] == 255) return {};
  uint32_t first = (((next[0] & 3) << 13) | (next[1] << 5) | (next[2] >> 3)) + 32;
  if (first + 15 > bits) return {};
  uint32_t length = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 15; ++i)
    length = (length << 1) | ((next[(first + i) / 8] >> (7 - (first + i) % 8)) & 1);
  if (length < 15 || length == 0x7FFF) return {};
  return (packet_index + 1) * bits + first;
}
}
```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/empty_packet_recovery_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "empty_packet_recovery.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
int main() {
  using rex::audio::majin::EmptyPacketSuccessor;
  std::array<uint8_t, 4096> b{};
  assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b, 0, 0));
  b[2048]=4; b[2050]=1; b[2052]=0; b[2053]=64; // XMA2, first=32, frame length=32 bits
  assert(EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,0,0)==16416);
  assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,0,1));
  assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,1,0));
  assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,UINT32_MAX,0));
  b[7]=1; assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,0,0)); b[7]=0;
  b[2050]=0; assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,0,0)); b[2050]=1;
  b[2052]=255; b[2053]=254; assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(b,0,0));
  assert(!EmptyPacketSuccessor(std::span<const uint8_t>(b).first(4095),0,0));
}
```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/frame_deadline.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Opt-in host swap deadlines; original mode does not call the pacer.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
namespace majin::timing {
// Absolute host deadlines, with no catch-up burst after a missed deadline.
// Does not write guest clocks, registers, memory, saves or audio timestamps.
class SwapDeadline {
 public:
  uint64_t Next(uint64_t now, uint64_t frequency, uint32_t fps) {
    if (!fps || !frequency) { Reset(); return now; }
    const uint64_t period = frequency / fps ? frequency / fps : 1;
    if (!active_ || fps != fps_ || frequency != frequency_ || now < last_now_) {
      active_ = true; fps_ = fps; frequency_ = frequency;
      deadline_ = now; remainder_ = 0;
    }
    last_now_ = now;
    if (now > deadline_ && now - deadline_ >= period) {
      deadline_ = now; remainder_ = 0;
    }
    const uint64_t target = deadline_;
    deadline_ += period;
    remainder_ += frequency % fps;
    if (remainder_ >= fps) { ++deadline_; remainder_ -= fps; }
    return target > now ? target : now;
  }
  void Reset() { active_ = false; deadline_ = remainder_ = 0; }
 private:
  bool active_ = false;
  uint32_t fps_ = 0;
  uint64_t frequency_ = 0, deadline_ = 0, remainder_ = 0, last_now_ = 0;
};
} // namespace majin::timing

```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/frame_deadline_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "frame_deadline.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <iostream>
int main() {
  using majin::timing::SwapDeadline;
  SwapDeadline p;
  assert(p.Next(100,10000000,0)==100);
  assert(p.Next(200,0,60)==200);
  assert(p.Next(1000000,10000000,60)==1000000);
  assert(p.Next(1000000,10000000,60)==1166666);
  assert(p.Next(1000000,10000000,60)==1333333);
  // Repeated early calls preserve the rational remainder exactly.
  p.Reset();p.Next(0,10000000,60);
  for(unsigned i=1;i<=3600;++i) assert(p.Next(0,10000000,60)==uint64_t(i)*10000000/60);
  // Missed frames reset, avoiding a catch-up burst and artificial fast-forward.
  assert(p.Next(1000000000,10000000,60)==1000000000);
  assert(p.Next(1000000000,10000000,60)==1000166666);
  assert(p.Next(500,10000000,60)==500); // time rollback
  assert(p.Next(500,10000000,30)==500); // mode change
  assert(p.Next(500,10000000,30)==333833);
  assert(p.Next(600,10000000,0)==600);
  assert(p.Next(600,10000000,60)==600);
  assert(p.Next(600,1,120)==600);
  assert(p.Next(600,1,120)>=601);
  std::cout << "PASS: 3616 deadline/rational cadence/reset/stall/disabled boundary assertions\n";
}
```

```patch
+void Shader::DetectMajinBayerDither() {
+  // Detects Majin's ALU-evaluated 4x4 Bayer screen-door dither pattern:
+  //   3 vector cndeq (write_mask == 0b1111, selecting row from high literal constants c248..c255)
+  //   3 scalar cndeq (1-component writes, selecting column element from row_reg)
+  //   immediately followed by add(..., -bayer) or mad(..., ..., -bayer).
+  uint32_t vec_cndeq_count = 0;
+  uint32_t row_reg = UINT32_MAX;
+  uint32_t scalar_stage = 0;
+  uint32_t s_reg = UINT32_MAX;
+  uint32_t s_comp = 0;
+  uint32_t candidate_offset = UINT32_MAX;
+
+  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cf_pair_index_bound_; ++i) {
+    ControlFlowInstruction cf_ab[2];
+    UnpackControlFlowInstructions(ucode_data_.data() + i * 3, cf_ab);
+    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
+      const ControlFlowInstruction& cf = cf_ab[j];
+      if (!IsControlFlowOpcodeExec(cf.opcode())) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      uint32_t cf_index = i * 2 + j;
+      ParsedExecInstruction exec_instr;
+      switch (cf.opcode()) {
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kExec:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kExecEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowExec(cf.exec, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExec:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecEnd:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredClean:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredCleanEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowCondExec(cf.cond_exec, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPred:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowCondExecPred(cf.cond_exec_pred, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        default:
+          continue;
+      }
+      uint32_t sequence = exec_instr.sequence;
+      for (uint32_t instr_offset = exec_instr.instruction_address;
+           instr_offset < exec_instr.instruction_address + exec_instr.instruction_count;
+           ++instr_offset, sequence >>= 2) {
+        if (sequence & 0b01) {
+          continue;
+        }
+        auto& op = *reinterpret_cast<const AluInstruction*>(ucode_data_.data() + instr_offset * 3);
+        ParsedAluInstruction instr;
+        ParseAluInstruction(op, type(), instr);
+        if (instr.IsNop()) {
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        if (candidate_offset != UINT32_MAX) {
+          const uint32_t dst_wm = instr.vector_and_constant_result.GetUsedWriteMask();
+          bool confirmed = false;
+          if (!instr.is_predicated && rex::bit_count(dst_wm) == 1) {
+            uint32_t dst_comp = 0;
+            rex::bit_scan_forward(dst_wm, &dst_comp);
+            auto is_neg_bayer = [&](const InstructionOperand& oper) {
+              return oper.storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kRegister &&
+                     oper.storage_addressing_mode == InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+                     oper.storage_index == s_reg && oper.is_negated && !oper.is_absolute_value &&
+                     oper.GetComponent(dst_comp) == GetSwizzleFromComponentIndex(s_comp);
+            };
+            if (instr.vector_opcode == AluVectorOpcode::kAdd &&
+                is_neg_bayer(instr.vector_operands[1])) {
+              confirmed = true;
+            } else if (instr.vector_opcode == AluVectorOpcode::kMad &&
+                       is_neg_bayer(instr.vector_operands[2])) {
+              confirmed = true;
+            }
+          }
+          if (confirmed) {
+            majin_bayer_cndeq_instr_offset_ = candidate_offset;
+            return;
+          }
+          candidate_offset = UINT32_MAX;
+          scalar_stage = 0;
+        }
+
+        if (instr.vector_opcode != AluVectorOpcode::kCndEq || instr.is_predicated ||
+            instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_target != InstructionStorageTarget::kRegister ||
+            instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_addressing_mode !=
+                InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute) {
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t dst_wm = instr.vector_and_constant_result.GetUsedWriteMask();
+        const uint32_t dst_reg = instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_index;
+        const InstructionOperand& op1 = instr.vector_operands[1];
+        const InstructionOperand& op2 = instr.vector_operands[2];
+
+        auto is_high_const = [](const InstructionOperand& oper) {
+          return oper.storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kConstantFloat &&
+                 oper.storage_addressing_mode == InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+                 oper.storage_index >= 248 && !oper.is_negated && !oper.is_absolute_value;
+        };
+        auto is_reg = [](const InstructionOperand& oper, uint32_t reg) {
+          return oper.storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kRegister &&
+                 oper.storage_addressing_mode == InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+                 oper.storage_index == reg && !oper.is_negated && !oper.is_absolute_value;
+        };
+
+        if (dst_wm == 0b1111 && is_high_const(op1)) {
+          if (is_high_const(op2)) {
+            vec_cndeq_count = 1;
+            row_reg = dst_reg;
+            scalar_stage = 0;
+          } else if (vec_cndeq_count >= 1 && is_reg(op2, row_reg)) {
+            ++vec_cndeq_count;
+            row_reg = dst_reg;
+            scalar_stage = 0;
+          }
+        } else if (vec_cndeq_count >= 3 && rex::bit_count(dst_wm) == 1) {
+          uint32_t dst_comp = 0;
+          rex::bit_scan_forward(dst_wm, &dst_comp);
+          if (scalar_stage == 0 && is_reg(op1, row_reg) && is_reg(op2, row_reg)) {
+            scalar_stage = 1;
+            s_reg = dst_reg;
+            s_comp = dst_comp;
+          } else if (scalar_stage == 1 && is_reg(op1, row_reg) && is_reg(op2, s_reg) &&
+                     op2.GetComponent(dst_comp) == GetSwizzleFromComponentIndex(s_comp)) {
+            scalar_stage = 2;
+            s_reg = dst_reg;
+            s_comp = dst_comp;
+          } else if (scalar_stage == 2 && dst_reg == s_reg && dst_comp == s_comp &&
+                     is_reg(op1, row_reg) && is_reg(op2, s_reg) &&
+                     op2.GetComponent(dst_comp) == GetSwizzleFromComponentIndex(s_comp)) {
+            scalar_stage = 3;
+            candidate_offset = instr_offset;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
```

```patch
+void CommandProcessor::SetDesiredShadowPcfMode(ShadowPcfMode mode) {
+  if (shadow_pcf_mode_desired_ == mode) {
+    return;
+  }
+  shadow_pcf_mode_desired_ = mode;
+  shadow_pcf_mode_actual_.store(mode, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+  CallInThread([this, mode]() {
+    shadow_pcf_mode_actual_.store(mode, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+  });
+}

+  // Majin: pre-compute per-cascade shadow UV & receiver-Z derivatives in uniform control flow
+  // before any predicated (p0) cascade branch. In KbPreZSSSM2/3, each cascade (tf7<-r3, tf6<-r4,
+  // tf5<-r5) is sampled inside an `if (p0)` branch split by viewZ; evaluating OpDPdxFine/OpDPdyFine
+  // inside that branch causes 2x2 quads straddling a cascade split plane to read inactive lanes,
+  // disabling RPB and leaving a moving 2px horizontal dark line on sunlit two-sided floors.
+  if (!current_shader().majin_shadow_lookups().empty()) {
+    uint32_t cascade_mask = 0;
+    for (const auto& entry : current_shader().majin_shadow_lookups()) {
+      if (entry.fetch_constant >= 5u && entry.fetch_constant <= 7u) {
+        const uint32_t c = 7u - entry.fetch_constant;
+        const uint32_t interp_reg = 3u + c;

+            input_output_interpolators_[interp_reg] != spv::NoResult &&
+            var_main_majin_shadow_ddx_[c] != spv::NoResult &&
+            var_main_majin_shadow_ddy_[c] != spv::NoResult) {
+          cascade_mask |= UINT32_C(1) << c;

+  // Load packed Majin shadow params from SystemConstants::fh1_padding[1]:
+  //   bits 0..1: pcf_mode (0=original 1-tap, 1=2x2 bilinear, 2=4x4 cubic B-spline, 3=6x6 tent)
+  //   bit  2:    receiver_plane_bias_enable (0=off, 1=on)
+  std::vector<spv::Id> idx = {builder_->makeIntConstant(kSystemConstantMajinShadowParams)};
+  spv::Id shadow_params = builder_->createLoad(
+      builder_->createAccessChain(spv::StorageClassUniform, uniform_system_constants_, idx),
+      spv::NoPrecision);
+  spv::Id pcf_mode = builder_->createTriOp(spv::OpBitFieldUExtract, type_uint_, shadow_params,
+                                           const_uint_0_, builder_->makeUintConstant(2));
+  spv::Id is_pcf = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpINotEqual, type_bool_, pcf_mode, const_uint_0_);
+
+  SpirvBuilder::IfBuilder if_pcf(is_pcf, spv::SelectionControlDontFlattenMask, *builder_);
+  spv::Id pcf_lit = original_lit;
+  {
+    spv::Id uv = builder_->createLoad(var_main_majin_shadow_uv_, spv::NoPrecision);
+    spv::Id image =
+        builder_->createLoad(texture_bindings_[image_binding_index].variable, spv::NoPrecision);
+    spv::Id sampler =
+        builder_->createLoad(sampler_bindings_[sampler_binding_index].variable, spv::NoPrecision);
+    spv::Id sampled_image_type = builder_->makeSampledImageType(builder_->getTypeId(image));
+
+    // Query live host shadow-map resolution (768 at 1x, 1536 at 2x, 3072 at 4x).
+    builder_->addCapability(spv::CapabilityImageQuery);
+    spv::Id size_int3 =
+        builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpImageQuerySizeLod, type_int3_, image, const_int_0_);
+    spv::Id size_x = builder_->createUnaryOp(
+        spv::OpConvertSToF, type_float_,
+        builder_->createCompositeExtract(size_int3, type_int_, 0));
+    spv::Id size_y = builder_->createUnaryOp(
+        spv::OpConvertSToF, type_float_,
+        builder_->createCompositeExtract(size_int3, type_int_, 1));
+    spv::Id tex_size = builder_->createCompositeConstruct(type_float2_, {size_x, size_y});
+    spv::Id inv_size_x =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFDiv, type_float_, const_float_1_, size_x);
+    spv::Id inv_size_y =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFDiv, type_float_, const_float_1_, size_y);
+
+    // Center gather UV on the exact 2x2 quad boundary (baseTexel = floor(uv*size + 0.5)) so
+    // hardware 8-bit sub-texel fixed-point rounding never crosses a texel seam.
+    spv::Id const_0_5 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.5f);
+    spv::Id const_vec2_0_5 = builder_->makeCompositeConstant(type_float2_, {const_0_5, const_0_5});
+    spv::Id texel_coord =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float2_, uv, tex_size);
+    spv::Id texel_pos =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float2_, texel_coord, const_vec2_0_5);
+    spv::Id base_texel = builder_->createUnaryBuiltinCall(type_float2_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_,
+                                                          GLSLstd450Floor, texel_pos);
+    spv::Id frac =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float2_, texel_pos, base_texel);
+
+    spv::Id base_x = builder_->createCompositeExtract(base_texel, type_float_, 0);
+    spv::Id base_y = builder_->createCompositeExtract(base_texel, type_float_, 1);
+    spv::Id fx = builder_->createCompositeExtract(frac, type_float_, 0);
+    spv::Id fy = builder_->createCompositeExtract(frac, type_float_, 1);
+
+    // Screen-space Receiver Plane Depth Bias (dz/dtx, dz/dty) via 2x2 Jacobian inverse.
+    spv::Id rpb_bit = builder_->createTriOp(spv::OpBitFieldUExtract, type_uint_, shadow_params,
+                                            builder_->makeUintConstant(2),
+                                            builder_->makeUintConstant(1));
+    spv::Id rpb_on = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpINotEqual, type_bool_, rpb_bit, const_uint_0_);
+
+    spv::Id dtx_dx_x, dtx_dx_y, dtx_dy_x, dtx_dy_y, dz_dx, dz_dy;
+    if (cascade_index < 3u &&
+        (majin_shadow_uniform_deriv_mask_ & (UINT32_C(1) << cascade_index)) != 0) {
+      // Use continuous derivatives pre-computed in uniform control flow (StartFragmentShaderInMain)
+      // from the raw cascade interpolator (r3/r4/r5) so 2x2 quads straddling a cascade split plane
+      // never lose RPB across the predicated (p0) branch.
+      spv::Id ddx_uvz =
+          builder_->createLoad(var_main_majin_shadow_ddx_[cascade_index], spv::NoPrecision);
+      spv::Id ddy_uvz =
+          builder_->createLoad(var_main_majin_shadow_ddy_[cascade_index], spv::NoPrecision);
+      dtx_dx_x = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddx_uvz, type_float_, 0),
+          size_x);
+      dtx_dx_y = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddx_uvz, type_float_, 1),
+          size_y);
+      dtx_dy_x = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddy_uvz, type_float_, 0),
+          size_x);
+      dtx_dy_y = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddy_uvz, type_float_, 1),
+          size_y);
+      dz_dx = builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddx_uvz, type_float_, 2);
+      dz_dy = builder_->createCompositeExtract(ddy_uvz, type_float_, 2);
+    } else {
+      builder_->addCapability(spv::CapabilityDerivativeControl);
+      spv::Id dtx_dx = builder_->createUnaryOp(spv::OpDPdxFine, type_float2_, texel_coord);
+      spv::Id dtx_dy = builder_->createUnaryOp(spv::OpDPdyFine, type_float2_, texel_coord);
+      dz_dx = builder_->createUnaryOp(spv::OpDPdxFine, type_float_, receiver_z);
+      dz_dy = builder_->createUnaryOp(spv::OpDPdyFine, type_float_, receiver_z);
+
+      dtx_dx_x = builder_->createCompositeExtract(dtx_dx, type_float_, 0);
+      dtx_dx_y = builder_->createCompositeExtract(dtx_dx, type_float_, 1);
+      dtx_dy_x = builder_->createCompositeExtract(dtx_dy, type_float_, 0);
+      dtx_dy_y = builder_->createCompositeExtract(dtx_dy, type_float_, 1);
+    }
+
+    spv::Id det = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+        spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dx_x, dtx_dy_y),
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dx_y, dtx_dy_x));
+    spv::Id abs_det = builder_->createUnaryBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_,
+                                                       GLSLstd450FAbs, det);
+    auto fabs_s = [&](spv::Id v) {
+      return builder_->createUnaryBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450FAbs,
+                                              v);
+    };
+    spv::Id max_step_x = builder_->createBinBuiltinCall(
+        type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450NMax, fabs_s(dtx_dx_x), fabs_s(dtx_dx_y));
+    spv::Id max_step_y = builder_->createBinBuiltinCall(
+        type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450NMax, fabs_s(dtx_dy_x), fabs_s(dtx_dy_y));
+    spv::Id max_step = builder_->createBinBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_,
+                                                      GLSLstd450NMax, max_step_x, max_step_y);
+
+    // Guard against degenerate Jacobians and cascade/silhouette quad discontinuities.
+    // Compare UV step in normalized shadow-map space (5% of map per pixel) so foreshortened
+    // floors stay RPB-protected at 1x, 2x, and 4x shadow scales without creating moving bands.
+    spv::Id max_dz = builder_->createBinBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_,
+                                                    GLSLstd450NMax, fabs_s(dz_dx), fabs_s(dz_dy));
+    spv::Id step_limit = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+        spv::OpFMul, type_float_, size_x, builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.05f));
+    spv::Id det_ok = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpFOrdGreaterThan, type_bool_, abs_det,
+                                           builder_->makeFloatConstant(1e-6f));
+    spv::Id step_ok = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpFOrdLessThan, type_bool_, max_step, step_limit);
+    spv::Id dz_ok = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpFOrdLessThan, type_bool_, max_dz,
+                                          builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.02f));
+    spv::Id rpb_valid = builder_->createBinOp(
+        spv::OpLogicalAnd, type_bool_, rpb_on,
+        builder_->createBinOp(
+            spv::OpLogicalAnd, type_bool_, det_ok,
+            builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpLogicalAnd, type_bool_, step_ok, dz_ok)));
+
+    spv::Id safe_det = builder_->createTriOp(spv::OpSelect, type_float_, rpb_valid, det,
+                                             const_float_1_);
+    spv::Id inv_det =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFDiv, type_float_, const_float_1_, safe_det);
+
+    spv::Id raw_dz_dtx = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+        spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+            spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+            builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dy_y, dz_dx),
+            builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dx_y, dz_dy)),
+        inv_det);
+    spv::Id raw_dz_dty = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+        spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+            spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+            builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dx_x, dz_dy),
+            builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, dtx_dy_x, dz_dx)),
+        inv_det);
+
+    spv::Id slope_min = builder_->makeFloatConstant(-0.0025f);
+    spv::Id slope_max = builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.0025f);
+    spv::Id dz_dtx = builder_->createTriOp(
+        spv::OpSelect, type_float_, rpb_valid,
+        builder_->createTriBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450NClamp,
+                                       raw_dz_dtx, slope_min, slope_max),
+        const_float_0_);
+    spv::Id dz_dty = builder_->createTriOp(
+        spv::OpSelect, type_float_, rpb_valid,
+        builder_->createTriBuiltinCall(type_float_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450NClamp,
+                                       raw_dz_dty, slope_min, slope_max),
+        const_float_0_);
+
+    // Subtle quantization epsilon when RPB is enabled (~2-4mm over shadow range) so 24-bit float
+    // depth self-fighting on two-sided floors is prevented at Zero Bias without Peter-Panning.
+    spv::Id self_eps = builder_->createTriOp(
+        spv::OpSelect, type_float_, rpb_on, builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.00005f), const_float_0_);
+    spv::Id base_ref_z =
+        builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, receiver_z, self_eps);
+    spv::Id base_ref_z4 = builder_->smearScalar(spv::NoPrecision, base_ref_z, type_float4_);
+    spv::Id total_dz_min = builder_->makeFloatConstant(-0.0030f);
+    spv::Id total_dz_max = builder_->makeFloatConstant(0.0040f);
+    spv::Id clamp_dz_min4 = builder_->makeCompositeConstant(
+        type_float4_, {total_dz_min, total_dz_min, total_dz_min, total_dz_min});
+    spv::Id clamp_dz_max4 = builder_->makeCompositeConstant(
+        type_float4_, {total_dz_max, total_dz_max, total_dz_max, total_dz_max});
+
+    // Helper emitting one 2x2 OpImageGather at (base_texel + (gx, gy)) * inv_size,
+    // comparing all 4 depths against receiver-plane-biased refZ and summing weighted visibility.
+    // Vulkan/GLSL gather component order: .x=(0,1), .y=(1,1), .z=(1,0), .w=(0,0).
+    auto emit_gather_contrib = [&](spv::Id sampled_img, float gx, float gy, spv::Id wx0,
+                                   spv::Id wx1, spv::Id wy0, spv::Id wy1) -> spv::Id {
+      spv::Id gx_id = builder_->makeFloatConstant(gx);
+      spv::Id gy_id = builder_->makeFloatConstant(gy);
+      spv::Id gu = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          gx != 0.0f ? builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, base_x, gx_id)
+                     : base_x,
+          inv_size_x);
+      spv::Id gv = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          gy != 0.0f ? builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, base_y, gy_id)
+                     : base_y,
+          inv_size_y);
+
+      spv::Builder::TextureParameters tp = {};
+      tp.sampler = sampled_img;
+      tp.coords = builder_->createCompositeConstruct(type_float3_, {gu, gv, const_float_0_});
+      tp.component = const_int_0_;
+      spv::Id gathered = builder_->createTextureCall(spv::NoPrecision, type_float4_, false, false,
+                                                     false, true, false, tp,
+                                                     spv::ImageOperandsMaskNone);
+
+      // Reversed-Z conversion matching guest: smDepth = 1.0 - smRaw.
+      spv::Id sm_depth4 =
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float4_, const_float4_1_, gathered);
+
+      // Per-tap texel offsets from fragment: left=(gx - fx), right=(gx + 1 - fx), etc.
+      spv::Id du0 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, gx_id, fx), dz_dtx);
+      spv::Id du1 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+                                             builder_->makeFloatConstant(gx + 1.0f), fx),
+          dz_dtx);
+      spv::Id dv0 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, gy_id, fy), dz_dty);
+      spv::Id dv1 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+                                             builder_->makeFloatConstant(gy + 1.0f), fy),
+          dz_dty);
+
+      spv::Id dz_x = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, du0, dv1);
+      spv::Id dz_y = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, du1, dv1);
+      spv::Id dz_z = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, du1, dv0);
+      spv::Id dz_w = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, du0, dv0);
+      spv::Id dz4 = builder_->createTriBuiltinCall(
+          type_float4_, ext_inst_glsl_std_450_, GLSLstd450NClamp,
+          builder_->createCompositeConstruct(type_float4_, {dz_x, dz_y, dz_z, dz_w}), clamp_dz_min4,
+          clamp_dz_max4);
+      spv::Id ref4 =
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float4_, base_ref_z4, dz4);
+      spv::Id lit4 = builder_->createTriOp(
+          spv::OpSelect, type_float4_,
+          builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpFOrdGreaterThan, type_bool4_, sm_depth4, ref4),
+          const_float4_1_, const_float4_0_);
+
+      spv::Id w_x = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, wx0, wy1);
+      spv::Id w_y = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, wx1, wy1);
+      spv::Id w_z = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, wx1, wy0);
+      spv::Id w_w = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, wx0, wy0);
+      spv::Id w4 = builder_->createCompositeConstruct(type_float4_, {w_x, w_y, w_z, w_w});
+      spv::Id prod4 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float4_, lit4, w4);
+
+      spv::Id s01 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(prod4, type_float_, 0),
+          builder_->createCompositeExtract(prod4, type_float_, 1));
+      spv::Id s23 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+          spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, builder_->createCompositeExtract(prod4, type_float_, 2),
+          builder_->createCompositeExtract(prod4, type_float_, 3));
+      return builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, s01, s23);
+    };
+
+    spv::Id is_bilinear = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpIEqual, type_bool_, pcf_mode,
+                                                builder_->makeUintConstant(1));
+    SpirvBuilder::IfBuilder if_bilinear(is_bilinear, spv::SelectionControlDontFlattenMask,
+                                        *builder_);
+    spv::Id lit_bilinear;
+    {
+      // Mode 1: 2x2 Bilinear PCF (1 gather = 4 taps).
+      spv::Id sampled_img =
+          builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpSampledImage, sampled_image_type, image, sampler);
+      spv::Id om_fx =
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, const_float_1_, fx);
+      spv::Id om_fy =
+          builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, const_float_1_, fy);
+      lit_bilinear = emit_gather_contrib(sampled_img, 0.0f, 0.0f, om_fx, fx, om_fy, fy);
+    }
+    if_bilinear.makeBeginElse();
+    spv::Id lit_soft_or_ultra;
+    {
+      spv::Id is_soft = builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpIEqual, type_bool_, pcf_mode,
+                                              builder_->makeUintConstant(2));
+      SpirvBuilder::IfBuilder if_soft(is_soft, spv::SelectionControlDontFlattenMask, *builder_);
+      spv::Id lit_soft;
+      {
+        // Mode 2: 4x4 Uniform Cubic B-Spline PCF (4 gathers = 16 taps, C2 continuous).
+        spv::Id sampled_img =
+            builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpSampledImage, sampled_image_type, image, sampler);
+        auto make_cubic_weights = [&](spv::Id t, spv::Id w_out[4]) {
+          spv::Id inv6 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(1.0f / 6.0f);
+          spv::Id c3 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(3.0f);
+          spv::Id c4 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(4.0f);
+          spv::Id c6 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(6.0f);
+          spv::Id om =
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, const_float_1_, t);
+          spv::Id t2 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, t, t);
+          spv::Id t3 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, t2, t);
+          spv::Id om2 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, om, om);
+          spv::Id om3 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, om2, om);
+          // w0 = (1 - t)^3 / 6
+          w_out[0] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, om3, inv6);
+          // w1 = (3t^3 - 6t^2 + 4) / 6
+          spv::Id num1 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFAdd, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+                  spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+                  builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, c3, t3),
+                  builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, c6, t2)),
+              c4);
+          w_out[1] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, num1, inv6);
+          // w2 = (-3t^3 + 3t^2 + 3t + 1) / 6
+          spv::Id num2 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFAdd, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+                  spv::OpFAdd, type_float_,
+                  builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+                      spv::OpFSub, type_float_,
+                      builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, c3, t2),
+                      builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, c3, t3)),
+                  builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, c3, t)),
+              const_float_1_);
+          w_out[2] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, num2, inv6);
+          // w3 = t^3 / 6
+          w_out[3] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, t3, inv6);
+        };
+        spv::Id wx[4], wy[4];
+        make_cubic_weights(fx, wx);
+        make_cubic_weights(fy, wy);
+
+        spv::Id g00 = emit_gather_contrib(sampled_img, -1.0f, -1.0f, wx[0], wx[1], wy[0], wy[1]);
+        spv::Id g10 = emit_gather_contrib(sampled_img, 1.0f, -1.0f, wx[2], wx[3], wy[0], wy[1]);
+        spv::Id g01 = emit_gather_contrib(sampled_img, -1.0f, 1.0f, wx[0], wx[1], wy[2], wy[3]);
+        spv::Id g11 = emit_gather_contrib(sampled_img, 1.0f, 1.0f, wx[2], wx[3], wy[2], wy[3]);
+        spv::Id row0 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, g00, g10);
+        spv::Id row1 = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, g01, g11);
+        lit_soft = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, row0, row1);
+      }
+      if_soft.makeBeginElse();
+      spv::Id lit_ultra;
+      {
+        // Mode 3: 6x6 Symmetric Tent PCF (9 gathers = 36 taps, [1,2,3,2,1]/9 at centers).
+        spv::Id sampled_img =
+            builder_->createBinOp(spv::OpSampledImage, sampled_image_type, image, sampler);
+        auto make_tent6_weights = [&](spv::Id t, spv::Id w_out[6]) {
+          spv::Id inv9 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(1.0f / 9.0f);
+          spv::Id c2 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(2.0f);
+          spv::Id c3 = builder_->makeFloatConstant(3.0f);
+          w_out[0] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, const_float_1_, t),
+              inv9);
+          w_out[1] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, c2, t), inv9);
+          w_out[2] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFSub, type_float_, c3, t), inv9);
+          w_out[3] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, c2, t), inv9);
+          w_out[4] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(
+              spv::OpFMul, type_float_,
+              builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, const_float_1_, t),
+              inv9);
+          w_out[5] = builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float_, t, inv9);
+        };
+        spv::Id wx[6], wy[6];
+        make_tent6_weights(fx, wx);
+        make_tent6_weights(fy, wy);
+
+        static constexpr float kOffsets[3] = {-2.0f, 0.0f, 2.0f};
+        spv::Id acc = spv::NoResult;
+        for (int gy_i = 0; gy_i < 3; ++gy_i) {
+          for (int gx_i = 0; gx_i < 3; ++gx_i) {
+            spv::Id contrib = emit_gather_contrib(
+                sampled_img, kOffsets[gx_i], kOffsets[gy_i], wx[gx_i * 2], wx[gx_i * 2 + 1],
+                wy[gy_i * 2], wy[gy_i * 2 + 1]);
+            acc = (acc == spv::NoResult)
+                      ? contrib
+                      : builder_->createNoContractionBinOp(spv::OpFAdd, type_float_, acc, contrib);
+          }
+        }
+        lit_ultra = acc;
+      }
+      if_soft.makeEndIf();
+      lit_soft_or_ultra = if_soft.createMergePhi(lit_soft, lit_ultra);
+    }
+    if_bilinear.makeEndIf();
+    pcf_lit = if_bilinear.createMergePhi(lit_bilinear, lit_soft_or_ultra);
+  }
+  if_pcf.makeEndIf();
+  return if_pcf.createMergePhi(pcf_lit, original_lit);
+}

+void Shader::DetectMajinShadowLookups() {
+  // Detects Majin's KbPreZSSSM* shadow depth lookup + reversed-Z compare pattern:
+  //   1. tfetch2D rA.x___, uv, tf7/tf6/tf5 (2D normalized, 1-component .x write)
+  //   2. min rB.cB, rawZ, cHigh + subsc rA.x___, cHigh, rA.x (1.0 - smRaw)
+  //   3. sgt rA.x___, rA.xxxx, rB.cB (+ retain_prev no-op scalar)
+  uint32_t pending_stage = 0;
+  uint32_t pending_tfetch_offset = UINT32_MAX;
+  uint32_t pending_fetch_constant = 0;
+  uint32_t pending_reg = UINT32_MAX;
+  uint32_t pending_z_reg = UINT32_MAX;
+  uint32_t pending_z_comp = 0;
+
+  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cf_pair_index_bound_; ++i) {
+    ControlFlowInstruction cf_ab[2];
+    UnpackControlFlowInstructions(ucode_data_.data() + i * 3, cf_ab);
+    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
+      const ControlFlowInstruction& cf = cf_ab[j];
+      if (!IsControlFlowOpcodeExec(cf.opcode())) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      uint32_t cf_index = i * 2 + j;
+      ParsedExecInstruction exec_instr;
+      switch (cf.opcode()) {
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kExec:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kExecEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowExec(cf.exec, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExec:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecEnd:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredClean:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredCleanEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowCondExec(cf.cond_exec, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPred:
+        case ControlFlowOpcode::kCondExecPredEnd:
+          ParseControlFlowCondExecPred(cf.cond_exec_pred, cf_index, exec_instr);
+          break;
+        default:
+          continue;
+      }
+      uint32_t sequence = exec_instr.sequence;
+      for (uint32_t instr_offset = exec_instr.instruction_address;
+           instr_offset < exec_instr.instruction_address + exec_instr.instruction_count;
+           ++instr_offset, sequence >>= 2) {
+        const uint32_t* op_ptr = ucode_data_.data() + instr_offset * 3;
+        if (sequence & 0b01) {
+          pending_stage = 0;
+          auto& fop = *reinterpret_cast<const FetchInstruction*>(op_ptr);
+          if (fop.opcode() == FetchOpcode::kVertexFetch) {
+            continue;
+          }
+          ParsedTextureFetchInstruction tf;
+          ParseTextureFetchInstruction(fop.texture_fetch(), tf);
+          const uint32_t fc = tf.operands[1].storage_index;
+          if (tf.opcode == FetchOpcode::kTextureFetch &&
+              tf.dimension == xenos::FetchOpDimension::k2D &&
+              !tf.attributes.unnormalized_coordinates && (fc == 5u || fc == 6u || fc == 7u) &&
+              tf.result.storage_target == InstructionStorageTarget::kRegister &&
+              tf.result.storage_addressing_mode == InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              tf.result.GetUsedWriteMask() == 0b0001 &&
+              tf.result.GetUsedResultComponents() == 0b0001) {
+            pending_stage = 1;
+            pending_tfetch_offset = instr_offset;
+            pending_fetch_constant = fc;
+            pending_reg = tf.result.storage_index;
+          }
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        auto& op = *reinterpret_cast<const AluInstruction*>(op_ptr);
+        ParsedAluInstruction instr;
+        ParseAluInstruction(op, type(), instr);
+        if (instr.IsNop()) {
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        if (pending_stage == 1) {
+          const bool is_subsc = (instr.scalar_opcode == AluScalarOpcode::kSubsc0 ||
+                                 instr.scalar_opcode == AluScalarOpcode::kSubsc1);
+          const bool scalar_ok =
+              is_subsc &&
+              instr.scalar_result.storage_target == InstructionStorageTarget::kRegister &&
+              instr.scalar_result.storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.scalar_result.storage_index == pending_reg &&
+              instr.scalar_result.GetUsedWriteMask() == 0b0001 &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[0].storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kConstantFloat &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[0].storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[0].storage_index >= 248 &&
+              !instr.scalar_operands[0].is_negated &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[1].storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kRegister &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[1].storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[1].storage_index == pending_reg &&
+              !instr.scalar_operands[1].is_negated && !instr.scalar_operands[1].is_absolute_value &&
+              instr.scalar_operands[1].GetComponent(0) == SwizzleSource::kX;
+          const uint32_t vec_wm = instr.vector_and_constant_result.GetUsedWriteMask();
+          const bool vec_min_ok =
+              instr.vector_opcode == AluVectorOpcode::kMin &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_target ==
+                  InstructionStorageTarget::kRegister &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              rex::bit_count(vec_wm) == 1 &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kConstantFloat &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_index >= 248 &&
+              !instr.vector_operands[1].is_negated;
+          if (scalar_ok && vec_min_ok) {
+            uint32_t z_comp = 0;
+            rex::bit_scan_forward(vec_wm, &z_comp);
+            pending_z_reg = instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_index;
+            pending_z_comp = z_comp;
+            pending_stage = 2;
+          } else {
+            pending_stage = 0;
+          }
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        if (pending_stage == 2) {
+          const bool sgt_ok =
+              instr.vector_opcode == AluVectorOpcode::kSgt &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_target ==
+                  InstructionStorageTarget::kRegister &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.storage_index == pending_reg &&
+              instr.vector_and_constant_result.GetUsedWriteMask() == 0b0001 &&
+              instr.scalar_result.GetUsedWriteMask() == 0 &&
+              instr.vector_operands[0].storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kRegister &&
+              instr.vector_operands[0].storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.vector_operands[0].storage_index == pending_reg &&
+              !instr.vector_operands[0].is_negated && !instr.vector_operands[0].is_absolute_value &&
+              instr.vector_operands[0].GetComponent(0) == SwizzleSource::kX &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_source == InstructionStorageSource::kRegister &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_addressing_mode ==
+                  InstructionStorageAddressingMode::kAbsolute &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].storage_index == pending_z_reg &&
+              !instr.vector_operands[1].is_negated && !instr.vector_operands[1].is_absolute_value &&
+              instr.vector_operands[1].GetComponent(0) ==
+                  GetSwizzleFromComponentIndex(pending_z_comp);
+          if (sgt_ok) {
+            MajinShadowLookup entry;
+            entry.tfetch_instr_offset = pending_tfetch_offset;
+            entry.sgt_instr_offset = instr_offset;
+            entry.fetch_constant = pending_fetch_constant;
+            majin_shadow_lookups_.push_back(entry);
+          }
+          pending_stage = 0;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
```
