```patch
+bool VulkanRenderTargetCache::CreateShadowDirectResolvePipelines() {
+  const ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* const vulkan_device = command_processor_.GetVulkanDevice();
+  const ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice::Functions& dfn = vulkan_device->functions();
+  const VkDevice device = vulkan_device->device();
+
+  VkDescriptorSetLayout set_layouts[] = {
+      command_processor_.GetSingleTransientDescriptorLayout(
+          VulkanCommandProcessor::SingleTransientDescriptorLayout::kStorageImageCompute),
+      descriptor_set_layout_sampled_image_x2_,
+  };
+  VkPushConstantRange pc_range;
+  pc_range.stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT;
+  pc_range.offset = 0;
+  pc_range.size = sizeof(ShadowDirectResolvePushConstants);
+  VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo layout_info = {};
+  layout_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
+  layout_info.setLayoutCount = uint32_t(rex::countof(set_layouts));
+  layout_info.pSetLayouts = set_layouts;
+  layout_info.pushConstantRangeCount = 1;
+  layout_info.pPushConstantRanges = &pc_range;
+  if (dfn.vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &layout_info, nullptr,
+                                 &shadow_direct_resolve_pipeline_layout_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
+    shadow_direct_resolve_pipeline_layout_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  for (uint32_t format_idx = 0; format_idx < 2; ++format_idx) {
+    const bool is_float24 =
+        (format_idx == uint32_t(xenos::DepthRenderTargetFormat::kD24FS8));
+    SpirvBuilder builder(spv::Spv_1_0, (SpirvShaderTranslator::kSpirvMagicToolId << 16) | 1,
+                         nullptr);
+    spv::Id ext_glsl = builder.import("GLSL.std.450");
+    builder.addCapability(spv::CapabilityShader);
+    builder.setMemoryModel(spv::AddressingModelLogical, spv::MemoryModelGLSL450);
+    builder.setSource(spv::SourceLanguageUnknown, 0);
+
+    spv::Id type_void = builder.makeVoidType();
+    spv::Id type_bool = builder.makeBoolType();
+    spv::Id type_int = builder.makeIntType(32);
+    spv::Id type_int2 = builder.makeVectorType(type_int, 2);
+    spv::Id type_uint = builder.makeUintType(32);
+    spv::Id type_uint3 = builder.makeVectorType(type_uint, 3);
+    spv::Id type_uint4 = builder.makeVectorType(type_uint, 4);
+    spv::Id type_float = builder.makeFloatType(32);
+    spv::Id type_float4 = builder.makeVectorType(type_float, 4);
+
+    // Set 0, binding 0: writeonly uimage2D (R32_UINT storage view over R32_SFLOAT shadow texture).
+    spv::Id dest_image = builder.createVariable(
+        spv::NoPrecision, spv::StorageClassUniformConstant,
+        builder.makeImageType(type_uint, spv::Dim2D, false, false, false, 2,
+                              spv::ImageFormatR32ui),
+        "dest_img");
+    builder.addDecoration(dest_image, spv::DecorationDescriptorSet, 0);
+    builder.addDecoration(dest_image, spv::DecorationBinding, 0);
+    builder.addDecoration(dest_image, spv::DecorationNonReadable);
+
+    // Set 1, binding 0: texture2D (1xMSAA depth image view from VulkanRenderTarget).
+    spv::Id src_depth = builder.createVariable(
+        spv::NoPrecision, spv::StorageClassUniformConstant,
+        builder.makeImageType(type_float, spv::Dim2D, false, false, false, 1,
+                              spv::ImageFormatUnknown),
+        "src_depth");
+    builder.addDecoration(src_depth, spv::DecorationDescriptorSet, 1);
+    builder.addDecoration(src_depth, spv::DecorationBinding, 0);
+
+    // Push constants: src_offset_x, src_offset_y, width, height, flags.
+    std::vector<spv::Id> pc_members(5, type_uint);
+    spv::Id type_pc = builder.makeStructType(pc_members, "ShadowDirectResolvePC");
+    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
+      builder.addMemberDecoration(type_pc, i, spv::DecorationOffset, int(sizeof(uint32_t) * i));
+    }
+    builder.addDecoration(type_pc, spv::DecorationBlock);
+    spv::Id pc_var =
+        builder.createVariable(spv::NoPrecision, spv::StorageClassPushConstant, type_pc, "pc");
+
+    spv::Id input_gid = builder.createVariable(spv::NoPrecision, spv::StorageClassInput, type_uint3,
+                                               "gl_GlobalInvocationID");
+    builder.addDecoration(input_gid, spv::DecorationBuiltIn, spv::BuiltInGlobalInvocationId);
+
+    std::vector<spv::Id> main_params;
+    std::vector<std::vector<spv::Decoration>> main_precs;
+    spv::Block* main_entry;
+    spv::Function* main_fn = builder.makeFunctionEntry(spv::NoPrecision, type_void, "main",
+                                                       main_params, main_precs, &main_entry);
+
+    auto load_pc = [&](int member_idx) -> spv::Id {
+      std::vector<spv::Id> idx = {builder.makeIntConstant(member_idx)};
+      return builder.createLoad(
+          builder.createAccessChain(spv::StorageClassPushConstant, pc_var, idx), spv::NoPrecision);
+    };
+
+    spv::Id gid = builder.createLoad(input_gid, spv::NoPrecision);
+    spv::Id x = builder.createCompositeExtract(gid, type_uint, 0);
+    spv::Id y = builder.createCompositeExtract(gid, type_uint, 1);
+    spv::Id width = load_pc(2);
+    spv::Id height = load_pc(3);
+
+    spv::Id in_bounds = builder.createBinOp(
+        spv::OpLogicalAnd, type_bool, builder.createBinOp(spv::OpULessThan, type_bool, x, width),
+        builder.createBinOp(spv::OpULessThan, type_bool, y, height));
+    spv::Block& then_block = builder.makeNewBlock();
+    spv::Block& merge_block = builder.makeNewBlock();
+    builder.createSelectionMerge(&merge_block, spv::SelectionControlMaskNone);
+    builder.createConditionalBranch(in_bounds, &then_block, &merge_block);
+    builder.setBuildPoint(&then_block);
+
+    spv::Id src_offset_x = load_pc(0);
+    spv::Id src_offset_y = load_pc(1);
+    spv::Id flags = load_pc(4);
+    spv::Id const_u0 = builder.makeUintConstant(0);
+    spv::Id const_u1 = builder.makeUintConstant(1);
+    spv::Id const_u3 = builder.makeUintConstant(3);
+    spv::Id const_u4 = builder.makeUintConstant(4);
+
+    spv::Id fill_hpo = builder.createBinOp(
+        spv::OpINotEqual, type_bool,
+        builder.createBinOp(spv::OpBitwiseAnd, type_uint, flags, const_u1), const_u0);
+    spv::Id hx = builder.createTriOp(spv::OpBitFieldUExtract, type_uint, flags, const_u1, const_u3);
+    spv::Id hy = builder.createTriOp(spv::OpBitFieldUExtract, type_uint, flags, const_u4, const_u3);
+    spv::Id px = builder.createTriOp(
+        spv::OpSelect, type_uint, fill_hpo,
+        builder.createBinBuiltinCall(type_uint, ext_glsl, GLSLstd450UMax, x, hx), x);
+    spv::Id py = builder.createTriOp(
+        spv::OpSelect, type_uint, fill_hpo,
+        builder.createBinBuiltinCall(type_uint, ext_glsl, GLSLstd450UMax, y, hy), y);
+
+    spv::Id sx = builder.createBinOp(spv::OpIAdd, type_uint, src_offset_x, px);
+    spv::Id sy = builder.createBinOp(spv::OpIAdd, type_uint, src_offset_y, py);
+    std::vector<spv::Id> src_coords_vec = {
+        builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpBitcast, type_int, sx),
+        builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpBitcast, type_int, sy),
+    };
+    spv::Builder::TextureParameters tp = {};
+    tp.sampler = builder.createLoad(src_depth, spv::NoPrecision);
+    tp.coords = builder.createCompositeConstruct(type_int2, src_coords_vec);
+    tp.lod = builder.makeIntConstant(0);
+    spv::Id fetched = builder.createTextureCall(spv::NoPrecision, type_float4, false, true, false,
+                                                false, false, tp, spv::ImageOperandsMaskNone);
+    spv::Id depth_f = builder.createCompositeExtract(fetched, type_float, 0);
+
+    spv::Id depth_u;
+    if (is_float24) {
+      // Exact bit-for-bit match to GetDumpPipeline (host [0, 0.5] -> guest 20e4 [0, 1]) +
+      // texture_load_32bpb_scaled_image (guest 20e4 -> float32 bits).
+      spv::Id depth_20e4 = SpirvShaderTranslator::PreClampedDepthTo20e4(
+          builder, depth_f, depth_float24_round(), true, ext_glsl);
+      depth_u = SpirvShaderTranslator::Depth20e4To32(builder, depth_20e4, 0, false, true, ext_glsl);
+    } else {
+      // Exact bit-for-bit match to GetDumpPipeline (UNORM24 roundEven) +
+      // texture_load_32bpb_scaled_image ((d24 + (d24 >> 23)) / 16777216.0).
+      spv::Id depth_clamped = builder.createTriBuiltinCall(
+          type_float, ext_glsl, GLSLstd450NClamp, depth_f, builder.makeFloatConstant(0.0f),
+          builder.makeFloatConstant(1.0f));
+      spv::Id d24 = builder.createUnaryOp(
+          spv::OpConvertFToU, type_uint,
+          builder.createUnaryBuiltinCall(
+              type_float, ext_glsl, GLSLstd450RoundEven,
+              builder.createBinOp(spv::OpFMul, type_float, depth_clamped,
+                                  builder.makeFloatConstant(float(0xFFFFFF)))));
+      spv::Id d24_adj = builder.createBinOp(
+          spv::OpIAdd, type_uint, d24,
+          builder.createBinOp(spv::OpShiftRightLogical, type_uint, d24,
+                              builder.makeUintConstant(23)));
+      spv::Id d_f32 = builder.createBinOp(
+          spv::OpFMul, type_float, builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpConvertUToF, type_float, d24_adj),
+          builder.makeFloatConstant(1.0f / 16777216.0f));
+      depth_u = builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpBitcast, type_uint, d_f32);
+    }
+
+    std::vector<spv::Id> dst_coords_vec = {
+        builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpBitcast, type_int, x),
+        builder.createUnaryOp(spv::OpBitcast, type_int, y),
+    };
+    spv::Id dst_coords = builder.createCompositeConstruct(type_int2, dst_coords_vec);
+    std::vector<spv::Id> texel_vec = {depth_u, const_u0, const_u0, const_u0};
+    spv::Id texel_u4 = builder.createCompositeConstruct(type_uint4, texel_vec);
+    spv::Id dst_loaded = builder.createLoad(dest_image, spv::NoPrecision);
+    std::vector<spv::Id> write_ops = {dst_loaded, dst_coords, texel_u4};
+    builder.createNoResultOp(spv::OpImageWrite, write_ops);
+
+    builder.createBranch(&merge_block);
+    builder.setBuildPoint(&merge_block);
+    builder.leaveFunction();
+
+    builder.addExecutionMode(main_fn, spv::ExecutionModeLocalSize, 16, 16, 1);
+    spv::Instruction* entry = builder.addEntryPoint(spv::ExecutionModelGLCompute, main_fn, "main");
+    entry->addIdOperand(input_gid);
+
+    std::vector<unsigned int> spirv;
+    builder.dump(spirv);
+    shadow_direct_resolve_pipelines_[format_idx] = ui::vulkan::util::CreateComputePipeline(
+        vulkan_device, shadow_direct_resolve_pipeline_layout_,
+        reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(spirv.data()), sizeof(uint32_t) * spirv.size());
+    if (shadow_direct_resolve_pipelines_[format_idx] == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
+      REXGPU_ERROR(
+          "VulkanRenderTargetCache: Failed to create shadow direct resolve compute pipeline ({})",
+          is_float24 ? "D24FS8" : "D24S8");
+      return false;
+    }
+    vulkan_device->SetObjectName(
+        VK_OBJECT_TYPE_PIPELINE, shadow_direct_resolve_pipelines_[format_idx],
+        is_float24 ? "Shadow Direct Depth Resolve (D24FS8)" : "Shadow Direct Depth Resolve (D24S8)");
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+
+bool VulkanRenderTargetCache::TryResolveShadowDepthDirectly(
+    const draw_util::ResolveInfo& resolve_info, uint32_t res_scale_x, uint32_t res_scale_y,
+    VulkanTextureCache& texture_cache, uint32_t& written_address_out,
+    uint32_t& written_length_out) {
+  if (shadow_direct_resolve_pipeline_layout_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (!resolve_info.IsCopyingDepth() || resolve_info.copy_dest_info.copy_dest_array ||
+      resolve_info.copy_dest_coordinate_info.offset_x_div_8 != 0 ||
+      resolve_info.copy_dest_coordinate_info.offset_y_div_8 != 0 ||
+      resolve_info.copy_dest_base != resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_start ||
+      (resolve_info.copy_dest_base & 0xFFFu) != 0 || res_scale_x != res_scale_y ||
+      res_scale_x <= 1 || resolve_info.depth_edram_info.msaa_samples != xenos::MsaaSamples::k1X) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  uint32_t dump_base, dump_row_length_used, dump_rows, dump_pitch;
+  resolve_info.GetCopyEdramTileSpan(dump_base, dump_row_length_used, dump_rows, dump_pitch);
+  GetResolveCopyRectanglesToDump(dump_base, dump_row_length_used, dump_rows, dump_pitch,
+                                 dump_rectangles_);
+  if (dump_rectangles_.size() != 1) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const ResolveCopyDumpRectangle& rect = dump_rectangles_[0];
+  if (rect.row_first != 0 || rect.rows != dump_rows || rect.row_first_start != 0 ||
+      rect.row_last_end != dump_row_length_used) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  auto* src_rt = static_cast<VulkanRenderTarget*>(rect.render_target);
+  if (!src_rt || !src_rt->key().is_depth || !IsShadowMapDepthTarget(src_rt->key()) ||
+      src_rt->key().msaa_samples != xenos::MsaaSamples::k1X ||
+      src_rt->key().GetPitchTiles() != dump_pitch || src_rt->resolution_scale() != res_scale_x) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  const uint32_t copy_w = uint32_t(resolve_info.coordinate_info.width_div_8) << 3;
+  const uint32_t copy_h = uint32_t(resolve_info.height_div_8) << 3;
+  const uint32_t tile_delta =
+      (resolve_info.depth_edram_info.base_tiles - src_rt->key().base_tiles) &
+      (xenos::kEdramTileCount - 1);
+  const uint32_t tile_y = tile_delta / dump_pitch;
+  const uint32_t tile_x = tile_delta % dump_pitch;
+  const uint32_t guest_src_x =
+      tile_x * xenos::kEdramTileWidthSamples +
+      (uint32_t(resolve_info.coordinate_info.edram_offset_x_div_8) << 3);
+  const uint32_t guest_src_y =
+      tile_y * xenos::kEdramTileHeightSamples +
+      (uint32_t(resolve_info.coordinate_info.edram_offset_y_div_8) << 3);
+  const uint32_t rt_guest_w = src_rt->key().GetWidth();
+  const uint32_t rt_guest_h =
+      GetRenderTargetHeight(src_rt->key().pitch_tiles_at_32bpp, src_rt->key().msaa_samples);
+  if (guest_src_x + copy_w > rt_guest_w || guest_src_y + copy_h > rt_guest_h) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  const uint32_t depth_fmt_idx = uint32_t(src_rt->key().GetDepthFormat());
+  if (depth_fmt_idx >= 2 || shadow_direct_resolve_pipelines_[depth_fmt_idx] == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const xenos::TextureFormat expected_format =
+      DepthRenderTargetToTextureFormat(src_rt->key().GetDepthFormat());
+  texture_cache.FindDirectShadowResolveTargets(
+      resolve_info.copy_dest_base, resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_length, copy_w, copy_h,
+      expected_format, res_scale_x, direct_shadow_resolve_targets_);
+  if (direct_shadow_resolve_targets_.empty()) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  // Allocate transient destination descriptors before modifying range state.
+  VkDescriptorSet dest_sets_inline[4];
+  std::vector<VkDescriptorSet> dest_sets_heap;
+  VkDescriptorSet* dest_sets = dest_sets_inline;
+  const size_t target_count = direct_shadow_resolve_targets_.size();
+  if (target_count > rex::countof(dest_sets_inline)) {
+    dest_sets_heap.resize(target_count);
+    dest_sets = dest_sets_heap.data();
+  }
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < target_count; ++i) {
+    dest_sets[i] = command_processor_.AllocateSingleTransientDescriptor(
+        VulkanCommandProcessor::SingleTransientDescriptorLayout::kStorageImageCompute);
+    if (dest_sets[i] == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  const uint32_t copy_dest_range_unscaled = resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_start -
+                                            resolve_info.copy_dest_base +
+                                            resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_length;
+  // Mark resolved ranges and notify shared memory first so all watches see the GPU write,
+  // then mark each directly populated shadow texture up-to-date and re-watched.
+  texture_cache.MarkShadowMapRangeAsResolved(resolve_info.copy_dest_base, copy_dest_range_unscaled);
+  texture_cache.MarkShadowMapRangeAsResolved(resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_start,
+                                             resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_length);
+  texture_cache.MarkRangeAsResolved(resolve_info.copy_dest_base, copy_dest_range_unscaled);
+  texture_cache.MarkRangeAsResolved(resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_start,
+                                    resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_length);
+
+  command_processor_.EndRenderPass();
+  DeferredCommandBuffer& command_buffer = command_processor_.deferred_command_buffer();
+  const uint32_t host_w = copy_w * res_scale_x;
+  const uint32_t host_h = copy_h * res_scale_y;
+
+  // Transition source shadow depth RT for compute shader read.
+  command_processor_.PushImageMemoryBarrier(
+      src_rt->image(),
+      ui::vulkan::util::InitializeSubresourceRange(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT |
+                                                   VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT),
+      src_rt->current_stage_mask(), VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
+      src_rt->current_access_mask(), VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, src_rt->current_layout(),
+      VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
+  src_rt->SetUsage(VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT,
+                   VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
+
+  const ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* const vulkan_device = command_processor_.GetVulkanDevice();
+  const ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice::Functions& dfn = vulkan_device->functions();
+  const VkDevice device = vulkan_device->device();
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < target_count; ++i) {
+    VkImageView dst_view =
+        texture_cache.PrepareDirectShadowResolveTarget(direct_shadow_resolve_targets_[i]);
+    VkDescriptorImageInfo img_info = {};
+    img_info.imageView = dst_view;
+    img_info.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL;
+    VkWriteDescriptorSet write = {};
+    write.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
+    write.dstSet = dest_sets[i];
+    write.dstBinding = 0;
+    write.descriptorCount = 1;
+    write.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE;
+    write.pImageInfo = &img_info;
+    dfn.vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, 1, &write, 0, nullptr);
+  }
+
+  command_processor_.SubmitBarriers(true);
+  command_processor_.BindExternalComputePipeline(shadow_direct_resolve_pipelines_[depth_fmt_idx]);
+  ShadowDirectResolvePushConstants pc = {};
+  pc.src_offset_x = guest_src_x * res_scale_x;
+  pc.src_offset_y = guest_src_y * res_scale_y;
+  pc.width = host_w;
+  pc.height = host_h;
+  pc.flags = uint32_t(resolve_info.depth_edram_info.fill_half_pixel_offset) |
+             ((res_scale_x >> 1) << 1) | ((res_scale_y >> 1) << 4);

+                                         nullptr);

+  const uint32_t groups_y = (host_h + 15) >> 4;
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < target_count; ++i) {

+                                           shadow_direct_resolve_pipeline_layout_, 0, 1,
+                                           &dest_sets[i], 0, nullptr);
+    command_buffer.CmdVkDispatch(groups_x, groups_y, 1);
+    texture_cache.FinalizeDirectShadowResolveTarget(direct_shadow_resolve_targets_[i]);
+  }

+  written_length_out = resolve_info.copy_dest_extent_length;

+void VulkanTextureCache::FindDirectShadowResolveTargets(
+    uint32_t copy_dest_base, uint32_t copy_dest_extent_length, uint32_t guest_width,
+    uint32_t guest_height, xenos::TextureFormat expected_format, uint32_t shadow_scale,
+    std::vector<DirectShadowResolveHandle>& targets_out) {
+  targets_out.clear();
+  if ((copy_dest_base & 0xFFFu) != 0 || shadow_scale <= 1) {
+    return;
+  }
+  const uint32_t target_base_page = copy_dest_base >> 12;
+  const uint32_t expected_host_w = guest_width * shadow_scale;
+  const uint32_t expected_host_h = guest_height * shadow_scale;
+  for (const auto& pair : textures()) {
+    const TextureKey& key = pair.first;
+    if (key.base_page != target_base_page || !key.scaled_resolve || !key.tiled ||
+        key.dimension != xenos::DataDimension::k2DOrStacked || key.mip_max_level != 0 ||
+        key.format != expected_format || key.GetWidth() != guest_width ||
+        key.GetHeight() != guest_height || !TextureKey::IsShadowMapTexture(key)) {
+      continue;
+    }
+    auto* vulkan_tex = static_cast<VulkanTexture*>(pair.second.get());
+    if (!vulkan_tex || vulkan_tex->storage_view() == VK_NULL_HANDLE ||
+        vulkan_tex->force_load_3d_tiling() || vulkan_tex->resolution_scale() != shadow_scale ||
+        vulkan_tex->host_width() != expected_host_w ||
+        vulkan_tex->host_height() != expected_host_h ||
+        copy_dest_extent_length < vulkan_tex->GetGuestBaseSize()) {
+      continue;
+    }
+    targets_out.push_back(vulkan_tex);
+  }
+}
+
+VkImageView VulkanTextureCache::PrepareDirectShadowResolveTarget(
+    DirectShadowResolveHandle texture) {
+  auto& vulkan_texture = *static_cast<VulkanTexture*>(texture);
+  vulkan_texture.MarkAsUsed();
+  auto old_usage = vulkan_texture.SetUsage(VulkanTexture::Usage::kComputeDestination);
+  VkPipelineStageFlags src_stage;
+  VkAccessFlags src_access;
+  VkImageLayout old_layout;
+  GetTextureUsageMasks(old_usage, src_stage, src_access, old_layout);
+  command_processor_.PushImageMemoryBarrier(
+      vulkan_texture.image(), ui::vulkan::util::InitializeSubresourceRange(), src_stage,
+      VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, src_access, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT, old_layout,
+      VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, false);
+  return vulkan_texture.storage_view();
+}
```

```patch
+namespace {
+
+const char* GetSwapDeDitherComputeSource(bool output_fxaa_luma) {
+  return output_fxaa_luma ? R"(
+cbuffer XeSwapPostConstants : register(b0) {
+  uint2 xe_dedither_size;
+  float2 xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  uint2 xe_dedither_scale;
+  uint xe_dedither_debug;
+  uint xe_dedither_has_depth;
+  float xe_dedither_strength;
+};
+
+RWTexture2D<float4> xe_dedither_dest : register(u0);
+Texture2D<float4> xe_dedither_source : register(t0);
+Texture2D<float4> xe_dedither_depth : register(t1);
+SamplerState xe_sampler_linear_clamp : register(s0);
+
+static const float3 kLumaWeights = float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f);
+
+float SampleOscillationAtStep(int2 dp, int stepVal, float depthScale, int2 depthMax) {
+  float zC  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(dp, 0)).r;
+  float zN  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( 0, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zS  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( 0,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zE  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal,  0), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zW  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal,  0), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zNW = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zNE = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zSW = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zSE = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+
+  float dW = zW - zC;
+  float dE = zE - zC;
+  float dN = zN - zC;
+  float dS = zS - zC;
+  float dNW = zNW - zC;
+  float dSE = zSE - zC;
+  float dNE = zNE - zC;
+  float dSW = zSW - zC;
+
+  bool oscH  = (dW * dE > 0.0f);
+  bool oscV  = (dN * dS > 0.0f);
+  bool oscD1 = (dNW * dSE > 0.0f);
+  bool oscD2 = (dNE * dSW > 0.0f);
+
+  float strH  = oscH  ? min(abs(dW),  abs(dE))  : 0.0f;
+  float strV  = oscV  ? min(abs(dN),  abs(dS))  : 0.0f;
+  float strD1 = oscD1 ? min(abs(dNW), abs(dSE)) : 0.0f;
+  float strD2 = oscD2 ? min(abs(dNE), abs(dSW)) : 0.0f;
+  float maxOscStr = max(max(strH, strV), max(strD1, strD2));
+
+  return maxOscStr / depthScale;
+}
+
+float DetectDitherAtStep(int2 p, int2 dp, int2 depthMax, int stepVal, out float3 outBoxAvg) {
+  float2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  float2 uv = (float2(p) + float2(0.5f, 0.5f)) * texel;
+  float2 st = float(stepVal) * texel;
+
+  float3 c  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv, 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 n  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( 0.0f, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 s  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( 0.0f,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 e  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x,  0.0f), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 w  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x,  0.0f), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 nw = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 ne = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 sw = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 se = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+
+  float3 cardAvg = 0.25f * (n + s + e + w);
+  float3 diagAvg = 0.25f * (nw + ne + sw + se);
+  outBoxAvg = 0.5f * (cardAvg + diagAvg);
+
+  if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float zC = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(dp, 0)).r;
+  float depthScale = max(min(zC, 1.0f - zC), 0.0005f);
+
+  const float kMinRelOsc = 0.0025f;
+
+  float relOsc = SampleOscillationAtStep(dp, stepVal, depthScale, depthMax);
+
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc) {
+    float relOsc2 = SampleOscillationAtStep(dp, stepVal * 2, depthScale, depthMax);
+    if (relOsc2 > kMinRelOsc) {
+      relOsc = relOsc2;
+    }
+  }
+
+  float lumaC = dot(c, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaN = dot(n, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaS = dot(s, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaE = dot(e, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaW = dot(w, kLumaWeights);
+
+  float minCardLuma = min(min(lumaN, lumaS), min(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float maxCardLuma = max(max(lumaN, lumaS), max(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float cardRange   = maxCardLuma - minCardLuma;
+  float darkDrop    = minCardLuma - lumaC;
+
+  bool isDarkStipple = (darkDrop > 0.025f) && (cardRange < max(darkDrop * 1.5f, 0.07f));
+
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc && !isDarkStipple) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float colorDiff = abs(dot(c - outBoxAvg, kLumaWeights));
+  if (colorDiff < 0.004f) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float oscConf = saturate((relOsc - kMinRelOsc) / 0.015f);
+  float stippleConf = isDarkStipple ? saturate((darkDrop - 0.02f) / 0.06f) : 0.0f;
+  float geomConf = max(oscConf, stippleConf);
+
+  float colorConf = saturate((colorDiff - 0.004f) / 0.025f);
+  return geomConf * colorConf;
+}
+
+[numthreads(16, 8, 1)]
+void main(uint3 xe_thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
+  uint2 pixel = xe_thread_id.xy;
+  if (any(pixel >= xe_dedither_size)) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  int2 p = int2(pixel);
+  float2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  float2 uv = (float2(pixel) + float2(0.5f, 0.5f)) * texel;
+  float3 c = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv, 0.0f).rgb;
+
+  uint depth_w = 0;
+  uint depth_h = 0;
+  xe_dedither_depth.GetDimensions(depth_w, depth_h);
+  int2 depth_max = int2(max(int(depth_w), 1) - 1, max(int(depth_h), 1) - 1);
+  int2 depth_p = (depth_w != xe_dedither_size.x || depth_h < xe_dedither_size.y)
+      ? int2(round(float2(p) * float2(depth_w, depth_h) * xe_dedither_size_inv))
+      : p;
+  depth_p = clamp(depth_p, int2(0, 0), depth_max);
+
+  int scaleVal = int(max(xe_dedither_scale.x, 1u));
+
+  float3 boxAvgScale;
+  float confScale = DetectDitherAtStep(p, depth_p, depth_max, scaleVal, boxAvgScale);
+
+  float confidence = confScale;
+  float3 bestBoxAvg = boxAvgScale;
+
+  if (scaleVal > 1) {
+    float3 boxAvgNative;
+    float confNative = DetectDitherAtStep(p, depth_p, depth_max, 1, boxAvgNative);
+    if (confNative > confidence) {
+      confidence = confNative;
+      bestBoxAvg = boxAvgNative;
+    }
+  }
+
+  float3 result = c;
+  if (xe_dedither_debug != 0u) {
+    if (pixel.x < 360u && pixel.y < 202u) {
+      if (pixel.x == 0u || pixel.x == 359u || pixel.y == 0u || pixel.y == 201u) {
+        result = float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
+      } else if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+        result = float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
+      } else {
+        int2 fullCoord = int2((float2(pixel) / float2(360.0f, 202.0f)) * float2(depth_max));
+        float pipZ = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(fullCoord, 0)).r;
+        float visZ = pow(saturate(pipZ), 0.35f);
+        result = float3(visZ, visZ, visZ);
+      }
+    } else {
+      if (confidence > 0.01f) {
+        float heatStrength = saturate(confidence * 1.5f * max(xe_dedither_strength, 0.2f));
+        result = lerp(c, float3(1.0f, 0.08f, 0.85f), heatStrength);
+      }
+    }
+  } else {
+    result = lerp(c, bestBoxAvg, saturate(confidence * xe_dedither_strength));
+  }
+
+  float outLuma = dot(result, kLumaWeights);
+  xe_dedither_dest[pixel] = float4(result, outLuma);
+}
+)"
+                         : R"(
+cbuffer XeSwapPostConstants : register(b0) {
+  uint2 xe_dedither_size;
+  float2 xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  uint2 xe_dedither_scale;
+  uint xe_dedither_debug;
+  uint xe_dedither_has_depth;
+  float xe_dedither_strength;
+};
+
+RWTexture2D<float4> xe_dedither_dest : register(u0);
+Texture2D<float4> xe_dedither_source : register(t0);
+Texture2D<float4> xe_dedither_depth : register(t1);
+SamplerState xe_sampler_linear_clamp : register(s0);
+
+static const float3 kLumaWeights = float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f);
+
+float SampleOscillationAtStep(int2 dp, int stepVal, float depthScale, int2 depthMax) {
+  float zC  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(dp, 0)).r;
+  float zN  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( 0, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zS  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( 0,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zE  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal,  0), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zW  = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal,  0), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zNW = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zNE = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal, -stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zSW = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2(-stepVal,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+  float zSE = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(clamp(dp + int2( stepVal,  stepVal), int2(0, 0), depthMax), 0)).r;
+
+  float dW = zW - zC;
+  float dE = zE - zC;
+  float dN = zN - zC;
+  float dS = zS - zC;
+  float dNW = zNW - zC;
+  float dSE = zSE - zC;
+  float dNE = zNE - zC;
+  float dSW = zSW - zC;
+
+  bool oscH  = (dW * dE > 0.0f);
+  bool oscV  = (dN * dS > 0.0f);
+  bool oscD1 = (dNW * dSE > 0.0f);
+  bool oscD2 = (dNE * dSW > 0.0f);
+
+  float strH  = oscH  ? min(abs(dW),  abs(dE))  : 0.0f;
+  float strV  = oscV  ? min(abs(dN),  abs(dS))  : 0.0f;
+  float strD1 = oscD1 ? min(abs(dNW), abs(dSE)) : 0.0f;
+  float strD2 = oscD2 ? min(abs(dNE), abs(dSW)) : 0.0f;
+  float maxOscStr = max(max(strH, strV), max(strD1, strD2));
+
+  return maxOscStr / depthScale;
+}
+
+float DetectDitherAtStep(int2 p, int2 dp, int2 depthMax, int stepVal, out float3 outBoxAvg) {
+  float2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  float2 uv = (float2(p) + float2(0.5f, 0.5f)) * texel;
+  float2 st = float(stepVal) * texel;
+
+  float3 c  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv, 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 n  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( 0.0f, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 s  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( 0.0f,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 e  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x,  0.0f), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 w  = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x,  0.0f), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 nw = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 ne = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x, -st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 sw = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2(-st.x,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+  float3 se = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv + float2( st.x,  st.y), 0.0f).rgb;
+
+  float3 cardAvg = 0.25f * (n + s + e + w);
+  float3 diagAvg = 0.25f * (nw + ne + sw + se);
+  outBoxAvg = 0.5f * (cardAvg + diagAvg);
+
+  if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float zC = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(dp, 0)).r;
+  float depthScale = max(min(zC, 1.0f - zC), 0.0005f);
+
+  const float kMinRelOsc = 0.0025f;
+
+  float relOsc = SampleOscillationAtStep(dp, stepVal, depthScale, depthMax);
+
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc) {
+    float relOsc2 = SampleOscillationAtStep(dp, stepVal * 2, depthScale, depthMax);
+    if (relOsc2 > kMinRelOsc) {
+      relOsc = relOsc2;
+    }
+  }
+
+  float lumaC = dot(c, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaN = dot(n, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaS = dot(s, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaE = dot(e, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaW = dot(w, kLumaWeights);
+
+  float minCardLuma = min(min(lumaN, lumaS), min(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float maxCardLuma = max(max(lumaN, lumaS), max(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float cardRange   = maxCardLuma - minCardLuma;
+  float darkDrop    = minCardLuma - lumaC;
+
+  bool isDarkStipple = (darkDrop > 0.025f) && (cardRange < max(darkDrop * 1.5f, 0.07f));
+
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc && !isDarkStipple) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float colorDiff = abs(dot(c - outBoxAvg, kLumaWeights));
+  if (colorDiff < 0.004f) {
+    return 0.0f;
+  }
+
+  float oscConf = saturate((relOsc - kMinRelOsc) / 0.015f);
+  float stippleConf = isDarkStipple ? saturate((darkDrop - 0.02f) / 0.06f) : 0.0f;
+  float geomConf = max(oscConf, stippleConf);
+
+  float colorConf = saturate((colorDiff - 0.004f) / 0.025f);
+  return geomConf * colorConf;
+}
+
+[numthreads(16, 8, 1)]
+void main(uint3 xe_thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
+  uint2 pixel = xe_thread_id.xy;
+  if (any(pixel >= xe_dedither_size)) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  int2 p = int2(pixel);
+  float2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  float2 uv = (float2(pixel) + float2(0.5f, 0.5f)) * texel;
+  float3 c = xe_dedither_source.SampleLevel(xe_sampler_linear_clamp, uv, 0.0f).rgb;
+
+  uint depth_w = 0;
+  uint depth_h = 0;
+  xe_dedither_depth.GetDimensions(depth_w, depth_h);
+  int2 depth_max = int2(max(int(depth_w), 1) - 1, max(int(depth_h), 1) - 1);
+  int2 depth_p = (depth_w != xe_dedither_size.x || depth_h < xe_dedither_size.y)
+      ? int2(round(float2(p) * float2(depth_w, depth_h) * xe_dedither_size_inv))
+      : p;
+  depth_p = clamp(depth_p, int2(0, 0), depth_max);
+
+  int scaleVal = int(max(xe_dedither_scale.x, 1u));
+
+  float3 boxAvgScale;
+  float confScale = DetectDitherAtStep(p, depth_p, depth_max, scaleVal, boxAvgScale);
+
+  float confidence = confScale;
+  float3 bestBoxAvg = boxAvgScale;
+
+  if (scaleVal > 1) {
+    float3 boxAvgNative;
+    float confNative = DetectDitherAtStep(p, depth_p, depth_max, 1, boxAvgNative);
+    if (confNative > confidence) {
+      confidence = confNative;
+      bestBoxAvg = boxAvgNative;
+    }
+  }
+
+  float3 result = c;
+  if (xe_dedither_debug != 0u) {
+    if (pixel.x < 360u && pixel.y < 202u) {
+      if (pixel.x == 0u || pixel.x == 359u || pixel.y == 0u || pixel.y == 201u) {
+        result = float3(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
+      } else if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+        result = float3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
+      } else {
+        int2 fullCoord = int2((float2(pixel) / float2(360.0f, 202.0f)) * float2(depth_max));
+        float pipZ = xe_dedither_depth.Load(int3(fullCoord, 0)).r;
+        float visZ = pow(saturate(pipZ), 0.35f);
+        result = float3(visZ, visZ, visZ);
+      }
+    } else {
+      if (confidence > 0.01f) {
+        float heatStrength = saturate(confidence * 1.5f * max(xe_dedither_strength, 0.2f));
+        result = lerp(c, float3(1.0f, 0.08f, 0.85f), heatStrength);
+      }
+    }
+  } else {
+    result = lerp(c, bestBoxAvg, saturate(confidence * xe_dedither_strength));
+  }
+
+  xe_dedither_dest[pixel] = float4(result, 1.0f);
+}

+D3D12RenderTargetCache::D3D12RenderTarget*
+D3D12RenderTargetCache::GetMainDepthRenderTarget(uint32_t width, uint32_t /*height*/) const {
+  if (GetPath() != Path::kHostRenderTargets) {
+    return nullptr;
+  }
+  auto IsValidSceneDepth = [this, width](D3D12RenderTarget* rt) -> bool {
+    if (!rt) return false;
+    const uint32_t guest_w = rt->key().GetWidth();
+    if (IsShadowMapDepthTarget(rt->key())) return false;
+    if (guest_w < 1280) return false;
+    const uint32_t host_w = guest_w * draw_resolution_scale_x();
+    if (width > 0 && host_w < width * 3 / 4 && guest_w < width * 3 / 4) return false;
+    return true;
+  };
+
+  if (IsValidSceneDepth(main_scene_depth_render_target_)) {
+    return main_scene_depth_render_target_;
+  }
+  if (IsValidSceneDepth(last_scene_depth_render_target_)) {
+    return last_scene_depth_render_target_;
+  }
+  return nullptr;
+}

+void TextureCache::UnmarkRangeAsResolved(uint32_t start_unscaled, uint32_t length_unscaled) {
+  if (length_unscaled == 0) {
+    return;
+  }
+  start_unscaled &= 0x1FFFFFFF;
+  length_unscaled = std::min(length_unscaled, 0x20000000 - start_unscaled);
+
+  if (IsDrawResolutionScaled()) {
+    uint32_t page_first = start_unscaled >> 12;
+    uint32_t page_last = (start_unscaled + length_unscaled - 1) >> 12;
+    uint32_t block_first = page_first >> 5;
+    uint32_t block_last = page_last >> 5;
+    auto global_lock = global_critical_region_.Acquire();
+    for (uint32_t i = block_first; i <= block_last; ++i) {
+      uint32_t clear_bits = UINT32_MAX;
+      if (i == block_first) {
+        clear_bits &= ~((UINT32_C(1) << (page_first & 31)) - 1);
+      }
+      if (i == block_last && (page_last & 31) != 31) {
+        clear_bits &= (UINT32_C(1) << ((page_last & 31) + 1)) - 1;
+      }
+      if (scaled_resolve_pages_) {
+        scaled_resolve_pages_[i] &= ~clear_bits;
+        if (scaled_resolve_pages_[i] == 0) {
+          scaled_resolve_pages_l2_[i >> 6] &= ~(UINT64_C(1) << (i & 63));
+        }
+      }
+      if (shadow_resolve_pages_) {
+        shadow_resolve_pages_[i] &= ~clear_bits;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  shared_memory().RangeWrittenByGpu(start_unscaled, length_unscaled);
+}
+
+void TextureCache::MarkShadowMapRangeAsResolved(uint32_t start_unscaled, uint32_t length_unscaled) {
+  if (!shadow_resolve_pages_) {
+    return;
+  }
+  uint32_t page_first = start_unscaled >> 12;
+  uint32_t page_last = (start_unscaled + length_unscaled - 1) >> 12;
+  uint32_t block_first = page_first >> 5;
+  uint32_t block_last = page_last >> 5;
+  auto global_lock = global_critical_region_.Acquire();
+  for (uint32_t i = block_first; i <= block_last; ++i) {
+    uint32_t add_bits = UINT32_MAX;
+    if (i == block_first) {
+      add_bits &= ~((UINT32_C(1) << (page_first & 31)) - 1);
+    }
+    if (i == block_last && (page_last & 31) != 31) {
+      add_bits &= (UINT32_C(1) << ((page_last & 31) + 1)) - 1;
+    }
+    shadow_resolve_pages_[i] |= add_bits;
+  }
+}
+
+bool TextureCache::IsShadowMapResolvedRange(uint32_t address) const {
+  if (!shadow_resolve_pages_) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  uint32_t page = address >> 12;
+  uint32_t block = page >> 5;
+  if (block >= (SharedMemory::kBufferSize / 4096 / 32)) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  return (shadow_resolve_pages_[block] & (UINT32_C(1) << (page & 31))) != 0;
+}

+bool IsShadowMapPass(const VulkanRenderTargetCache* cache) {
+  if (!cache || cache->GetPath() != RenderTargetCache::Path::kHostRenderTargets) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  return cache->IsLastUpdateShadowMapDepth();

+// Majin shadow diagnostics. Logs each distinct suspicious configuration once
+// (bounded), so a capture in a flickering spot shows which draws are
+// classified inconsistently between the render target, the draw viewport
+// scale and the depth bias.
+void MajinShadowDiagDraw(const VulkanRenderTargetCache* cache, const RegisterFile& regs,
+                         uint32_t applied_scale, uint32_t shadow_scale, uint32_t scene_scale) {
+  static std::unordered_set<uint64_t> seen;
+  static uint32_t logged = 0;
+  constexpr uint32_t kMaxLogs = 256;
+  if (!cache || logged >= kMaxLogs) {
+    return;
+  }
+  const auto* rt = cache->MajinLastUpdateDepthRenderTarget();
+  if (!rt) {
+    return;
+  }
+  const auto key = rt->key();
+  if (!key.is_depth) {
+    return;
+  }
+  const auto pass_key = cache->last_update_render_pass_key();
+  const bool depth_only = pass_key.depth_and_color_used == 1;
+  const bool shadow_rt = key.IsShadowMapDepthTarget();
+  const bool shadow_pass = cache->IsLastUpdateShadowMapDepth();
+  const uint32_t width = key.GetWidth();
+  const uint32_t rt_scale = rt->resolution_scale();
+
+  auto mode = regs.Get<reg::PA_SU_SC_MODE_CNTL>();
+  const float bias_scale = regs.Get<float>(XE_GPU_REG_PA_SU_POLY_OFFSET_FRONT_SCALE);
+  const float bias_offset = regs.Get<float>(XE_GPU_REG_PA_SU_POLY_OFFSET_FRONT_OFFSET);
+
+  const char* reason = nullptr;
+  if (shadow_rt && !shadow_pass) {
+    // A: shadow-shaped RT, but the draw is NOT treated as a shadow pass ->
+    // viewport uses the scene scale over a shadow-scaled RT.
+    reason = "A: shadow RT but draw not classified as shadow pass";
+  } else if (shadow_pass && rt_scale != applied_scale) {
+    // C: classified as shadow but the RT was created at another scale.
+    reason = "C: shadow pass with RT scale != applied scale";
+  } else if (!shadow_rt && depth_only && width < 1280) {
+    // B: depth-only pass into a small RT that the heuristic doesn't recognize
+    // (possible secondary/spot light shadow map left at the scene scale).
+    reason = "B: depth-only small RT not recognized as shadow RT";
+  } else if (shadow_pass) {
+    // D: normal shadow pass - log each distinct depth-bias setup once.
+    reason = "D: shadow pass bias setup";
+  }
+  if (!reason) {
+    return;
+  }
+  uint64_t sig = uint64_t(key.key) ^ (uint64_t(pass_key.key) << 32) ^
+                 (uint64_t(reason[0]) << 56) ^ (uint64_t(applied_scale) << 48);
+  if (reason[0] == 'D') {
+    uint32_t bs, bo;
+    std::memcpy(&bs, &bias_scale, 4);
+    std::memcpy(&bo, &bias_offset, 4);
+    sig ^= (uint64_t(bs) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) ^ (uint64_t(bo) << 16) ^
+           (uint64_t(mode.value) << 8);
+  }
+  if (!seen.insert(sig).second) {
+    return;
+  }
+  ++logged;
+  REXGPU_WARN(
+      "[ShadowDiag] {} | rt={} width={} pitch_tiles={} msaa={}x base_tiles={} rt_scale={} | "
+      "pass_key=0x{:04X} depth_and_color_used=0x{:X} | applied_scale={} shadow_scale={} "
+      "scene_scale={} | poly_offset front_en={} back_en={} para_en={} scale={} offset={} "
+      "cull_front={} cull_back={}",
+      reason, key.GetDebugName(), width, uint32_t(key.pitch_tiles_at_32bpp),
+      uint32_t(1) << uint32_t(key.msaa_samples), uint32_t(key.base_tiles), rt_scale,
+      uint32_t(pass_key.key), uint32_t(pass_key.depth_and_color_used), applied_scale,
+      shadow_scale, scene_scale, uint32_t(mode.poly_offset_front_enable),
+      uint32_t(mode.poly_offset_back_enable), uint32_t(mode.poly_offset_para_enable), bias_scale,
+      bias_offset, uint32_t(mode.cull_front), uint32_t(mode.cull_back));
+  if (logged == kMaxLogs) {
+    REXGPU_WARN("[ShadowDiag] log limit reached ({}), further draw diagnostics suppressed",
+                kMaxLogs);
+  }
+}
+

+void VulkanTextureCache::ClearCache() {
+  const ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* const vulkan_device = command_processor_.GetVulkanDevice();
+
+  TextureCache::ClearCache();
+
+  // Keep scaled_resolve_buffer_ and its already-committed sparse physical memory
+  // blocks alive across mid-game cache clears instead of destroying and
+  // recreating the 16 GB sparse buffer.
+  scaled_resolve_last_usage_write_ = false;
+  scaled_resolve_last_written_range_ = std::make_pair(uint64_t(0), uint64_t(0));
+  if (scaled_resolve_buffer_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE &&
+      (IsDrawResolutionScaled() ||
+       (vulkan_device && vulkan_device->properties().sparseResidencyBuffer))) {
+    if (!InitializeScaledResolveBuffer()) {
+      REXGPU_ERROR(
+          "VulkanTextureCache: Failed to initialize scaled resolve buffer in ClearCache");
+    }
+  }
```

```patch
+const char* GetSwapDeDitherComputeSource(bool output_fxaa_luma) {
+  return output_fxaa_luma ? R"(#version 450
+layout(local_size_x = 16, local_size_y = 8, local_size_z = 1) in;
+
+layout(push_constant) uniform XeSwapPostConstants {
+  uvec2 xe_dedither_size;
+  vec2 xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  uvec2 xe_dedither_scale;
+  uint xe_dedither_debug;
+  uint xe_dedither_has_depth;
+  float xe_dedither_strength;
+};
+
+layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D xe_dedither_source;
+layout(set = 1, binding = 0, rgba16f) writeonly uniform image2D xe_dedither_dest;
+layout(set = 2, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D xe_dedither_depth;
+
+const vec3 kLumaWeights = vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114);
+
+ivec2 ClampCoord(ivec2 p) {
+  return clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(xe_dedither_size) - ivec2(1));
+}
+
+float SampleOscillationAtStep(ivec2 p, int stepVal, float depthScale) {
+  float zC  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, p, 0).r;
+  float zN  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( 0, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zS  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( 0,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zE  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal,  0)), 0).r;
+  float zW  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal,  0)), 0).r;
+  float zNW = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zNE = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zSW = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zSE = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+
+  float dW = zW - zC;
+  float dE = zE - zC;
+  float dN = zN - zC;
+  float dS = zS - zC;
+  float dNW = zNW - zC;
+  float dSE = zSE - zC;
+  float dNE = zNE - zC;
+  float dSW = zSW - zC;
+
+  // Real bidirectional oscillation check (peak or valley):
+  // (d1 * d2 > 0.0) ensures center is a true alternating extremum, not a monotonic step edge.
+  bool oscH  = (dW * dE > 0.0);
+  bool oscV  = (dN * dS > 0.0);
+  bool oscD1 = (dNW * dSE > 0.0);
+  bool oscD2 = (dNE * dSW > 0.0);
+
+  float strH  = oscH  ? min(abs(dW),  abs(dE))  : 0.0;
+  float strV  = oscV  ? min(abs(dN),  abs(dS))  : 0.0;
+  float strD1 = oscD1 ? min(abs(dNW), abs(dSE)) : 0.0;
+  float strD2 = oscD2 ? min(abs(dNE), abs(dSW)) : 0.0;
+  float maxOscStr = max(max(strH, strV), max(strD1, strD2));
+
+  return maxOscStr / depthScale;
+}
+
+float DetectDitherAtStep(ivec2 p, int stepVal, out vec3 outBoxAvg) {
+  vec2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  vec2 uv = (vec2(p) + vec2(0.5)) * texel;
+  vec2 st = float(stepVal) * texel;
+
+  vec3 c  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv, 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 n  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( 0.0, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 s  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( 0.0,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 e  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x,  0.0), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 w  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x,  0.0), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 nw = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 ne = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 sw = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 se = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+
+  vec3 cardAvg = 0.25 * (n + s + e + w);
+  vec3 diagAvg = 0.25 * (nw + ne + sw + se);
+  outBoxAvg = 0.5 * (cardAvg + diagAvg);
+
+  if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  float zC = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, p, 0).r;
+  float depthScale = max(min(zC, 1.0 - zC), 0.0005);
+
+  const float kMinRelOsc = 0.0025;
+
+  // 1. Primary bidirectional oscillation check at stepVal
+  float relOsc = SampleOscillationAtStep(p, stepVal, depthScale);
+
+  // 2. Secondary check at 2 * stepVal to capture Bayer 4x4 sub-grid patterns (25%/75% opacity) in distant canopies
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc) {
+    float relOsc2 = SampleOscillationAtStep(p, stepVal * 2, depthScale);
+    if (relOsc2 > kMinRelOsc) {
+      relOsc = relOsc2;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // 3. Isolated dark stipple detector (dense foliage interior, dark shadow/AO dithering)
+  float lumaC = dot(c, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaN = dot(n, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaS = dot(s, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaE = dot(e, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaW = dot(w, kLumaWeights);
+
+  float minCardLuma = min(min(lumaN, lumaS), min(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float maxCardLuma = max(max(lumaN, lumaS), max(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float cardRange   = maxCardLuma - minCardLuma;
+  float darkDrop    = minCardLuma - lumaC;
+
+  // Isolated Dark Stipple: center C is noticeably darker than all 4 cardinal neighbors (N, S, E, W),
+  // while the cardinal neighbors are consistent with each other (low spread).
+  bool isDarkStipple = (darkDrop > 0.025) && (cardRange < max(darkDrop * 1.5, 0.07));
+
+  // EXCLUSION: Reject if neither real bidirectional depth oscillation nor isolated dark stipple is detected.
+  // Solid 3D silhouettes produce monotonic step edges (relOsc == 0.0 and darkDrop <= 0.0) and are 100% blocked.
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc && !isDarkStipple) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  // Color contrast test:
+  float colorDiff = abs(dot(c - outBoxAvg, kLumaWeights));
+  if (colorDiff < 0.004) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  float oscConf = clamp((relOsc - kMinRelOsc) / 0.015, 0.0, 1.0);
+  float stippleConf = isDarkStipple ? clamp((darkDrop - 0.02) / 0.06, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
+  float geomConf = max(oscConf, stippleConf);
+
+  float colorConf = clamp((colorDiff - 0.004) / 0.025, 0.0, 1.0);
+  return geomConf * colorConf;
+}
+
+void main() {
+  uvec2 pixel = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
+  if (any(greaterThanEqual(pixel, xe_dedither_size))) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  ivec2 p = ivec2(pixel);
+  vec2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  vec2 uv = (vec2(pixel) + vec2(0.5)) * texel;
+  vec3 c = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv, 0.0).rgb;
+
+  int scaleVal = int(max(xe_dedither_scale.x, 1u));
+

+  float confScale = DetectDitherAtStep(p, scaleVal, boxAvgScale);
+
+  float confidence = confScale;
+  vec3 bestBoxAvg = boxAvgScale;
+
+  if (scaleVal > 1) {
+    vec3 boxAvgNative;
+    float confNative = DetectDitherAtStep(p, 1, boxAvgNative);
+    if (confNative > confidence) {
+      confidence = confNative;
+      bestBoxAvg = boxAvgNative;
+    }
+  }
+
+  vec3 result = c;
+  if (xe_dedither_debug != 0u) {
+    if (pixel.x < 360u && pixel.y < 202u) {
+      if (pixel.x == 0u || pixel.x == 359u || pixel.y == 0u || pixel.y == 201u) {
+        result = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.0);
+      } else if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+        result = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+      } else {
+        ivec2 fullCoord = ivec2((vec2(pixel) / vec2(360.0, 202.0)) * vec2(xe_dedither_size));
+        float pipZ = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, fullCoord, 0).r;
+        float visZ = pow(clamp(pipZ, 0.0, 1.0), 0.35);
+        result = vec3(visZ);
+      }
+    } else {
+      if (confidence > 0.01) {
+        float heatStrength = clamp(confidence * 1.5 * max(xe_dedither_strength, 0.2), 0.0, 1.0);
+        result = mix(c, vec3(1.0, 0.08, 0.85), heatStrength);
+      }
+    }
+  } else {
+    result = mix(c, bestBoxAvg, clamp(confidence * xe_dedither_strength, 0.0, 1.0));
+  }
+
+  float outLuma = dot(result, kLumaWeights);
+  imageStore(xe_dedither_dest, ivec2(pixel), vec4(result, outLuma));
+}

+layout(local_size_x = 16, local_size_y = 8, local_size_z = 1) in;
+
+layout(push_constant) uniform XeSwapPostConstants {
+  uvec2 xe_dedither_size;
+  vec2 xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  uvec2 xe_dedither_scale;
+  uint xe_dedither_debug;
+  uint xe_dedither_has_depth;
+  float xe_dedither_strength;
+};
+
+layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D xe_dedither_source;
+layout(set = 1, binding = 0, rgb10_a2) writeonly uniform image2D xe_dedither_dest;
+layout(set = 2, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D xe_dedither_depth;
+
+const vec3 kLumaWeights = vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114);
+
+ivec2 ClampCoord(ivec2 p) {
+  return clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(xe_dedither_size) - ivec2(1));
+}
+
+float SampleOscillationAtStep(ivec2 p, int stepVal, float depthScale) {
+  float zC  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, p, 0).r;
+  float zN  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( 0, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zS  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( 0,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zE  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal,  0)), 0).r;
+  float zW  = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal,  0)), 0).r;
+  float zNW = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zNE = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal, -stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zSW = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2(-stepVal,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+  float zSE = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, ClampCoord(p + ivec2( stepVal,  stepVal)), 0).r;
+
+  float dW = zW - zC;
+  float dE = zE - zC;
+  float dN = zN - zC;
+  float dS = zS - zC;
+  float dNW = zNW - zC;
+  float dSE = zSE - zC;
+  float dNE = zNE - zC;
+  float dSW = zSW - zC;
+
+  // Real bidirectional oscillation check (peak or valley):
+  // (d1 * d2 > 0.0) ensures center is a true alternating extremum, not a monotonic step edge.
+  bool oscH  = (dW * dE > 0.0);
+  bool oscV  = (dN * dS > 0.0);
+  bool oscD1 = (dNW * dSE > 0.0);
+  bool oscD2 = (dNE * dSW > 0.0);
+
+  float strH  = oscH  ? min(abs(dW),  abs(dE))  : 0.0;
+  float strV  = oscV  ? min(abs(dN),  abs(dS))  : 0.0;
+  float strD1 = oscD1 ? min(abs(dNW), abs(dSE)) : 0.0;
+  float strD2 = oscD2 ? min(abs(dNE), abs(dSW)) : 0.0;
+  float maxOscStr = max(max(strH, strV), max(strD1, strD2));
+
+  return maxOscStr / depthScale;
+}
+
+float DetectDitherAtStep(ivec2 p, int stepVal, out vec3 outBoxAvg) {
+  vec2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  vec2 uv = (vec2(p) + vec2(0.5)) * texel;
+  vec2 st = float(stepVal) * texel;
+
+  vec3 c  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv, 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 n  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( 0.0, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 s  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( 0.0,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 e  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x,  0.0), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 w  = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x,  0.0), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 nw = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 ne = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x, -st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 sw = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2(-st.x,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+  vec3 se = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv + vec2( st.x,  st.y), 0.0).rgb;
+
+  vec3 cardAvg = 0.25 * (n + s + e + w);
+  vec3 diagAvg = 0.25 * (nw + ne + sw + se);
+  outBoxAvg = 0.5 * (cardAvg + diagAvg);
+
+  if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  float zC = texelFetch(xe_dedither_depth, p, 0).r;
+  float depthScale = max(min(zC, 1.0 - zC), 0.0005);
+
+  const float kMinRelOsc = 0.0025;
+
+  // 1. Primary bidirectional oscillation check at stepVal
+  float relOsc = SampleOscillationAtStep(p, stepVal, depthScale);
+
+  // 2. Secondary check at 2 * stepVal to capture Bayer 4x4 sub-grid patterns (25%/75% opacity) in distant canopies
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc) {
+    float relOsc2 = SampleOscillationAtStep(p, stepVal * 2, depthScale);
+    if (relOsc2 > kMinRelOsc) {
+      relOsc = relOsc2;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // 3. Isolated dark stipple detector (dense foliage interior, dark shadow/AO dithering)
+  float lumaC = dot(c, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaN = dot(n, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaS = dot(s, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaE = dot(e, kLumaWeights);
+  float lumaW = dot(w, kLumaWeights);
+
+  float minCardLuma = min(min(lumaN, lumaS), min(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float maxCardLuma = max(max(lumaN, lumaS), max(lumaE, lumaW));
+  float cardRange   = maxCardLuma - minCardLuma;
+  float darkDrop    = minCardLuma - lumaC;
+
+  // Isolated Dark Stipple: center C is noticeably darker than all 4 cardinal neighbors (N, S, E, W),
+  // while the cardinal neighbors are consistent with each other (low spread).
+  bool isDarkStipple = (darkDrop > 0.025) && (cardRange < max(darkDrop * 1.5, 0.07));
+
+  // EXCLUSION: Reject if neither real bidirectional depth oscillation nor isolated dark stipple is detected.
+  // Solid 3D silhouettes produce monotonic step edges (relOsc == 0.0 and darkDrop <= 0.0) and are 100% blocked.
+  if (relOsc <= kMinRelOsc && !isDarkStipple) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  // Color contrast test:
+  float colorDiff = abs(dot(c - outBoxAvg, kLumaWeights));
+  if (colorDiff < 0.004) {
+    return 0.0;
+  }
+
+  float oscConf = clamp((relOsc - kMinRelOsc) / 0.015, 0.0, 1.0);
+  float stippleConf = isDarkStipple ? clamp((darkDrop - 0.02) / 0.06, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
+  float geomConf = max(oscConf, stippleConf);
+
+  float colorConf = clamp((colorDiff - 0.004) / 0.025, 0.0, 1.0);
+  return geomConf * colorConf;
+}
+
+void main() {
+  uvec2 pixel = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
+  if (any(greaterThanEqual(pixel, xe_dedither_size))) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  ivec2 p = ivec2(pixel);
+  vec2 texel = xe_dedither_size_inv;
+  vec2 uv = (vec2(pixel) + vec2(0.5)) * texel;
+  vec3 c = textureLod(xe_dedither_source, uv, 0.0).rgb;

+      } else if (xe_dedither_has_depth == 0u) {
```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/xma_packet_nav.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace rex::audio::xma {

struct NextPacketOffsetResult {
  // Bit offset within the buffer when a packet with a frame start is found;
  // equals kBitsPerPacketHeader (32) when no further packet exists in this buffer.
  uint32_t read_offset = 32;
  // Packet index overflow past packet_count when crossing into the next input buffer
  // (for multi-stream interleaved XMA2), or 0 if terminated by skip_count == 0xFF.
  uint32_t next_buffer_packet_index = 0;
  bool reached_buffer_end = true;
};

// Advance across packets in an XMA2 input buffer until a packet containing a frame
// start (packet_frame_offset <= kMaxFrameSizeinBits) is found or the buffer ends.
// Continuation packets with no frame start (e.g. header 03 FF F8 <skip>,
// packet_frame_offset == 32799) advance using their own skip_count so interleaved
// multi-stream XMA2 streams never step into sibling streams or zero-padded tail packets.
inline NextPacketOffsetResult FindNextPacketReadOffset(const uint8_t* buffer,
                                                       uint32_t next_packet_index,
                                                       uint32_t packet_count) {
  constexpr uint32_t kBytesPerPacket = 2048;
  constexpr uint32_t kBitsPerPacket = kBytesPerPacket * 8;
  constexpr uint32_t kBitsPerPacketHeader = 32;
  constexpr uint32_t kMaxFrameSizeinBits = 0x4000 - kBitsPerPacketHeader;

  while (next_packet_index < packet_count) {
    const uint8_t* pkt = buffer + (static_cast<size_t>(next_packet_index) * kBytesPerPacket);
    const uint32_t frame_offset =
        static_cast<uint16_t>(((pkt[0] & 0x3) << 13) | (pkt[1] << 5) | (pkt[2] >> 3)) +
        kBitsPerPacketHeader;

    if (frame_offset <= kMaxFrameSizeinBits) {
      return {next_packet_index * kBitsPerPacket + frame_offset, 0, false};
    }

    const uint8_t skip_count = pkt[3];
    if (skip_count == 0xFF) {
      return {kBitsPerPacketHeader, 0, true};
    }
    next_packet_index += static_cast<uint32_t>(skip_count) + 1;
  }

  return {kBitsPerPacketHeader,
          next_packet_index >= packet_count ? (next_packet_index - packet_count) : 0, true};
}

}  // namespace rex::audio::xma

```

`patches/rexglue-0.10.0/xma_packet_nav_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "xma_packet_nav.h"
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace {
void WriteHeader(std::vector<uint8_t>& buf, uint32_t pkt_idx, uint8_t b0, uint8_t b1, uint8_t b2,
                 uint8_t b3) {
  const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(pkt_idx) * 2048;
  buf[off + 0] = b0;
  buf[off + 1] = b1;
  buf[off + 2] = b2;
  buf[off + 3] = b3;
}
}  // namespace

int main() {
  using rex::audio::xma::FindNextPacketReadOffset;
  constexpr uint32_t kBitsPerPacket = 2048 * 8;

  // 1. Single-stream (skip=0): continuation packet 03 FF F8 00 advances to pkt + 1.
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(4 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 1, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x00);  // no new frame, skip=0 -> pkt 2
    WriteHeader(buf, 2, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00);  // valid frame at offset 32
    auto r = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 1, 4);
    assert(!r.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r.read_offset == 2 * kBitsPerPacket + 32);
  }

  // 2. Multi-stream 6ch (eb55c234.gtd chunk 0): pkt 31 (03 FF F8 02) skips to pkt 34 (Stream 2),
  //    NOT pkt 32 (Stream 0).
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(64 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 30, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x01);  // Stream 0 cont -> pkt 32
    WriteHeader(buf, 31, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x02);  // Stream 2 cont -> pkt 34
    WriteHeader(buf, 32, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02);  // Stream 0 start
    WriteHeader(buf, 33, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02);  // Stream 1 start
    WriteHeader(buf, 34, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02);  // Stream 2 start

    auto r0 = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 30, 64);
    assert(!r0.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r0.read_offset == 32 * kBitsPerPacket + 32);

    auto r2 = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 31, 64);
    assert(!r2.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r2.read_offset == 34 * kBitsPerPacket + 32);
  }

  // 3. Multi-stream with ALL_ZERO tail packet (eb55c234.gtd chunk 8):
  //    pkt 30 (03 FF F8 02) must skip over ALL_ZERO pkt 31 directly to pkt 33 (Stream 1).
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(64 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 30, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x02);  // Stream 1 cont -> pkt 33
    // pkt 31 is ALL_ZERO (00 00 00 00)
    WriteHeader(buf, 32, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02);  // Stream 0
    WriteHeader(buf, 33, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x01, 0x02);  // Stream 1
    auto r = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 30, 64);
    assert(!r.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r.read_offset == 33 * kBitsPerPacket + 32);
  }

  // 4. Multi-stream buffer-end deadlock case (eb55c234.gtd chunk 11):
  //    pkt 62 (03 FF F8 03) followed by ALL_ZERO pkt 63 must terminate buffer with overflow=2,
  //    NOT land on ALL_ZERO pkt 63.
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(64 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 62, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x03);  // Stream 2 cont -> pkt 66 (overflow=2)
    // pkt 63 is ALL_ZERO
    auto r = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 62, 64);
    assert(r.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r.read_offset == 32);
    assert(r.next_buffer_packet_index == 2);
  }

  // 5. Full packet skip (0xFF) terminates buffer with overflow=0.
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(8 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 2, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0xFF);
    auto r = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 2, 8);
    assert(r.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r.read_offset == 32);
    assert(r.next_buffer_packet_index == 0);
  }

  // 6. Chained continuation packets across multiple hops.
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(12 * 2048, 0);
    WriteHeader(buf, 1, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x02);  // -> pkt 4
    WriteHeader(buf, 4, 0x03, 0xFF, 0xF8, 0x03);  // -> pkt 8
    WriteHeader(buf, 8, 0x08, 0x10, 0x01, 0x02);  // frame offset = (0x10 << 5) + 32 = 544
    auto r = FindNextPacketReadOffset(buf.data(), 1, 12);
    assert(!r.reached_buffer_end);
    assert(r.read_offset == 8 * kBitsPerPacket + 544);
  }

  return 0;
}
```

```cmake
if(REXSDK_DIR)
    add_subdirectory("${REXSDK_DIR}" rexglue-sdk)
    message(STATUS "Using ReXGlue SDK from source tree: ${REXSDK_DIR}")

    if(REXSDK_VERSION)
        find_package(rexglue ${REXSDK_VERSION} EXACT QUIET CONFIG)
    else()
        find_package(rexglue 0.10.1 QUIET CONFIG)
    endif()
    if(NOT rexglue_FOUND)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "ReXGlue SDK not found. Either:\n"
            "  - Set REXSDK_DIR to the rexglue-sdk source tree (e.g. thirdparty/rexglue-sdk)\n"
            "  - Install the SDK package and ensure it is on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "Found ReXGlue SDK ${REXGLUE_VERSION_STRING} at ${rexglue_DIR}")
endif()

# Host target name used by the codegen-emitted dll_targets.cmake to colocate
# guest DLLs with the host EXE. Defaults to PROJECT_NAME (which the
# manifest-first init flow sets equal to the host target name).
if(NOT DEFINED REXGLUE_HOST_TARGET)
    set(REXGLUE_HOST_TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME})
endif()

set(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO "line-tables-only" CACHE STRING
    "Debug info level for generated code: line-tables-only, full, or none")

# Guest SEH scopes emit __try/__except, which traps hardware faults only under
# asynchronous EH. clang++ spells that flag the GNU way.
set(REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS "")
if(WIN32)
    if(MSVC)
        list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS /EHa)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS -fasync-exceptions)
    endif()
endif()
if(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO STREQUAL "none")
    list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang,AppleClang,GNU>:-g0>)
elseif(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO STREQUAL "line-tables-only")
    list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang,AppleClang>:-gline-tables-only>)
endif()

# Include entrypoint generated code if codegen has been run.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/sources.cmake")
    include(generated/default/sources.cmake)
    set(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
    set(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default")

    # Carried on the sources so they hold for whichever target compiles them.
    set_source_files_properties(${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES}
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS}")
endif()

# The options go on the target as well: CMake compiles the header from its own
# cmake_pch.hxx.cxx, which carries none of the source properties above, and
# clang rejects a PCH whose EH mode disagrees with the TU including it.
function(rexglue_apply_recomp_settings target_name pch_header)
    target_precompile_headers(${target_name} PRIVATE "${pch_header}")
    target_compile_options(${target_name} PRIVATE ${REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS})
endfunction()

# Configure a rexglue target with SDK libraries and platform settings.
# Call after add_executable() in your CMakeLists.txt.
# Usage: rexglue_setup_target(<target> [GPU_PLUGINS xenos])
macro(rexglue_setup_target target_name)
    if(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES)
        add_library(${target_name}_recomp OBJECT
            ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES})
        target_include_directories(${target_name}_recomp PRIVATE
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
            ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}
        )
        target_link_libraries(${target_name}_recomp PRIVATE rex::runtime)
        rexglue_apply_target_settings(${target_name}_recomp)
        rexglue_apply_recomp_settings(${target_name}_recomp
            "${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}/majin_pch.h")
        add_dependencies(${target_name}_recomp majin_codegen)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${target_name}_recomp)
    endif()
    # Also on the host, so a tree that has never run codegen still generates it.
    add_dependencies(${target_name} majin_codegen)
    target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}
    )
    target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE rex::runtime)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/metadata/icons")
        rexglue_embed_metadata(${target_name}
            DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/metadata/icons"
            PREFIX "icons")
    endif()
    rexglue_configure_target(${target_name} ${ARGN})
endmacro()

# Codegen runs as part of the build, re-running only when an input in codegen.d
# changes. Build it alone with 'cmake --build . --target majin_codegen'.
# Listing the sources as outputs orders any target that compiles them after
# codegen, including one a project assembles itself rather than taking the
# library rexglue_setup_target() builds. The stamp comes first: the DEPFILE
# names it. The headers are outputs too: the precompiled header and the host
# sources know them only from their depfiles, so ninja would judge those up to
# date before codegen rewrites the headers, and every source compiled after it
# would then reject the stale precompiled header.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.build.stamp"
           ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES}
           "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/majin_pch.h"
           "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/majin_init.h"
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:rex::rexglue> codegen ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/majin_manifest.toml
    DEPFILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.d"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    COMMENT "Generating recompiled code for majin"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(majin_codegen
    DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.build.stamp")

# Include DLL module shared library targets if codegen has generated them
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/dll_targets.cmake")
    include(generated/default/dll_targets.cmake)
endif()
```


`prototype/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
# majin - ReXGlue Recompiled Project (European / PAL 0.0.0.3)
#
# SDK boilerplate lives in generated/rexglue.cmake.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(majin LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Target microarchitecture optimizations (Issue #19)
# Requires x86-64-v3 (AVX2, FMA, BMI1/2, MOVBE). CPUs lacking AVX2 are unsupported.
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64" OR CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        add_compile_options(
            -march=x86-64-v3
            -mavx2
            -mfma
            -mbmi
            -mbmi2
            -ffp-contract=fast
            -fno-trapping-math
        )
    elseif(MSVC)
        add_compile_options(/arch:AVX2 /fp:fast)
    endif()
endif()

# ThinLTO (Link-Time Optimization) for Release builds (Issue #19)
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release" OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo")
    include(CheckIPOSupported)
    check_ipo_supported(RESULT ipo_supported OUTPUT ipo_error)
    if(ipo_supported)
        set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION ON)
        message(STATUS "ThinLTO (IPO) enabled for ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE} build.")
    else()
        message(STATUS "ThinLTO (IPO) probe returned unsupported: ${ipo_error}")
        if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
            add_compile_options(-flto=thin)
            add_link_options(-flto=thin -fuse-ld=lld)
            message(STATUS "Fallback ThinLTO (-flto=thin -fuse-ld=lld) enabled for Clang.")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

option(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS "Enable high-frequency diagnostic tracing hooks in core runtime" OFF)
if(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
    add_compile_definitions(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS=1)
    message(STATUS "High-frequency diagnostic tracing ENABLED.")
endif()

add_compile_definitions(MAJIN_EDITION_PAL=1)

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

set(MAJIN_SHARED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src")

# Sources from unified src/
set(MAJIN_SOURCES
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/main.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/diagnostics.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/timing.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/cutscene.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/vulkan_hooks.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/scene_resolution.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/step_fix.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/anim_speed.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/frame_timer.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/camera_fov.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/draw_distance.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/post_effects.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/sssm_uv_align.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/language.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/ui_fonts.cpp
    ${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}/in_game_menu.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(majin WIN32 ${MAJIN_SOURCES})
    target_link_libraries(majin PRIVATE winmm)
else()
    add_executable(majin ${MAJIN_SOURCES})
endif()

target_include_directories(majin PRIVATE "${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}")
rexglue_setup_target(majin GPU_PLUGINS xenos)
if(TARGET majin_recomp)
    target_include_directories(majin_recomp PRIVATE "${MAJIN_SHARED_DIR}")
endif()
target_include_directories(majin PRIVATE "${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH}/include/renderdoc")

# Separate opt-in research build. Never enabled by the normal build script.
option(MAJIN_1080P_STARTUP_PROBE "Probe engine startup dimensions; not validated 1080p" OFF)
if(MAJIN_1080P_STARTUP_PROBE)
    target_sources(majin PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../experiments/1080p/startup_probe.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../experiments/1080p/game_trace.cpp")
endif()

```

`prototype/generated/rexglue.cmake`:

```cmake
# Auto-generated by rexglue - DO NOT EDIT

# SDK version
# Set REXSDK_VERSION to pin a specific SDK version.
# Otherwise, the version of the SDK that generated this file is used.
set(REXSDK_VERSION "" CACHE STRING "Override SDK version (leave empty for default)")

# Find SDK
set(REXSDK_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Path to rexglue-sdk source tree")
if(REXSDK_DIR)
    add_subdirectory("${REXSDK_DIR}" rexglue-sdk)
    message(STATUS "Using ReXGlue SDK from source tree: ${REXSDK_DIR}")
else()
    if(REXSDK_VERSION)
        find_package(rexglue ${REXSDK_VERSION} EXACT QUIET CONFIG)
    else()
        find_package(rexglue 0.10.1 QUIET CONFIG)
    endif()
    if(NOT rexglue_FOUND)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "ReXGlue SDK not found. Either:\n"
            "  - Set REXSDK_DIR to the rexglue-sdk source tree (e.g. thirdparty/rexglue-sdk)\n"
            "  - Install the SDK package and ensure it is on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "Found ReXGlue SDK ${REXGLUE_VERSION_STRING} at ${rexglue_DIR}")
endif()

# Host target name used by the codegen-emitted dll_targets.cmake to colocate
# guest DLLs with the host EXE. Defaults to PROJECT_NAME (which the
# manifest-first init flow sets equal to the host target name).
if(NOT DEFINED REXGLUE_HOST_TARGET)
    set(REXGLUE_HOST_TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME})
endif()

set(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO "line-tables-only" CACHE STRING
    "Debug info level for generated code: line-tables-only, full, or none")

# Guest SEH scopes emit __try/__except, which traps hardware faults only under
# asynchronous EH. clang++ spells that flag the GNU way.
set(REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS "")
if(WIN32)
    if(MSVC)
        list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS /EHa)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS -fasync-exceptions)
    endif()
endif()
if(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO STREQUAL "none")
    list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang,AppleClang,GNU>:-g0>)
elseif(REXGLUE_RECOMP_DEBUG_INFO STREQUAL "line-tables-only")
    list(APPEND REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS
        $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang,AppleClang>:-gline-tables-only>)
endif()

# Include entrypoint generated code if codegen has been run.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/sources.cmake")
    include(generated/default/sources.cmake)
    set(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
    set(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default")

    # Carried on the sources so they hold for whichever target compiles them.
    set_source_files_properties(${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES}
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS}")
endif()

# The options go on the target as well: CMake compiles the header from its own
# cmake_pch.hxx.cxx, which carries none of the source properties above, and
# clang rejects a PCH whose EH mode disagrees with the TU including it.
function(rexglue_apply_recomp_settings target_name pch_header)
    target_precompile_headers(${target_name} PRIVATE "${pch_header}")
    target_compile_options(${target_name} PRIVATE ${REXGLUE_RECOMP_OPTIONS})
endfunction()

# Configure a rexglue target with SDK libraries and platform settings.
# Call after add_executable() in your CMakeLists.txt.
# Usage: rexglue_setup_target(<target> [GPU_PLUGINS xenos])
macro(rexglue_setup_target target_name)
    if(REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES)
        add_library(${target_name}_recomp OBJECT
            ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES})
        target_include_directories(${target_name}_recomp PRIVATE
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
            ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}
        )
        target_link_libraries(${target_name}_recomp PRIVATE rex::runtime)
        rexglue_apply_target_settings(${target_name}_recomp)
        rexglue_apply_recomp_settings(${target_name}_recomp
            "${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}/majin_pch.h")
        add_dependencies(${target_name}_recomp majin_codegen)
        target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE
            ${target_name}_recomp)
    endif()
    # Also on the host, so a tree that has never run codegen still generates it.
    add_dependencies(${target_name} majin_codegen)
    target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_INCLUDE_DIR}
    )
    target_link_libraries(${target_name} PRIVATE rex::runtime)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/metadata/icons")
        rexglue_embed_metadata(${target_name}
            DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/metadata/icons"
            PREFIX "icons")
    endif()
    rexglue_configure_target(${target_name} ${ARGN})
endmacro()

# Codegen runs as part of the build, re-running only when an input in codegen.d
# changes. Build it alone with 'cmake --build . --target majin_codegen'.
# Listing the sources as outputs orders any target that compiles them after
# codegen, including one a project assembles itself rather than taking the
# library rexglue_setup_target() builds. The stamp comes first: the DEPFILE
# names it. The headers are outputs too: the precompiled header and the host
# sources know them only from their depfiles, so ninja would judge those up to
# date before codegen rewrites the headers, and every source compiled after it
# would then reject the stale precompiled header.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.build.stamp"
           ${REXGLUE_ENTRYPOINT_GENERATED_SOURCES}
           "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/majin_pch.h"
           "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/majin_init.h"
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:rex::rexglue> codegen ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/majin_manifest.toml
    DEPFILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.d"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    COMMENT "Generating recompiled code for majin"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(majin_codegen
    DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/codegen.build.stamp")

# Include DLL module shared library targets if codegen has generated them
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/dll_targets.cmake")
    include(generated/default/dll_targets.cmake)
endif()
```
