`prototype/tests/equivalent_counter_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
#include "equivalent_counter.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
int main() {
  using majin::timing::EquivalentCounter;
  for (double fps : {30., 45., 60., 120.}) {
    EquivalentCounter counter;
    uint32_t value = 0; unsigned expires = 0;
    for (unsigned frame = 1; frame <= unsigned(fps * 31); ++frame) {
      value = counter.BeforeIncrement(value, 30. / fps) + 1;
      if (value > 870 && !expires) expires = frame;
    }
    assert(expires && expires / fps >= 29 && expires / fps < 29.05);
  }
  EquivalentCounter counter;
  uint32_t value = 0;
  for (unsigned frame = 0; frame != 100; ++frame)
    value = counter.BeforeIncrement(value, .5) + 1;
  assert(value == 50);
  value = counter.BeforeIncrement(0, .5) + 1;  // Original input resets it.
  assert(value == 1);
  value = counter.BeforeIncrement(value, .5) + 1;
  assert(value == 1);
  value = counter.BeforeIncrement(value, 0) + 1; assert(value == 1);
  for (double invalid : {-1., 1e30, std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(),
                          std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()}) {
    counter.Reset(); assert(counter.BeforeIncrement(0, invalid) == 0);
  }
  counter.Reset(); assert(counter.BeforeIncrement(0, 8) + 1 == 8);
  counter.Reset(); assert(counter.BeforeIncrement(UINT32_MAX, 8) + 1 == 1000000);
  std::cout << "PASS: original idle duration, input reset, stalls and invalid boundaries\n";
}
```

`scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs
 *
 * Standalone Performance CSV Analyzer & Verification Gate
 *
 * Computes deterministic frame-time percentiles, spike metrics, and stutter rates
 * from .performance.csv or normalized benchmark CSV files.
 *
 * Supports:
 *   - Direct CSV analysis (full session or bounded by explicit frame range)
 *   - Log-marker lifecycle correlation (--log=<path>): detects CSV anchor timestamp,
 *     identifies 3D gameplay start (flow_a / cutscene bypass) and save I/O (ContentCreateEx),
 *     and separates full session from pure active gameplay.
 *   - Multi-run N-sample aggregation (mean, min, max, std dev across runs)
 *   - Automated verification gate (--verify / --gate) evaluating against official D8 thresholds
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs --input=reports/baseline-shader/baseline-vulkan-cold-run1.csv --log=game-data/runtime/logs/runtime-20261108-114458.log
 *   node scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs --input=run1.csv,run2.csv,run3.csv --gate
 *   node scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs --input=reports/baseline-shader/baseline-vulkan-warm-*.csv --json
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function printUsage() {
  console.error(`Usage: node scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs --input=<csv_file> [options]

Options:
  --input=<path,...>    Path to CSV file(s). Supports comma-separated list or multiple flags.
  --log=<path,...>      Matching runtime log file(s) for lifecycle marker correlation.
  --start-frame=<N>     Explicit starting frame index (inclusive). Overrides log detection.
  --end-frame=<N>       Explicit ending frame index (inclusive). Overrides log detection.
  --gameplay-only       Restrict metrics and gate evaluation to active 3D gameplay window.
  --exclude-save-io     Exclude frames occurring during ContentCreateEx save disk I/O.
  --cold                Evaluate against Cold first-boot DoD §6.1a thresholds (P99.9 <= 50ms, stalls > 100ms <= 5).
  --warm                Evaluate against Warm subsequent-session DoD §6.1b thresholds (P99.9 <= 33.3ms, stalls > 100ms == 0).
  --verify, --gate      Evaluate against official D8 thresholds (exit code 1 if failed).
  --max-p999=<ms>       Custom P99.9 threshold in ms (default: 33.33).
  --max-stalls-100=<N>  Custom stalls > 100 ms threshold (default: 0).
  --max-stalls-33=<N>   Custom stalls > 33.33 ms threshold (default: 8 full / 3 gameplay-only).
  --max-excess-rate=<ms>Custom excess spike ms per 1k frames threshold (default: 50.0).
  --json                Emit machine-readable JSON to stdout (default: pretty JSON).
  -h, --help            Show this help message.
`);
}

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const inputPaths = [];
const logPaths = [];
let startFrameArg = null;
let endFrameArg = null;
let gameplayOnly = false;
let excludeSaveIO = false;
let verifyGate = false;
let compactJson = false;

let threshP999 = 33.33;
let threshStalls100 = 0;
let threshStalls33 = null; // null = set dynamically based on gameplayOnly
let threshExcessRate = 50.0;
let isColdRun = false;
let isWarmRun = false;

for (const arg of args) {
  if (arg.startsWith('--input=')) {
    const val = arg.substring('--input='.length);
    for (const p of val.split(',')) {
      if (p.trim()) inputPaths.push(p.trim());
    }
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--log=')) {
    const val = arg.substring('--log='.length);
    for (const p of val.split(',')) {
      if (p.trim()) logPaths.push(p.trim());
    }
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--start-frame=')) {
    startFrameArg = parseInt(arg.substring('--start-frame='.length), 10);
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--end-frame=')) {
    endFrameArg = parseInt(arg.substring('--end-frame='.length), 10);
  } else if (arg === '--gameplay-only') {
    gameplayOnly = true;
  } else if (arg === '--exclude-save-io') {
    excludeSaveIO = true;
  } else if (arg === '--cold') {
    isColdRun = true;
    threshP999 = 50.0;
    threshStalls100 = 5;
    threshStalls33 = 12;
    threshExcessRate = 150.0;
  } else if (arg === '--warm') {
    isWarmRun = true;
    threshP999 = 33.33;
    threshStalls100 = 0;
    threshStalls33 = null;
    threshExcessRate = 50.0;
  } else if (arg === '--verify' || arg === '--gate') {
    verifyGate = true;
  } else if (arg === '--json') {
    compactJson = true;
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--max-p999=')) {
    threshP999 = parseFloat(arg.substring('--max-p999='.length));
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--max-stalls-100=')) {
    threshStalls100 = parseInt(arg.substring('--max-stalls-100='.length), 10);
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--max-stalls-33=')) {
    threshStalls33 = parseInt(arg.substring('--max-stalls-33='.length), 10);
  } else if (arg.startsWith('--max-excess-rate=')) {
    threshExcessRate = parseFloat(arg.substring('--max-excess-rate='.length));
  } else if (arg === '--help' || arg === '-h') {
    printUsage();
    process.exit(0);
  } else if (!arg.startsWith('--')) {
    inputPaths.push(arg);
  }
}

if (threshStalls33 === null) {
  threshStalls33 = gameplayOnly ? 3 : 8;
}

if (inputPaths.length === 0) {
  console.error('Error: No input CSV file specified. Use --input=<path>');
  printUsage();
  process.exit(1);
}

function parseTimestampMs(line) {
  const m = line.match(/^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3})\]/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return new Date(m[1].replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z').getTime();
}

function median(arr) {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

function percentile(sorted, p) {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return 0;
  const idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sorted.length * p) - 1));
  return sorted[idx] / 1000; // ms
}

function computeMetrics(frames) {
  if (!frames || frames.length === 0) return null;

  const fts = frames.map(f => f.us);
  const sorted = [...fts].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const totalUs = fts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const durationS = totalUs / 1000000;
  const avgFps = fts.length / (durationS || 1);

  let over33 = 0;
  let over50 = 0;
  let over100 = 0;
  const spikes = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < fts.length; i++) {
    const ft = fts[i];
    if (ft > 33333) over33++;
    if (ft > 50000) over50++;
    if (ft > 100000) over100++;

    const med = median(fts.slice(Math.max(0, i - 59), i + 1));
    const isSpike = (ft > 2 * med && ft > 25000 && med > 0);
    const excessMs = isSpike ? (ft - med) / 1000 : 0;

    if (isSpike) {
      spikes.push({
        frameIndex: frames[i].frameNum,
        frameTimeMs: ft / 1000,
        rollingMedianMs: med / 1000,
        excessMs
      });
    }
  }

  const excessSpikeMs = spikes.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.excessMs, 0);
  const excessRate1k = (excessSpikeMs / fts.length) * 1000;
  const worstSpikeMs = spikes.length > 0 ? Math.max(...spikes.map(s => s.frameTimeMs)) : (sorted[sorted.length - 1] / 1000);

  return {
    totalFrames: fts.length,
    durationSeconds: parseFloat(durationS.toFixed(2)),
    averageFps: parseFloat(avgFps.toFixed(2)),
    percentilesMs: {
      p50: parseFloat(percentile(sorted, 0.50).toFixed(2)),
      p90: parseFloat(percentile(sorted, 0.90).toFixed(2)),
      p95: parseFloat(percentile(sorted, 0.95).toFixed(2)),
      p99: parseFloat(percentile(sorted, 0.99).toFixed(2)),
      p999: parseFloat(percentile(sorted, 0.999).toFixed(2)),
      max: parseFloat((sorted[sorted.length - 1] / 1000).toFixed(2))
    },
    stalls: {
      over33ms: over33,
      over50ms: over50,
      over100ms: over100
    },
    spikes: {
      count: spikes.length,
      ratePer1kFrames: parseFloat(((spikes.length / fts.length) * 1000).toFixed(2)),
      totalExcessTimeMs: parseFloat(excessSpikeMs.toFixed(2)),
      excessRatePer1kFrames: parseFloat(excessRate1k.toFixed(2)),
      worstSpikeMs: parseFloat(worstSpikeMs.toFixed(2))
    },
    shaderTelemetry: (() => {
      const hasTel = frames.some(f => f.pipelineMs !== undefined || f.pipelineCompileMs !== undefined || f.pipelineMisses !== undefined);
      if (!hasTel) return undefined;
      return {
        totalPipelineMs: parseFloat(frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.pipelineMs || 0), 0).toFixed(2)),
        totalCompileMs: parseFloat(frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.pipelineCompileMs || 0), 0).toFixed(2)),
        totalWaitMs: parseFloat(frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.pipelineWaitMs || 0), 0).toFixed(2)),
        totalShaderMs: parseFloat(frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.shaderMs || 0), 0).toFixed(2)),
        pipelineCacheHits: frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.pipelineHits || 0), 0),
        pipelineCacheMisses: frames.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.pipelineMisses || 0), 0)
      };
    })()
  };
}

function parseLogLifecycle(logPath) {
  if (!logPath || !fs.existsSync(logPath)) return null;

  const content = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8');
  const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);

  let swapStartMs = null;
  let firstLogMs = null;
  let gameplayStartMs = null;
  let lastMarkerMs = null;
  const saveEventMs = [];

  for (const line of lines) {
    const ts = parseTimestampMs(line);
    if (!ts) continue;

    if (!firstLogMs) firstLogMs = ts;

    if (line.includes('[Majin performance] Release counter mode:') ||
        line.includes('[Majin performance] Perf counters enabled:')) {
      swapStartMs = ts;
    }

    // Detect gameplay entry markers across PAL and USA editions
    if (
      line.includes('flow_a returned') ||
      line.includes('flow_a result') ||
      line.includes('8236FBF0 returned') ||
      line.includes('[Majin Cutscene] fast-forward off')
    ) {
      if (!gameplayStartMs || ts > gameplayStartMs) {
        gameplayStartMs = ts;
      }
    }

    if (line.includes('ContentCreateEx') && line.includes('enter')) {
      saveEventMs.push(ts);
    }

    lastMarkerMs = ts;
  }

  return {
    anchorStartMs: swapStartMs || firstLogMs,
    gameplayStartMs,
    sessionEndMs: lastMarkerMs,
    saveEventMs
  };
}

function processSingleFile(csvPath, matchingLogPath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(csvPath)) {
    throw new Error(`File not found: ${csvPath}`);
  }

  const raw = fs.readFileSync(csvPath, 'utf8').trim();
  const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/);
  if (lines.length < 2) {
    throw new Error(`Insufficient CSV data in ${csvPath}`);
  }

  const header = lines[0].split(',').map(s => s.trim());
  let ftIdx = header.indexOf('frame_time_us');
  let ftIsMs = false;
  if (ftIdx === -1) {
    ftIdx = header.indexOf('frame_time_ms');
    if (ftIdx !== -1) ftIsMs = true;
  }
  if (ftIdx === -1) {
    ftIdx = header.indexOf('ms');
    if (ftIdx !== -1) ftIsMs = true;
  }
  if (ftIdx === -1) {
    throw new Error(`Neither 'frame_time_us', 'frame_time_ms', nor 'ms' found in ${csvPath}`);
  }

  const frameIdxCol = header.indexOf('frame_index');
  const pipeIdx = header.indexOf('pipeline_ms');
  const pipeCompIdx = header.indexOf('pipeline_compile_ms');
  const pipeWaitIdx = header.indexOf('pipeline_wait_ms');
  const shaderIdx = header.indexOf('shader_ms');
  const pipeHitsIdx = header.indexOf('pipeline_cache_hits');
  const pipeMissIdx = header.indexOf('pipeline_cache_misses');

  // Parse log if available
  let autoLog = matchingLogPath;
  if (!autoLog) {
    const candidateSameDir = csvPath.replace(/\.performance\.csv$/, '.log').replace(/\.csv$/, '.log');
    if (fs.existsSync(candidateSameDir)) autoLog = candidateSameDir;
  }
  const lifecycle = parseLogLifecycle(autoLog);

  const allFrames = [];
  let cumUs = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const parts = lines[i].split(',');
    const frameNum = frameIdxCol !== -1 ? parseInt(parts[frameIdxCol], 10) : i;
    const rawVal = parseFloat(parts[ftIdx]);
    if (isNaN(rawVal) || rawVal <= 0) continue;

    const us = ftIsMs ? Math.round(rawVal * 1000) : Math.round(rawVal);
    const frameTimestampMs = lifecycle && lifecycle.anchorStartMs
      ? lifecycle.anchorStartMs + (cumUs / 1000)
      : null;

    cumUs += us;

    const isGameplay = (!lifecycle || !lifecycle.gameplayStartMs || (frameTimestampMs !== null && frameTimestampMs >= lifecycle.gameplayStartMs));
    const isSaveIO = lifecycle && lifecycle.saveEventMs.some(sMs => Math.abs(frameTimestampMs - sMs) <= 600);

    const pipelineMs = pipeIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[pipeIdx]) || 0 : undefined;
    const pipelineCompileMs = pipeCompIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[pipeCompIdx]) || 0 : undefined;
    const pipelineWaitMs = pipeWaitIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[pipeWaitIdx]) || 0 : undefined;
    const shaderMs = shaderIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[shaderIdx]) || 0 : undefined;
    const pipelineHits = pipeHitsIdx !== -1 ? parseInt(parts[pipeHitsIdx], 10) || 0 : undefined;
    const pipelineMisses = pipeMissIdx !== -1 ? parseInt(parts[pipeMissIdx], 10) || 0 : undefined;

    allFrames.push({
      frameNum,
      us,
      timestampMs: frameTimestampMs,
      isGameplay,
      isSaveIO,
      pipelineMs,
      pipelineCompileMs,
      pipelineWaitMs,
      shaderMs,
      pipelineHits,
      pipelineMisses
    });
  }

  // If analyzing fh1.csv and companion .performance.csv exists, pull pipeline hits/misses
  if (pipeHitsIdx === -1 && csvPath.endsWith('.fh1.csv')) {
    const perfCompanion = csvPath.replace(/\.fh1\.csv$/, '.performance.csv');
    if (fs.existsSync(perfCompanion)) {
      try {
        const perfLines = fs.readFileSync(perfCompanion, 'utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/);
        if (perfLines.length > 1) {
          const pHeader = perfLines[0].split(',').map(s => s.trim());
          const pHitsIdx = pHeader.indexOf('pipeline_cache_hits');
          const pMissIdx = pHeader.indexOf('pipeline_cache_misses');
          if (pHitsIdx !== -1 || pMissIdx !== -1) {
            for (let i = 1; i < perfLines.length && (i - 1) < allFrames.length; i++) {
              const pParts = perfLines[i].split(',');
              if (pHitsIdx !== -1) allFrames[i - 1].pipelineHits = parseInt(pParts[pHitsIdx], 10) || 0;
              if (pMissIdx !== -1) allFrames[i - 1].pipelineMisses = parseInt(pParts[pMissIdx], 10) || 0;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  // Filter frames according to flags
  const filteredFrames = allFrames.filter(f => {
    if (startFrameArg !== null && f.frameNum < startFrameArg) return false;
    if (endFrameArg !== null && f.frameNum > endFrameArg) return false;
    if (gameplayOnly && !f.isGameplay) return false;
    if (excludeSaveIO && f.isSaveIO) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const fullMetrics = computeMetrics(allFrames);
  const activeMetrics = computeMetrics(filteredFrames);

  const firstGameplayFrame = allFrames.find(f => f.isGameplay);
  const gameplayStartFrameIndex = firstGameplayFrame ? firstGameplayFrame.frameNum : null;

  return {
    file: csvPath,
    logFile: autoLog || null,
    lifecycleDetected: !!lifecycle,
    gameplayStartFrame: gameplayStartFrameIndex,
    evaluatedWindow: {
      startFrame: filteredFrames.length > 0 ? filteredFrames[0].frameNum : null,
      endFrame: filteredFrames.length > 0 ? filteredFrames[filteredFrames.length - 1].frameNum : null,
      totalEvaluatedFrames: filteredFrames.length
    },
    metrics: activeMetrics,
    fullSessionMetrics: gameplayOnly ? fullMetrics : undefined
  };
}

function evaluateGate(metrics) {
  if (!metrics) return { passed: false, checks: [] };

  const p999 = metrics.percentilesMs.p999;
  const stalls100 = metrics.stalls.over100ms;
  const stalls33 = metrics.stalls.over33ms;
  const excessRate = metrics.spikes.excessRatePer1kFrames;

  const checks = [
    {
      metric: 'P99.9 Frame Time',
      target: `< ${threshP999.toFixed(2)} ms`,
      actual: `${p999.toFixed(2)} ms`,
      passed: p999 <= threshP999
    },
    {
      metric: 'Severe Stalls (> 100 ms)',
      target: `<= ${threshStalls100}`,
      actual: `${stalls100}`,
      passed: stalls100 <= threshStalls100
    },
    {
      metric: 'Stalled Frames (> 33.33 ms)',
      target: `<= ${threshStalls33}`,
      actual: `${stalls33}`,
      passed: stalls33 <= threshStalls33
    },
    {
      metric: 'Excess Spike Time / 1k Frames',
      target: `< ${threshExcessRate.toFixed(1)} ms`,
      actual: `${excessRate.toFixed(1)} ms`,
      passed: excessRate <= threshExcessRate
    }
  ];

  const allPassed = checks.every(c => c.passed);
  return { passed: allPassed, checks };
}

function computeAggregate(results) {
  if (results.length <= 1) return null;

  const n = results.length;
  const metricsList = results.map(r => r.metrics);

  function stat(getter) {
    const vals = metricsList.map(getter);
    const mean = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
    const min = Math.min(...vals);
    const max = Math.max(...vals);
    const variance = vals.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - mean, 2), 0) / n;
    const stdDev = Math.sqrt(variance);
    return {
      mean: parseFloat(mean.toFixed(2)),
      min: parseFloat(min.toFixed(2)),
      max: parseFloat(max.toFixed(2)),
      stdDev: parseFloat(stdDev.toFixed(2))
    };
  }

  return {
    sampleCount: n,
    averageFps: stat(m => m.averageFps),
    p50Ms: stat(m => m.percentilesMs.p50),
    p95Ms: stat(m => m.percentilesMs.p95),
    p99Ms: stat(m => m.percentilesMs.p99),
    p999Ms: stat(m => m.percentilesMs.p999),
    maxMs: stat(m => m.percentilesMs.max),
    stallsOver33ms: stat(m => m.stalls.over33ms),
    stallsOver50ms: stat(m => m.stalls.over50ms),
    stallsOver100ms: stat(m => m.stalls.over100ms),
    spikeCount: stat(m => m.spikes.count),
    excessRatePer1kFrames: stat(m => m.spikes.excessRatePer1kFrames)
  };
}

try {
  const individualResults = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < inputPaths.length; i++) {
    const csv = inputPaths[i];
    const log = logPaths[i] || null;
    const res = processSingleFile(csv, log);
    individualResults.push(res);
  }

  const aggregate = computeAggregate(individualResults);

  // If single run, evaluate gate on that run; if aggregate, evaluate on mean values
  let gateEvaluation = null;
  if (verifyGate) {
    if (aggregate) {
      const pseudoMetrics = {
        percentilesMs: { p999: aggregate.p999Ms.mean },
        stalls: { over100ms: Math.round(aggregate.stallsOver100ms.mean), over33ms: Math.round(aggregate.stallsOver33ms.mean) },
        spikes: { excessRatePer1kFrames: aggregate.excessRatePer1kFrames.mean }
      };
      gateEvaluation = evaluateGate(pseudoMetrics);
    } else {
      gateEvaluation = evaluateGate(individualResults[0].metrics);
    }
  }

  const finalOutput = {
    runs: individualResults,
    aggregate,
    gate: gateEvaluation
  };

  if (compactJson) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify(finalOutput));
  } else {
    console.log(JSON.stringify(finalOutput, null, 2));
  }

  if (verifyGate && gateEvaluation && !gateEvaluation.passed) {
    process.exit(1);
  }
} catch (err) {
  console.error(`Execution error: ${err.message}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
```

`scripts/build-patched-runtime.ps1`:

```ps1
param([ValidateSet('Debug','Release')][string]$Configuration='Debug')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$source=Join-Path $root 'tools/source/rexglue-sdk-audio-debug'
$patchRoot=Join-Path $root 'patches/rexglue-0.10.0'
$revision='f5337cdc947ff6d4c4196737e2c807a48f2a1fc2'
function Check-Native($step) { if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "$step failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)."} }
if(!(Test-Path "$source/.git")) {
    if(Test-Path $source){throw "Existing directory is not the expected SDK checkout: $source"}
    git clone --branch v0.10.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk.git $source
    Check-Native 'SDK clone'
}
$head=git -C $source rev-parse HEAD
Check-Native 'SDK revision check'
if($head -ne $revision){throw "SDK revision mismatch; expected $revision, found $head."}
$modules=@('cli11','libmspack','FFmpeg','tomlplusplus','simde','xxHash','spdlog','fmt','utfcpp','imgui','sdl3','tracy','o1heap','inja')
foreach($name in $modules){
    $expected=(git -C $source ls-tree HEAD "thirdparty/$name") -split '\s+'
    Check-Native 'Submodule reference'
    $module=Join-Path $source "thirdparty/$name"
    $actual=''
    if(Test-Path "$module/.git"){$actual=git -C $module rev-parse HEAD; Check-Native 'Submodule revision'}
    if($actual -ne $expected[2]){
        git -C $source submodule update --init --depth 1 -- "thirdparty/$name"
        Check-Native "Dependency $name"
    }
}
# Git without symlink support writes small relative-path placeholders on Windows.
$module=Join-Path $source 'thirdparty/libmspack'
git -C $module ls-files -s | ForEach-Object {
    if($_ -match '^120000 .*\t(.+)$'){
        $dest=Join-Path $module $Matches[1]
        $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $dest
        if(!($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -and $item.Length -lt 256){
            $relative=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $dest -Raw).Trim()
            $target=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Split-Path $dest -Parent) $relative))
            if(!$target.StartsWith($module+[IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)){throw 'Dependency link leaves module.'}
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $target -Destination $dest -Force
        }
    }
}
# Remove only our exact optional timing patch before the base patch checks.
# This makes repeated builds idempotent and still rejects unrelated edits.
$fpsPatch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'fps60.patch'
git -C $source apply --reverse --check $fpsPatch 2>$null
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){
 git -C $source apply --reverse $fpsPatch
 Check-Native 'Prior timing patch removal'
}
$patch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'xma-context.patch'
git -C $source apply --reverse --check $patch 2>$null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){
    git -C $source apply --check $patch
    Check-Native 'XMA patch check'
    git -C $source apply $patch
    Check-Native 'XMA patch application'
}
Copy-Item (Join-Path $patchRoot 'empty_packet_recovery.h') "$source/src/audio/empty_packet_recovery.h" -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $patchRoot 'empty_packet_recovery_test.cpp') "$source/src/audio/empty_packet_recovery_test.cpp" -Force
# Bound only the known repeated texture warning; retain samples and counts.
$loggingPatch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'texture-warning-logging.patch'
git -C $source apply --reverse --check $loggingPatch 2>$null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and !([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $source 'src/core/logging.cpp')).Contains('if (name == "gpu") sinks = {std::make_shared<majin::TextureWarningSink>(std::move(sinks))};'))){
 git -C $source apply --check $loggingPatch
 Check-Native 'Texture logging patch check'
 git -C $source apply $loggingPatch
 Check-Native 'Texture logging patch application'
}
$flushPatch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'texture-warning-flush.patch'
git -C $source apply --reverse --check $flushPatch 2>$null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){
 git -C $source apply --check $flushPatch
 Check-Native 'Texture flush patch check'
 git -C $source apply $flushPatch
 Check-Native 'Texture flush patch application'
}
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'texture_warning_sink.h') -Destination (Join-Path $source 'src/core/texture_warning_sink.h') -Force
# Enable only local frame CSV in Release; keep the ordinary graphics backend.
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'release_frame_timing.h') -Destination (Join-Path $source 'src/graphics/release_frame_timing.h') -Force
$framePatch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'release-frame-capture.patch'
git -C $source apply --reverse --check $framePatch 2>$null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){
 $legacyFramePatch=Join-Path $patchRoot 'release-frame-capture-legacy.patch'
 git -C $source apply --reverse --check $legacyFramePatch 2>$null
 if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){
  git -C $source apply --reverse $legacyFramePatch
  Check-Native 'Prior frame patch migration'
 }
 git -C $source apply --check $framePatch
 Check-Native 'Release frame capture patch check'
 git -C $source apply $framePatch
 Check-Native 'Release frame capture patch application'
}
# Refuse unrelated/abandoned graphics experiments before building the plugin.
$frameExpected=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'release-frame-capture.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$frameText=[IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $source $frameExpected.Path)).Replace("`r`n","`n")
$hasher=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try{$frameHash=([BitConverter]::ToString($hasher.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($frameText)))).Replace('-','')}finally{$hasher.Dispose()}
if($frameHash -ne $frameExpected.NormalizedPatchedSHA256){throw 'Unexpected command-processor changes; use a clean pinned SDK checkout.'}
$graphicsChanges=@(git -C $source diff --name-only -- src/graphics)
Check-Native 'Graphics source audit'
if(@($graphicsChanges | Where-Object {$_ -ne $frameExpected.Path}).Count){throw 'Unrelated GPU source modifications detected; use a clean pinned SDK checkout.'}
git -C $source apply --check $fpsPatch
Check-Native '60 FPS patch check'
git -C $source apply $fpsPatch
Check-Native '60 FPS patch application'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'frame_deadline.h') -Destination (Join-Path $source 'src/graphics/frame_deadline.h') -Force
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'frame_deadline.h') -Destination (Join-Path $source 'src/ui/d3d12/frame_deadline.h') -Force
$fpsExpected=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $patchRoot 'fps60.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach($item in $fpsExpected.Files){
 $normalized=[IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $source $item.Path)).Replace("`r`n","`n")
 $hasher=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
 try{$hash=([BitConverter]::ToString($hasher.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($normalized)))).Replace('-','')}finally{$hasher.Dispose()}
 if($hash -ne $item.NormalizedPatchedSHA256){throw 'Unexpected optional timing source; use a clean pinned SDK checkout.'}
}
$vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
$vsRoot = if (Test-Path $vswhere) { & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath } else { $null }
if(!$vsRoot){throw 'Visual Studio C++ tools required.'}
& (Join-Path $vsRoot 'Common7/Tools/Launch-VsDevShell.ps1') -Arch amd64 -HostArch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation
$cmakeRoot=Join-Path $vsRoot 'Common7/IDE/CommonExtensions/Microsoft/CMake'
$clangDir=Join-Path $root 'tools/clang+llvm-20.1.8-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/bin'
if(!(Test-Path "$clangDir/clang++.exe")){$clangDir=Join-Path $vsRoot 'VC/Tools/Llvm/x64/bin'}
$env:PATH=$clangDir+';'+(Join-Path $cmakeRoot 'CMake/bin')+';'+(Join-Path $cmakeRoot 'Ninja')+';'+$env:PATH
Push-Location $source
try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null
    clang++ -std=c++20 src/audio/empty_packet_recovery_test.cpp -o out/empty_packet_recovery_test.exe
    Check-Native 'XMA test compilation'
    & ./out/empty_packet_recovery_test.exe
    Check-Native 'XMA boundary tests'
    clang++ -std=c++20 "-I$source/thirdparty/spdlog/include" "-I$source/thirdparty/fmt/include" (Join-Path $patchRoot 'texture_warning_sink_test.cpp') -o out/texture_warning_sink_test.exe
    Check-Native 'Texture logging test compilation'
    & ./out/texture_warning_sink_test.exe
    Check-Native 'Texture logging tests'
    cmake --preset win-amd64 -DREXGLUE_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
    Check-Native 'SDK configuration'
    cmake --build out/build/win-amd64 --config $Configuration --target rexruntime rexgpu-xenos --parallel 4
    Check-Native 'SDK runtime build'
} finally {Pop-Location}
Write-Output "Patched $Configuration runtime built; XMA boundary tests passed."
```

`scripts/build-release-package.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Assembles a complete, self-contained, clean-room release package for Majistic Recomp.
.PARAMETER Version
    The release version tag (defaults to 0.1.0).
.PARAMETER CreateZip
    Whether to create a compressed .zip archive of the release package.
#>
param(
    [string]$Version = "0.1.5",
    [switch]$CreateZip = $true
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$releaseDir = Join-Path $root "release-v$Version"
$zipPath = Join-Path $root "Majistic-Recomp-v$Version-Windows-x64.zip"

Write-Host "============================================================"
Write-Host "Creating Majistic Recomp Release Package: v$Version"
Write-Host "Destination: $releaseDir"
Write-Host "============================================================"

# Ensure release dir is fresh
if (Test-Path $releaseDir) {
    Write-Host "Removing previous release folder: $releaseDir..."
    Remove-Item -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Force
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $releaseDir -Force | Out-Null

# 1. Copy Majistic Launcher.exe
$launcherExe = Join-Path $root 'Majistic Launcher.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $launcherExe)) {
    throw "Launcher executable not found at $launcherExe. Please build it first."
}
Copy-Item $launcherExe (Join-Path $releaseDir 'Majistic Launcher.exe') -Force
Write-Host "[1/7] Copied Majistic Launcher.exe"

# 2. Copy scripts
$destScripts = Join-Path $releaseDir 'scripts'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destScripts -Force | Out-Null
$scriptFiles = @(
    'build-launcher-usa.ps1',
    'build-usa.ps1',
    'diagnostics-common.ps1',
    'extract-iso.ps1',
    'generate-icons.ps1',
    'run-usa.ps1',
    'unpack-xex-usa.ps1',
    'vs-env.ps1'
)
foreach ($s in $scriptFiles) {
    $src = Join-Path $root "scripts\$s"
    if (Test-Path $src) {
        Copy-Item $src (Join-Path $destScripts $s) -Force
    }
}
Write-Host "[2/7] Copied core scripts"

# 3. Copy tools/sdk/win-amd64 (precompiled SDK)
$destSdk = Join-Path $releaseDir 'tools\sdk\win-amd64'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destSdk -Force | Out-Null
$srcSdk = Join-Path $root 'tools\sdk\win-amd64'
Copy-Item "$srcSdk\*" $destSdk -Recurse -Force
Write-Host "[3/7] Copied tools/sdk/win-amd64"

# 4. Copy prototype-usa (excluding build cache 'out' and 'private')
$destProto = Join-Path $releaseDir 'prototype-usa'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destProto -Force | Out-Null
$srcProto = Join-Path $root 'prototype-usa'
Get-ChildItem -Path $srcProto -Exclude 'out', 'private' | ForEach-Object {
    Copy-Item $_.FullName (Join-Path $destProto $_.Name) -Recurse -Force
}
Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $destProto 'private') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host "[4/7] Copied prototype-usa (source & manifest)"

# 4b. Copy prototype (PAL, excluding build cache 'out' and 'private')
$destPalProto = Join-Path $releaseDir 'prototype'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destPalProto -Force | Out-Null
$srcPalProto = Join-Path $root 'prototype'
Get-ChildItem -Path $srcPalProto -Exclude 'out', 'private' | ForEach-Object {
    Copy-Item $_.FullName (Join-Path $destPalProto $_.Name) -Recurse -Force
}
Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $destPalProto 'private') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host "[4b/7] Copied prototype (PAL source & manifest)"

# 4c. Copy shared unified source
$destSrc = Join-Path $releaseDir 'src'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destSrc -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'src\*') $destSrc -Recurse -Force
Write-Host "[4c/7] Copied shared unified source (src/)"

# 5. Copy branding & licenses
$destBranding = Join-Path $releaseDir 'branding'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destBranding -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'branding\majistic_logo.png') (Join-Path $destBranding 'majistic_logo.png') -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'branding\majistic_icon.png') (Join-Path $destBranding 'majistic_icon.png') -Force

$destLicenses = Join-Path $releaseDir 'LICENSES'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destLicenses -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'LICENSES\*') $destLicenses -Recurse -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'LICENSE') (Join-Path $releaseDir 'LICENSE') -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'README.md') (Join-Path $releaseDir 'README.md') -Force
Write-Host "[5/7] Copied branding, LICENSE, and README.md"

# 5b. Copy Clean-Room shader prebuild manifest (.xpl + shader_recipes.json)
$srcPrebuild = Join-Path $root 'launcher\resources\prebuild'
$xplManifest = Join-Path $srcPrebuild '4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl'
$recipesManifest = Join-Path $srcPrebuild 'shader_recipes.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $xplManifest) -or -not (Test-Path $recipesManifest)) {
    throw "Clean-Room prebuild manifest files (4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl / shader_recipes.json) not found in $srcPrebuild."
}
$destPrebuild = Join-Path $releaseDir 'launcher\resources\prebuild'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destPrebuild -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $xplManifest (Join-Path $destPrebuild '4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl') -Force
Copy-Item $recipesManifest (Join-Path $destPrebuild 'shader_recipes.json') -Force
Write-Host "[5b/7] Copied Clean-Room shader prebuild manifest (4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpl + shader_recipes.json)"

# 6. Deploy precompiled game binary, runtime DLLs, and game-data template
$destGameData = Join-Path $releaseDir 'game-data'
$destBin = Join-Path $destGameData 'bin'
$destUnpacked = Join-Path $destGameData 'unpacked'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destGameData, $destBin, $destUnpacked -Force | Out-Null

$srcBin = Join-Path $root 'game-data\bin'
$srcPalExe = Join-Path $root 'prototype\out\build\win-amd64-release\majin.exe'
$srcUsaExe = Join-Path $root 'prototype-usa\out\build\win-amd64-release\majin.exe'

# Copy edition-specific binaries
if (Test-Path $srcPalExe) {
    Copy-Item $srcPalExe (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-pal.exe') -Force
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $srcBin 'majin-pal.exe')) {
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $srcBin 'majin-pal.exe') (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-pal.exe') -Force
}

if (Test-Path $srcUsaExe) {
    Copy-Item $srcUsaExe (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-usa.exe') -Force
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $srcBin 'majin-usa.exe')) {
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $srcBin 'majin-usa.exe') (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-usa.exe') -Force
}

# Deploy default majin.exe
$exeSource = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-pal.exe')) {
    Join-Path $destBin 'majin-pal.exe'
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $destBin 'majin-usa.exe')) {
    Join-Path $destBin 'majin-usa.exe'
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $srcBin 'majin.exe')) {
    Join-Path $srcBin 'majin.exe'
} else {
    $null
}

if ($exeSource) {
    Copy-Item $exeSource (Join-Path $destBin 'majin.exe') -Force
    $exeSize = (Get-Item (Join-Path $destBin 'majin.exe')).Length / 1MB
    Write-Host ("[6/7] Copied precompiled majin.exe ({0:N1} MB), majin-pal.exe, and majin-usa.exe" -f $exeSize)
} else {
    Write-Warning "majin.exe not found! Please build it before packaging."
}

# Copy runtime DLLs to game-data/bin
$runtimeDll = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $srcBin 'rexruntime.dll')) {
    Join-Path $srcBin 'rexruntime.dll'
} else {
    Join-Path $root 'tools\sdk\win-amd64\bin\rexruntime.dll'
}
$gpuDll = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $srcBin 'rexgpu-xenos.dll')) {
    Join-Path $srcBin 'rexgpu-xenos.dll'
} else {
    Join-Path $root 'tools\sdk\win-amd64\bin\rexgpu-xenos.dll'
}
if (Test-Path $runtimeDll) { Copy-Item $runtimeDll $destBin -Force }
if (Test-Path $gpuDll) { Copy-Item $gpuDll $destBin -Force }

$readmeText = @"
Majistic Recomp - Game Data Directory
====================================
This directory contains the game executable and your extracted game assets.
Use 'Majistic Launcher.exe' (in the Setup & Build tab) to automatically
extract your legally owned Xbox 360 ISO image of Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom.

Structure:
- game-data/bin/        -> Native game executable (majin.exe) and runtime DLLs
- game-data/unpacked/   -> Decrypted executable image (loaded-image.bin)
- game-data/runtime/    -> Save profiles (saves/), cache, and logs
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $destGameData 'README.txt') -Value $readmeText -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "[6/7] Initialized game-data/ with precompiled binary and runtime DLLs"

# Security & Copyright Verification Gate:
# Strictly verify that NO original/proprietary game assets exist anywhere in the release folder.
Write-Host "Verifying release package compliance (zero-asset policy)..."
$prohibitedPatterns = @('*.iso', '*.xex', '*.cpk', '*.bik', '*.csb', '*.xma', 'loaded-image.bin', '*.xsh', '*.vkpc')
$violations = Get-ChildItem -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Include $prohibitedPatterns -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($violations) {
    Remove-Item -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Force
    throw "SECURITY ABORT: Proprietary game files found in release directory! Aborting release generation:`n$($violations.FullName -join "`n")"
}
Write-Host "Verification PASSED: 100% clean-room package confirmed (Zero original game assets present)."

# Purge any residual debug captures, screenshots, reports, or launcher logs from release distribution
Get-ChildItem -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Include 'capture_*.bmp', 'launcher-debug.log', 'launcher-chromium.log', 'Majistic Launcher (Dev).exe' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
Get-ChildItem -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Filter 'reports' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force


# 7. Create ZIP archive if requested
if ($CreateZip) {
    if (Test-Path $zipPath) {
        Remove-Item $zipPath -Force
    }
    Write-Host "[7/7] Compressing into $zipPath..."
    Compress-Archive -Path "$releaseDir\*" -DestinationPath $zipPath -CompressionLevel Optimal
    $zipSize = (Get-Item $zipPath).Length / 1MB
    $msg = "Created archive: {0} ({1:N1} MB)" -f $zipPath, $zipSize
    Write-Host $msg

    # Sign archive with minisign for Tauri auto-updater and generate latest.json (Strictly UTF-8 without BOM)
    $keyPath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".tauri\majistic-launcher.key"
    if (Test-Path $keyPath) {
        Write-Host "Signing release archive for in-app updater..."
        Push-Location (Join-Path $root 'launcher')
        try {
            $signOutput = & npm run tauri -- signer sign --private-key-path $keyPath --app-version $Version $zipPath
            $sigPath = "$zipPath.sig"
            $sig = if (Test-Path $sigPath) {
                (Get-Content -Path $sigPath -Raw).Trim()
            } else {
                $rawSig = ($signOutput | Out-String).Trim()
                $sigMatch = [regex]::Match($rawSig, '(?s)(dW50cnVzdGVkIGNvbW1lbnQ6[A-Za-z0-9+/=\r\n]+?)(?:\r?\n\r?\n|$)')
                if ($sigMatch.Success) { $sigMatch.Groups[1].Value.Trim() } else { $null }
            }
            if ($sig) {
                $cleanReinstallHeader = "[!] IMPORTANT — CLEAN REINSTALL REQUIRED:`n" +
                    "This update performs a clean installation of Majistic Recomp v$Version to avoid conflicts with older engine binaries and shader caches.`n" +
                    "- Your existing save files and achievements will be backed up and migrated automatically into the new Save Profiles folder (game-data\runtime\saves).`n" +
                    "- You will need your Xbox 360 game ISO file again after updating to re-extract assets and precompile shaders in Setup Game.`n" +

                    version = $Version
                    notes = ($cleanReinstallHeader + $releaseHighlights)
                    pub_date = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
                    platforms = @{

                        }
                    }
                } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
                $latestJsonPath = Join-Path $root 'latest.json'
                $utf8NoBom = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($latestJsonPath, $latestJson, $utf8NoBom)
                Write-Host "Generated latest.json (UTF-8 without BOM) pointing to unified package ($latestJsonPath)"
            } else {
                Write-Warning "Could not extract signature from output: $rawSig"
            }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
    }
}
```

```ps1
param(
    [ValidateSet('Debug','Release')][string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [string]$GameDataRoot = 'game-data'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$projectRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'vs-env.ps1')

$sdk = ($projectRoot -replace '\\', '/') + '/tools/sdk/win-amd64'
$preset = 'win-amd64-' + $Configuration.ToLower()

if (Get-Process majin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    throw 'Close majin.exe before rebuilding.'
}

# Resolve game data directory
if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($GameDataRoot)) {
    $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot $GameDataRoot
    if (-not (Test-Path $candidate) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data'))) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data'
    } elseif (-not (Test-Path $candidate) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data-usa'))) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data-usa'
    }
    $GameDataRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate)
}

$xexPath = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'default.xex'
if (-not (Test-Path $xexPath)) {
    throw "Entrypoint XEX not found at $xexPath. Please check your game-data directory."
}

# Detect edition from default.xex (USA = 76FDB642, PAL = 67BD87EF)
$isPal = $false
try {
    $headerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($xexPath)
    $maxScan = [Math]::Min($headerBytes.Length, 16384)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt ($maxScan - 4); $i++) {
        if ($headerBytes[$i] -eq 0x67 -and $headerBytes[$i+1] -eq 0xBD -and $headerBytes[$i+2] -eq 0x87 -and $headerBytes[$i+3] -eq 0xEF) {
            $isPal = $true
            break
        }
    }
} catch {
    $isPal = $false
}

$protoFolder = if ($isPal) { 'prototype' } else { 'prototype-usa' }
$editionName = if ($isPal) { 'Europe / PAL (0.0.0.3)' } else { 'USA / NTSC-U (0.0.0.2)' }
Write-Output "Detected Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom: $editionName (using $protoFolder)"

# Helper for PowerShell 5.1 compatibility (Path.GetRelativePath only exists in .NET Core 2.1+)
function Get-RelativePathCompat([string]$fromPath, [string]$toPath) {
    try {
        if (-not $fromPath.EndsWith('\') -and -not $fromPath.EndsWith('/')) {
            $fromPath += '\'
        }
        $fromUri = New-Object System.Uri($fromPath)
        $toUri = New-Object System.Uri($toPath)
        $relUri = $fromUri.MakeRelativeUri($toUri)
        return [System.Uri]::UnescapeDataString($relUri.ToString()).Replace('\', '/')
    } catch {
        return '../' + (Split-Path $toPath -Leaf)
    }
}

# Dynamically sync majin_manifest.toml with actual GameDataRoot
$protoPath = Join-Path $projectRoot $protoFolder
$relGameData = Get-RelativePathCompat $protoPath $GameDataRoot
$relXex = "$relGameData/default.xex"

$manifestPath = Join-Path $protoPath 'majin_manifest.toml'
if (Test-Path $manifestPath) {
    $manifestContent = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    $updatedManifest = $manifestContent -replace '(?m)^game_root\s*=.*$', "game_root = `"$relGameData`""
    $updatedManifest = $updatedManifest -replace '(?m)^file_path\s*=.*$', "file_path = `"$relXex`""
    if ($updatedManifest -ne $manifestContent) {
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Value $updatedManifest -Encoding UTF8
        Write-Output "Updated $manifestPath with game_root = '$relGameData'"
    }
}

Push-Location $protoPath
try {
    Write-Output "[1/3] Running rexglue.exe codegen majin_manifest.toml ($protoFolder)..."
    & "$sdk/bin/rexglue.exe" --log-file "../reports/codegen-$protoFolder.log" codegen 'majin_manifest.toml'
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Codegen validation failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." }

    Write-Output "[2/3] Configuring CMake for $protoFolder ($preset)..."
    cmake --fresh --preset $preset "-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$sdk" -DMAJIN_1080P_STARTUP_PROBE=OFF
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "CMake configure failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." }

    Write-Output "[3/3] Compiling majin.exe ($preset)..."
    cmake --build --preset $preset --parallel 4
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Build failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." }
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

$suffix = if ($Configuration -eq 'Debug') { 'd' } else { '' }
$runtime = Join-Path $projectRoot "tools\source\rexglue-sdk\out\win-amd64\$Configuration\rexruntime$suffix.dll"
if (-not (Test-Path $runtime)) {
    $runtime = Join-Path $projectRoot "tools\sdk\win-amd64\bin\rexruntime$suffix.dll"
}
$target = Join-Path $protoPath "out\build\$preset\rexruntime$suffix.dll"
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $runtime -Destination $target -Force

$gpu = Join-Path $projectRoot "tools\source\rexglue-sdk\out\win-amd64\$Configuration\rexgpu-xenos$suffix.dll"
if (-not (Test-Path $gpu)) {
    $gpu = Join-Path $projectRoot "tools\sdk\win-amd64\bin\rexgpu-xenos$suffix.dll"
}
$gpuTarget = Join-Path $protoPath "out\build\$preset\rexgpu-xenos$suffix.dll"
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $gpu -Destination $gpuTarget -Force

# Deploy executable and runtime DLLs into unified game-data/bin
$gameDataBin = Join-Path $GameDataRoot "bin"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $gameDataBin | Out-Null
$builtExe = Join-Path $protoPath "out\build\$preset\majin.exe"
if (Test-Path $builtExe) {
    Copy-Item $builtExe -Destination (Join-Path $gameDataBin "majin.exe") -Force
    Copy-Item $target -Destination $gameDataBin -Force
    Copy-Item $gpuTarget -Destination $gameDataBin -Force
    Write-Output "Copied majin.exe and patched DLLs to $gameDataBin"
}

Write-Output "SUCCESS: majin.exe ($Configuration) compiled and installed into $gameDataBin!"
```

```ps1
param([ValidateRange(1,5)][int]$SessionCount=3,[switch]$IncludeHardware,[switch]$SkipHardware)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'diagnostics-common.ps1')
$reports=Join-Path $root 'reports'
$name='Majin-Diagnostics-'+(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')+'-'+[Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6)
$destination=Join-Path $reports $name
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null
$notes=New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
$copiedBytes=0L;$index=@()
$allowHardware=Get-MajinDiagnosticConsent -Root $root -IncludeHardware:$IncludeHardware -SkipHardware:$SkipHardware
$sessions=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $reports -File -Filter '*.log.settings.json' | Where-Object Name -Match '^runtime-\d{8}-\d{6}\.log\.settings\.json$' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First $SessionCount)
foreach($session in $sessions){
    $stem=$session.Name.Replace('.log.settings.json','')
    $selected=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $reports -File -Filter ($stem+'*') | Where-Object Name -Match ('^'+[regex]::Escape($stem)+'(?:\.\d+)?\.log(?:\.settings\.json|\.hardware\.json|\.performance\.csv|\.performance-1s\.csv|\.performance-summary\.json)?$') | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -First 26)
    foreach($file in $selected){
        $entry=Copy-MajinDiagnosticArtifact -File $file -Destination $destination -LocalRoots @($root) -AllowHardware $allowHardware -CopiedBytes ([ref]$copiedBytes)
        if($entry){$index+=$entry}else{$notes.Add('Excluded or size-limited artifact: '+$file.Name)}
    }
}
$binaries=@()
foreach($configuration in @('release','debug')){
    $build=Join-Path $root ('prototype/out/build/win-amd64-'+$configuration)
    if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $build){foreach($binary in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $build -File | Where-Object Name -Match '^(majin\.exe|rexruntime[d]?\.dll|rexgpu-xenos[d]?\.dll)$'){
        $binaries+=@{Name=$binary.Name;Configuration=$configuration;SHA256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}
    }}
}
$hardware=$null
if($allowHardware){try{$hardware=Get-MajinHardwareSummary}catch{$notes.Add('Hardware query unavailable: '+$_.Exception.GetType().Name)}}
$version=if(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'VERSION')){(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'VERSION') -Raw).Trim()}else{'unversioned'}
@{CollectorVersion=3;Version=$version;Collected=(Get-Date -Format o);SessionCount=$sessions.Count;HardwareOptIn=$allowHardware;Hardware=$hardware;Binaries=$binaries;Files=$index;Notes=@($notes);Excludes=@('game data','ISO','saves','shader-cache contents','user/computer names','serial numbers','network identifiers');ActiveGPUAlreadyInRuntimeLog=$true;AutomaticUpload=$false} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $destination 'DIAGNOSTIC-INFO.json') -Encoding UTF8
$archive=$destination+'.zip'
Compress-Archive -LiteralPath $destination -DestinationPath $archive -CompressionLevel Optimal
Write-Output "Diagnostics: $archive"
Write-Output 'Includes local frame metrics when available; truncated files are marked in the inventory.'
Write-Output ('Optional CPU/RAM/GPU details included: '+$allowHardware)
Write-Output 'Review the ZIP before sharing. Nothing was uploaded.'
```

`scripts/diagnostics-common.ps1`:

```ps1
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
function Protect-MajinDiagnosticText([string]$Text,[string[]]$LocalRoots=@()) {
    foreach($path in @($LocalRoots | Where-Object {$_} | Sort-Object Length -Descending)+@($env:USERPROFILE)) {
        if($path){$Text=$Text.Replace($path.Replace('\','\\'),'<LOCAL>').Replace($path,'<LOCAL>').Replace($path.Replace('\','/'),'<LOCAL>')}
    }
    $Text=[regex]::Replace($Text,'(?i)[a-z]:(?:\\+|/)Users(?:\\+|/)[^\\/"\r\n]+','<USERPROFILE>')
    # Network share names may identify a machine or account; do not export them.
    $Text=[regex]::Replace($Text,'(?i)(?<![a-z0-9:])\\\\[^\\\s"<>]+\\[^\s"<>]*','<NETWORK-PATH>')
    return $Text
}

function Get-MajinHardwareSummary {
    # Explicit property allowlist. Never serialize whole CIM/WMI objects.
    $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem -Property Caption,Version,BuildNumber,TotalVisibleMemorySize -ErrorAction Stop
    return [ordered]@{
        OS=[string]$os.Caption; OSVersion=[string]$os.Version; Build=[string]$os.BuildNumber
        UsableRAMGiB=[math]::Round([double]$os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2)
        CPU=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor -Property Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object {
            @{Name=[string]$_.Name;Cores=[int]$_.NumberOfCores;LogicalProcessors=[int]$_.NumberOfLogicalProcessors}
        })
        GPU=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController -Property Name,DriverVersion -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object {
            @{Name=[string]$_.Name;DriverVersion=[string]$_.DriverVersion}
        })
        Excludes=@('user and computer names','serial numbers','hardware UUIDs','SIDs','IP and MAC addresses','installed applications')
    }
}

function Initialize-MajinPerformanceTools {
    if(-not ('Majin.Diagnostics.Frames' -as [type])) {Add-Type -Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'performance-metrics.cs')}
}

function Get-MajinWarningSummary([string]$LogPath) {
    $summary=[ordered]@{WarningRecords=0L;ErrorRecords=0L;CriticalRecords=0L;FatalRecords=0L;TextureSamples=0L;TextureOccurrences=$null;TextureSuppressed=$null;XmaRecoveryEvents=0L;UnscaledResolveWarning=$false;ActiveGPU=$null;CaptureLimitReached=$false;ScanTruncated=$false}
    if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $LogPath)){return $summary}
    Initialize-MajinPerformanceTools
    $reader=New-Object IO.StreamReader($LogPath)
    $lineCount=0;$chars=0L
    try {
        while($null -ne ($line=[Majin.Diagnostics.Frames]::ReadBoundedLine($reader))) {
            $chars+=$line.Length
            if(++$lineCount -gt 500000 -or $chars -gt 32MB){$summary.ScanTruncated=$true;break}
            if($line -match '\] \[(warning|error|critical|fatal)\] '){
                switch($Matches[1]) {warning{$summary.WarningRecords++} error{$summary.ErrorRecords++} critical{$summary.CriticalRecords++} fatal{$summary.FatalRecords++}}
            }
            if($line.Contains('Texture fetch constant') -and $line.Contains('invalid')){$summary.TextureSamples++}
            if($line -match '\[Majin texture-warning summary\] occurrences=(\d+); suppressed=(\d+)'){
                $summary.TextureOccurrences=[math]::Max([long]$summary.TextureOccurrences,[long]$Matches[1]);$summary.TextureSuppressed=[math]::Max([long]$summary.TextureSuppressed,[long]$Matches[2])
            }
            if($line.Contains('[Majin XMA recovery')){$summary.XmaRecoveryEvents++}
            if($line.Contains('Frame capture reached 2000000 rows and stopped')){$summary.CaptureLimitReached=$true}
            if($line.Contains('swap source is unscaled')){$summary.UnscaledResolveWarning=$true}
            if($line -match 'DXGI adapter: (.+) \(vendor '){$summary.ActiveGPU=$Matches[1]}
        }
    } catch {$summary.ScanTruncated=$true} finally {$reader.Dispose()}
    return $summary
}

function Write-MajinPerformanceSummary([string]$LogPath) {
    Initialize-MajinPerformanceTools
    $csv=$LogPath+'.performance.csv'
    $frames=$null
    $notes=New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
    if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $csv){
        try {$frames=[Majin.Diagnostics.Frames]::Analyze($csv,$LogPath+'.performance-1s.csv')}
        catch {$notes.Add('Frame analysis unavailable: '+$_.Exception.GetType().Name)}
    } else {$notes.Add('No frame CSV available; an older game binary or disabled recording may be in use.')}
    $warnings=Get-MajinWarningSummary $LogPath
    $result=[ordered]@{SchemaVersion=1;Frames=$frames;Warnings=$warnings;Notes=@($notes);AutomaticUpload=$false}
    $result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath ($LogPath+'.performance-summary.json') -Encoding UTF8
    if($frames -and $frames.ValidIntervals -gt 0){
        $culture=[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
        $message='[Majin performance summary] source=guest_gpu_swap_interval intervals={0} average_fps={1} mean_ms={2} p95_ms={3} p99_ms={4} max_ms={5}; includes loading/pauses; not GPU execution time.' -f $frames.ValidIntervals,$frames.AverageFPS.ToString('F3',$culture),$frames.MeanFrameMs.ToString('F3',$culture),$frames.P95FrameMs.ToString('F3',$culture),$frames.P99FrameMs.ToString('F3',$culture),$frames.MaximumFrameMs.ToString('F3',$culture)
        Add-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value $message -Encoding UTF8
    }
    return $result
}

function Get-MajinDiagnosticConsent([string]$Root,[switch]$IncludeHardware,[switch]$SkipHardware) {
    if($SkipHardware){return $false}
    if($IncludeHardware){return $true}
    $settings=Join-Path $Root 'private/launcher.json'
    if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $settings){try {
        $saved=Get-Content -LiteralPath $settings -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        return ($saved.IncludeHardware -is [bool] -and $saved.IncludeHardware)
    }catch{}}
    return $false
}

function Copy-MajinDiagnosticArtifact([IO.FileInfo]$File,[string]$Destination,[string[]]$LocalRoots,[bool]$AllowHardware,[ref]$CopiedBytes) {
    if($File.Name.EndsWith('.hardware.json') -and !$AllowHardware){return $false}
    $max=if($File.Name.EndsWith('.performance.csv')){8MB}else{2MB}
    if($CopiedBytes.Value+[math]::Min($File.Length,$max)+4096 -gt 25MB){return $false}
    $tail=$File.Length -gt $max
    if($tail -and $File.Extension -eq '.json'){return $false}
    $stream=[IO.File]::Open($File.FullName,[IO.FileMode]::Open,[IO.FileAccess]::Read,[IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
    $reader=New-Object IO.StreamReader($stream)
    try {
        $header=$null
        if($tail){
            if($File.Extension -eq '.csv'){$header=$reader.ReadLine()}
            $reader.DiscardBufferedData();[void]$stream.Seek([math]::Max(0,$stream.Length-$max),[IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin)
            [void]$reader.ReadLine()
        }
        $text=$reader.ReadToEnd()
        if($header){$text=$header+"`n"+$text}
    }finally{$reader.Dispose()}
    if($File.Name.EndsWith('.log.settings.json')){
        # Export only diagnostic settings, never arbitrary game/cache paths.
        $raw=$text | ConvertFrom-Json;$safe=[ordered]@{}
        foreach($key in @('FrameRateMode','Configuration','RenderingPath','RenderScale','CacheFilesBefore','WindowSize','Fullscreen','VSync','PostEffect','InputMode','MouseSensitivity','RecordPerformance','IncludeHardware')){
            if($raw.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $key){$safe[$key]=$raw.$key}
        }
        $text=$safe | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
    }
    $text=Protect-MajinDiagnosticText $text $LocalRoots
    $bytes=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($text)
    if($CopiedBytes.Value+$bytes -gt 25MB){return $false}
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $Destination $File.Name),$text)
    $CopiedBytes.Value+=$bytes
    return [pscustomobject]@{File=$File.Name;TailOnly=$tail;OriginalBytes=$File.Length;ExportedBytes=$bytes}
}
```

`scripts/discovery/d1-stutter-attribution.mjs`:

```mjs
/**
 * DISCOVERY ONLY — D1: Stutter Attribution Analysis Script
 *
 * Analyzes all existing `*.performance.csv` and `*.log` files under `reports/`
 * and `game-data/runtime/logs/` using the D1 spike definition:
 *   frame_time_us > 2x rolling median (window = 60 frames) AND > 25 ms (25,000 us)
 *
 * Also parses all Vulkan `fh1_frame_cost` slow-frame windows (`GPU slow frames: ...`)
 * logged by `tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics/fh1_frame_cost.h`.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/discovery/d1-stutter-attribution.mjs
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

const roots = ['reports', 'game-data/runtime/logs'];

function walk(dir) {
  let results = [];
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return results;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      results = results.concat(walk(full));
    } else {
      results.push(full);
    }
  }
  return results;
}

const allFiles = roots.flatMap(walk);
const csvFiles = allFiles.filter(f => f.endsWith('.csv'));
const logFiles = allFiles.filter(f => f.endsWith('.log'));
const logMap = new Map(logFiles.map(f => [path.basename(f), f]));

function parseTimestampMs(line) {
  const m = line.match(/^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3})\]/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return new Date(m[1].replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z').getTime();
}

function median(arr) {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

let emptyOrHeaderOnlyCsvs = 0;

let nonZeroCounterCsvs = 0;

const sessions = [];

for (const cp of csvFiles) {
  const base = path.basename(cp);

  if (!raw) {
    emptyOrHeaderOnlyCsvs++;

  }
  const csvLines = raw.split(/\r?\n/);
  const fts = [];

  for (let i = 1; i < csvLines.length; i++) {
    const parts = csvLines[i].split(',');
    const ft = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    if (!isNaN(ft) && ft > 0) fts.push(ft);
    for (let c = 2; c < parts.length; c++) {
      if (parts[c] && parts[c] !== '0') fileHasNonZeroCounters = true;
    }
  }
  if (fileHasNonZeroCounters) nonZeroCounterCsvs++;
  if (fts.length === 0) {
    emptyOrHeaderOnlyCsvs++;
    continue;
  }
  validCsvs++;

  let backend = base.includes('vulkan') ? 'Vulkan' : 'Unknown';
  let edition = base.includes('usa') ? 'USA' : 'PAL';
  let shadersPreloaded = 0;
  let pipelinesPreloaded = 0;
  let swapStartMs = null;
  let preloadDone = false;
  const runtimePipelineCreations = [];
  const slowFramePipelineWindows = [];
  const ioTimestamps = [];
  const swapchainTimestamps = [];

  if (lp && fs.existsSync(lp)) {
    const lt = fs.readFileSync(lp, 'utf8');
    if (lt.includes('DXGI adapter') || lt.includes('Direct3D 12')) backend = 'D3D12';
    else if (lt.includes('Vulkan device')) backend = 'Vulkan';
    if (lt.includes('USA')) edition = 'USA';
    else if (lt.includes('Europe / PAL')) edition = 'PAL';

    const hasPreloadLine = lt.includes('Created ') && lt.includes('graphics pipelines');

    for (const line of lt.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const ts = parseTimestampMs(line);
      if (line.includes('[Majin performance] Release counter mode:')) swapStartMs = ts;
      if (line.includes('Initializing shader storage for title') && !hasPreloadLine) preloadDone = true;
      const ms = line.match(/Translated (\d+) shaders from the storage/);
      if (ms) shadersPreloaded = parseInt(ms[1], 10);
      const mp = line.match(/Created (\d+) graphics pipelines/);
      if (mp) {
        pipelinesPreloaded = parseInt(mp[1], 10);
        preloadDone = true;
      }
      if (ts && preloadDone && line.includes('Creating graphics pipeline state with VS')) {
        runtimePipelineCreations.push(ts);
      }
      if (ts && line.includes('GPU slow frames:') && line.includes('pipelines ') && !line.includes('pipelines 0.0 (0.0 ms)')) {
        slowFramePipelineWindows.push(ts);
      }
      if (ts && (line.includes('[Majin loading') || line.includes('[Majin save') || line.includes('[Majin SceneTitleLogo]') || line.includes('[Majin XMA') || line.includes('audio endpoint'))) {
        ioTimestamps.push(ts);
      }
      if (ts && (line.includes('Swapchain') || line.includes('swapchain') || line.includes('Window gained focus') || line.includes('Frame captured:'))) {
        swapchainTimestamps.push(ts);
      }
    }
  }

  const spikes = [];
  let cumUs = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < fts.length; i++) {
    const ft = fts[i];
    const frameStartMs = swapStartMs ? swapStartMs + cumUs / 1000 : null;
    cumUs += ft;
    const frameEndMs = swapStartMs ? swapStartMs + cumUs / 1000 : null;
    const med = median(fts.slice(Math.max(0, i - 59), i + 1));
    if (ft > 2 * med && ft > 25000 && med > 0) {
      const ftMs = ft / 1000;
      const excessMs = (ft - med) / 1000;
      const hasPipeLog = frameStartMs !== null && (
        runtimePipelineCreations.some(pts => pts >= frameStartMs - 500 && pts <= frameEndMs + 500) ||
        slowFramePipelineWindows.some(sts => frameEndMs >= sts - 10500 && frameEndMs <= sts + 500)
      );
      const hasSwapchain = frameStartMs !== null && swapchainTimestamps.some(sts => sts >= frameStartMs - 500 && sts <= frameEndMs + 500);
      const hasIo = i <= 5 || (frameStartMs !== null && ioTimestamps.some(its => its >= frameStartMs - 1000 && its <= frameEndMs + 1000));

      spikes.push({
        frameIdx: i + 1,
        ftMs,
        medMs: med / 1000,
        excessMs,
        hasPipeLog,
        hasSwapchain,
        hasIo,
      });
    }
  }

  sessions.push({
    base,
    logName: logName || base,
    backend,
    edition,
    frames: fts.length,
    totalMs: fts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / 1000,
    shadersPreloaded,
    pipelinesPreloaded,
    runtimePipeLogs: runtimePipelineCreations.length,
    spikes,
    spikeCount: spikes.length,
    spikeMs: spikes.reduce((a, b) => a + b.ftMs, 0),
    excessMs: spikes.reduce((a, b) => a + b.excessMs, 0),
  });
}

const d3dByTime = sessions.filter(s => s.backend === 'D3D12').sort((a, b) => a.logName.localeCompare(b.logName));
for (let i = 0; i < d3dByTime.length; i++) {

    cur.pipelinesBuiltInSession = next.pipelinesPreloaded - cur.pipelinesPreloaded;
  } else {
    cur.pipelinesBuiltInSession = 0;
  }
}

console.log('=== CSV INVENTORY ===');

for (const b of ['Vulkan', 'D3D12']) {

      let c;
      if (isColdOrGrowing) c = cats.cold_or_growing_cache_sessions;
      else if (sp.hasSwapchain) c = cats.warm_cache_swapchain_window;
      else if (sp.hasIo) c = cats.warm_cache_io_load_save_boot;
      else c = cats.warm_cache_unexplained_pacing;

      c.excessMs += sp.excessMs;
    }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cats)) {
      console.log(`  ${k}: ${v.count} spikes (${((v.count / totalSpikes) * 100).toFixed(1)}%) | spikeMs=${v.spikeMs.toFixed(1)} ms (${((v.spikeMs / totalSpikeMs) * 100).toFixed(1)}%) | excessMs=${v.excessMs.toFixed(1)} ms (${((v.excessMs / totalExcessMs) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);

const slowRegex = /GPU slow frames: (\d+) of (\d+) in (\d+) s over (\d+) ms \(worst (\d+) ms, typical (\d+) ms\); each: command processor ([^,]+), (\d+) ms GPU waits, (\d+) ms game waits, (\d+) draws \(typical (\d+)\); textures ([\d.]+) new \(([\d.]+) MB, ([\d.]+) ms\), ([\d.]+) loaded \(([\d.]+) MB, ([\d.]+) ms\), ([\d.]+) evicted \(([\d.]+) MB\); uploads ([\d.]+) MB \(([\d.]+) ms\); shaders ([\d.]+) \(([\d.]+) ms\), pipelines ([\d.]+) \(([\d.]+) ms\); render targets ([\d.]+) new \(([\d.]+) MB, ([\d.]+) ms\), (\d+) trims; resolve readbacks ([\d.]+) \(([\d.]+) MB, ([\d.]+) ms, ([\d.]+) ms GPU waits\); cause: (.+)$/;

    if (!m) continue;
    slowWindows++;

    const gpuWaitMs = parseFloat(m[8]);
    const gameWaitMs = parseFloat(m[9]);
    const texCreateMs = parseFloat(m[14]);
    const texLoadMs = parseFloat(m[17]);
    const uploadMs = parseFloat(m[21]);
    const shaderMs = parseFloat(m[23]);
    const pipelineMs = parseFloat(m[25]);

    slowFramesTotal += n;
    sumShaderMs += shaderMs * n;
    sumPipelineMs += pipelineMs * n;
    sumTexMs += (texCreateMs + texLoadMs) * n;
    sumUploadMs += uploadMs * n;
    sumGpuWaitMs += gpuWaitMs * n;
    sumGameWaitMs += gameWaitMs * n;

    if (shaderMs + pipelineMs >= 4.0) slowFramesShaderPipe += n;
    else if (gameWaitMs >= 4.0) slowFramesGameWait += n;
    else slowFramesUnclear += n;
  }
}
```

`scripts/discovery/d2-miss-cost-breakdown.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * D2 — Miss Cost Breakdown Analysis Script (Revised with Sub-Stage Decomposition & Patch Split)
 * Issue #4: Implement shader pre-compilation / cache warm-up to eliminate in-game stuttering
 *
 * Breaks down a pipeline/shader cache miss on Vulkan and D3D12 into:
 *   (a) Guest shader translation (Xenos ucode analysis + SPIR-V / DXBC generation + VkShaderModule / binding layout UID setup)
 *   (b) Host PSO creation & driver-cache/lookahead wrapper:
 *       - (b1) Raw vkCreateGraphicsPipelines / ID3D12Device::CreateGraphicsPipelineState
 *       - (b2) Per-PSO .vkpc driver cache overhead (CreateDriverCache + GetDriverCacheData ~2 MB + MakeEntry FNV-1a checksum)
 *       - (b3) Outcome::kStale double-compilation and double-serialization overhead
 *       - (b4) Fh1WaitForAhead multi-PSO lookahead queue wait
 *   (c) The rest of the draw path (command processor CPU time per draw and per frame when caches hit)
 *
 * Also separates:
 *   - Per-slow-frame pipeline_ms vs. true per-PSO cost (accounting for background lookahead PSOs)
 *   - D3D12 builds WITH d3d12-blocking-pso-precompile.patch (multi-threaded) vs. WITHOUT patch (single-threaded after commit 3954dec)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/discovery/d2-miss-cost-breakdown.mjs
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const ROOTS = ['reports', 'game-data/runtime/logs'];

function walk(dir) {
  let results = [];
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return results;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      results = results.concat(walk(full));
    } else {
      results.push(full);
    }
  }
  return results;
}

function parseTimestampMs(line) {
  const m = line.match(/^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3})\]/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return new Date(m[1].replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z').getTime();
}

function percentile(sorted, p) {
  if (!sorted.length) return 0;
  const idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) * p)));
  return sorted[idx];
}

function round(val, digits = 2) {
  return Number((val || 0).toFixed(digits));
}

function summarizeDist(values, digits = 2) {
  if (!values.length) {
    return { count: 0, sum: 0, mean: 0, min: 0, p25: 0, p50: 0, p75: 0, p90: 0, p95: 0, p99: 0, max: 0 };
  }
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const sum = sorted.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return {
    count: sorted.length,
    sum: round(sum, digits),
    mean: round(sum / sorted.length, digits),
    min: round(sorted[0], digits),
    p25: round(percentile(sorted, 0.25), digits),
    p50: round(percentile(sorted, 0.50), digits),
    p75: round(percentile(sorted, 0.75), digits),
    p90: round(percentile(sorted, 0.90), digits),
    p95: round(percentile(sorted, 0.95), digits),
    p99: round(percentile(sorted, 0.99), digits),
    max: round(sorted[sorted.length - 1], digits),
  };
}

function histogram(values, buckets) {
  const total = values.length || 1;
  const counts = buckets.map((b) => ({
    label: b.label,
    min: b.min,
    max: b.max === Infinity ? 'inf' : b.max,
    count: 0,
    pct: 0,
    sumMs: 0,
  }));
  for (const v of values) {
    for (let i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
      if (v >= buckets[i].min && v < buckets[i].max) {
        counts[i].count++;
        counts[i].sumMs = round(counts[i].sumMs + v, 2);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  for (const c of counts) {
    c.pct = round((100 * c.count) / total, 1);
  }
  return counts;
}

const allFiles = ROOTS.flatMap(walk);
const logFiles = allFiles.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.log')).sort();
const csvFiles = allFiles.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.csv')).sort();
const logMap = new Map(logFiles.map((f) => [path.basename(f), f]));

// Data structures for Vulkan
const vkSlowWindows = [];

  const isD3D12 = text.includes('DXGI adapter') || text.includes('Direct3D 12');

  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);

  if (isVk) {

    let driverSavedPipelines = null;
    let initDone = false;

    let prevLookaheadWaits = 0;
    let prevLookaheadWaitMs = 0;
    let lastLookaheadStats = null;
    let sessionSlowPipelineMs = 0;
    let sessionSlowShaderMs = 0;
    let sessionSlowFramesCount = 0;
    let sessionCpDirectPipelinesInSlow = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const line = lines[i];
      const tsMs = parseTimestampMs(line);

      if (line.includes('SHADER_WARMUP: Vulkan begin')) {
        warmupBeginMs = tsMs;
      }
      const storedMatch = line.match(
        /Vulkan driver pipeline cache: (\d+) stored pipelines \((\d+) bytes\) for startup warm-up/
      );
      if (storedMatch) {

        warmupTranslateBeginMs = tsMs;
      }
      if (line.includes('SHADER_WARMUP: Vulkan progress 0/')) {

      }
      const progMatch = line.match(/SHADER_WARMUP: Vulkan progress (\d+)\/(\d+)/);
      if (progMatch && tsMs !== null) {

      }
      const compMatch = line.match(/SHADER_WARMUP: Vulkan complete in (\d+) ms/);
      if (compMatch) {

      }
      const drvMatch = line.match(

        driverReused = Number(drvMatch[1]);
        driverCompiled = Number(drvMatch[2]);

      }
      if (!initDone && line.includes('Initializing shader storage for title') && !text.includes('Created ') && !text.includes('SHADER_WARMUP:')) {
        initDone = true;
      }
      const saveMatch = line.match(/Vulkan driver pipeline cache: saved (\d+) bytes for (\d+) pipelines/);
      if (saveMatch) {
        driverSavedBytes = Number(saveMatch[1]);

      }

      // Track lookahead wait deltas and cumulative stats
      const laFullMatch = line.match(
        /Pipelines: (\d+) total \((\d+) preload, (\d+) ahead, (\d+) inline\), (\d+) shaders; lookahead: (\d+) walks \(([^)]+)\), (\d+) packets, (\d+) draws, (\d+) queued, (\d+) unmet waits, ([\d.]+) ms; (\d+) waits ([\d.]+) ms/
      );
      if (laFullMatch) {
        const totalPipes = Number(laFullMatch[1]);
        const preloadPipes = Number(laFullMatch[2]);
        const aheadPipes = Number(laFullMatch[3]);
        const inlinePipes = Number(laFullMatch[4]);
        const shadersCount = Number(laFullMatch[5]);
        const walks = Number(laFullMatch[6]);
        const queued = Number(laFullMatch[10]);
        const unmetWaits = Number(laFullMatch[11]);
        const walkMs = Number(laFullMatch[12]);
        const waits = Number(laFullMatch[13]);
        const waitMs = Number(laFullMatch[14]);

        const dWaits = waits - prevLookaheadWaits;
        const dWaitMs = waitMs - prevLookaheadWaitMs;
        if (dWaits > 0 && dWaitMs > 0) {
          const avgWait = dWaitMs / dWaits;
          for (let k = 0; k < dWaits; k++) {
            vkLookaheadWaitSamplesMs.push(avgWait);
          }
        }
        prevLookaheadWaits = waits;
        prevLookaheadWaitMs = waitMs;
        lastLookaheadStats = {
          line: i + 1,
          totalPipes,
          preloadPipes,
          aheadPipes,
          inlinePipes,
          runtimePipesTotal: aheadPipes + inlinePipes,
          shadersCount,
          walks,
          queued,
          unmetWaits,
          walkMs,
          waits,
          waitMs,
        };
      }

      // Track runtime "Creating graphics pipeline state" deltas after startup
      if (initDone && line.includes('Creating graphics pipeline state with VS') && tsMs !== null) {
        if (prevCreateTs !== null) {
          const delta = tsMs - prevCreateTs;
          if (delta >= 0 && delta <= 1000) {
            vkRuntimeCreateDeltasMs.push({ file, line: i + 1, deltaMs: delta });
          }
        }
        prevCreateTs = tsMs;
      }

      // Parse GPU slow frames lines
      if (line.includes('GPU slow frames:')) {
        const m = line.match(
```
