```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/discovery/d7-feature-support.mjs
 *
 * Discovery Phase D7 Analysis Script:
 * "What do the SDK and drivers support for cheaper pipeline creation?"
 *
 * Evaluates:
 * 1. Hardware & Driver Capability Probe:
 *    - Executes local vulkaninfo to extract exact extensions, properties, and feature flags.
 *    - Probes VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library (graphicsPipelineLibrary, fastLinking).
 *    - Probes VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state (1, 2, 3) features.
 * 2. State-Space Permutation Collapse Simulation:
 *    - Parses 342 Vulkan FBO PSOs (4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso).
 *    - Simulates permutation reduction under:
 *      a) Baseline (Vulkan 1.0 + SDK current)
 *      b) + Extended Dynamic State 1 & 2 (culling, depth, stencil dynamic)
 *      c) + Extended Dynamic State 3 (color blend, write mask dynamic)
 *      d) + Graphics Pipeline Library (GPL fast-link: decoupling VS/PS from state)
 * 3. SDK Device & Pipeline Setup Audit:
 *    - Audits tools/source/rexglue-sdk/src/ui/vulkan/vulkan_device.cpp
 *    - Audits pipeline creation flags in pipeline_cache.cpp
 *    - Audits D3D12 pipeline creation flags and CachedPSO
 * 4. Cross-Vendor Feasibility Matrix (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel).
 */

  localDeviceInfo.eds3ColorBlend = /extendedDynamicState3ColorBlendEnable\s*=\s*true/i.test(vkInfo);

  const devMatch = vkInfo.match(/deviceName\s*=\s*(.+)/);
  if (devMatch) localDeviceInfo.deviceName = devMatch[1].trim();

  const drvMatch = vkInfo.match(/driverInfo\s*=\s*(.+)/);
  if (drvMatch) localDeviceInfo.driverVersion = drvMatch[1].trim();

  const apiMatch = vkInfo.match(/Vulkan Instance Version:\s*([0-9.]+)/);
  if (apiMatch) localDeviceInfo.apiVersion = apiMatch[1].trim();
} catch (e) {
  console.warn('Note: vulkaninfo execution encountered warning/error, using verified device parameters:', e.message);
}

console.table([

    'Dynamic State 2': localDeviceInfo.eds2Supported ? 'YES (Raster/Bias)' : 'NO',

  }

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION 3: State-Space Permutation Collapse Simulation
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
console.log('\n>>> SECTION 3: SIMULATED STATE-SPACE COLLAPSE ON REAL GAME PSO POPULATION');

const vkXpsoPath = path.join(projectRoot, 'game-data/runtime/cache/vulkan-vulkan/release/shaders/shareable/4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso');

function parseXpsoRecords(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return [];
  const buf = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
  const count = Math.floor((buf.length - 20) / 68);
  const records = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const off = 20 + i * 68;
    const vsHash = buf.readBigUInt64LE(off + 8).toString(16);
    const vsMod = buf.readBigUInt64LE(off + 16).toString(16);
    const psHash = buf.readBigUInt64LE(off + 24).toString(16);
    const psMod = buf.readBigUInt64LE(off + 32).toString(16);
    const rpKey = buf.readUInt32LE(off + 40);
    const w1 = buf.readUInt32LE(off + 44);
    const w2 = buf.readUInt32LE(off + 48);
    const rt0 = buf.readUInt32LE(off + 52);

    records.push({
      pairNoMod: `${vsHash}:${psHash}`,
      pairWithMod: `${vsHash}:${vsMod}:${psHash}:${psMod}`,
      vsHash,
      vsMod,
      psHash,
      psMod,
      rpKey,
      rasterState: w1 & 0x7FFF, // culling + polygon mode
      depthState: (w1 >> 15) & 0x1F, // depth write + compare
      stencilState: (w1 >> 20) | (w2 << 12),
      blendState: rt0 & 0x3FFFFFF, // src/dst blend + ops + write mask
      rawState: buf.slice(off + 40, off + 68).toString('hex')
    });
  }
  return records;
}

const records = parseXpsoRecords(vkXpsoPath);
const totalPsos = records.length;
const uniquePairsHashOnly = new Set(records.map(r => r.pairNoMod)).size;
const uniquePairsWithMod = new Set(records.map(r => r.pairWithMod)).size;

// Scenario 1: Baseline (Observed in D3/D5)
const baselineStates = new Set(records.map(r => r.rawState)).size;

// Scenario 2: With Extended Dynamic State 1 & 2
// Culling, Front Face, Depth Test/Write/Compare, Stencil are DYNAMIC (removed from PSO key)
const eds12States = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.rpKey}:${r.blendState}`)).size;
const eds12PsosHashOnly = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.pairNoMod}:${r.rpKey}:${r.blendState}`)).size;
const eds12Psos = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.pairWithMod}:${r.rpKey}:${r.blendState}`)).size;

// Scenario 3: With Extended Dynamic State 1, 2 & 3
// Blend Equations, Blend Enable, and Color Write Mask are ALSO DYNAMIC
const eds3States = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.rpKey}`)).size;
const eds3PsosHashOnly = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.pairNoMod}:${r.rpKey}`)).size;
const eds3Psos = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.pairWithMod}:${r.rpKey}`)).size;

// Scenario 4: With Graphics Pipeline Library (GPL)
// VS:mod and PS:mod are compiled independently as libraries.
// Note: Fast-link time is an engineering projection (< 1 ms); pending M2a spike validation.
const uniqueVsLibs = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.vsHash}:${r.vsMod}`)).size;
const uniquePsLibs = new Set(records.map(r => `${r.psHash}:${r.psMod}`)).size;
```

`scripts/discovery/d8-baseline.mjs`:

```mjs
/**
 * DISCOVERY ONLY — D8: Measured Baseline Evaluation Script
 *
 * Establishes the authoritative measured baseline metrics for the shader precompilation
 * and stutter mitigation plan on the maintainer's hardware (RTX 3060 Ti, Driver 621.14, Vulkan 1.4.357).
 *
 * Evaluates triplicate cold runs and triplicate warm runs across both Vulkan and D3D12:
 *   - Vulkan Cold: Fresh/growing pipeline storage, cold GLCache on first encounters
 *   - Vulkan Warm: Fully populated shader & pipeline cache (re-run reference)
 *   - D3D12 Cold: Early growing-cache sessions on initial route
 *   - D3D12 Warm: Fully warm DXCache sessions
 *
 * Produces:
 *   - reports/baseline-shader/baseline-*.csv (normalized per-frame CSVs)
 *   - reports/baseline-shader/baseline-summary.csv (comprehensive tabular comparison)
 *   - reports/baseline-shader/baseline-summary.json (machine-readable metrics)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/discovery/d8-baseline.mjs
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

const outDir = path.join('reports', 'baseline-shader');
if (!fs.existsSync(outDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
}

function percentile(sorted, p) {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return 0;
  const idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sorted.length * p) - 1));
  return sorted[idx] / 1000; // ms
}

function median(arr) {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const s = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(s.length / 2);
  return s.length % 2 !== 0 ? s[mid] : (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2;
}

function analyzeSession(spec) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(spec.srcCsv, 'utf8').trim();
  const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/);
  const header = lines[0].split(',');
  const ftIdx = header.indexOf('frame_time_us');

  const fts = [];
  const normalizedRows = ['frame_index,frame_time_us,frame_time_ms,rolling_med_ms,is_spike,excess_ms'];

  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const parts = lines[i].split(',');
    const v = parseInt(parts[ftIdx], 10);
    if (!isNaN(v) && v > 0) fts.push(v);
  }

  const sorted = [...fts].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const totalUs = fts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const durS = totalUs / 1000000;
  const avgFps = fts.length / durS;

  let over33 = 0;
  let over50 = 0;
  let over100 = 0;
  const spikes = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < fts.length; i++) {
    const ft = fts[i];
    if (ft > 33333) over33++;
    if (ft > 50000) over50++;
    if (ft > 100000) over100++;

    const med = median(fts.slice(Math.max(0, i - 59), i + 1));
    const isSpike = (ft > 2 * med && ft > 25000 && med > 0);
    const excessMs = isSpike ? (ft - med) / 1000 : 0;

    if (isSpike) {
      spikes.push({
        idx: i + 1,
        ftMs: ft / 1000,
        medMs: med / 1000,
        excessMs
      });
    }

    normalizedRows.push(`${i + 1},${ft},${(ft / 1000).toFixed(3)},${(med / 1000).toFixed(3)},${isSpike ? 1 : 0},${excessMs.toFixed(3)}`);
  }

  const spikeCount = spikes.length;
  const totalSpikeMs = spikes.reduce((a, b) => a + b.ftMs, 0);
  const excessSpikeMs = spikes.reduce((a, b) => a + b.excessMs, 0);
  const worstSpikeMs = spikes.length > 0 ? Math.max(...spikes.map(s => s.ftMs)) : (sorted[sorted.length - 1] / 1000);

  // Parse log telemetry
  let preloadedPso = 0;
  let preloadedShaders = 0;
  let rtPipes = 0;
  let slowWindows = 0;
  let slowFrames = 0;
  let pipelineMs = 0;
  let shaderMs = 0;
  let textureLoadMs = 0;

  if (spec.srcLog && fs.existsSync(spec.srcLog)) {
    const txt = fs.readFileSync(spec.srcLog, 'utf8');
    const mp = txt.match(/Created (\d+) graphics pipelines/);
    if (mp) preloadedPso = parseInt(mp[1], 10);
    const ms = txt.match(/Translated (\d+) shaders from the storage/);
    if (ms) preloadedShaders = parseInt(ms[1], 10);

    const logLines = txt.split(/\r?\n/);
    rtPipes = logLines.filter(l => l.includes('Creating graphics pipeline state with VS')).length;

    for (const l of logLines) {
      if (l.includes('GPU slow frames:')) {
        slowWindows++;
        const sfm = l.match(/GPU slow frames:\s+(\d+)/);
        if (sfm) slowFrames += parseInt(sfm[1], 10);
        const ppm = l.match(/pipelines\s+[\d.]+\s+\(([\d.]+)\s+ms\)/);
        if (ppm) pipelineMs += parseFloat(ppm[1]);
        const psm = l.match(/shaders\s+[\d.]+\s+\(([\d.]+)\s+ms\)/);
        if (psm) shaderMs += parseFloat(psm[1]);
        const ptm = l.match(/textures\s+[\d.]+\s+\(([\d.]+)\s+ms\)/);
        if (ptm) textureLoadMs += parseFloat(ptm[1]);
      }
    }
  }

  // Write normalized CSV
  const targetCsvPath = path.join(outDir, spec.targetCsvName);
  fs.writeFileSync(targetCsvPath, normalizedRows.join('\n'), 'utf8');

  return {
    id: spec.id,
    group: spec.group,
    backend: spec.backend,
    cacheState: spec.cacheState,
    edition: spec.edition,
    route: spec.route,
    targetCsv: spec.targetCsvName,
    srcLog: spec.srcLog,
    frames: fts.length,
    durationS: durS,
    avgFps,
    p50Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.50),
    p90Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.90),
    p95Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.95),
    p99Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.99),
    p999Ms: percentile(sorted, 0.999),
    maxMs: sorted[sorted.length - 1] / 1000,
    over33,
    over50,
    over100,
    spikeCount,
    spikeRate1k: (spikeCount / fts.length) * 1000,
    totalSpikeMs,
    excessSpikeMs,
    excessRate1k: (excessSpikeMs / fts.length) * 1000,
    worstSpikeMs,
    preloadedPso,
    preloadedShaders,
    runtimePsoCreations: rtPipes,
    slowWindows,
    slowFrames,
    pipelineMs,
    shaderMs,
    textureLoadMs
  };
}
```

`scripts/extract-iso.ps1`:

```ps1
using namespace System
using namespace System.IO
using namespace System.Text
using namespace System.Collections.Generic

param(
  [string]$IsoPath,
  [string]$OutputDir
)

$csharp = @'
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace IsoDumper {
  public class Extractor {
    sealed class Entry { public string Path; public long Offset; public int Size; }
    public static void Extract(string isoPath, string outDir) {
      using(FileStream stream = new FileStream(isoPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read)) {
        long partition = -1;
        byte[] descriptor = null;
        foreach(long candidate in new long[]{0, 0xFB20, 0x20600, 0x2080000, 0xFD90000, 0x18300000}) {
          long pos = candidate + 65536;
          if(pos + 2048 > stream.Length) continue;
          stream.Position = pos;
          byte[] d = new byte[2048];
          stream.Read(d, 0, 2048);
          if(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(d, 0, 20) == "MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA" && Encoding.ASCII.GetString(d, 2028, 20) == "MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA") {
            descriptor = d; partition = candidate; break;
          }
        }
        if(descriptor == null) throw new Exception("No Xbox partition found");
        Console.WriteLine("Partition found at: 0x" + partition.ToString("X"));
        
        List<Entry> files = new List<Entry>();
        uint rootSector = BitConverter.ToUInt32(descriptor, 20);
        uint rootSize = BitConverter.ToUInt32(descriptor, 24);

        Stack<Tuple<uint, uint, string>> dirs = new Stack<Tuple<uint, uint, string>>();
        dirs.Push(new Tuple<uint, uint, string>(rootSector, rootSize, ""));

        while(dirs.Count > 0) {
          var item = dirs.Pop();
          uint sector = item.Item1;
          uint size = item.Item2;
          string parent = item.Item3;
          if(size == 0) continue;
          byte[] table = new byte[size];
          stream.Position = partition + (long)sector * 2048;
          stream.Read(table, 0, (int)size);
          Stack<int> pending = new Stack<int>();
          pending.Push(0);
          HashSet<int> visited = new HashSet<int>();

          while(pending.Count > 0) {
            int offset = pending.Pop();
            while(offset >= 0 && offset + 14 <= size && visited.Add(offset)) {
              ushort lSub = BitConverter.ToUInt16(table, offset);
              ushort rSub = BitConverter.ToUInt16(table, offset + 2);
              uint fSector = BitConverter.ToUInt32(table, offset + 4);
              uint fSize = BitConverter.ToUInt32(table, offset + 8);
              byte attr = table[offset + 12];
              byte nameLen = table[offset + 13];
              if(offset + 14 + nameLen > size) break;
              string name = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(table, offset + 14, nameLen);
              string rel = string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) ? name : parent + "\\" + name;

              if((attr & 0x10) != 0) {
                dirs.Push(new Tuple<uint, uint, string>(fSector, fSize, rel));
              } else {
                files.Add(new Entry { Path = rel, Offset = partition + (long)fSector * 2048, Size = (int)fSize });
              }

              if(rSub != 0 && rSub != 0xFFFF) pending.Push(rSub * 4);
              if(lSub != 0 && lSub != 0xFFFF) offset = lSub * 4;
              else break;
            }
          }
        }

        Console.WriteLine("Total files found: " + files.Count);
        int count = 0;
        byte[] buffer = new byte[1048576];
        foreach(var f in files) {
          string target = System.IO.Path.Combine(outDir, f.Path);
          Directory.CreateDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(target));
          stream.Position = f.Offset;
          using(FileStream outStream = new FileStream(target, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write)) {
            int remaining = f.Size;
            while(remaining > 0) {
              int toRead = Math.Min(remaining, buffer.Length);
              int read = stream.Read(buffer, 0, toRead);
              if(read <= 0) break;
              outStream.Write(buffer, 0, read);
              remaining -= read;
            }
          }
          count++;
          if(count % 500 == 0 || count == files.Count) {
            Console.WriteLine(string.Format("Extracted {0}/{1} files...", count, files.Count));
          }
        }
        Console.WriteLine("Extraction complete!");
      }
    }
  }
}
'@

Add-Type -TypeDefinition $csharp

if (-not $IsoPath -or -not $OutputDir) {
  Write-Host "Usage: .\extract-iso.ps1 -IsoPath <path-to-iso> -OutputDir <destination-folder>"
  exit 1
}

$projectRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($OutputDir)) {
  $OutputDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $projectRoot $OutputDir))
}
if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($IsoPath)) {
  $IsoPath = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $projectRoot $IsoPath))
}

Write-Host "Extracting Xbox 360 ISO: $IsoPath"
Write-Host "Destination: $OutputDir"
[IsoDumper.Extractor]::Extract($IsoPath, $OutputDir)
```

`scripts/find_dispatch_thunks.py`:

```py
"""Find exact 4-instruction virtual dispatch thunks in a private code snapshot.

No guessing of function boundaries: each match is lwz/lwz/mtctr/bctr, 16 bytes.
This writes a candidate report only. Config additions require review.
"""
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data = (ROOT / 'private/loaded-text.bin').read_bytes()
base = 0x82150000
mapping = (ROOT / 'prototype/generated/default/majin_init.cpp').read_text()
known = {int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'\{ 0x([0-9A-F]{8}),', mapping)}
results = []
for offset in range(0, len(data) - 15, 4):
    a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from('>4I', data, offset)
    # lwz r12,0(r3); lwz r11,slot(r12), or both loads through r11.
    valid_loads = ((a == 0x81830000 and b >> 16 == 0x816C) or
                   (a == 0x81630000 and b >> 16 == 0x816B))
    slot = b & 0xFFFF
    if valid_loads and slot % 4 == 0 and slot < 0x8000 and c == 0x7D6903A6 and d == 0x4E800420:
        address = base + offset
        results.append({'address': f'0x{address:08X}', 'slot_offset': slot,
                        'registered': address in known, 'size': 16,
                        'words': [f'{word:08X}' for word in (a,b,c,d)]})
(ROOT / 'reports/dispatch-thunks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
missing = [item for item in results if not item['registered']]
print(f'Exact matches: {len(results)}; already registered: {len(results)-len(missing)}; missing: {len(missing)}')
print(json.dumps(missing[:12], indent=2))

```

`scripts/find_dispatch_variants.py`:

```py
"""Audit four-instruction virtual dispatch through volatile r9-r12.

Recognize lwz table,0(r3); lwz target,slot(table); mtctr target; bctr.
Only missing entry seeds are emitted, with sizes inferred for shared tails.
"""
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data = (root / 'private/loaded-text.bin').read_bytes()
mapping = (root / 'prototype/generated/default/majin_init.cpp').read_text()
known = {int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'\{ 0x([0-9A-F]{8}),', mapping)}
matches = []
for offset in range(0, len(data) - 15, 4):
    a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from('>4I', data, offset)
    table, target = (a >> 21) & 31, (b >> 21) & 31
    if table not in range(9, 13) or target not in range(9, 13):
        continue
    if a != (0x80030000 | (table << 21)):
        continue
    if b >> 16 != (0x8000 | (target << 5) | table):
        continue
    slot = b & 0xFFFF
    if slot >= 0x8000 or slot % 4:
        continue
    if c != (0x7C0903A6 | (target << 21)) or d != 0x4E800420:
        continue
    address = offset + 0x82150000
    matches.append(dict(address=f'0x{address:08X}', table_register=table,
                        target_register=target, slot=slot, registered=address in known))
missing = [item for item in matches if not item['registered']]
(root / 'reports/dispatch-variants.json').write_text(json.dumps(matches, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(dict(matches=len(matches), missing=len(missing), entries=missing), indent=2))

```

`scripts/find_member_dispatch_thunks.py`:

```py
"""Audit exact member-object dispatch thunks; emit config only with --emit.

Pattern observed at runtime targets 0x824419F8 and 0x82750410.
Only five aligned instructions with a terminal bctr and zero padding qualify.
No guest instruction is replaced. Original code snapshot stays private.
"""
import argparse
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--emit', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data = (root / 'private/loaded-text.bin').read_bytes()
mapping = (root / 'prototype/generated/default/majin_init.cpp').read_text()
known = {int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'\{ 0x([0-9A-F]{8}),', mapping)}
matches = []
for offset in range(0, len(data) - 23, 4):
    a, b, c, d, e, padding = struct.unpack_from('>6I', data, offset)
    # lwz r3,member(r3); lwz r11,0(r3); lwz r10/r11,slot(r11)
    # mtctr r10/r11; bctr; zero padding.
    if a >> 16 != 0x8063 or b != 0x81630000:
        continue
    if not ((c >> 16 == 0x814B and d == 0x7D4903A6) or
            (c >> 16 == 0x816B and d == 0x7D6903A6)):
        continue
    member, slot = a & 0xFFFF, c & 0xFFFF
    if member >= 0x8000 or member % 4 or slot >= 0x8000 or slot % 4:
        continue
    if e != 0x4E800420 or padding != 0:
        continue
    address = 0x82150000 + offset
    matches.append(dict(address=f'0x{address:08X}', member_offset=member,
                        slot_offset=slot, size=20, registered=address in known))
missing = [item for item in matches if not item['registered']]
if args.emit:
    config = ['# Exact five-instruction member dispatch thunks; see audit report.', '[functions]']
    # Let the analyzer resolve shared tails with existing inner-entry thunks.
    config += [f"{item['address']} = {{ name = \"sub_{item['address'][2:]}\" }}" for item in missing]
    (root / 'prototype/member-dispatch-thunks.toml').write_text('\n'.join(config) + '\n')
(root / 'reports/member-dispatch-thunks.json').write_text(json.dumps(matches, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(dict(matches=len(matches), missing=len(missing), entries=missing), indent=2))

```

`scripts/generate-icons.ps1`:

```ps1
# Generate all launcher icons from branding/majistic_icon.png
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Definition
$rootDir = Split-Path -Parent $scriptDir
$sourcePng = Join-Path $rootDir "branding\majistic_icon.png"
$iconsDir = Join-Path $rootDir "launcher\src-tauri\icons"

if (-not (Test-Path $sourcePng)) {
    Write-Error "Source icon not found: $sourcePng"
    exit 1
}

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

function Resize-Bitmap {
    param(
        [System.Drawing.Bitmap]$source,
        [int]$width,
        [int]$height
    )
    $dest = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($width, $height, [System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format32bppArgb)
    $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($dest)
    $g.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
    $g.SmoothingMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode]::HighQuality
    $g.PixelOffsetMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.PixelOffsetMode]::HighQuality
    $g.CompositingQuality = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.CompositingQuality]::HighQuality
    $g.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::Transparent)
    $g.DrawImage($source, 0, 0, $width, $height)
    $g.Dispose()
    return $dest
}

function Create-BmpIconData {
    param([System.Drawing.Bitmap]$bmp)
    $w = $bmp.Width
    $h = $bmp.Height
    $andRowStride = [int]([Math]::Ceiling($w / 32.0) * 4)
    $andMaskSize = $andRowStride * $h
    $xorSize = $w * $h * 4
    $totalSize = 40 + $xorSize + $andMaskSize

    $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
    $bw = New-Object System.IO.BinaryWriter($ms)

    # BITMAPINFOHEADER (40 bytes)
    $bw.Write([uint32]40)              # biSize
    $bw.Write([int32]$w)               # biWidth
    $bw.Write([int32]($h * 2))         # biHeight (doubled for ICO BMP)
    $bw.Write([uint16]1)               # biPlanes
    $bw.Write([uint16]32)              # biBitCount (32bpp ARGB)
    $bw.Write([uint32]0)               # biCompression (BI_RGB)
    $bw.Write([uint32]($xorSize + $andMaskSize)) # biSizeImage
    $bw.Write([int32]0)                # biXPelsPerMeter
    $bw.Write([int32]0)                # biYPelsPerMeter
    $bw.Write([uint32]0)               # biClrUsed
    $bw.Write([uint32]0)               # biClrImportant

    # XOR mask (bottom-up BGRA)
    for ($y = $h - 1; $y -ge 0; $y--) {
        for ($x = 0; $x -lt $w; $x++) {
            $c = $bmp.GetPixel($x, $y)
            $bw.Write([byte]$c.B)
            $bw.Write([byte]$c.G)
            $bw.Write([byte]$c.R)
            $bw.Write([byte]$c.A)
        }
    }

    # AND mask (bottom-up 1bpp, 1 = transparent, 0 = opaque)
    for ($y = $h - 1; $y -ge 0; $y--) {
        $row = New-Object byte[] $andRowStride
        for ($x = 0; $x -lt $w; $x++) {
            $c = $bmp.GetPixel($x, $y)
            if ($c.A -eq 0) {
                $byteIdx = [int]($x / 8)
                $bitIdx = 7 - ($x % 8)
                $row[$byteIdx] = [byte]($row[$byteIdx] -bor (1 -shl $bitIdx))
            }
        }
        $bw.Write($row, 0, $andRowStride)
    }

    $bw.Flush()
    $bytes = $ms.ToArray()
    $bw.Dispose()
    $ms.Dispose()
    return $bytes
}

Write-Host "Loading source image: $sourcePng"
$src = [System.Drawing.Bitmap]::FromFile($sourcePng)

# Generate individual PNG files for web / icons
$pngSizes = @{
    "16x16.png" = 16
    "32x32.png" = 32
    "64x64.png" = 64
    "128x128.png" = 128
    "128x128@2x.png" = 256
    "icon.png" = 512
}

foreach ($name in $pngSizes.Keys) {
    $size = $pngSizes[$name]
    $destPath = Join-Path $iconsDir $name
    $resized = Resize-Bitmap $src $size $size
    $resized.Save($destPath, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    $resized.Dispose()
    Write-Host "Generated $destPath ($size x $size)"
}

# Now generate multi-resolution icon.ico:
# Sizes <= 64 are BMP (standard uncompressed DIB with alpha), size 256 is PNG compressed
$icoBmpSizes = @(16, 24, 32, 48, 64)
$icoPngSizes = @(256)

$imageBytesList = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[byte[]]
$sizesList = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[int]

foreach ($s in $icoBmpSizes) {
    $resized = Resize-Bitmap $src $s $s
    $bmpData = Create-BmpIconData $resized
    $imageBytesList.Add($bmpData)
    $sizesList.Add($s)
    $resized.Dispose()
}

foreach ($s in $icoPngSizes) {
    $resized = Resize-Bitmap $src $s $s
    $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
    $resized.Save($ms, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    $imageBytesList.Add($ms.ToArray())
    $sizesList.Add($s)
    $ms.Dispose()
    $resized.Dispose()
}

$icoPath = Join-Path $iconsDir "icon.ico"
$icoMs = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$icoBw = New-Object System.IO.BinaryWriter($icoMs)

$count = $imageBytesList.Count
$icoBw.Write([uint16]0)      # reserved
$icoBw.Write([uint16]1)      # type 1 = icon
$icoBw.Write([uint16]$count) # count

$offset = 6 + (16 * $count)
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $count; $i++) {
    $s = $sizesList[$i]
    $data = $imageBytesList[$i]
    $wByte = if ($s -eq 256) { [byte]0 } else { [byte]$s }
    $hByte = if ($s -eq 256) { [byte]0 } else { [byte]$s }

    $icoBw.Write($wByte)
    $icoBw.Write($hByte)
    $icoBw.Write([byte]0)        # color count
    $icoBw.Write([byte]0)        # reserved
    $icoBw.Write([uint16]1)      # planes
    $icoBw.Write([uint16]32)     # bpp
    $icoBw.Write([uint32]$data.Length)
    $icoBw.Write([uint32]$offset)
    $offset += $data.Length
}

for ($i = 0; $i -lt $count; $i++) {
    $icoBw.Write($imageBytesList[$i])
}

$icoBw.Flush()
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($icoPath, $icoMs.ToArray())
$icoBw.Dispose()
$icoMs.Dispose()
$src.Dispose()

Write-Host "Generated multi-resolution $icoPath with $($imageBytesList.Count) frames (16-64 BMP, 256 PNG)"
```

`scripts/generate-usa-tomls.py`:

```py
"""Generate and byte-verify all 4 USA .toml configuration files and majin_manifest.toml."""
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIV = ROOT / "prototype-usa" / "private"
REF_PROTO = ROOT / "prototype"
OUT_PROTO = ROOT / "prototype-usa"
REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"

text = (PRIV / "loaded-text.bin").read_bytes()
TEXT_BASE = 0x82150000

SPLIT_VA = 0x821C0000  # Exact transition region between delta=0 and delta=-0x70


def pal_to_usa(pal_va: int) -> int:
    return pal_va if pal_va < SPLIT_VA else (pal_va - 0x70)


def read_words(va: int, n: int = 4):
    off = va - TEXT_BASE
    return struct.unpack_from(f">{n}I", text, off)


# 1. Translate and verify dispatch-thunks.toml
pal_dt_lines = (REF_PROTO / "dispatch-thunks.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
usa_dt_lines = []
dt_verified = 0
for line in pal_dt_lines:
    m = re.match(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\s*=\s*\{\s*size\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*\}", line)
    if m:
        p_va = int(m.group(1), 16)
        sz = int(m.group(2))
        u_va = pal_to_usa(p_va)
        a, b, c, d = read_words(u_va, 4)
        assert c == 0x7D6903A6 and d == 0x4E800420, f"Invalid thunk at USA 0x{u_va:08X}"
        usa_dt_lines.append(f"0x{u_va:08X} = {{ size = {sz} }}")
        dt_verified += 1
    else:
        usa_dt_lines.append(line)

(OUT_PROTO / "dispatch-thunks.toml").write_text("\n".join(usa_dt_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

# 2. Translate and verify dispatch-variants.toml
pal_dv_lines = (REF_PROTO / "dispatch-variants.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
usa_dv_lines = []
dv_verified = 0
for line in pal_dv_lines:
    m = re.match(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\s*=\s*\{\s*name\s*=\s*\"sub_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}\"\s*\}", line)
    if m:
        p_va = int(m.group(1), 16)
        u_va = pal_to_usa(p_va)
        a, b, c, d = read_words(u_va, 4)
        assert d == 0x4E800420, f"Invalid variant thunk at USA 0x{u_va:08X}"
        usa_dv_lines.append(f'0x{u_va:08X} = {{ name = "sub_{u_va:08X}" }}')
        dv_verified += 1
    else:
        usa_dv_lines.append(line)

(OUT_PROTO / "dispatch-variants.toml").write_text("\n".join(usa_dv_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

# 3. Translate and verify member-dispatch-thunks.toml
pal_mt_lines = (REF_PROTO / "member-dispatch-thunks.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
usa_mt_lines = []
mt_verified = 0
for line in pal_mt_lines:
    m = re.match(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\s*=\s*\{\s*name\s*=\s*\"sub_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}\"\s*\}", line)
    if m:
        p_va = int(m.group(1), 16)
        u_va = pal_to_usa(p_va)
        a, b, c, d, e = read_words(u_va, 5)
        assert e == 0x4E800420, f"Invalid member thunk at USA 0x{u_va:08X}"
        usa_mt_lines.append(f'0x{u_va:08X} = {{ name = "sub_{u_va:08X}" }}')
        mt_verified += 1
    else:
        usa_mt_lines.append(line)

(OUT_PROTO / "member-dispatch-thunks.toml").write_text("\n".join(usa_mt_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

# 4. Translate and verify analysis-overrides.toml
pal_ao_lines = (REF_PROTO / "analysis-overrides.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
usa_ao_lines = []
ao_verified = 0
for line in pal_ao_lines:
    m = re.match(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\s*=\s*\{\s*name\s*=\s*\"sub_[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}\"\s*\}", line)
    if m:
        p_va = int(m.group(1), 16)
        u_va = pal_to_usa(p_va)
        w = read_words(u_va, 2)
        assert w[0] != 0, f"Zero opcode at USA 0x{u_va:08X}"
        usa_ao_lines.append(f'0x{u_va:08X} = {{ name = "sub_{u_va:08X}" }}')
        ao_verified += 1
    else:
        usa_ao_lines.append(line)

(OUT_PROTO / "analysis-overrides.toml").write_text("\n".join(usa_ao_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

# 5. Create majin_manifest.toml in prototype-usa/
manifest = """# Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom (USA 0.0.0.2) ReXGlue Manifest

[project]
name = "majin"
sdk_version = "0.10.0"
game_root = "../game-data-usa"

[entrypoint]
file_path = "../game-data-usa/default.xex"
out_directory_path = "generated/default"
includes = ["analysis-overrides.toml", "dispatch-thunks.toml", "member-dispatch-thunks.toml", "dispatch-variants.toml"]
"""
(OUT_PROTO / "majin_manifest.toml").write_text(manifest, encoding="utf-8")

print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "dispatch_thunks_verified": dt_verified,
            "dispatch_variants_verified": dv_verified,
            "member_thunks_verified": mt_verified,
            "analysis_overrides_verified": ao_verified,
            "total_verified": dt_verified + dv_verified + mt_verified + ao_verified,
        },
        indent=2,
    )
)
```

`scripts/harvest-demos.ps1`:

```ps1
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Majistic Recomp - Automated Cutscene Shader Harvester & Merger Script
#
# Fluxo completo:
# 1. Backup de Seguranca dos caches de shader existentes (.xpso e .xsh)
# 2. Execucao automatizada das 82 cutscenes com majin.exe (--majin_harvest_demos=true)
# 3. Consolidacao e merge via merge_shaders.exe com relatorio comparativo

param(
    [ValidateRange(1.0, 16.0)][double]$HarvestSpeed = 5.0,
    [ValidateRange(1, 82)][int]$BatchSize = 1,
    [int]$MaxDemos = 0,
    [int]$StartIndex = 0,
    [string]$GameDataRoot = 'game-data',
    [ValidateSet('Debug','Release')][string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [switch]$NoMerge
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Write-Host "=========================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Majin Recomp - Automated Cutscene Shader Harvester    " -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "=========================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Resolucao de Diretorios e Binarios
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$projectRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent

if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($GameDataRoot)) {
    $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot $GameDataRoot
    if (-not (Test-Path $candidate) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data-usa'))) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data-usa'
    }
    $GameDataRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate)
}

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'default.xex'))) {
    throw "default.xex nao encontrado em $GameDataRoot"
}

$binDir = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'bin'
$targetExe = Join-Path $binDir 'majin.exe'
$buildPal = Join-Path $projectRoot ('prototype\out\build\win-amd64-' + $Configuration.ToLower() + '\majin.exe')
$buildUsa = Join-Path $projectRoot ('prototype-usa\out\build\win-amd64-' + $Configuration.ToLower() + '\majin.exe')
$buildExe = if (Test-Path $buildPal) { $buildPal } else { $buildUsa }

# Garante que majin.exe esteja atualizado com o build mais recente
if (Test-Path $buildExe) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $targetExe) -or ((Get-Item $buildExe).LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Item $targetExe).LastWriteTime)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $buildExe -Destination $targetExe -Force
        Write-Host "[INIT] Binario atualizado em $targetExe a partir do build." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    $exe = $targetExe
} elseif (Test-Path $targetExe) {
    $exe = $targetExe
} else {
    throw "Executavel do jogo nao encontrado em $targetExe. Compile o projeto primeiro."
}

$sessionRoot = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'runtime'
$cacheKey = 'vulkan-vulkan/' + $Configuration.ToLower()
$cacheRoot = Join-Path $sessionRoot ('cache/' + $cacheKey)
$metadataRoot = Join-Path $sessionRoot ('metadata/' + $cacheKey)
$shaderDir = Join-Path $cacheRoot 'shaders/shareable'
$logDir = Join-Path $sessionRoot 'logs'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $shaderDir, $logDir, "$sessionRoot/user", $metadataRoot | Out-Null

$xpsoPath = Join-Path $shaderDir '4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso'
$xshPath  = Join-Path $shaderDir '4E4D0816.xsh'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Backup de Seguranca
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`n[ETAPA 1/3] Backup de Seguranca dos Caches..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$xpsoInitialSize = 0
$psoBefore = 0
$xshInitialSize = 0

$xpsoBakPath = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso.preharvest-$timestamp.bak"
$xshBakPath  = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.xsh.preharvest-$timestamp.bak"
$xpsoCanonicalBak = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso.preharvest.bak"
$xshCanonicalBak  = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.xsh.preharvest.bak"

if (Test-Path $xpsoPath) {
    $xpsoInitialSize = (Get-Item $xpsoPath).Length
    if ($xpsoInitialSize -ge 20) {
        $psoBefore = [int](($xpsoInitialSize - 20) / 68)
    }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $xpsoPath -Destination $xpsoBakPath -Force
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $xpsoPath -Destination $xpsoCanonicalBak -Force
    Write-Host "  -> Backup XPSO salvo: $xpsoBakPath" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  -> Contagem inicial de PSOs: $psoBefore ($xpsoInitialSize bytes)" -ForegroundColor White
} else {
    Write-Host "  -> Nenhum XPSO previo encontrado. Criando base limpa." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

if (Test-Path $xshPath) {
    $xshInitialSize = (Get-Item $xshPath).Length
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $xshPath -Destination $xshBakPath -Force
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $xshPath -Destination $xshCanonicalBak -Force
    Write-Host "  -> Backup XSH salvo: $xshBakPath" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  -> Tamanho inicial do XSH: $([Math]::Round($xshInitialSize / 1KB, 2)) KB ($xshInitialSize bytes)" -ForegroundColor White
} else {
    Write-Host "  -> Nenhum XSH previo encontrado. Criando base limpa." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Execucao do Harvester em Lotes Seguros
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$demoPackageDir = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package'
if (-not (Test-Path $demoPackageDir)) {
    $demoPackageDir = Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package'
}
$demoFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $demoPackageDir -Filter "demo*.pak" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$totalAvailable = if ($demoFiles) { $demoFiles.Count } else { 82 }
$totalDemosToRun = if ($MaxDemos -gt 0) { [Math]::Min($totalAvailable - $StartIndex, $MaxDemos) } else { $totalAvailable - $StartIndex }
$endIndex = $StartIndex + $totalDemosToRun

Write-Host "`n[ETAPA 2/3] Executando Harvester de Cutscenes em Lotes ($totalDemosToRun cutscenes, offset $($StartIndex + 1) a $endIndex de $totalAvailable)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$workingDir = Split-Path $exe -Parent
$batchIndex = 0

for ($start = $StartIndex; $start -lt $endIndex; $start += $BatchSize) {
    $batchIndex++
    $count = [Math]::Min($BatchSize, $endIndex - $start)
    $batchEnd = $start + $count
    Write-Host "`n>>> [LOTE $batchIndex] Cutscenes $($start + 1) ate $batchEnd de $totalAvailable <<<" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $runtimeLog = Join-Path $logDir ("harvest-$timestamp-batch$batchIndex.log")
    $launchArgs = @(
        '--gpu_plugin', 'xenos',
        '--gpu_backend=vulkan',
        '--game_data_root', $GameDataRoot,
        '--user_data_root', "$sessionRoot/user",
        '--cache_root', $cacheRoot,
        '--metadata_root', $metadataRoot,
        '--log_file', $runtimeLog,
        '--flush_log=true',
        '--window_width=1280',
        '--window_height=720',
        '--fullscreen=false',
        '--vsync=false',
        '--resolution_scale=1',
        '--swap_post_effect=none',
        '--swap_dedither_strength=0.85',
        '--present_effect=cas',
        '--present_dither=false',
        '--gpu_allow_invalid_fetch_constants=true',
        '--render_target_path_vulkan=fbo',
        '--vulkan_dynamic_rendering=false',
        '--vulkan_async_skip_incomplete_frames=false',
        '--async_shader_compilation=false',
        '--majin_window_fps=false',
        '--majin_record_performance=false',
        '--majin_60fps=true',
        '--majin_skip_cutscenes=false',
        '--majin_skip_intro_logos=true',
        '--user_language=1',
        '--majin_step_fix=false',
        '--majin_submotion_fix=false',
        '--majin_dt_smooth=false',
        '--majin_fov_scale=1.0',
        '--majin_draw_distance_scale=1.0',
        '--majin_pause_distortion=false',
        '--majin_dof=true',
        '--majin_bloom=1.0',
        '--majin_harvest_demos=true',
        "--majin_harvest_speed=$HarvestSpeed",
        "--majin_harvest_start=$start",
        "--majin_harvest_count=$count"
    )

    $quotedArgs = @($launchArgs | ForEach-Object {
        '"' + (($_ -replace '(\\*)"', '$1$1\"') -replace '(\\+)$', '$1$1') + '"'
    })

    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $quotedArgs -WorkingDirectory $workingDir -PassThru

    $lastLogPos = 0
    while (-not $process.HasExited) {
        if (Test-Path $runtimeLog) {
            try {
                $stream = [System.IO.File]::Open($runtimeLog, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
                if ($stream.Length -gt $lastLogPos) {
                    $stream.Seek($lastLogPos, [System.IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin) | Out-Null
                    $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
                    while (-not $reader.EndOfStream) {
                        $line = $reader.ReadLine()
                        if ($line -match '\[HARVEST\]') {
                            Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Green
                        } elseif ($line -match '\[error\]|\[critical\]|FATAL') {
                            Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Red
                        } elseif ($line -match '\[warn\]') {
                            Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Yellow
                        }
                    }
                    $lastLogPos = $stream.Position
                    $reader.Close()
                }
                $stream.Close()
            } catch { }
        }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
    }

    if (Test-Path $runtimeLog) {
        try {
            $stream = [System.IO.File]::Open($runtimeLog, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
            if ($stream.Length -gt $lastLogPos) {
                $stream.Seek($lastLogPos, [System.IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin) | Out-Null
                $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
                while (-not $reader.EndOfStream) {
                    $line = $reader.ReadLine()
                    if ($line -match '\[HARVEST\]') {
                        Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Green
                    }
                }
                $reader.Close()
            }
            $stream.Close()
        } catch { }
    }

    Write-Host "`n[LOTE $batchIndex] Finalizado com ExitCode: $($process.ExitCode)" -ForegroundColor $(if ($process.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'Cyan' } else { 'Yellow' })
}

if ($NoMerge) {
    Write-Host "Parametro -NoMerge especificado. Encerrando sem consolidacao." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Consolidacao via merge_shaders.exe e Relatorio
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`n[ETAPA 3/3] Consolidacao via merge_shaders.exe..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$mergeShadersDir = Join-Path $projectRoot 'tools\merge-shaders'
$mergeShadersExe = Join-Path $mergeShadersDir 'merge_shaders.exe'
$mergeShadersSrc = Join-Path $mergeShadersDir 'merge_shaders.cpp'

if (-not (Test-Path $mergeShadersExe)) {
    Write-Host "  merge_shaders.exe nao encontrado. Tentando compilar..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $vcvars = "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat"
    if (Test-Path $vcvars) {
        $sdkInclude = Join-Path $projectRoot 'tools\sdk\win-amd64\include'
        $objPath = Join-Path $mergeShadersDir 'merge_shaders.obj'
        cmd /c "call `"$vcvars`" >nul && cl /nologo /EHsc /O2 /std:c++20 /I`"$sdkInclude`" `"$mergeShadersSrc`" /Fe`"$mergeShadersExe`" /Fo`"$objPath`" && del `"$objPath`""
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path $mergeShadersExe)) {
        throw "Nao foi possivel compilar ou localizar merge_shaders.exe em $mergeShadersDir"
    }
    Write-Host "  merge_shaders.exe compilado com sucesso." -ForegroundColor Green
}

# Função auxiliar para cópia segura com retentativas (evita colisão de handle no Windows)
function Safe-CopyFile([string]$Source, [string]$Dest) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Source)) { return }
    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 10; $attempt++) {
        try {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Source -Destination $Dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            return
        } catch {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
        }
    }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Source -Destination $Dest -Force
}

# Aguarda liberação completa de handles pelo kernel do Windows
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000

# Preserva copia bruta do que o harvester acabou de gerar antes do merge
$xshHarvestedPath  = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.xsh.harvested-$timestamp"
$xpsoHarvestedPath = Join-Path $shaderDir "4E4D0816.fbo.vk.xpso.harvested-$timestamp"

Safe-CopyFile -Source $xshPath -Dest $xshHarvestedPath
Safe-CopyFile -Source $xpsoPath -Dest $xpsoHarvestedPath

$baseXsh  = if (Test-Path $xshBakPath)  { $xshBakPath }  else { $xshPath }
$baseXpso = if (Test-Path $xpsoBakPath) { $xpsoBakPath } else { $xpsoPath }
$newXsh   = if (Test-Path $xshHarvestedPath)  { $xshHarvestedPath }  else { $xshPath }
$newXpso  = if (Test-Path $xpsoHarvestedPath) { $xpsoHarvestedPath } else { $xpsoPath }

$mergeArgs = @(
    "--base-xsh=$baseXsh",
    "--base-xpso=$baseXpso",
    "--new-xsh=$newXsh",
    "--new-xpso=$newXpso",
    "--out-xsh=$xshPath",
    "--out-xpso=$xpsoPath"
)

Write-Host "  Executando merge_shaders.exe..." -ForegroundColor White
$mergeProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $mergeShadersExe -ArgumentList $mergeArgs -WorkingDirectory $projectRoot -PassThru -Wait
if ($mergeProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) {
    Write-Warning "merge_shaders.exe retornou codigo de saida: $($mergeProcess.ExitCode)"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Relatorio Final Comparativo
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$psoAfter = 0
$xshFinalSize = 0

if (Test-Path $xpsoPath) {
    $xpsoFinalSize = (Get-Item $xpsoPath).Length
    if ($xpsoFinalSize -ge 20) {
        $psoAfter = [int](($xpsoFinalSize - 20) / 68)
    }
}
if (Test-Path $xshPath) {
    $xshFinalSize = (Get-Item $xshPath).Length
}

$psoDiff = $psoAfter - $psoBefore
$xshDiff = $xshFinalSize - $xshInitialSize

Write-Host "`n=========================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "            RELATORIO DO SHADER HARVEST                  " -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "=========================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("  PSOs antes do harvest:     {0,5}" -f $psoBefore) -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host ("  PSOs apos o harvest:      {0,5} (+{1} novos PSOs consolidados)" -f $psoAfter, $psoDiff) -ForegroundColor $(if ($psoDiff -gt 0) { 'Green' } else { 'Yellow' })
Write-Host ("  Tamanho do .xsh antes:    {0,8:N2} KB ({1} bytes)" -f ($xshInitialSize / 1KB), $xshInitialSize) -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host ("  Tamanho do .xsh apos:     {0,8:N2} KB ({1} bytes) (+{2:N2} KB)" -f ($xshFinalSize / 1KB), $xshFinalSize, ($xshDiff / 1KB)) -ForegroundColor $(if ($xshDiff -gt 0) { 'Green' } else { 'Yellow' })
Write-Host "=========================================================`n" -ForegroundColor Green
```

`scripts/map-pal-to-usa.py`:

```py
"""Map exact address deltas between PAL (0.0.0.3) and USA (0.0.0.2) across .text."""
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIV = ROOT / "prototype-usa" / "private"
REF_PROTO = ROOT / "prototype"
REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"

text = (PRIV / "loaded-text.bin").read_bytes()
pdata = (PRIV / "loaded-pdata.bin").read_bytes()
TEXT_BASE = 0x82150000

pdata_starts = set()
for off in range(0, len(pdata), 8):
    begin, _ = struct.unpack_from(">II", pdata, off)
    if begin:
        pdata_starts.add(begin)

# Collect all 4-insn thunks (Layer 1 + Layer 2) in USA
usa_thunks = {}
for off in range(0, len(text) - 15, 4):
    a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from(">4I", text, off)
    table, target = (a >> 21) & 31, (b >> 21) & 31
    if table in range(9, 13) and target in range(9, 13):
        if a == (0x80030000 | (table << 21)) and (b >> 16) == (0x8000 | (target << 5) | table):
            slot = b & 0xFFFF
            if slot < 0x8000 and slot % 4 == 0 and c == (0x7C0903A6 | (target << 21)) and d == 0x4E800420:
                usa_thunks[TEXT_BASE + off] = (a, b, c, d)

pal_thunks_txt = (REF_PROTO / "dispatch-thunks.toml").read_text()
pal_vars_txt = (REF_PROTO / "dispatch-variants.toml").read_text()
pal_addrs = sorted(
    [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})", pal_thunks_txt, re.M)]
    + [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})", pal_vars_txt, re.M)]
)

print(f"Total PAL thunks + variants to probe: {len(pal_addrs)}")
transitions = []
last_d = object()
matched = 0
for p in pal_addrs:
    found_d = None
    for d in range(0, -0x200, -4):
        if (p + d) in usa_thunks:
            found_d = d
            break
    if found_d is None:
        for d in range(4, 0x200, 4):
            if (p + d) in usa_thunks:
                found_d = d
                break
    if found_d is not None:
        matched += 1
    if found_d != last_d:
        u_str = f"0x{p + found_d:08X}" if found_d is not None else "NONE"
        d_str = f"{found_d:+d} (0x{found_d:+X})" if found_d is not None else "NONE"
        print(f"  PAL 0x{p:08X} -> USA {u_str} | delta = {d_str}")
        transitions.append((p, found_d))
        last_d = found_d

print(f"Matched {matched}/{len(pal_addrs)} PAL thunks!")

```

`scripts/measure-gpu.ps1`:

```ps1
# Samples NVIDIA GPU utilization/power/clock while majin.exe runs and prints a
# summary. Diagnostic only: reads nvidia-smi, changes nothing.
# Usage: .\scripts\measure-gpu.ps1 -Label rov-1x -Seconds 60 [-WaitForGame]
param(
    [string]$Label = 'session',
    [ValidateRange(5, 3600)][int]$Seconds = 60,
    [switch]$WaitForGame
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$reports = Join-Path $root 'reports'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reports | Out-Null
if (-not (Get-Command nvidia-smi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'nvidia-smi not found.' }

if ($WaitForGame) {
    while (-not (Get-Process majin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
}

$csv = Join-Path $reports ("gpu-$Label-" + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.csv')
$samples = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($Seconds)
while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    if (-not (Get-Process majin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { break }
    $line = (nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,power.draw,clocks.gr,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits) -split ',\s*'
    $samples.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        t = (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss.fff')
        util = [double]$line[0]; power = [double]$line[1]; clock = [double]$line[2]; vram = [double]$line[3]
    })
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
}
$samples | Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation -Path $csv
if ($samples.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'No samples (majin.exe not running).'; return }

function Stat($name) {
    $v = $samples | ForEach-Object { $_.$name } | Sort-Object
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Metric = $name
        Avg = [math]::Round(($v | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 1)
        P50 = $v[[int][math]::Floor(($v.Count - 1) * 0.5)]
        P95 = $v[[int][math]::Floor(($v.Count - 1) * 0.95)]
        Max = $v[-1]
    }
}
Write-Output "[$Label] $($samples.Count) samples -> $csv"
'util', 'power', 'clock', 'vram' | ForEach-Object { Stat $_ } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

```

`scripts/merge-shader-caches.ps1`:

```ps1
param(
    [string]$CacheRoot = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($CacheRoot)) {
    $CacheRoot = Join-Path $root 'private\runtime-usa\cache'
}

if (-not (Test-Path $CacheRoot)) {
    Write-Host "Cache directory not found: $CacheRoot"
    exit 0
}

Write-Host "Consolidating shader caches in: $CacheRoot"

foreach ($backend in @('d3d12-default', 'd3d12-rov')) {
    $backendDir = Join-Path $CacheRoot $backend
    if (-not (Test-Path $backendDir)) { continue }

    $targetDir = Join-Path $backendDir 'release\shaders\shareable'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $targetDir | Out-Null

    $targetXsh = Join-Path $targetDir '4E4D0816.xsh'
    $targetXpsoName = if ($backend -eq 'd3d12-rov') { '4E4D0816.rov.d3d12.xpso' } else { '4E4D0816.rtv.d3d12.xpso' }
    $targetXpso = Join-Path $targetDir $targetXpsoName

    # Collect all matching files from any scale subdirectories
    $allXsh = Get-ChildItem -Path $backendDir -Recurse -Filter '4E4D0816.xsh' | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $targetXsh }
    $allXpso = Get-ChildItem -Path $backendDir -Recurse -Filter $targetXpsoName | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $targetXpso }

    # Keep the largest / most comprehensive shader microcode file
    $bestXsh = ($allXsh | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($bestXsh -and (-not (Test-Path $targetXsh) -or $bestXsh.Length -gt (Get-Item $targetXsh).Length)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $bestXsh.FullName -Destination $targetXsh -Force
        Write-Host "[$backend] Updated 4E4D0816.xsh from $($bestXsh.FullName) ($($bestXsh.Length) bytes)"
    }

    # Keep the largest / most comprehensive PSO descriptions file
    $bestXpso = ($allXpso | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($bestXpso -and (-not (Test-Path $targetXpso) -or $bestXpso.Length -gt (Get-Item $targetXpso).Length)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $bestXpso.FullName -Destination $targetXpso -Force
        Write-Host "[$backend] Updated $targetXpsoName from $($bestXpso.FullName) ($($bestXpso.Length) bytes)"
    }
}

Write-Host "Cache consolidation completed."

```

`scripts/performance-metrics.cs`:

```cs
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace Majin.Diagnostics {
    public sealed class FrameSummary {
        public int SchemaVersion = 1;
        public string Source = "guest_gpu_swap_interval";
        public string Scope = "Intervals between guest swap packets; includes loading, pauses and stalls. Not GPU execution or monitor display timing.";
        public long ValidIntervals, ZeroIntervals, InvalidRows;
        public bool InputTruncated;
        public double MeasuredSeconds, AverageFPS, MeanFrameMs, MinimumFrameMs, MaximumFrameMs;
        public double P50FrameMs, P95FrameMs, P99FrameMs;
        public long Over33Point333Ms, Over50Ms, Over100Ms;
        public string PercentileMethod = "Nearest rank over all valid intervals, without removing outliers.";
        public string EndOfSessionLimit = "The upstream buffered writer may lose its final 59 rows on hard exit/crash.";
    }

    public static class Frames {
        // Bounded offline analysis: never runs on the game's frame thread.
        const int MaxRows = 2000000, MaxLine = 4096;
        const long MaxBytes = 128L * 1024 * 1024;
        static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

        public static string ReadBoundedLine(TextReader reader) {
            var value = new StringBuilder(256);
            int c;
            while ((c = reader.Read()) != -1) {
                if (c == '\n') break;
                if (value.Length >= MaxLine) throw new InvalidDataException("Diagnostic record exceeds the line limit.");
                if (c != '\r') value.Append((char)c);
            }
            return c == -1 && value.Length == 0 ? null : value.ToString();
        }
        static double Percentile(List<long> sorted, double fraction) {
            int index = Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Ceiling(sorted.Count * fraction) - 1);
            return sorted[index] / 1000.0;
        }
        static string Number(double value) { return value.ToString("0.######", Inv); }
        static void Window(StreamWriter writer, double elapsedUs, long count, double totalUs, long maxUs) {
            if (count == 0) return;
            writer.WriteLine(Number(elapsedUs / 1000) + "," + count.ToString(Inv) + "," + Number(totalUs / 1000) + "," +
                Number(count * 1000000.0 / totalUs) + "," + Number(totalUs / count / 1000) + "," + Number(maxUs / 1000.0));
        }
        public static FrameSummary Analyze(string csv, string series) {
            var info = new FileInfo(csv);
            if (info.Length > MaxBytes) throw new InvalidDataException("Frame CSV exceeds 128 MiB; retain the original and analyze a bounded excerpt.");
            var result = new FrameSummary();
            var times = new List<long>();
            double total = 0, windowUs = 0;
            long windowCount = 0, windowMax = 0;
            using (var input = new StreamReader(csv, Encoding.UTF8, true, 65536))
            using (var output = new StreamWriter(series, false, new UTF8Encoding(false), 65536)) {
                var header = ReadBoundedLine(input);
                if (header == null) throw new InvalidDataException("Empty frame CSV.");
                var columns = header.Split(',');
                int index = Array.IndexOf(columns, "frame_time_us");
                if (index < 0 || columns.Length > 64) throw new InvalidDataException("Unsupported frame CSV header.");
                output.WriteLine("elapsed_ms,intervals,window_ms,average_fps,mean_frame_ms,max_frame_ms");
                string line;
                int rows = 0;
                while ((line = ReadBoundedLine(input)) != null) {
                    if (++rows > MaxRows) { result.InputTruncated = true; break; }
                    var fields = line.Split(',');
                    long dt;
                    if (fields.Length != columns.Length || !Int64.TryParse(fields[index], NumberStyles.None, Inv, out dt) || dt > 86400000000L) {
                        ++result.InvalidRows; continue;
                    }
                    if (dt == 0) { ++result.ZeroIntervals; continue; }
                    times.Add(dt); total += dt; windowUs += dt; ++windowCount; windowMax = Math.Max(windowMax, dt);
                    if (dt > 100000.0 / 3) ++result.Over33Point333Ms;
                    if (dt > 50000) ++result.Over50Ms;
                    if (dt > 100000) ++result.Over100Ms;
                    if (windowUs >= 1000000) {
                        Window(output, total, windowCount, windowUs, windowMax);
                        windowCount = 0; windowUs = 0; windowMax = 0;
                    }
                }
                Window(output, total, windowCount, windowUs, windowMax);
            }
            result.ValidIntervals = times.Count;
            if (times.Count == 0) return result;
            times.Sort();
            result.MeasuredSeconds = total / 1000000;
            result.AverageFPS = times.Count * 1000000.0 / total;
            result.MeanFrameMs = total / times.Count / 1000;
            result.MinimumFrameMs = times[0] / 1000.0;
            result.MaximumFrameMs = times[times.Count - 1] / 1000.0;
            result.P50FrameMs = Percentile(times, .50);
            result.P95FrameMs = Percentile(times, .95);
            result.P99FrameMs = Percentile(times, .99);
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```ps1
param(
    [string]$Version = "0.1.1"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$staging = Join-Path $root 'updater-staging'

if (Test-Path $staging) { Remove-Item $staging -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $staging 'game-data\bin'), (Join-Path $staging 'scripts') -Force | Out-Null

Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'Majistic Launcher.exe') $staging -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'game-data\bin\majin.exe') (Join-Path $staging 'game-data\bin') -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'game-data\bin\rexgpu-xenos.dll') (Join-Path $staging 'game-data\bin') -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'game-data\bin\rexruntime.dll') (Join-Path $staging 'game-data\bin') -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'scripts\*') (Join-Path $staging 'scripts') -Recurse -Force

# Create ZIP archive with Method 0 (Store - No compression) via bsdtar (tar.exe).
# This is REQUIRED because the Tauri updater zip crate in v0.1.0 was compiled without
# DEFLATE (Method 8) support. Store (Method 0) is natively supported by all versions of the zip crate.
$zip = Join-Path $root "Majistic-Launcher-v$Version-windows-x64.zip"
if (Test-Path $zip) { Remove-Item $zip -Force }

$tarExe = "C:\Windows\System32\tar.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path $tarExe)) {
    $tarExe = (Get-Command tar.exe).Source
}

Push-Location $staging
try {
    & $tarExe -cf $zip --format zip --options zip:compression=store *
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "tar.exe failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

Remove-Item $staging -Recurse -Force

# Validate that the zip local header uses Method 0
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($zip)
$method = [System.BitConverter]::ToUInt16($bytes, 8)
if ($method -ne 0) {
    throw "Verification failed: ZIP compression method is $method, expected 0 (Store)"
}

$zipItem = Get-Item $zip
Write-Host "Created updater zip (Method 0 - Store verified): $($zipItem.FullName) ($([math]::Round($zipItem.Length / 1MB, 1)) MB)"

# Sign archive with minisign for Tauri auto-updater and generate latest.json
$keyPath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".tauri\majistic-launcher.key"
if (Test-Path $keyPath) {
    Write-Host "Signing updater package for in-app updater..."
    Push-Location (Join-Path $root 'launcher')
    try {
        $signOutput = & npm run tauri -- signer sign --private-key-path $keyPath --app-version $Version $zip
        $sigPath = "$zip.sig"
        $sig = if (Test-Path $sigPath) {
            (Get-Content -Path $sigPath -Raw).Trim()
        } else {
            $rawSig = ($signOutput | Out-String).Trim()
            $sigMatch = [regex]::Match($rawSig, '(?s)(dW50cnVzdGVkIGNvbW1lbnQ6[A-Za-z0-9+/=\r\n]+?)(?:\r?\n\r?\n|$)')
            if ($sigMatch.Success) { $sigMatch.Groups[1].Value.Trim() } else { $null }
        }
        if ($sig) {
            $latestJson = [ordered]@{
                version = $Version
                notes = "Majistic Recomp v$Version Update:`n- Separate Dev & Release launcher modes (zero local logs and no dev tools in release)`n- Resolved WebView2 console window popup and lock collision errors on startup`n- Default rendering path set to Vulkan FBO and VSync disabled by default`n- Mouse Sensitivity slider in Gameplay & Controls (0.1x to 10.0x)`n- Post-processing effects disabled by default with descriptive labels`n- Launcher window size increased to 980x710 (resizable)"
                pub_date = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
                platforms = @{
                    "windows-x86_64" = @{
                        signature = $sig
                        url = "https://github.com/kelvynzucco/majistic-recomp/releases/download/v$Version/Majistic-Launcher-v$Version-windows-x64.zip"
                    }
                }
            } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
            $latestJsonPath = Join-Path $root 'latest.json'
            Set-Content -Path $latestJsonPath -Value $latestJson -Encoding UTF8
            Write-Host "Generated latest.json pointing to updater package ($latestJsonPath)"
        } else {
            throw "Could not extract signature from output: $signOutput"
        }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
} else {
    Write-Warning "Minisign key not found at $keyPath. Skipping signing."
}

```

```ps1
function ConvertTo-Bool($val) {
    if ($val -is [bool]) { return $val }
    $s = "$val".Trim().ToLowerInvariant().TrimStart('$')
    return ($s -eq 'true' -or $s -eq '1')
}

        $maxScan = [Math]::Min($xexBytes.Length, 16384)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt ($maxScan - 4); $i++) {
            if ($xexBytes[$i] -eq 0x67 -and $xexBytes[$i+1] -eq 0xBD -and $xexBytes[$i+2] -eq 0x87 -and $xexBytes[$i+3] -eq 0xEF) {

                $editionSuffix = 'pal'

                break
            }
        }
    } catch {

    $dofVal = if (ConvertTo-Bool $DepthOfField) { 0.40 } else { 0.0 }

        $dofVal = [double]::Parse($DepthOfField.ToString().TrimStart('$'), [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)

    $bloomVal = if (ConvertTo-Bool $Bloom) { 0.80 } else { 0.0 }

    $parsed = 0.80

        $bloomVal = $parsed
    }

}

    Write-Output "PREVIEW OK: $exe $($launchArgs -join ' ')"
    return
}

if ($logPath) {
    Write-Output "Runtime log: $logPath"
}
$quotedArgs = @($launchArgs | ForEach-Object {
    '"' + (($_ -replace '(\\*)"', '$1$1\"') -replace '(\\+)$', '$1$1') + '"'
})

$workingDir = if (Test-Path (Split-Path $exe -Parent)) {
    Split-Path $exe -Parent
} elseif (Test-Path $build) {
    $build
} else {
    $projectRoot
}
$windowStyle = if ($ShaderPrebuildOnly) { 'Hidden' } else { 'Normal' }
try {
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $quotedArgs -WorkingDirectory $workingDir -WindowStyle $windowStyle -PassThru -Wait
    Write-Output "majin.exe exited with ExitCode: $($process.ExitCode)"
} finally {
    if ($tempPrebuildLog -and $logPath -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logPath)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
```

`scripts/scan-usa-cpu.py`:

```py
"""Static CPU & Vtable scanner for Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom (USA 0.0.0.2)."""
import json
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIV = ROOT / "prototype-usa" / "private"
OUT_PROTOTYPE = ROOT / "prototype-usa"
REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"

pdata = (PRIV / "loaded-pdata.bin").read_bytes()
text = (PRIV / "loaded-text.bin").read_bytes()
rdata = (PRIV / "loaded-rdata.bin").read_bytes()

TEXT_BASE = 0x82150000
TEXT_END = TEXT_BASE + len(text)
RDATA_BASE = 0x82000600

# 1. Parse .pdata function intervals
pdata_starts = set()
pdata_intervals = []
for off in range(0, len(pdata), 8):
    begin, info = struct.unpack_from(">II", pdata, off)
    if begin == 0:
        continue
    func_len = ((info >> 8) & 0x3FFFFF) * 4
    pdata_starts.add(begin)
    pdata_intervals.append((begin, begin + func_len))

pdata_intervals.sort()


def find_enclosing_pdata(addr: int):
    # Binary search in sorted intervals
    lo, hi = 0, len(pdata_intervals) - 1
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        b, e = pdata_intervals[mid]
        if addr < b:
            hi = mid - 1
        elif addr >= e:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            return (b, e)
    return None


# 2. Scan direct bl targets in .text
bl_targets = set()
for off in range(0, len(text), 4):
    insn = struct.unpack_from(">I", text, off)[0]
    if (insn >> 26) == 18 and (insn & 3) == 1:  # bl (AA=0, LK=1)
        li = insn & 0x03FFFFFC
        if li & 0x02000000:
            li -= 0x04000000
        target = (TEXT_BASE + off + li) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        if TEXT_BASE <= target < TEXT_END:
            bl_targets.add(target)

known_seed = pdata_starts | bl_targets | {0x8267C090}

# 3. Layer 1: Exact 4-instruction virtual dispatch thunks (lwz r12/r11,0(r3); lwz r11,slot(r12/r11); mtctr r11; bctr)
layer1_all = []
layer1_missing = []
for off in range(0, len(text) - 15, 4):
    a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from(">4I", text, off)
    valid_loads = (a == 0x81830000 and (b >> 16) == 0x816C) or (
        a == 0x81630000 and (b >> 16) == 0x816B
    )
    slot = b & 0xFFFF
    if valid_loads and slot % 4 == 0 and slot < 0x8000 and c == 0x7D6903A6 and d == 0x4E800420:
        addr = TEXT_BASE + off
        enclosing = find_enclosing_pdata(addr)
        in_seed = addr in known_seed
        entry = {
            "address": f"0x{addr:08X}",
            "addr_int": addr,
            "slot_offset": slot,
            "in_seed": in_seed,
            "enclosing_pdata": f"0x{enclosing[0]:08X}..0x{enclosing[1]:08X}" if enclosing else None,
        }
        layer1_all.append(entry)
        if not in_seed and enclosing is None:
            layer1_missing.append(entry)

layer1_addrs = {x["addr_int"] for x in layer1_all}

# 4. Layer 2: Volatile r9-r12 variants (excluding Layer 1 and internal .pdata cases)
layer2_all = []
layer2_missing = []
layer2_internal_deferred = []
for off in range(0, len(text) - 15, 4):
    a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from(">4I", text, off)
    table, target = (a >> 21) & 31, (b >> 21) & 31
    if table not in range(9, 13) or target not in range(9, 13):
        continue
    if a != (0x80030000 | (table << 21)):
        continue
    if (b >> 16) != (0x8000 | (target << 5) | table):
        continue
    slot = b & 0xFFFF
    if slot >= 0x8000 or slot % 4 != 0:
        continue
    if c != (0x7C0903A6 | (target << 21)) or d != 0x4E800420:
        continue
    addr = TEXT_BASE + off
    if addr in layer1_addrs:
        continue
    enclosing = find_enclosing_pdata(addr)
    in_seed = addr in known_seed
    entry = {
        "address": f"0x{addr:08X}",
        "addr_int": addr,
        "table_reg": table,
        "target_reg": target,
        "slot_offset": slot,
        "in_seed": in_seed,
        "enclosing_pdata": f"0x{enclosing[0]:08X}..0x{enclosing[1]:08X}" if enclosing else None,
    }
    layer2_all.append(entry)
    if enclosing is not None and enclosing[0] != addr:
        layer2_internal_deferred.append(entry)
    elif not in_seed:
        layer2_missing.append(entry)

# 5. Layer 3: 5-instruction member-object dispatch thunks
layer3_all = []
layer3_missing = []
for off in range(0, len(text) - 23, 4):
    a, b, c, d, e, padding = struct.unpack_from(">6I", text, off)
    if (a >> 16) != 0x8063 or b != 0x81630000:
        continue
    if not (((c >> 16) == 0x814B and d == 0x7D4903A6) or ((c >> 16) == 0x816B and d == 0x7D6903A6)):
        continue
    member, slot = a & 0xFFFF, c & 0xFFFF
    if member >= 0x8000 or member % 4 != 0 or slot >= 0x8000 or slot % 4 != 0:
        continue
    if e != 0x4E800420 or padding != 0:
        continue
    addr = TEXT_BASE + off
    enclosing = find_enclosing_pdata(addr)
    in_seed = addr in known_seed
    entry = {
        "address": f"0x{addr:08X}",
        "addr_int": addr,
        "member_offset": member,
        "slot_offset": slot,
        "in_seed": in_seed,
        "enclosing_pdata": f"0x{enclosing[0]:08X}..0x{enclosing[1]:08X}" if enclosing else None,
    }
    layer3_all.append(entry)
    if not in_seed and enclosing is None:
        layer3_missing.append(entry)

summary = {
    "pdata_function_count": len(pdata_starts),
    "direct_bl_targets": len(bl_targets),
    "combined_seed_count": len(known_seed),
    "layer1_standard_thunks_total": len(layer1_all),
    "layer1_missing_from_seed": len(layer1_missing),
    "layer2_variants_total": len(layer2_all),
    "layer2_missing_from_seed": len(layer2_missing),
    "layer2_internal_deferred": layer2_internal_deferred,
    "layer3_member_thunks_total": len(layer3_all),
    "layer3_entries": layer3_all,
}

(REPORTS / "usa-thunk-scan-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
```

```ps1
    Write-Error "default.xex not found at $xexPath. Please place your game dump in $GameDataRoot."

$encFileKey = $bytes[(0x88 + 0x150)..(0x88 + 0x15F)]

$aesKeyDec = [System.Security.Cryptography.Aes]::Create()
$aesKeyDec.Mode = [System.Security.Cryptography.CipherMode]::ECB
$aesKeyDec.Padding = [System.Security.Cryptography.PaddingMode]::None
$fileKey = $aesKeyDec.CreateDecryptor($retailKey, $null).TransformFinalBlock($encFileKey, 0, 16)

$aesPayload = [System.Security.Cryptography.Aes]::Create()
$aesPayload.Mode = [System.Security.Cryptography.CipherMode]::CBC
$aesPayload.Padding = [System.Security.Cryptography.PaddingMode]::None
$iv = New-Object byte[] 16

$peOffset = 0x3000
$rawPayloadSize = $bytes.Length - $peOffset
$decrypted = $aesPayload.CreateDecryptor($fileKey, $iv).TransformFinalBlock($bytes, $peOffset, $rawPayloadSize)

# Expand the 4 Basic Compression blocks from Format Info header at 0x1768
$fmtOffset = 0x1768
$blocks = @(
    @{ Data = 0x148000; Zero = 0x8000 },
    @{ Data = 0x9E8000; Zero = 0x8000 },
    @{ Data = 0x48000;  Zero = 0x270000 },
    @{ Data = 0x30000;  Zero = 0x0 }
)

$imageSize = 0xE30000
$image = New-Object byte[] $imageSize
$srcPos = 0
$dstPos = 0
foreach ($b in $blocks) {
    [Array]::Copy($decrypted, $srcPos, $image, $dstPos, $b.Data)
    $srcPos += $b.Data
    $dstPos += $b.Data + $b.Zero
}

$imagePathUsa = Join-Path $privDirUsa 'loaded-image.bin'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($imagePathUsa, $image)

    $imagePathPal = Join-Path $privDirPal 'loaded-image.bin'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($imagePathPal, $image)
}

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($unpackedImagePath, $image)
Write-Host "Saved unpacked linear PE image ($($image.Length) bytes) to $imagePathUsa and $unpackedImagePath"

# Detect edition from default.xex (USA = 76FDB642, PAL = 67BD87EF) and configure matching executable
$isPal = $false
$maxScan = [Math]::Min($bytes.Length, 16384)
for ($i = 0; $i -lt ($maxScan - 4); $i++) {
    if ($bytes[$i] -eq 0x67 -and $bytes[$i+1] -eq 0xBD -and $bytes[$i+2] -eq 0x87 -and $bytes[$i+3] -eq 0xEF) {
        $isPal = $true
        break
    }
}

$editionSuffix = if ($isPal) { 'pal' } else { 'usa' }

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $binDir | Out-Null
$targetExe = Join-Path $binDir 'majin.exe'
$precompiledEdition = Join-Path $binDir "majin-$editionSuffix.exe"
$buildEdition = if ($isPal) {
    Join-Path $root 'prototype\out\build\win-amd64-release\majin.exe'
} else {
    Join-Path $root 'prototype-usa\out\build\win-amd64-release\majin.exe'
}

if (Test-Path $precompiledEdition) {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $precompiledEdition -Destination $targetExe -Force
    Write-Host "Deployed precompiled game binary for $editionName (majin-$editionSuffix.exe -> majin.exe)"
} elseif (Test-Path $buildEdition) {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $buildEdition -Destination $targetExe -Force
    Write-Host "Deployed built game binary for $editionName ($buildEdition -> majin.exe)"
}
```
