`scripts/verify-shader-mitigation.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Automated Shader Mitigation Verification Gate Runner.

.DESCRIPTION
    Launches Majin under Vulkan with controlled cache parameters, runs for a specified duration,
    gracefully closes the process, and evaluates performance telemetry against DoD thresholds
    via scripts/analyze-performance-csv.mjs.

.PARAMETER Cold
    Runs with clean cache (first boot). Evaluates against DoD §6.1a thresholds.

.PARAMETER Warm
    Runs with pre-populated cache (subsequent session). Evaluates against DoD §6.1b thresholds.

.PARAMETER DurationSeconds
    Execution duration in seconds before initiating graceful shutdown (default: 60).

.PARAMETER VerifyGate
    Evaluates output against gate thresholds; exits with code 1 if failed.

.PARAMETER GameplayOnly
    Restricts gate evaluation to active 3D gameplay window.

.PARAMETER Vkpc
    Sets --vulkan_pipeline_cache=true/false (default: 'false').

.PARAMETER GameDataRoot
    Path to game-data folder (default: 'game-data-usa').

.PARAMETER Configuration
    Build configuration: 'Release' or 'Debug' (default: 'Release').

.PARAMETER OutputPath
    Optional file path to save the resulting JSON report.
#>
param(
    [switch]$Cold,
    [switch]$Warm,
    [int]$DurationSeconds = 60,
    [switch]$VerifyGate,
    [switch]$GameplayOnly,
    [switch]$Json,
    [string]$Vkpc = 'true',
    [string]$GameDataRoot = 'game-data',
    [string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [string]$OutputPath = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$projectRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent

if (-not $Cold -and -not $Warm) {
    $Cold = $true
}

# Resolve game data root
if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($GameDataRoot)) {
    $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot $GameDataRoot
    if (-not (Test-Path $candidate) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data'))) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $projectRoot 'game-data'
    }
    $GameDataRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate)
}

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'default.xex'))) {
    throw "default.xex not found in $GameDataRoot"
}

# Locate majin.exe
$unifiedExe = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'bin\majin.exe'
$buildPal = Join-Path $projectRoot ('prototype\out\build\win-amd64-' + $Configuration.ToLower())
$buildUsa = Join-Path $projectRoot ('prototype-usa\out\build\win-amd64-' + $Configuration.ToLower())
$exe = if (Test-Path $unifiedExe) {
    $unifiedExe
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $buildPal 'majin.exe')) {
    Join-Path $buildPal 'majin.exe'
} elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $buildUsa 'majin.exe')) {
    Join-Path $buildUsa 'majin.exe'
} else {
    $unifiedExe
}

if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) {
    throw "majin.exe executable not found at $exe. Please build the runtime first."
}

# Session directories
$sessionRoot = Join-Path $GameDataRoot 'runtime'
$cacheKey = 'vulkan-vulkan/' + $Configuration.ToLower()
$cacheRoot = Join-Path $sessionRoot ('cache/' + $cacheKey)
$metadataRoot = Join-Path $sessionRoot ('metadata/' + $cacheKey)
$logDir = Join-Path $sessionRoot 'logs'
$userDir = Join-Path $sessionRoot 'user'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir, $userDir, $metadataRoot, $cacheRoot | Out-Null

# Handle Cold vs Warm cache state
if ($Cold) {
    Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] COLD run requested: Purging pipeline cache at $cacheRoot..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    if (Test-Path $cacheRoot) {
        Remove-Item -Path "$cacheRoot\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] WARM run requested: Retaining existing cache at $cacheRoot." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $existingCaches = Get-ChildItem -Path $cacheRoot -Include "*.xpso","*.vkpc" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $existingCaches -or $existingCaches.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Warning "[verify-shader-mitigation] WARM run requested but no cache found in $cacheRoot! Results may reflect cold run."
    }
}

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$logPath = Join-Path $logDir "runtime-verify-$timestamp.log"
$csvPath = "$logPath.performance.csv"
$fh1CsvPath = "$logPath.fh1.csv"

# Build launch arguments
$launchArgs = @(
    '--gpu_plugin', 'xenos',
    '--gpu_backend=vulkan',
    '--game_data_root', $GameDataRoot,
    '--user_data_root', $userDir,
    '--cache_root', $cacheRoot,
    '--metadata_root', $metadataRoot,
    '--log_file', $logPath,
    '--window_width=1280',
    '--window_height=720',
    '--fullscreen=false',
    '--vsync=true',
    '--resolution_scale=1',
    '--swap_post_effect=none',
    '--present_effect=fsr',
    '--present_dither=false',
    '--gpu_allow_invalid_fetch_constants=true',
    '--render_target_path_vulkan=fbo',
    '--vulkan_dynamic_rendering=false',
    '--vulkan_async_skip_incomplete_frames=false',
    "--vulkan_store_pipeline_cache=$Vkpc",
    '--mnk_mode=false',
    '--mnk_mouse=false',
    '--majin_window_fps=true',
    '--majin_record_performance=true',
    "--perf_log_csv=$csvPath",
    "--fh1_frame_cost_csv=$fh1CsvPath",
    '--majin_60fps=false',
    '--majin_skip_cutscenes=true',
    '--majin_cutscene_speed=4',
    '--majin_skip_intro_logos=true',
    '--majin_fov_scale=1.0',
    '--majin_pause_blur=false',
    '--majin_dof=false',
    '--majin_bloom=false'
)

$quotedArgs = @($launchArgs | ForEach-Object {
    '"' + (($_ -replace '(\\*)"', '$1$1\"') -replace '(\\+)$', '$1$1') + '"'
})

$workingDir = Split-Path $exe -Parent

Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] Launching majin.exe (Duration: ${DurationSeconds}s, Mode: $(if ($Cold) { 'Cold' } else { 'Warm' }))..." -ForegroundColor Green
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $quotedArgs -WorkingDirectory $workingDir -WindowStyle Normal -PassThru

try {
    $elapsed = 0
    $checkInterval = 2
    while ($elapsed -lt $DurationSeconds) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds $checkInterval
        $elapsed += $checkInterval
        if ($proc.HasExited) {
            Write-Warning "[verify-shader-mitigation] Process exited prematurely after $elapsed seconds (ExitCode: $($proc.ExitCode))."
            break
        }
    }
} finally {
    if (-not $proc.HasExited) {
        Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] Initiating graceful shutdown via CloseMainWindow..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
        $proc.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null
        $closed = $proc.WaitForExit(6000)
        if (-not $closed -and -not $proc.HasExited) {
            Write-Warning "[verify-shader-mitigation] Process did not exit cleanly within 6s; terminating process."
            $proc.Kill() | Out-Null
            $proc.WaitForExit(3000)
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] Run completed. Waiting for CSV flush..." -ForegroundColor Green
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

# Check CSV files (prefer fh1CsvPath for detailed shader compiler telemetry)
$targetCsv = if (Test-Path $fh1CsvPath) {
    $fh1CsvPath
} elseif (Test-Path $csvPath) {
    $csvPath
} else {
    throw "Neither $fh1CsvPath nor $csvPath was produced by the run!"
}

# Run analyzer
$analyzerScript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'analyze-performance-csv.mjs'
$analyzerArgs = @($analyzerScript, "--input=$targetCsv")

if (Test-Path $logPath) {
    $analyzerArgs += "--log=$logPath"
}
if ($Cold) {
    $analyzerArgs += '--cold'
} else {
    $analyzerArgs += '--warm'
}
if ($GameplayOnly) {
    $analyzerArgs += '--gameplay-only'
}
if ($VerifyGate) {
    $analyzerArgs += '--gate'
}
if ($Json -or $OutputPath) {
    $analyzerArgs += '--json'
}

Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] Running analyzer: node $($analyzerArgs -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$analysisOutput = & node $analyzerArgs
$exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

if ($OutputPath) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputPath, $analysisOutput, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] Analysis saved to $OutputPath" -ForegroundColor Green
}

if (-not $Json) {
    Write-Host $analysisOutput
}

if ($exitCode -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "[verify-shader-mitigation] GATE PASSED (exit code 0)" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Warning "[verify-shader-mitigation] GATE FAILED (exit code $exitCode)"
}

exit $exitCode
```

`scripts/verify-usa-mappings.py`:

```py
"""Verify all 32 analysis-overrides, timing hooks, and save hooks in USA (0.0.0.2)."""
import json
import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIV = ROOT / "prototype-usa" / "private"
REF_PROTO = ROOT / "prototype"
REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"

text = (PRIV / "loaded-text.bin").read_bytes()
pdata = (PRIV / "loaded-pdata.bin").read_bytes()
rdata = (PRIV / "loaded-rdata.bin").read_bytes()
TEXT_BASE = 0x82150000
RDATA_BASE = 0x82000600

pdata_starts = set()
for off in range(0, len(pdata), 8):
    begin, _ = struct.unpack_from(">II", pdata, off)
    if begin:
        pdata_starts.add(begin)


def disasm_words(va, count=5):
    off = va - TEXT_BASE
    return [f"{w:08X}" for w in struct.unpack_from(f">{count}I", text, off)]


ov_txt = (REF_PROTO / "analysis-overrides.toml").read_text()
ov_addrs = [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r"^0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})", ov_txt, re.M)]

print(f"=== Verifying {len(ov_addrs)} PAL analysis-overrides.toml at USA = PAL - 0x70 ===")
ov_results = []
for p in ov_addrs:
    u = p - 0x70
    prev_w = disasm_words(u - 4, 1)[0]
    words = disasm_words(u, 5)
    # Check if prev_w is a function terminator (blr=4E800020, bctr=4E800420, b=48xxxxxx, or 00000000 padding)
    is_boundary = (
        prev_w in ("4E800020", "4E800420", "00000000")
        or (int(prev_w, 16) >> 26 == 18 and (int(prev_w, 16) & 3) == 0)
    )
    print(
        f"  PAL 0x{p:08X} -> USA 0x{u:08X} | boundary={str(is_boundary):5s} (prev={prev_w}) | insns={' '.join(words)}"
    )
    ov_results.append(
        {
            "pal": f"0x{p:08X}",
            "usa": f"0x{u:08X}",
            "boundary_ok": is_boundary,
            "prev_opcode": prev_w,
            "opcodes": words,
        }
    )

print("\n=== Finding exact split point between delta=0 and delta=-0x70 ===")
# Check where in 0x821B2C18 .. 0x821F506C the 0x70 shift happens
# Let's check SceneTitleTitle (PAL 0x821CC390) and save caller (PAL 0x821B9DF4)
probes = [
    ("timing: sub_82162238", 0x82162238, 0),
    ("timing: caller 0x821616EC", 0x821616EC, 0),
    ("save: caller 0x821B9DF4 (d=0)", 0x821B9DF4, 0),
    ("save: caller 0x821B9DF4 (d=-0x70)", 0x821B9DF4, -0x70),
    ("timing: sub_821CC390 (d=0)", 0x821CC390, 0),
    ("timing: sub_821CC390 (d=-0x70)", 0x821CC390, -0x70),
    ("save: ContentCreateEx 0x8267AFE0", 0x8267AFE0, -0x70),
    ("save: ContentClose 0x8267B070", 0x8267B070, -0x70),
    ("save: ContentSetThumbnail 0x8267B078", 0x8267B078, -0x70),
    ("save: GetLastError 0x8267B190", 0x8267B190, -0x70),
    ("save: GetOverlappedResult 0x8267B510", 0x8267B510, -0x70),
    ("save: WriteFile 0x8267B6C8", 0x8267B6C8, -0x70),
    ("save: SetLastNtError 0x8267D3E0", 0x8267D3E0, -0x70),
]
for label, p, d in probes:
    u = p + d
    in_p = u in pdata_starts
    w = disasm_words(u, 4)
    print(f"  {label:36s} -> USA 0x{u:08X} | in_pdata={str(in_p):5s} | {' '.join(w)}")

print("\n=== Checking SceneTitleTitle vtable in USA .text ===")
for va in range(0x821CB000, 0x821CD000, 4):
    off = va - TEXT_BASE
    w = struct.unpack_from(">I", text, off)[0]
    if (w >> 26) == 15 and (w & 0xFFFE) == 0x820E:
        print(f"  At USA 0x{va:08X}: {' '.join(disasm_words(va, 6))}")
```

```ps1
# Shared toolchain discovery for build scripts.
# Locates any Visual Studio 2022 edition (Community, Professional, Enterprise or
# Build Tools) via vswhere, enters its x64 developer shell, and puts Clang/LLVM,
# CMake and Ninja on PATH. Clang is taken from the VS-bundled LLVM component
# when installed, otherwise from a standalone LLVM install (e.g. LLVM 20.1.8).
# Exposes $vsRoot and $llvmBin to the dot-sourcing script.

$vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
$vsRoot = $null
if (Test-Path $vswhere) {
    $vsRoot = & $vswhere -latest -products * -version '[17.0,18.0)' `
        -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath |
        Select-Object -First 1
}
if (-not $vsRoot -or -not (Test-Path $vsRoot)) {
    throw 'Visual Studio 2022 with C++ x64 tools not found (Community or Build Tools).'
}

& (Join-Path $vsRoot 'Common7\Tools\Launch-VsDevShell.ps1') -Arch amd64 -HostArch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation | Out-Null

$llvmBin = Join-Path $vsRoot 'VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin'
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $llvmBin 'clang-cl.exe'))) {
    $llvmBin = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'LLVM\bin'
}
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $llvmBin 'clang-cl.exe'))) {
    throw 'clang-cl.exe not found (install the VS Clang component or LLVM for Windows).'
}

$cmakeRoot = Join-Path $vsRoot 'Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake'
$extraPaths = @($llvmBin, (Join-Path $cmakeRoot 'CMake\bin'), (Join-Path $cmakeRoot 'Ninja')) |
    Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }
$env:PATH = (($extraPaths + $env:PATH) -join ';')

foreach ($tool in 'cmake', 'ninja', 'clang++', 'clang-cl') {
    if (-not (Get-Command $tool -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "$tool not found on PATH." }
}
```

`src/anim_speed.cpp`:

```cpp
// Majistic Recomp - partial animations at their speed above 30 fps
// Adapted from ArthurMS15/MajinRecomp
//
// A skeleton has two sub-motion slots (pointers at +244 and +248) for partial
// animations played over the body's motion: Majin's idle face, Tepeu's
// gestures when giving Majin orders, Majin healing Tepeu. sub_822BBEB8 updates
// them every frame: it adds the slot's speed (slot+60, in 30 fps frames) to its
// time (slot+36) and samples the curves there (sub_82289EC8 stores the new
// time). The step is not scaled by the frame time, unlike the body's motion
// (obj+0x10 * speed), so these animations ran at frame rate / 30 times their
// speed: four times as fast at 120 fps.
//
// The hooks at 0x822BC1A4 and 0x822BC23C (both branches, just before the add)
// scale the speed by the frame's dt in 30 fps frames.
//
// Some world objects have the same problem with their main motion: the update
// at sub_822421C8 steps the motion player with sub_822BCE90 (time += speed,
// +264 += speed) at the speed set when the motion started, while characters
// set that speed to obj+0x5D0 * obj+0x10 every frame first (sub_82344F98).
// The hook before the call (0x822421E4) records the object's dt in 30 fps
// frames (obj+0x10), and the hooks in sub_822BCE90 scale the speed only for
// that call.

#include "frame_timer.h"

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>
#include <rex/system/kernel_state.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(majin_submotion_fix, false, "Majin",
                    "Play partial animations (Majin's face, Tepeu's gestures, healing) and some "
                    "world objects' animations at their speed above 30 fps");

void Majin_SubMotionStep(PPCRegister& speed) {
  const float dt = majin::GameFrameTime();
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(majin_submotion_fix) || !(dt > 0.0f)) {
    return;
  }
  // The game adds it as a single.
  speed.f64 = double(float(speed.f64 * dt * 30.0f));
}

namespace {

// The dt (30 fps frames) of the object whose motion sub_822BCE90 is stepping
// for sub_822421C8, 0 otherwise. Set and consumed on the same thread.
thread_local float object_step_scale = 0.0f;

float LoadFloat(uint32_t address) {
  uint32_t v;
  std::memcpy(&v, REX_KERNEL_MEMORY()->TranslateVirtual<uint8_t*>(address), 4);
  return std::bit_cast<float>(std::byteswap(v));
}

}  // namespace

void Majin_ObjectMotionStepBegin(PPCRegister& r31) {
  const float frames = LoadFloat(r31.u32 + 0x10);
  object_step_scale =
      REXCVAR_GET(majin_submotion_fix) && frames > 0.0f && frames < 10.0f ? frames : 0.0f;
}

void Majin_MotionStepTime(PPCRegister& speed) {
  if (object_step_scale > 0.0f) {
    speed.f64 = double(float(speed.f64 * object_step_scale));
  }
}

void Majin_MotionStepTotal(PPCRegister& speed) {
  if (object_step_scale > 0.0f) {
    speed.f64 = double(float(speed.f64 * object_step_scale));
    object_step_scale = 0.0f;
  }
}
```

`src/camera_fov.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Majistic Recomp - camera field of view multiplier (Issue #25)
// Adapted from ArthurMS15/MajinRecomp

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_DOUBLE(majin_fov_scale, 1.0, "Majin",
                      "Field of view multiplier (1 = original)")
    .range(0.5, 2.0);

namespace {

constexpr double kDegToRad = 3.14159265358979323846 / 180.0;

void Scale(PPCRegister& f) {
  const double scale = REXCVAR_GET(majin_fov_scale);
  if (scale != 1.0) {
    // The game reads it back as a single; stay well under 180 degrees.
    f.f64 = double(float(std::min(f.f64 * scale, 150.0)));
  }
}

void ScaleRadians(PPCRegister& f) {
  const double scale = REXCVAR_GET(majin_fov_scale);
  if (scale != 1.0) {
    // sub_829E1628 (PAL) / sub_829E15B8 (USA) receives VFOV in radians.
    constexpr double kMaxFovRad = 150.0 * kDegToRad;
    f.f64 = double(float(std::min(f.f64 * scale, kMaxFovRad)));
  }
}

}  // namespace

void Majin_FovFrustumA(PPCRegister& f0) { Scale(f0); }
void Majin_FovFrustumB(PPCRegister& f12) { Scale(f12); }
void Majin_FovFrustumRad(PPCRegister& f) { ScaleRadians(f); }
void Majin_FovProjection(PPCRegister& f13) { Scale(f13); }

void Majin_ClampTanHalfHfov(PPCRegister& f) {
  if (!std::isfinite(f.f64)) {
    f.f64 = 1.0;
  } else {
    // Prevent extreme tan(HFOV/2) values on ultrawide displays at high FOV.
    f.f64 = double(float(std::clamp(f.f64, -10.0, 10.0)));
  }
}

void Majin_ActorConeCullThreshold(PPCRegister& f0) {
  const double scale = REXCVAR_GET(majin_fov_scale);
  if (scale > 1.0) {
    // Original threshold in .rdata is cos(45 deg) = ~0.7071 for a 90 deg view cone.
    // When FOV is expanded, widen the cone up to 170 deg (85 deg half-angle)
    // so actors and props on screen edges are not put into SLEEP/INACTIVE state.
    const double scaled_half_angle_deg = std::min(45.0 * scale, 85.0);
    f0.f64 = double(float(std::cos(scaled_half_angle_deg * kDegToRad)));
  }
}
```

`src/cutscene.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Majistic Recomp - Unified In-game 3D Cutscene (DEMO) Fast-Forward
//
// Fast-forward is driven purely by the state of the engine's DEMO player, read
// once per frame from the main timing hook (timing.cpp). It is NOT driven by
// script-command polling (DEMO_END_CHECK / CHECK_END_MESSAGE), because those are
// also polled while the player is in control (gameplay dialogue, event cameras).

#include <windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include "generated/default/majin_pch.h"
#include "edition_offsets.h"
#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/audio/audio_driver.h>
#include <rex/ui/windowed_app_context.h>

namespace majin {
rex::ui::WindowedAppContext* g_app_context = nullptr;
void RequestCleanQuit() {
  if (g_app_context) {
    g_app_context->RequestDeferredQuit();
  }
}
}  // namespace majin

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(majin_skip_cutscenes, true, "Gameplay",
    "Allow fast-forwarding in-game cutscenes by holding Select/Back on controller or Tab/Backspace on keyboard");

REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(majin_cutscene_speed, 4, "Gameplay",
    "In-game cutscene fast-forward speed multiplier (2, 4, 6, 8)");

REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(majin_cutscene_end_margin, 90, "Gameplay",
    "Cutscene frames before the end of a DEMO where fast-forward is forced back to normal speed");

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(majin_cutscene_ff_camera_demos, false, "Gameplay",
    "Also allow fast-forward during short DEMO_CAMERA events (camera-only scripted shots)");

REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, majin_harvest_demos);
REXCVAR_DECLARE(int32_t, majin_harvest_start);
REXCVAR_DECLARE(int32_t, majin_harvest_count);

DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215B918);
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215A700);
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215B290);
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215BEC8);
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215BA58);
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8215AD28);
#if !defined(MAJIN_EDITION_USA)
DECLARE_REX_FUNC(sub_8235A140);
#endif

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kScenarioRootPtr = majin::offsets::kScenarioRootPtr;
constexpr uint32_t kDemoManagerOffset = 0x15144;
constexpr uint32_t kDemoNodeOffset = 120;
constexpr uint32_t kDemoCameraNodeOffset = 124;

bool Enabled() {
  return REXCVAR_GET(majin_skip_cutscenes);
}

bool CameraDemosEnabled() {
  return REXCVAR_GET(majin_cutscene_ff_camera_demos);
}

float EndMarginFrames() {
  const int32_t v = REXCVAR_GET(majin_cutscene_end_margin);
  return static_cast<float>(v < 15 ? 15 : (v > 600 ? 600 : v));
}

float SpeedMultiplier() {
  const int32_t spd = REXCVAR_GET(majin_cutscene_speed);
  return static_cast<float>(spd < 2 ? 2 : (spd > 16 ? 16 : spd));
}

bool Span(uint32_t addr, uint32_t size) {
  return addr >= 0x10000 && addr <= UINT32_MAX - size;
}

float LoadFloat(uint8_t* base, uint32_t address) {
  return std::bit_cast<float>(REX_LOAD_U32(address));
}

struct DemoProgress {
  float current = 0.0f;  // current frame
  float end = 0.0f;      // last frame
  float step = 0.0f;     // frames advanced on the last tick
};

// Returns true only while the DEMO player in `slot` is actively playing.
bool ReadDemoPlayer(uint8_t* base, uint32_t slot, DemoProgress& out) {
  const uint32_t root = REX_LOAD_U32(kScenarioRootPtr);
  if (!Span(root, kDemoManagerOffset + 4)) return false;
  const uint32_t manager = REX_LOAD_U32(root + kDemoManagerOffset);
  if (!Span(manager, 128)) return false;
  const uint32_t node = REX_LOAD_U32(manager + slot);
  if (!Span(node, 24)) return false;
  const uint32_t player = REX_LOAD_U32(node + 20);
  if (!Span(player, 160)) return false;

  const int32_t state = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(player + 96));
  const int32_t request = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(player + 92));
  if (state != 1 && state != 2) return false;  // not playing
  if (request == 3) return false;              // stop already requested

  const uint32_t resource = REX_LOAD_U32(player + 156);
  if (!Span(resource, 104)) return false;
  const int32_t start = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(resource + 96));
  const int32_t end = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(resource + 100));
  if (end <= start) return false;

  out.current = LoadFloat(base, player + 80);
  out.step = LoadFloat(base, player + 88);
  out.end = static_cast<float>(end);
  return std::isfinite(out.current) && std::isfinite(out.step);
}

// True while a DEMO is playing and is still far enough from its last frame.
bool DemoAllowsTurbo(uint8_t* base, uint32_t slot, float& remaining_out) {
  DemoProgress demo;
  if (!ReadDemoPlayer(base, slot, demo)) return false;
  const float step = demo.step > 0.0f ? demo.step : 0.0f;
  const float guard = EndMarginFrames() + step * 4.0f;
  remaining_out = demo.end - demo.current;
  return remaining_out > guard;
}

std::atomic<bool> s_turbo_active{false};
std::atomic<bool> s_must_release_button{false};

} // namespace

bool IsBackOrTabHeld() {
  if (!Enabled()) return false;

  // Keyboard check: Tab key or Backspace
  if ((GetAsyncKeyState(VK_TAB) & 0x8000) != 0 || (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_BACK) & 0x8000) != 0) {
    return true;
  }

  // Gamepad check: XInput controllers (Back / Select button = 0x0020)
  static HMODULE xinput = []() -> HMODULE {
    HMODULE h = LoadLibraryA("xinput1_4.dll");
    if (!h) h = LoadLibraryA("xinput1_3.dll");
    if (!h) h = LoadLibraryA("xinput9_1_0.dll");
    return h;
  }();

  if (xinput) {
    typedef DWORD (WINAPI *PFN_XInputGetState)(DWORD dwUserIndex, void* pState);
    static PFN_XInputGetState pfnGetState = (PFN_XInputGetState)GetProcAddress(xinput, "XInputGetState");
    if (pfnGetState) {
      struct {
        DWORD dwPacketNumber;
        struct {
          WORD wButtons;
          BYTE bLeftTrigger;
          BYTE bRightTrigger;
          SHORT sThumbLX;
          SHORT sThumbLY;
          SHORT sThumbRX;
          SHORT sThumbRY;
        } Gamepad;
      } state{};
      for (DWORD i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        if (pfnGetState(i, &state) == 0) {
          if ((state.Gamepad.wButtons & 0x0020) != 0) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return false;
}

float UpdateCutsceneTurbo(uint8_t* base) {
  float multiplier = 1.0f;
  float remaining = 0.0f;
  const bool button_held = IsBackOrTabHeld();

  static bool s_was_button_held = false;
  if (button_held && !s_was_button_held && Enabled()) {
    DemoProgress demo{};
    const bool demo_present = ReadDemoPlayer(base, kDemoNodeOffset, demo);
    if (demo_present) {
#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
      REXLOG_INFO("[Majin Cutscene] button pressed during DEMO (frame {:.1f}/{:.1f}, step {:.2f}, {})",
                  demo.current, demo.end, demo.step, MAJIN_EDITION_NAME);
#endif
    } else {
      REXLOG_DEBUG("[Majin Cutscene] button pressed, but no DEMO active ({})", MAJIN_EDITION_NAME);
    }
  }
  s_was_button_held = button_held;

  // Button release latch: if turbo was previously forced off while the button
  // was held, the user must release the button before turbo can be re-engaged.
  if (s_must_release_button.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
    if (!button_held) {
      s_must_release_button.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
  }

  if (Enabled() && !s_must_release_button.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
    bool demo_ok = DemoAllowsTurbo(base, kDemoNodeOffset, remaining);
    if (!demo_ok && CameraDemosEnabled()) {
      demo_ok = DemoAllowsTurbo(base, kDemoCameraNodeOffset, remaining);
    }
    // Only engage fast-forward while a DEMO cutscene is running and far from the end
    if (demo_ok && button_held) {
      multiplier = SpeedMultiplier();
    }
  }

  const bool active = multiplier > 1.0f;
  const bool was_active = s_turbo_active.exchange(active, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if (was_active != active) {
    rex::audio::SetPlaybackFrequencyRatio(active ? multiplier : 1.0f);
    if (active) {
#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
      REXLOG_INFO("[Majin Cutscene] fast-forward x{} ({} frames left, {})",
                  static_cast<int>(multiplier), static_cast<int>(remaining), MAJIN_EDITION_NAME);
#endif
    } else {
#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
      REXLOG_INFO("[Majin Cutscene] fast-forward off ({})", MAJIN_EDITION_NAME);
#endif
      // If turbo stopped while the button is still held (end margin reached or cutscene ended),
      // lock out turbo so it never affects gameplay even if held continuously.
      if (button_held) {
        s_must_release_button.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
      }
    }
  }
  return multiplier;
}

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

std::vector<uint32_t> DiscoverDemoQueue() {
  std::vector<fs::path> candidates = {
    "game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "KB/demo/package",
    "../finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "../../finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "../../../game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "../../game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package",
    "../game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package"
  };

#if defined(_WIN32)
  wchar_t exe_path[MAX_PATH]{};
  if (GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe_path, MAX_PATH)) {
    fs::path exe_dir = fs::path(exe_path).parent_path();
    candidates.push_back(exe_dir / "finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package");
    candidates.push_back(exe_dir / "../finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package");
    candidates.push_back(exe_dir / "../../finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package");
    candidates.push_back(exe_dir / "../game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package");
    candidates.push_back(exe_dir / "../../game-data/finalizedXBox360/KB/demo/package");
  }
#endif

  fs::path package_dir;
  for (const auto& candidate : candidates) {
    std::error_code ec;
    if (fs::is_directory(candidate, ec)) {
      package_dir = candidate;
      break;
    }
  }

  std::vector<uint32_t> queue;
  if (package_dir.empty()) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("[HARVEST] Pasta de pacotes demo (KB/demo/package) nao encontrada!");
    return queue;
  }

  std::error_code ec;
  for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(package_dir, ec)) {
    if (!entry.is_regular_file()) continue;
    const std::string filename = entry.path().filename().string();
    if (filename.size() > 8 &&
        (filename.compare(0, 4, "demo") == 0 || filename.compare(0, 4, "DEMO") == 0) &&
        (filename.compare(filename.size() - 4, 4, ".pak") == 0 || filename.compare(filename.size() - 4, 4, ".PAK") == 0)) {
      std::string id_str = filename.substr(4, filename.size() - 8);
      try {
        const uint32_t id = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(id_str));
        queue.push_back(id);
      } catch (...) {
        // Ignora caso nao numerico
      }
    }
  }

  std::sort(queue.begin(), queue.end());
  REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] {} demos descobertas em '{}'",
              queue.size(), package_dir.string());
  return queue;
}

enum class HarvestState {
  kUninitialized,
  kWaitingForEngine,
  kMountPackage,
  kWaitingForMount,
  kStartDemo,
  kPlayingDemo,
  kDemoCooldown,
  kAllFinished
};

HarvestState s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kUninitialized;
std::vector<uint32_t> s_demo_queue;
size_t s_current_index = 0;
size_t s_global_offset = 0;
size_t s_total_demos = 0;
uint32_t s_warmup_frames = 0;
uint32_t s_mount_wait_frames = 0;
uint32_t s_playing_frames = 0;
uint32_t s_cooldown_frames = 0;
bool s_has_detected_playing = false;
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point s_demo_start_time;

uint32_t FindDemoNode(uint8_t* base, uint32_t manager, uint32_t demo_id) {
  uint32_t node = REX_LOAD_U32(manager + 52);
  while (node != 0 && Span(node, 36)) {
    if (REX_LOAD_U32(node + 24) == demo_id) {
      return node;
    }
    node = REX_LOAD_U32(node + 16);
  }
  return 0;
}

bool IsDemoInManagerList(uint8_t* base, uint32_t manager, uint32_t demo_id) {
  return FindDemoNode(base, manager, demo_id) != 0;
}

uint32_t CheckDemoStatus(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t manager, uint32_t demo_id) {
  PPCContext call_ctx = ctx;
  call_ctx.r1.u32 = ctx.r1.u32 - 128;
  REX_STORE_U32(call_ctx.r1.u32, ctx.r1.u32);
  const uint32_t guest_scratch = call_ctx.r1.u32 + 64;
  REX_STORE_U32(guest_scratch, 0);

  call_ctx.r3.u32 = guest_scratch;
  call_ctx.r4.u32 = manager;
  call_ctx.r5.u32 = demo_id;
  sub_8215B290(call_ctx, base);

  return REX_LOAD_U32(guest_scratch);
}

} // namespace

void UpdateCutsceneHarvest(PPCContext& ctx, uint8_t* base) {
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(majin_harvest_demos)) return;

#if defined(_WIN32)
  static bool s_console_init = false;
  if (!s_console_init) {
    s_console_init = true;
    HANDLE hStd = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
    if (hStd == NULL || hStd == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
      if (AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS)) {
        FILE* fp = nullptr;
        freopen_s(&fp, "CONOUT$", "w", stdout);
        freopen_s(&fp, "CONOUT$", "w", stderr);
      }
    }
  }
#endif

  const uint32_t root = REX_LOAD_U32(kScenarioRootPtr);
  if (!Span(root, kDemoManagerOffset + 4)) return;
  const uint32_t manager = REX_LOAD_U32(root + kDemoManagerOffset);
  if (!Span(manager, 164)) return;

  switch (s_harvest_state) {
    case HarvestState::kUninitialized: {
      std::vector<uint32_t> full_queue = DiscoverDemoQueue();
      if (full_queue.empty()) {
        REXLOG_ERROR("[HARVEST] Nenhuma cutscene encontrada para colheita. Desativando...");
        std::printf("[HARVEST] ERRO: Nenhuma cutscene encontrada para colheita.\n");
        std::fflush(stdout);
        s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kAllFinished;
        return;
      }

      s_total_demos = full_queue.size();
      const int32_t start_idx = std::max(0, REXCVAR_GET(majin_harvest_start));
      const int32_t count = REXCVAR_GET(majin_harvest_count);

      if (static_cast<size_t>(start_idx) < full_queue.size()) {
        const size_t end_idx = (count > 0) ? std::min(full_queue.size(), static_cast<size_t>(start_idx + count)) : full_queue.size();
        s_demo_queue = std::vector<uint32_t>(full_queue.begin() + start_idx, full_queue.begin() + end_idx);
        s_global_offset = static_cast<size_t>(start_idx);
      } else {
        s_demo_queue.clear();
        s_global_offset = static_cast<size_t>(start_idx);
      }

      if (s_demo_queue.empty()) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Fila deste lote esta vazia (inicio {} >= total {}). Finalizando.",
                    start_idx, full_queue.size());
        s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kAllFinished;
        return;
      }

      std::printf("[HARVEST] Lote configurado: %zu demos (offset %zu de %zu totais). Aguardando motor...\n",
                  s_demo_queue.size(), s_global_offset + 1, s_total_demos);
      std::fflush(stdout);
      s_current_index = 0;
      s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kWaitingForEngine;
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kWaitingForEngine: {
      if (++s_warmup_frames < 60) return;

      REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Motor estabilizado (ScenarioRoot=0x{:08X}, DemoManager=0x{:08X})",
                  root, manager);
      REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Iniciando lote de {} cutscenes (offset {}/{})...",
                  s_demo_queue.size(), s_global_offset + 1, s_total_demos);
      std::printf("[HARVEST] Motor estabilizado. Iniciando lote de %zu cutscenes (%zu a %zu de %zu)...\n",
                  s_demo_queue.size(), s_global_offset + 1, s_global_offset + s_demo_queue.size(), s_total_demos);
      std::fflush(stdout);
      s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kMountPackage;
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kMountPackage: {
      if (s_current_index >= s_demo_queue.size()) {
        s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kAllFinished;
        break;
      }

      const uint32_t demo_id = s_demo_queue[s_current_index];
      REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] [{}/{}] Montando demo{:05d}.pak...",
                  s_global_offset + s_current_index + 1, s_total_demos, demo_id);

      PPCContext call_ctx = ctx;
      call_ctx.r3.u32 = manager;
      call_ctx.r4.u32 = demo_id;
      sub_8215B918(call_ctx, base);

      s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kWaitingForMount;
      s_mount_wait_frames = 0;
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kWaitingForMount: {
      s_mount_wait_frames++;
      const uint32_t demo_id = s_demo_queue[s_current_index];
      const uint32_t task_handle = REX_LOAD_U32(manager + 160);
      bool package_ready = false;
      if (task_handle != 0 && Span(task_handle, 64)) {
        const uint32_t status_flags = REX_LOAD_U32(task_handle + 56);
        if ((status_flags & 1) != 0) {
          package_ready = true;
        }
      }

      // Garante ao menos 10 frames de montagem para o novo pacote ser registrado
      if (package_ready && s_mount_wait_frames >= 10) {
        s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kStartDemo;
      } else if (s_mount_wait_frames >= 300) {
        REXLOG_WARN("[HARVEST] Timeout aguardando montagem do pacote demo{:05d}.pak. Pulando...", demo_id);
        std::printf("[HARVEST] Timeout aguardando montagem de demo%05u.pak. Pulando...\n", demo_id);
        std::fflush(stdout);
        s_current_index++;
        s_harvest_state = (s_current_index < s_demo_queue.size()) ? HarvestState::kMountPackage : HarvestState::kAllFinished;
      }
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kStartDemo: {
      const uint32_t demo_id = s_demo_queue[s_current_index];
      PPCContext call_ctx = ctx;
      call_ctx.r3.u32 = manager;
      call_ctx.r4.u32 = demo_id;
      sub_8215A700(call_ctx, base);

      const uint32_t node = FindDemoNode(base, manager, demo_id);
      const uint32_t player = (node != 0) ? REX_LOAD_U32(node + 20) : 0;
#if !defined(MAJIN_EDITION_USA)
      if (player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) {
        PPCContext p_ctx = ctx;
        p_ctx.r3.u32 = player;
        sub_8235A140(p_ctx, base);
      }
#endif

      call_ctx = ctx;
      call_ctx.r3.u32 = manager;
      call_ctx.r4.u32 = demo_id;
      sub_8215AD28(call_ctx, base);

      if (player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) {
        REX_STORE_U32(player + 96, 1);
      }

      REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Reproducao iniciada: demo{:05d}.pak (node=0x{:X}, player=0x{:X})",
                  demo_id, node, player);
      std::printf("[HARVEST] Reproducao iniciada: demo%05u.pak (node=0x%X, player=0x%X)\n",
                  demo_id, node, player);
      std::fflush(stdout);

      s_demo_start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      s_playing_frames = 0;
      s_has_detected_playing = false;
      s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kPlayingDemo;
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kPlayingDemo: {
      const uint32_t demo_id = s_demo_queue[s_current_index];
      s_playing_frames++;

      const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      const double elapsed_sec = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - s_demo_start_time).count();

      const uint32_t active_node = REX_LOAD_U32(manager + 120);
      const uint32_t node = FindDemoNode(base, manager, demo_id);
      const bool in_list = (node != 0);
      const uint32_t player = in_list ? REX_LOAD_U32(node + 20) : 0;
      const uint32_t pstate = (player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) ? REX_LOAD_U32(player + 96) : 0;
      const uint32_t prequest = (player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) ? REX_LOAD_U32(player + 92) : 0;

      float cur_f = 0.0f;
      float end_f = 0.0f;
      static float s_last_cur_f = 0.0f;
      static float s_last_end_f = 0.0f;
      const char* finish_reason = "";

      if (s_playing_frames == 1) {
        s_last_cur_f = 0.0f;
        s_last_end_f = 0.0f;
      }

      if (player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) {
        cur_f = LoadFloat(base, player + 80);
        const uint32_t resource = REX_LOAD_U32(player + 156);
        if (resource != 0 && Span(resource, 104)) {
          end_f = static_cast<float>(static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(resource + 100)));
        }
        if (cur_f > 0.0f) s_last_cur_f = cur_f;
        if (end_f > 0.0f) s_last_end_f = end_f;
      }

      if (pstate == 1 || pstate == 2) {
        s_has_detected_playing = true;
      } else if (s_playing_frames <= 10 && player != 0 && Span(player, 160)) {
        // Assegura que o player permanece no estado de reproducao
        REX_STORE_U32(player + 96, 1);
        s_has_detected_playing = true;
      }

      if (s_playing_frames <= 35 || (s_playing_frames % 60 == 0)) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST DBG] demo{} f{} in_list={} act_node=0x{:X} node=0x{:X} player=0x{:X} pstate={} req={} frames={:.1f}/{:.1f}",
                    demo_id, s_playing_frames, in_list, active_node, node, player, pstate, prequest, cur_f, end_f);
        std::printf("[HARVEST DBG] demo%u f%u in_list=%d act_node=0x%X node=0x%X player=0x%X pstate=%u req=%u frames=%.1f/%.1f\n",
                    demo_id, s_playing_frames, in_list ? 1 : 0, active_node, node, player, pstate, prequest, cur_f, end_f);
        std::fflush(stdout);
      }

      bool demo_finished = false;

      // Completion conditions:
      // 1. Natural end after cutscene was confirmed playing and advanced frames:
      if (s_has_detected_playing && s_last_cur_f > 1.0f) {
        if (active_node == 0) {
          // sub_8215BEC8 liberou o node ativo ao término natural da demo
          demo_finished = true;
          finish_reason = "active_node==0";
        } else if (pstate != 1 && pstate != 2) {
          demo_finished = true;
          finish_reason = "pstate_stopped";
        } else if (!in_list || player == 0) {
          demo_finished = true;
          finish_reason = "unlinked_from_manager";
        } else if (end_f > 0.0f && cur_f >= end_f - 1.0f) {
          demo_finished = true;
          finish_reason = "reached_end_frame";
        }
      }

      // Safety watchdog: max 45s real-time per demo
      if (elapsed_sec >= 45.0) {
        demo_finished = true;
        finish_reason = "watchdog_timeout_45s";
        REXLOG_WARN("[HARVEST] Watchdog acionado: demo{:05d}.pak atingiu 45s de execucao! Avancando...",
                    demo_id);
        std::printf("[HARVEST] Watchdog acionado: demo%05u.pak atingiu 45s de execucao! Avancando...\n",
                    demo_id);
        std::fflush(stdout);
      }

      if (demo_finished) {
        const float report_cur = (cur_f > 0.0f) ? cur_f : s_last_cur_f;
        const float report_end = (end_f > 0.0f) ? end_f : s_last_end_f;
        REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] [{}/{}] demo{:05d}.pak concluido | Tempo: {:.1f}s | Frame final: {:.1f}/{:.1f} ({})",
                    s_global_offset + s_current_index + 1, s_total_demos, demo_id, elapsed_sec, report_cur, report_end, finish_reason);
        std::printf("[HARVEST] [%zu/%zu] demo%05u.pak concluido | Tempo: %.1fs | Frame final: %.1f/%.1f (%s)\n",
                    s_global_offset + s_current_index + 1, s_total_demos, demo_id, elapsed_sec, report_cur, report_end, finish_reason);
        std::fflush(stdout);

        // Flush continuo de shaders para disco
        _flushall();

        s_cooldown_frames = 0;
        s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kDemoCooldown;
      }
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kDemoCooldown: {
      s_cooldown_frames++;
      // Intervalo entre demos para o motor liberar recursos e o storage thread persistir PSOs
      if (s_cooldown_frames >= 30) {
        s_current_index++;
        if (s_current_index < s_demo_queue.size()) {
          s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kMountPackage;
        } else {
          s_harvest_state = HarvestState::kAllFinished;
        }
      }
      break;
    }

    case HarvestState::kAllFinished: {
      static bool s_shutdown_started = false;
      static auto s_shutdown_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      if (!s_shutdown_started) {
        s_shutdown_started = true;
        s_shutdown_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Lote de {} cutscenes concluido com sucesso!", s_demo_queue.size());
        REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Solicitando encerramento limpo da aplicacao para commit dos caches...");
        std::printf("[HARVEST] Lote de %zu cutscenes concluido com sucesso!\n", s_demo_queue.size());
        std::printf("[HARVEST] Solicitando encerramento limpo da aplicacao para commit dos caches...\n");
        std::fflush(stdout);
        _flushall();
        majin::RequestCleanQuit();
      } else {
        const auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - s_shutdown_time).count();
        if (elapsed >= 3) {
          REXLOG_INFO("[HARVEST] Watchdog de finalizacao: chamando exit(0)...");
          std::printf("[HARVEST] Watchdog de finalizacao: chamando exit(0)...\n");
          std::fflush(stdout);
          _flushall();
          std::exit(0);
        }
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}
```

```cpp
// Majistic Recomp - Unified Diagnostic & Save Tracing Hooks
#include "generated/default/majin_pch.h"
#include "edition_offsets.h"
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <atomic>

#define MAJIN_CONCAT_IMPL(a, b) a##b
#define MAJIN_CONCAT(a, b) MAJIN_CONCAT_IMPL(a, b)

#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
#define MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE(address, operation) \
    REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_CONCAT(__imp__sub_, address)); \
    REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_CONCAT(sub_, address)) { \
        static std::atomic<unsigned> calls{0}; \
        const unsigned id = calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed); \
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin save " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] " operation " id={} enter LR={:08X} r3={:08X} r4={:08X} r5={:08X} r6={:08X} r7={:08X} r8={:08X} r9={:08X} r10={:08X}", \
                    id, uint32_t(ctx.lr), ctx.r3.u32, ctx.r4.u32, ctx.r5.u32, \
                    ctx.r6.u32, ctx.r7.u32, ctx.r8.u32, ctx.r9.u32, ctx.r10.u32); \
        MAJIN_CONCAT(__imp__sub_, address)(ctx, base); \
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin save " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] " operation " id={} returned={:08X}", id, ctx.r3.u32); \
    }

MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE(MAJIN_ADDR_CONTENT_CREATE_EX, "ContentCreateEx")
MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE(MAJIN_ADDR_CONTENT_CLOSE, "ContentClose")
MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE(MAJIN_ADDR_CONTENT_SET_THUMBNAIL, "ContentSetThumbnail")
MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE(MAJIN_ADDR_GET_OVERLAPPED_RESULT, "GetOverlappedResult")
#undef MAJIN_TRACE_SAVE
#endif

// WriteFile & GetLastError
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_WRITE_FILE);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_GET_LAST_ERROR);

REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_WRITE_FILE) {
    const uint32_t caller = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
    const uint32_t requested = ctx.r5.u32;
    const uint32_t bytesOut = ctx.r6.u32;
    const uint32_t overlapped = ctx.r7.u32;
    MAJIN_IMP_WRITE_FILE(ctx, base);
    // Caller in save state machine is below 0x821C0000 (LR is 0x821B9DF4 in both editions)
    if (caller == 0x821B9DF4 && ctx.r3.u32 == 0 && overlapped && requested) {
        auto probe = ctx;
        MAJIN_IMP_GET_LAST_ERROR(probe, base);
        const uint32_t status = REX_LOAD_U32(overlapped);
        const uint32_t written = REX_LOAD_U32(overlapped + 4);
        const bool completed = probe.r3.u32 == 997 && status == 0 && written == requested;
#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin save " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] write completion lastError={} status={:08X} bytes={}/{} immediate={}",
                    probe.r3.u32, status, written, requested, completed);
#endif
        if (completed) {
            if (bytesOut) REX_STORE_U32(bytesOut, written);
            ctx.r3.u64 = 1;
        }
    }
}

#if defined(MAJIN_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS)
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_GET_LAST_ERROR) {
    const uint32_t caller = uint32_t(ctx.lr);
    MAJIN_IMP_GET_LAST_ERROR(ctx, base);
    if (caller >= 0x821B9000 && caller < 0x821BB000) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin save " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] GetLastError LR={:08X} result={:08X}", caller, ctx.r3.u32);
    }
}

// Diagnostic trace hooks:
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_A);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_B);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_C);

REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_SAVE_FLOW_A) {
    static std::atomic<unsigned> calls{0};
    const bool trace = calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) < 4;
    if (trace) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin loading " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] flow_a entry LR={:08X} r3={:08X}",
                    uint32_t(ctx.lr), ctx.r3.u32);
    }
    MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_A(ctx, base);
    if (trace) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin loading " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] flow_a returned r3={:08X}", ctx.r3.u32);
    }
}

REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_SAVE_FLOW_B) {
    static std::atomic<unsigned> calls{0};
    if (calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) < 4) {
        const uint32_t table = REX_LOAD_U32(ctx.r3.u32);
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin thread " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] LR={:08X} object={:08X} table={:08X}",
                    uint32_t(ctx.lr), ctx.r3.u32, table);
    }
    MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_B(ctx, base);
}

REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_SAVE_FLOW_C) {
    static std::atomic<unsigned> calls{0};
    const unsigned call = calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (call < 8) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin trace " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] flow_c entry: LR={:08X} r3={:08X} r1={:08X}",
                    uint32_t(ctx.lr), ctx.r3.u32, ctx.r1.u32);
    }
    MAJIN_IMP_SAVE_FLOW_C(ctx, base);
    if (call < 8) {
        REXLOG_INFO("[Majin trace " MAJIN_EDITION_NAME "] flow_c result: r3={:08X}", ctx.r3.u32);
    }
}
#endif
```

`src/draw_distance.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Majistic Recomp - Dynamic Draw Distance Multiplier (Issue #25)

#include "generated/default/majin_pch.h"
#include "edition_offsets.h"

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>
#include <rex/system/kernel_state.h>
#include <rex/system/xmemory.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_DOUBLE(
    majin_draw_distance_scale, 1.0, "Majin",
    "Draw distance multiplier (1.0 = original)")
    .range(0.5, 3.0);

namespace {

inline bool ValidGuestPtr(uint32_t addr) {
  return addr >= 0x10000u && addr < 0xF0000000u;
}

inline double GetClampedDrawDistanceScale() {
  const double scale = REXCVAR_GET(majin_draw_distance_scale);
  if (!std::isfinite(scale)) return 1.0;
  return std::clamp(scale, 0.5, 3.0);
}

// Quadratic curve for instanced vegetation (mapXXX_ins):
//   0.5x -> 0.25x (clearly trims near/mid foliage even on 70m-80m maps like map107)
//   1.0x -> 1.00x (exact vanilla)
//   2.0x -> 4.00x (20m grass in map409 reaches 80m)
//   3.0x -> 9.00x (15m-20m foliage in map407/map409 reaches 135m-180m, eliminating pop-in)
inline double GetFoliageDrawDistanceScale() {
  const double scale = GetClampedDrawDistanceScale();
  return scale * scale;
}

uint32_t LoadU32(uint32_t address) {
  if (!ValidGuestPtr(address)) return 0;
  uint32_t v = 0;
  std::memcpy(&v, REX_KERNEL_MEMORY()->TranslateVirtual<uint8_t*>(address), 4);
  return std::byteswap(v);
}

float LoadF32(uint32_t address) {
  return std::bit_cast<float>(LoadU32(address));
}

void StoreF32(uint32_t address, float value) {
  if (!ValidGuestPtr(address)) return;
  const uint32_t be = std::byteswap(std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(value));
  std::memcpy(REX_KERNEL_MEMORY()->TranslateVirtual<uint8_t*>(address), &be, 4);
}

// Inspects a 608-byte CMaterial descriptor (sub_82340768 / sub_829AC6D0 / sub_829AC7D0):
//   +296 (uint32_t Big-Endian): blend_mode
//     0 = Opaque
//     1 = Alpha-Test Cutout (foliage leaves, grass, bushes)
//     2 = Translucent Alpha-Blend (SRCALPHA / INVSRCALPHA)
//     3 = Alpha-Test Dither / Foliage Fade
//     4 = Additive Blend (SRCALPHA / ONE, BLENDOP_ADD - magic barriers, energy fields, auras)
//     5 = Reverse-Subtract Blend (BLENDOP_REVSUBTRACT - dark corruption barriers/auras)
// Keep modes 2, 4, 5 protected for Issue #25 magic barriers/auras while allowing mode 3
// (Alpha-Test Dither / Foliage Fade) so instanced foliage actually scales its GPU fade.
bool IsTranslucentOrEffectMaterial(uint32_t mat_addr) {
  if (!ValidGuestPtr(mat_addr)) return false;
  const uint32_t blend_mode = LoadU32(mat_addr + 296);
  return blend_mode == 2 || blend_mode == 4 || blend_mode == 5;
}

// Open-world adjacent-zone streaming upgrade state:
// SysKbMap has 4 map slots (stride 10768 at SysKbMap+48). When draw distance > 1.0x,
// KB/data/grid/world neighbor commands requesting L0-only (mask = 2, _1.pak) are promoted
// to FULL+L0 (mask = 3, _0.pak + _1.pak) so distant visible zones display high-detail meshes,
// HD textures, and mapXXX_ins vegetation immediately instead of bare L0 shells.
// Promoted slots are tracked so sub_82379160 binds their FULL mesh and mapXXX_ins visuals
// without prematurely spawning enemies/gimmicks/events (sub_82375B20) or _0.pak triggers
// until the player actually enters a native mask-3 border box.
struct SlotStreamState {
  uint32_t slot_addr = 0;
  int32_t map_id = -1;
  bool promoted_full_only = false;
};

constexpr size_t kMaxMapSlots = 8;
std::mutex g_stream_mutex;
std::array<SlotStreamState, kMaxMapSlots> g_slot_states{};
std::atomic<bool> g_last_stream_upgrade_enabled{false};
thread_local bool g_in_world_box_apply = false;

bool MapSupportsFullUpgrade(int32_t map_id) {
  if (map_id <= 0) return false;
  // map501 and map508 only ship _1.pak (no _0.pak); map601 only ships _0.pak (no _1.pak);
  // map605 is the dynamic castle/boss slot with custom offset/rotation rules.
  if (map_id == 501 || map_id == 508 || map_id == 601 || map_id == 605) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

void SetSlotPromotedState(uint32_t slot_addr, int32_t map_id, bool promoted) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_stream_mutex);
  SlotStreamState* free_entry = nullptr;
  for (auto& entry : g_slot_states) {
    if (entry.slot_addr == slot_addr) {
      entry.map_id = map_id;
      entry.promoted_full_only = promoted;
      return;
    }
    if (entry.slot_addr == 0 && !free_entry) {
      free_entry = &entry;
    }
  }
  if (free_entry) {
    free_entry->slot_addr = slot_addr;
    free_entry->map_id = map_id;
    free_entry->promoted_full_only = promoted;
  }
}

bool IsSlotPromotedFullOnly(uint32_t slot_addr, int32_t map_id) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_stream_mutex);
  for (const auto& entry : g_slot_states) {
    if (entry.slot_addr == slot_addr) {
      return entry.promoted_full_only && entry.map_id == map_id;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

}  // namespace

// Character & Gimmick CPU distance culling thresholds in sub_8233DE98 (PAL) / sub_8233DE28 (USA)
// (model+644 == 0: 636(r31) per-object and 120(r11) global 60m threshold)
void Majin_DrawDistanceScale(PPCRegister& f) {
  const double scale = GetClampedDrawDistanceScale();
  if (scale != 1.0 && std::isfinite(f.f64) && f.f64 > 0.0) {
    // Round back to IEEE-754 single precision to match the game's native lfs/fcmpu math.
    f.f64 = double(float(f.f64 * scale));
  }
}

// Instanced vegetation (mapXXX_ins, model+644 != 0) CPU distance culling in sub_8233DE98 / sub_8233DE28
// Uses the same quadratic scale curve as Majin_FoliageFadeScale so CPU cull and GPU fade stay synced.
void Majin_InstanceDrawDistanceScale(PPCRegister& f) {
  const double scale = GetFoliageDrawDistanceScale();
  if (scale != 1.0 && std::isfinite(f.f64) && f.f64 > 0.0) {
    f.f64 = double(float(f.f64 * scale));
  }
}

// Foliage / Bush / Grass GPU shader fade-out threshold (636(r28) -> constant 3164(r25)) in sub_8218B600
void Majin_FoliageFadeScale(PPCRegister& f, PPCRegister& mat, PPCRegister& model) {
  const double scale = GetFoliageDrawDistanceScale();
  if (scale != 1.0 && std::isfinite(f.f64) && f.f64 > 0.0) {
    // Skip translucent/additive/subtractive materials and forced-translucent models (+544)
    // so near-camera proximity fade on barriers/auras is never scaled.
    if (IsTranslucentOrEffectMaterial(mat.u32) ||
        (ValidGuestPtr(model.u32) && LoadU32(model.u32 + 544) != 0)) {
      return;
    }
    f.f64 = double(float(f.f64 * scale));
  }
}

// Instanced vegetation with isCullByDistance == 0 (628(r28) == 0, e.g. 114/177 plants in map107
// and 126/239 in map111) hits loc_8218B910 in sub_8218B600, uploading infinite clip values.
// When scale < 1.0x, apply a smooth GPU shader fade using a 70m virtual base distance (matching
// the culled plants in map107/map111 -> 17.5m at 0.5x) while leaving >= 1.0x untouched.
void Majin_FoliageCullOffFade(PPCRegister& ins_clip_vec,
                              PPCRegister& mat,
                              PPCRegister& model,
                              PPCRegister& render_cfg) {
  const double raw_scale = GetClampedDrawDistanceScale();
  if (raw_scale >= 1.0) return;
  if (!ValidGuestPtr(ins_clip_vec.u32) || !ValidGuestPtr(render_cfg.u32)) return;
  if (IsTranslucentOrEffectMaterial(mat.u32) ||
      (ValidGuestPtr(model.u32) && LoadU32(model.u32 + 544) != 0)) {
    return;
  }

  const float fade_start_mul = LoadF32(render_cfg.u32 + 492);
  const float fade_end_mul = LoadF32(render_cfg.u32 + 1252);
  if (!std::isfinite(fade_start_mul) || !std::isfinite(fade_end_mul) ||
      fade_start_mul <= 0.0f || fade_end_mul <= 0.0f) {
    return;
  }

  constexpr double kVirtualCullOffBaseDist = 7000.0;
  const double dist = kVirtualCullOffBaseDist * (raw_scale * raw_scale);
  StoreF32(ins_clip_vec.u32 + 0, static_cast<float>(dist * fade_start_mul));
  StoreF32(ins_clip_vec.u32 + 4, static_cast<float>(dist * fade_end_mul));
}

// Per-zone lod%03d model swapper: sub_822517D0 (PAL) / sub_82251760 (USA)
// TaskMap+2780 holds the lod%03d OBB state evaluated in sub_8237A3D0/sub_8237A440:
//   0 = Full map (+880) with fallback to L0 (+884)
//   1 = Force low-poly L0 (+884)
//   2 = Force NULL (completely hide the loaded zone)
// When draw distance > 1.0x, temporarily override non-zero states to 0 so loaded adjacent
// zones are never hidden or trapped in L0 until the player is right on top of them.
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_TASKMAP_UPDATE_LOD);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_TASKMAP_UPDATE_LOD) {
  const double scale = GetClampedDrawDistanceScale();
  const uint32_t task_map = ctx.r4.u32;
  if (scale > 1.0 && ValidGuestPtr(task_map)) {
    const uint32_t orig_lod_state = REX_LOAD_U32(task_map + 2780);
    if (orig_lod_state != 0u) {
      REX_STORE_U32(task_map + 2780, 0u);
      MAJIN_IMP_TASKMAP_UPDATE_LOD(ctx, base);
      REX_STORE_U32(task_map + 2780, orig_lod_state);
      return;
    }
  }
  MAJIN_IMP_TASKMAP_UPDATE_LOD(ctx, base);
}

// Per-frame World Grid PVS update: sub_82175700 (identical in PAL and USA)
// Called from sub_821720B0 every frame with r3 = SysKbMap*.
// 1. Sets SysKbMap+47296 = 1 when scale > 1.0x to bypass the 100m cell PVS.
// 2. When scale crosses 1.0x live, clears SysKbMap+43144 (last active WorldBox*) so
//    sub_821720B0 immediately re-runs sub_82173FF8 on this frame without needing to move.
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_WORLD_PVS_UPDATE);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_WORLD_PVS_UPDATE) {
  const uint32_t sys_map = ctx.r3.u32;
  MAJIN_IMP_WORLD_PVS_UPDATE(ctx, base);
  if (ValidGuestPtr(sys_map)) {
    const bool want_upgrade = (GetClampedDrawDistanceScale() > 1.0);
    if (want_upgrade) {
      REX_STORE_U32(sys_map + 47296, 1u);
    }
    const bool prev_upgrade =
        g_last_stream_upgrade_enabled.exchange(want_upgrade, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (prev_upgrade != want_upgrade && REX_LOAD_U32(sys_map + 43144) != 0u) {
      REX_STORE_U32(sys_map + 43144, 0u);
    }
  }
}

// World streaming box applier: sub_82173FF8 (identical in PAL and USA)
// Scopes g_in_world_box_apply so MapSlot unload/load promotion only applies to world-grid
// box updates (never manual shutdown/teardown calls).
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_WORLD_BOX_APPLY);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_WORLD_BOX_APPLY) {
  g_last_stream_upgrade_enabled.store(GetClampedDrawDistanceScale() > 1.0,
                                      std::memory_order_relaxed);
  const bool prev_in_apply = g_in_world_box_apply;
  g_in_world_box_apply = true;
  MAJIN_IMP_WORLD_BOX_APPLY(ctx, base);
  g_in_world_box_apply = prev_in_apply;
}

// MapSlot pack unload: sub_82378A78 (PAL) / sub_82378A08 (USA)
// Called from sub_82173FF8 with r3 = MapSlot*, r4 = ~(immediateMask | asyncMask).
// Records whether each slot natively requested FULL (_0.pak, bit 0) vs L0-only (_1.pak, bit 1),
// and preserves bit 0 when promoting an eligible L0-only neighbor at scale > 1.0x.
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_UNLOAD);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_MAPSLOT_UNLOAD) {
  const uint32_t slot = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (g_in_world_box_apply && ValidGuestPtr(slot)) {
    const int32_t map_id = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(slot + 1564));
    const uint32_t unload_mask = ctx.r4.u32;
    const uint32_t native_mask = ~unload_mask;
    const bool native_has_full = (native_mask & 1u) != 0u;
    const bool native_has_l0 = (native_mask & 2u) != 0u;
    const bool promote = (GetClampedDrawDistanceScale() > 1.0) &&
                         !native_has_full && native_has_l0 &&
                         MapSupportsFullUpgrade(map_id);
    SetSlotPromotedState(slot, map_id, promote);
    if (promote) {
      ctx.r4.u64 = static_cast<uint64_t>(unload_mask & ~1u);
    }
  } else if (ValidGuestPtr(slot)) {
    SetSlotPromotedState(slot, -1, false);
  }
  MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_UNLOAD(ctx, base);
}

// MapSlot pack load: sub_823788C0 (PAL) / sub_82378850 (USA)
// Called from sub_82173FF8 with r3 = MapSlot*, r4 = load_mask, r5 = is_async_streaming.
// When a neighbor slot was marked promoted_full_only, upgrade mask 2 -> 3 to stream _0.pak
// (FULL mesh + HD textures + mapXXX_ins vegetation).
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_LOAD);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_MAPSLOT_LOAD) {
  const uint32_t slot = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (g_in_world_box_apply && ValidGuestPtr(slot)) {
    const int32_t map_id = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(slot + 1564));
    const uint32_t load_mask = ctx.r4.u32;
    if ((load_mask & 2u) != 0u && (load_mask & 1u) == 0u &&
        IsSlotPromotedFullOnly(slot, map_id)) {
      ctx.r4.u64 = static_cast<uint64_t>(load_mask | 1u);
    }
  }
  MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_LOAD(ctx, base);
}

// MapSlot per-frame resource binder: sub_82379160 (PAL) / sub_823790F0 (USA)
// In sub_82379160, all visual resources (FULL mesh r4=10, L0 mesh r4=11, mapXXX_ins r4=17)
// bind via sub_8237AA30 without reading MapSlot+10536. Only two gameplay blocks read +10536 == 3:
//   1. loc_82379528: placer/enemy/gimmick/event spawn (sub_82375B20) / despawn (sub_82375F28)
//   2. loc_82379620: _0.pak sound/battle/event script activation (sub_8237B9E8)
// For promoted visual-only neighbor slots, temporarily mask +10536 (3 -> 1) across this call
// so FULL geometry and vegetation display at distance while enemies/events stay strictly vanilla.
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_APPLY_RES);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_MAPSLOT_APPLY_RES) {
  const uint32_t slot = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (ValidGuestPtr(slot)) {
    const int32_t map_id = static_cast<int32_t>(REX_LOAD_U32(slot + 1564));
    if (map_id != 605 && IsSlotPromotedFullOnly(slot, map_id)) {
      const uint32_t orig_state = REX_LOAD_U32(slot + 10536);
      if (orig_state == 3u) {
        REX_STORE_U32(slot + 10536, 1u);
        MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_APPLY_RES(ctx, base);
        REX_STORE_U32(slot + 10536, orig_state);
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  MAJIN_IMP_MAPSLOT_APPLY_RES(ctx, base);
}

// Shadow cascade split update: sub_8218DD60 (identical in PAL and USA)
// Scales gameplay shadow far (env+3484, default 4000.0 = 40m) smoothly across [0.5x..2.0x]
// (20m..80m) while leaving cutscene demoShadowFar (env+3476, 15m) untouched.
// For shadow_scale > 1.0, gently increases PSSM lambda (env+3972, default 0.50 -> up to 0.65)
// so cascade 0 stays sharp near the player while cascade 2 reaches further.
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_IMP_SHADOW_CASCADE_UPDATE);
REX_EXTERN(MAJIN_FN_SHADOW_CASCADE_UPDATE) {
  const double scale = GetClampedDrawDistanceScale();
  const uint32_t env = ctx.r3.u32;
  if (scale != 1.0 && ValidGuestPtr(env)) {
    const uint32_t orig_far_bits = REX_LOAD_U32(env + 3484);
    const float orig_far = std::bit_cast<float>(orig_far_bits);
    if (std::isfinite(orig_far) && orig_far > 0.0f) {
      const double shadow_scale =
          (scale < 1.0) ? scale : (1.0 + (scale - 1.0) * 0.5);
      const float scaled_far = static_cast<float>(static_cast<double>(orig_far) * shadow_scale);
      REX_STORE_U32(env + 3484, std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(scaled_far));

      uint32_t orig_lambda_bits = 0;
      bool modified_lambda = false;
      if (shadow_scale > 1.0) {
        orig_lambda_bits = REX_LOAD_U32(env + 3972);
        const float orig_lambda = std::bit_cast<float>(orig_lambda_bits);
        if (std::isfinite(orig_lambda) && orig_lambda >= 0.0f && orig_lambda < 0.80f) {
          const float boosted_lambda = static_cast<float>(
              std::min(0.80, static_cast<double>(orig_lambda) + 0.15 * (shadow_scale - 1.0)));
          REX_STORE_U32(env + 3972, std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(boosted_lambda));
          modified_lambda = true;
        }
      }

      MAJIN_IMP_SHADOW_CASCADE_UPDATE(ctx, base);

      REX_STORE_U32(env + 3484, orig_far_bits);
      if (modified_lambda) {
        REX_STORE_U32(env + 3972, orig_lambda_bits);
      }
      return;
    }
  }
  MAJIN_IMP_SHADOW_CASCADE_UPDATE(ctx, base);
}
```

`src/equivalent_counter.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
namespace majin::timing {
// Feed original-rate frame equivalents into an existing incrementing counter.
// A reset by original input/state code is recognized on the next observation.
class EquivalentCounter {
 public:
  uint32_t BeforeIncrement(uint32_t observed, double original_ticks) {
    if (!active_ || observed != expected_) { value_ = observed; active_ = true; }
    if (std::isfinite(original_ticks) && original_ticks >= 0 && original_ticks <= 8)
      value_ += original_ticks;
    expected_ = uint32_t(std::fmin(1000000.0,
        std::fmax(1.0, std::floor(value_ + 1e-7))));
    return expected_ - 1;  // Original code adds one; never underflow unsigned.
  }
  void Reset() { active_ = false; value_ = 0; expected_ = 0; }
 private:
  bool active_ = false;
  double value_ = 0;
  uint32_t expected_ = 0;
};
}
```

`src/frame_timer.cpp`:

```cpp
// Majistic Recomp - hook on the engine's frame timer (sub_82162238)
// Adapted from ArthurMS15/MajinRecomp
//
// The timer measures the real time since the last frame, scales it, clamps it
// to 0.1 s and stores it at +0x150F4 (dt in seconds) and dt * rate at +0x150F8
// (the rate at +0x15104, frames of reference). The hook runs at 0x82162360,
// just before the store, with the dt in f0.
//
// The character gets stuck on small edges and holes when frames are short or
// uneven (above ~80 fps, or at 60 with frame generation, whose proxy swap
// chain makes the frame times jitter). --majin_dt_smooth replaces the measured
// dt with a smoothed one: steps are even, and the difference is carried over so
// that game time still follows real time. --majin_log_dt logs the dt spread
// once per second.

#include "frame_timer.h"

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(majin_dt_smooth, false, "Majin",
                    "Even out the game's frame time steps (keeps game time in step with real time)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(majin_log_dt, false, "Majin",
                    "Log the game's frame time (dt) spread once per second (diagnostics)");

namespace {

// Read by animation hooks, which may run on other threads.
std::atomic<float> game_dt{0.0f};

// Only touched by the game's main thread, which runs the timer.
double smoothed = 0.0;  // average step, seconds
double carry = 0.0;     // real time not yet handed to the game, seconds

struct Stats {
  int64_t second = 0;
  uint32_t frames = 0;
  double min_in = 1.0, max_in = 0.0, min_out = 1.0, max_out = 0.0, sum_in = 0.0;
} stats;

void LogStats(double in, double out) {
  const int64_t now = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(
                          std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                          .count();
  if (now != stats.second) {
    if (stats.frames) {
      REXLOG_INFO("majin dt: {} frames, real {:.2f}..{:.2f} ms (avg {:.2f}), game {:.2f}..{:.2f} ms",
                  stats.frames, stats.min_in * 1e3, stats.max_in * 1e3,
                  stats.sum_in * 1e3 / stats.frames, stats.min_out * 1e3, stats.max_out * 1e3);
    }
    stats = Stats{};
    stats.second = now;
  }
  ++stats.frames;
  stats.sum_in += in;
  stats.min_in = std::min(stats.min_in, in);
  stats.max_in = std::max(stats.max_in, in);
  stats.min_out = std::min(stats.min_out, out);
  stats.max_out = std::max(stats.max_out, out);
}

double Smooth(double dt) {
  // Loading screens (dt clamped to 0.1 s) and the first frame (dt 0): no
  // smoothing, start over. A single long frame is not a reason: with frame
  // generation a 50 ms frame is followed by a 0.5 ms one, and that pair is
  // exactly what has to be spread out.
  if (dt <= 0.0 || dt >= 0.1 || smoothed <= 0.0) {
    smoothed = dt > 0.0 && dt < 0.1 ? dt : 0.0;
    carry = 0.0;
    return dt;
  }
  // Slow average: follows frame rate changes within a fraction of a second,
  // ignores frame-to-frame jitter.
  smoothed += (dt - smoothed) * 0.05;
  carry += dt;
  // Hand out the average step plus a small share of the backlog, so the
  // backlog never grows and game time stays within a few ms of real time.
  double step = smoothed + (carry - smoothed) * 0.1;
  step = std::clamp(step, smoothed * 0.75, smoothed * 1.25);
  // Fell far behind (a sudden drop in frame rate): catch up at once.
  if (carry - step > 0.05) step = carry;
  // May run ahead of real time by a few steps (up to 0.1 s), repaid by the
  // next steps: short frames come in bursts (a few 2-3 ms frames at 30 fps
  // with frame generation), and each would otherwise get a short step.
  step = std::min(step, carry + std::min(smoothed * 3.0, 0.1));
  carry -= step;
  return step;
}

}  // namespace

void Majin_FrameDt(PPCRegister& f0) {
  const double in = f0.f64;
  double out = in;
  if (REXCVAR_GET(majin_dt_smooth)) {
    out = Smooth(in);
    // The game reads it back as a single.
    f0.f64 = double(float(out));
  }
  if (REXCVAR_GET(majin_log_dt)) {
    LogStats(in, out);
  }
  game_dt.store(float(f0.f64), std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

float majin::GameFrameTime() {
  return game_dt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
```

```cpp
void PushFontSafe(ImFont* font) {
  if (font) {
    ImGui::PushFont(font);
  }

void PopFontSafe(ImFont* font) {
  if (font) {
    ImGui::PopFont();

std::filesystem::path FindLauncherConfigPath() {
  const std::vector<std::filesystem::path> candidates = {
      "private/launcher-usa.json",
      "../private/launcher-usa.json",
      "../../private/launcher-usa.json",
  };
  for (const auto& path : candidates) {
    if (std::filesystem::exists(path)) {
      return std::filesystem::absolute(path);
    }
  }
  return {};
}

void ReplaceJsonField(std::string& json, const std::string& key, const std::string& new_val) {
  const std::string pattern = "\"" + key + "\":";
  size_t pos = json.find(pattern);
  if (pos == std::string::npos) {
    // Insert missing keys before the closing brace so older launcher configs upgrade cleanly.
    size_t close_brace = json.rfind('}');
    if (close_brace == std::string::npos) return;
    size_t last_non_ws = json.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n", close_brace - 1);
    const bool needs_comma = (last_non_ws != std::string::npos && json[last_non_ws] != '{' && json[last_non_ws] != ',');
    const std::string entry = (needs_comma ? ",\n  " : "\n  ") + pattern + " " + new_val + "\n";
    json.insert(last_non_ws != std::string::npos ? last_non_ws + 1 : close_brace, entry);
    return;
  }
  size_t val_start = json.find_first_not_of(" \t", pos + pattern.size());
  if (val_start == std::string::npos) return;
  size_t val_end = json.find_first_of(",\r\n}", val_start);
  if (val_end == std::string::npos) val_end = json.size();
  json.replace(val_start, val_end - val_start, new_val);
}

void DrawPillBadge(const char* label, const ImVec4& bg, const ImVec4& border, const ImVec4& text_col) {
  const auto& fonts = GetUiFonts();
  PushFontSafe(fonts.caption);
  const ImVec2 text_sz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label);
  const ImVec2 pad(8.0f, 2.5f);
  const ImVec2 box_sz(text_sz.x + pad.x * 2.0f, text_sz.y + pad.y * 2.0f);
  const ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  ImGui::Dummy(box_sz);

  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  const ImVec2 p_max(pos.x + box_sz.x, pos.y + box_sz.y);
  dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(bg), 6.0f);
  dl->AddRect(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(border), 6.0f, 0, 1.0f);
  dl->AddText(ImVec2(pos.x + pad.x, pos.y + pad.y), ImGui::GetColorU32(text_col), label);
  PopFontSafe(fonts.caption);
}

bool BeginCard(const char* id, const char* title, const char* icon = nullptr) {
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, kColDarkCard);
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, kColDarkBorder);
  ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildRounding, 10.0f);
  ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(16.0f, 14.0f));

  const ImGuiChildFlags flags =
      ImGuiChildFlags_Borders | ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY | ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding;
  const bool open = ImGui::BeginChild(id, ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), flags, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
  if (open && title && title[0] != '\0') {
    const auto& fonts = GetUiFonts();
    PushFontSafe(fonts.semibold);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, kColSkyAccent);
    if (icon && icon[0] != '\0') {
      ImGui::Text("%s  %s", icon, title);
    } else {
      ImGui::TextUnformatted(title);
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    PopFontSafe(fonts.semibold);

    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Separator, ImVec4(0.196f, 0.220f, 0.290f, 0.65f));
    ImGui::Separator();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0.0f, 4.0f));
  }
  return open;
}

void EndCard() {
  ImGui::EndChild();
  ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
  ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
  ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0.0f, 6.0f));
}

bool DrawSidebarItem(const char* id, const char* icon, const char* label, bool active) {
  const auto& fonts = GetUiFonts();
  PushFontSafe(fonts.semibold);

  const float width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
  const float height = 42.0f;
  const ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  const bool pressed = ImGui::InvisibleButton(id, ImVec2(width, height));
  const bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();

  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  const ImVec2 p_max(pos.x + width, pos.y + height);

  if (active) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(kColMajinTintBg), 10.0f);
    dl->AddRect(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(kColMajinTintBdr), 10.0f, 0, 1.0f);
    // Crisp left accent bar matching launcher active state
    dl->AddRectFilled(
        ImVec2(pos.x + 2.0f, pos.y + 9.0f),
        ImVec2(pos.x + 5.0f, p_max.y - 9.0f),
        ImGui::GetColorU32(kColMajinGreen),
        2.0f);
  } else if (hovered) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.137f, 0.153f, 0.204f, 0.78f)), 10.0f);
  }

  const ImVec4 content_col =
      active ? kColMajinLight : (hovered ? kColTextPrimary : kColTextMuted);
  const ImU32 col_u32 = ImGui::GetColorU32(content_col);

  const ImVec2 icon_sz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(icon);
  const ImVec2 label_sz = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label);
  const float icon_y = pos.y + (height - icon_sz.y) * 0.5f;
  const float label_y = pos.y + (height - label_sz.y) * 0.5f;

  dl->AddText(ImVec2(pos.x + 14.0f, icon_y), col_u32, icon);
  dl->AddText(ImVec2(pos.x + 42.0f, label_y), col_u32, label);

  PopFontSafe(fonts.semibold);
  return pressed;
}

std::string UpperAscii(std::string s) {
  for (char& ch : s) {
    ch = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
  }
  return s;
}

int32_t GetEffectiveFpsLimit() {
  if (!rex::cvar::GetFlagByName("majin_fps_limit").empty()) {
    const int32_t limit = rex::cvar::Query<int32_t>("majin_fps_limit");
    if (limit >= 0) return limit;
  }
  return rex::cvar::Query<bool>("majin_60fps") ? 60 : 30;
}

void ApplyLiveFpsLimit(int32_t fps_limit) {
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_fps_limit", std::to_string(fps_limit));
  rex::cvar::SetFlagByName("majin_60fps", (fps_limit == 0 || fps_limit > 30) ? "true" : "false");
}

// Persisted across menu open/close during a play session.
// Opens fullscreen by default; switching to windowed mode remembers position & size.
struct OverlayWindowState {
  bool is_fullscreen = true;
  bool has_windowed_rect = false;
  ImVec2 windowed_pos = ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
  ImVec2 windowed_size = ImVec2(880.0f, 640.0f);
};

OverlayWindowState g_overlay_state;

void ClampWindowedRect(const ImVec2& vp_pos, const ImVec2& vp_size) {
  const float min_w = std::min(720.0f, std::max(320.0f, vp_size.x - 24.0f));
  const float min_h = std::min(480.0f, std::max(280.0f, vp_size.y - 24.0f));
  const float max_w = std::max(min_w, vp_size.x - 16.0f);
  const float max_h = std::max(min_h, vp_size.y - 16.0f);

  g_overlay_state.windowed_size.x = std::clamp(g_overlay_state.windowed_size.x, min_w, max_w);
  g_overlay_state.windowed_size.y = std::clamp(g_overlay_state.windowed_size.y, min_h, max_h);

  const float min_x = vp_pos.x - g_overlay_state.windowed_size.x + 120.0f;
  const float max_x = vp_pos.x + vp_size.x - 120.0f;
  const float min_y = vp_pos.y;
  const float max_y = vp_pos.y + vp_size.y - 56.0f;

  g_overlay_state.windowed_pos.x = std::clamp(g_overlay_state.windowed_pos.x, min_x, std::max(min_x, max_x));
  g_overlay_state.windowed_pos.y = std::clamp(g_overlay_state.windowed_pos.y, min_y, std::max(min_y, max_y));
}

void InitDefaultWindowedRect(const ImVec2& vp_pos, const ImVec2& vp_size) {
  const float def_w = std::clamp(vp_size.x * 0.72f, 720.0f, 960.0f);
  const float def_h = std::clamp(vp_size.y * 0.78f, 480.0f, 680.0f);
  g_overlay_state.windowed_size = ImVec2(def_w, def_h);
  g_overlay_state.windowed_pos = ImVec2(
      vp_pos.x + (vp_size.x - def_w) * 0.5f,
      vp_pos.y + (vp_size.y - def_h) * 0.5f);
  ClampWindowedRect(vp_pos, vp_size);
  g_overlay_state.has_windowed_rect = true;
}

bool DrawWindowModeButton(const char* id, float size, bool is_fullscreen, bool* out_hovered) {
  const ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  const bool pressed = ImGui::InvisibleButton(id, ImVec2(size, size));
  const bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
  const bool active = ImGui::IsItemActive();
  if (out_hovered) *out_hovered = hovered;

  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  const ImVec2 p_max(pos.x + size, pos.y + size);

  if (active) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.240f, 0.270f, 0.350f, 1.00f)), 7.0f);
  } else if (hovered) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.196f, 0.220f, 0.290f, 0.90f)), 7.0f);
  }

  const ImU32 icon_col = ImGui::GetColorU32(
      hovered ? kColTextPrimary : ImVec4(0.760f, 0.800f, 0.860f, 1.00f));
  const float cx = pos.x + size * 0.5f;
  const float cy = pos.y + size * 0.5f;

  if (is_fullscreen) {
    // Restore Down (Windowed Mode) icon: overlapping front + back squares
    const ImVec2 front_min(cx - 5.0f, cy - 2.0f);
    const ImVec2 front_max(cx + 3.0f, cy + 6.0f);
    dl->AddRect(front_min, front_max, icon_col, 1.5f, 0, 1.5f);

    // Back square top & right edges peeking behind the front square
    dl->PathClear();
    dl->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx - 2.0f, cy - 2.5f));
    dl->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx - 2.0f, cy - 5.0f));
    dl->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx + 5.5f, cy - 5.0f));
    dl->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx + 5.5f, cy + 2.5f));
    dl->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx + 3.0f, cy + 2.5f));
    dl->PathStroke(icon_col, 0, 1.5f);
  } else {
    // Maximize (Fullscreen Mode) icon: crisp rounded square
    dl->AddRect(ImVec2(cx - 5.0f, cy - 5.0f), ImVec2(cx + 5.0f, cy + 5.0f),
                icon_col, 1.5f, 0, 1.5f);
  }

  if (hovered) {
    ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", is_fullscreen
                                ? "Windowed Mode (drag to inspect live changes)"
                                : "Fullscreen Mode");
  }
  return pressed;
}

bool DrawCloseButton(const char* id, float size, bool* out_hovered) {
  const ImVec2 pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  const bool pressed = ImGui::InvisibleButton(id, ImVec2(size, size));
  const bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
  const bool active = ImGui::IsItemActive();
  if (out_hovered) *out_hovered = hovered;

  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  const ImVec2 p_max(pos.x + size, pos.y + size);

  if (active) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(kColRoseBtn), 7.0f);
  } else if (hovered) {
    dl->AddRectFilled(pos, p_max, ImGui::GetColorU32(kColRoseBtnHov), 7.0f);
  }

  const ImU32 icon_col = ImGui::GetColorU32(
      hovered ? kColTextPrimary : ImVec4(0.760f, 0.800f, 0.860f, 1.00f));
  const float cx = pos.x + size * 0.5f;
  const float cy = pos.y + size * 0.5f;
  constexpr float kHalf = 4.5f;
  dl->AddLine(ImVec2(cx - kHalf, cy - kHalf), ImVec2(cx + kHalf, cy + kHalf), icon_col, 1.75f);
  dl->AddLine(ImVec2(cx + kHalf, cy - kHalf), ImVec2(cx - kHalf, cy + kHalf), icon_col, 1.75f);

  if (hovered) {
    ImGui::SetTooltip("Close Menu (F1 / ESC)");
  }
  return pressed;
}
```
